text: Really abysmal game. Installed this to earn currency in a different game I play. I'm not even at level 100 and need to get to about level 3500 to earn my reward. The game becomes hard and doesn't give you enough moves to win the levels without powerups you have to pay for, which was the EXACT same reason I stopped playing Candy Crush years ago. Progressing is IMPOSSIBLE without waiting hours to recharge lives or "energy". Don't waste your time on this game, and play something else.

Pay to win if you want to actually enjoy the game. If the game doesn't want you to complete a level, there is nothing you can do other than waste you 5 lives attempting to do it. When you do complete a level you will be rewarded with 15-30 coins. If you are struggling on a level you can 'pay' for extra moves which costs 900 coins. So you essentially burn through your 5 lives and make maybe 120-150 coins and then are stuck while your lives refresh at 30 mins per life to try and fail again.

Good game, but now you have to pay to progress. I'm over level 7000, but I've noticed that when using bonuses, it intentionally doesn't go to where it should when you have one move remaining, trying to get you to buy 900 coins every time. Stop with the Greed! I've spent about £70 in a month, which I think encourages them to keep making me pay.

I've played this game for years now, and used to love it, even spending money on the game passes etc. However, I am no longer seeing the side games (in nearly a month) so I am assuming that my chromebook which is not new but works well, isn't receiving game updates. There is no way I am replacing it for one game, so I fear my time in Homescapes is coming to an end. I don't want to play only "part" of a game, and I suspect Playrix will lose other players/customers by not supporting older devices.

Too harsh. Some levels are easy to complete, but some others are really advanced and you only get 5 or 6 tries to clear the board!! unlike other similar games, they give a few more tries to complete otherwise it's almost impossible. Not enough, and how on earth are you meant to clear a board on a flimsy 6 tries? Absolutely not fair and way too harsh to get to the next level. Not sure if I want to keep on going with this game as it's getting ridiculous and off putting 👎

I've been playing this game for years, but now that I am at the end of it and they come up with new levels every week while waiting for the new levels you enter a tournament, there comes the problem, you play hundreds of levels and you don't get any stars, it's so bad , they keep updating the game but don't change that, it is bad, those stars you can't buy them or anything like that, you get them by playing but in this case playing is useless.

I have played this for years, reached high levels and enjoyed it, but the game has changed. I am one of a really helpful friendly supportive Team until today. The game will no longer let you chat to other members of the team. didn't even get a warning. we can no longer ask for others to exchange cards etc so you are part of a team but feel you are playing alone. I feel many will abandon the game because of this move, I will be. I feel that many

I used to like this game, however, the creators have taken away the ability to chat to other players in the same team, the levels feels like i have played them before, they have taken away some of the features, i.e: the double airplane option and it feels extremely frustrating finishing some of the levels, even the easy ones.

Loved this game and have been playing it for years, on level 20158 and am no longer getting the Expeditions, it notified me on the last two expeditions, hit continue and nothing appears, have switched tablet off, I have plenty storage, considering uninstalling. I also play Gardenscapes and have had no issues getting the expeditions on that game.

After playing this game for years (lvl 20141) almost every level now is hard or super hard and it is taking the fun out of the game, it also makes it nearly impossible to win any of the challenges that take place without spending gold or using all the boosters you have. The 900 gold to continue trying to finish is level is excessive as well, especially when the average you can win on a level is around 20! So you have to win around 45 levels to get enough gold for 5 extra tries on a level.

I like the game. I like redoing the house and garden, however I wish they had maybe 5 different game options for earning stars, energy, and coins, that way when you get stuck or frustrated with one you can earn power ups and stuff from the other games. you could also have different levels, such as relaxed mode, where there are no limited number of moves. And challenge mode, which would be like it is now.

It's a good time killer game. It's really unfortunate that once you make it to other spots on the map that the element of choosing decorations severely decreases. It goes from choosing 90% of decorations to choosing 5% of decorations once you leave the main house area. Isn't being able to decorate the entire idea of playing the match 3 game? I've been playing a long time and now I just don't want to because what's the point now?!

This has become the most frustrating game to play; unlimited life opportunities are few and far between and when you do get them it continues to delete lives. The adventure has completely disapeared,the only way to get through the harder games is to pay either with coins or hard cash. Games should be of course challenging but also fun.

The ads for this game are, of course, 100% misrepresentation. You don't get to pick each puzzle level or choose items to help a mother, child & baby rebuild their life, etc. It's a basic matching puzzle game, with a predetermined backstory about a butler and his family & friends rehab various abandoned buildings & yards. Very occasionally, you get to choose one of three chairs, rugs, wallpaper, or whatever. If you're OK with that, go ahead and install it.

Horrible, greedy, no fun, pay to play game. This game is ridiculous. You can't win the super hard levels, which are about every third game, unless you buy coins or collect them to buy more moves. If you like playing a level 50 plus times without winning then this is the game for you. Being forced to buy coins and boosters every 3 games pretty much guarantees I won't so they are actually shooting themselves in the foot.

Fun game and very entertaining. I am not a big fan, however, of the game's algorithm. Tailoring how pieces fall out on certain levels that puts players in a box to lose lives and/or use power ups is annoying. After losing a level multiple times, especially when on a free infinite lives gift, spending some power ups magically works in the players favor to finish the level. I understand that making everyone a winner isn't a game, but frustrations like I'm experiencing make me not want to play.

Playing this game again after almost three years away from it and my word...it's become soulless. All the little animations and the quirks that made it fun even while the player was waiting for the lives to load have been removed. It's very flat and literally everything constantly needs an update. Don't get me started on the constant reminder that you want us to pay money. Also, the new coin system is preposterous. 10 coins?! From 50 coins?! Even the smallest task requires about 3 stars!!

Had this game for years on two different accounts. Was pretty good at first as a standard play and decorate game. Everytime I open this app now, I'm bombarded with like 10 different events and a new same storyline that goes nowhere that I don't care for. Other than that the levels itself are fine. Some are pretty hard and occasionally require power ups but they aren't that hard to get. Overall, pretty solid but could go without the expeditions I doubt anyone cares for.

While I enjoy a challenging game, this one has become ridiculous. Levels have become too difficult to pass, taking too many boasters and free time. Would not recommend this game as none of the issues have been resolved despite many stating the same issues. The frustration level is to the point of wanting to give a negative rating if it was possible.

I liked playing homescapes. I've been playing since 2020. I've seen improvements and some not. I gave this 3 stars but now just 1. It's getting harder to win the "hard or super hard levels without boosters and extra coins to buy added moves. I've been stuck on the same level for more than 3 days already. I've been playing consistently but since I don't have extra coins to buy moves, I can't win the level. Also, it sucks that they removed the airplane booster.

took a break from it, and came back to beginner levels that almost require you to use power-ups or coins to be able to pull through. As soon as level 7 or so hit, suddenly I couldnt complete a level without using upgrades or buying more moves, and even then it wasnt guaranteed and I end up wasting time and money. the level scaling seems to have simply broke

I enjoy playing the game, but for some reason, in this game and Family Island, the top .5 inch of the screen doesn't work. I don't have this issue in any other games or on my phone in general. But it makes some of the puzzles unplayable. Flipping my phone over to the other side also doesn't fix it. It's really frustrating, so I'm just going to uninstall.

this used to be my favorite game but it barely deserves 2 stars now. it's incredibly difficult and when you need support it's a bot. it seems impossible impossible to get a real person. I had unlimited lives for 30 minutes and yet it was still subtracting lives when I lost a level. it's never done that. I couldn't get any help. I'm incredibly disappointed.

I’m so disappointed! I worked hard for all the bonuses I had, but suddenly the app froze, and I was forced out without any reason. When I reopened it, all my bonuses were gone, and my progress toward the "Super Rainbow Ball" reset to zero. Hours of effort wasted just like that. This is so frustrating!

Update: 8 days later I am still stuck on the same level because I refuse to pay; my latest review stands: My review of this was originally 2 stars because the game is an obvious cash grab, but after the latest update this game is not worth it at all. They clearly leaned further into the cash grab, introducing more frequent ridiculous levels that require you to either play them over and over and over, or, like they want, pay money to advance. Obviously this company extremely greedy.

it's ok. it's not a game I would play on its own. I got this game to earn gems for my Disney Kingdoms game. But reviewing the game by itself, decorating is pretty fun. I like that aspect. But the characters are kinda boring to me? so having quests like "greet this character, make this phone call, etc" isn't too fun, especially when it costs stars that you have to earn from beating levels.

Games are good. But when the moves are exhausted, it is too much to pay 900 for just 5 moves. And at times just 1-2 moves are enough to get over with the game. Money gets exhausted very soon. Love the merge mode games. Keep continuing with them please. They are really fun. The hunt expedition that keeps coming up often takes up too many energies in just clearing half a minute thrash. In three turns all 100 energies are exhausted. Bring more of merge mode games. You have stopped them altogether

I genuinely hate the animations and style of the game now. Its cartoony and doesnt match the rest of the game, and its really distracting. I understand updating an animation if it's been a while, but if its not broke dont fix it you'll just cause problems. Based in other comments most people agree. I am genuinely considering deleting the game if this is not fixed

It's definitely a money-grab game. Most of the boards will cost you money to even pass. I purchased a package before for 20k coins and spent it within a few days, bc you pay 900 or more to keep playing to pass it, while the reward for passing it is only 35 or 100 coins. Not worth it! I refuse to make any other purchases. Eventually, what will happen is I will get bored with being stuck on the same board again and just quit playing altogether. 🤷‍♀️

i used to love this game but the updates keep on getting worse. it always asks for a lot of requirements to fulfill just to finish one level. they keep on focusing on more events but not on the gameplay. i also love to play the games to earn coins but the coins keeps getting smaller and the task keeps getting complicated. i hope the developer would fix this problem.

I enjoy this game. Currently level 5500+. I feel like they have made the game with more hard and super hard levels though. Don't mind working through hard levels, but when it feels like its a hard push to make you spend money, it makes me not want to play. Adding some difficulty, fine, but this feels over the line. Hard, super hard, and now ultra hard levels? With a few easy levels sprinkled in. And no added bonuses. Come on now. Not even the 3 star levels anymore. Forget me spending $ again.

It was a very good game in the past, and I still enjoy playing it. However, recent updates, such as reducing the win reward to 10 coins for a normal level, have made me wish you would increase the win reward to 50 coins like before and also increase the value of the...The rewards that existed in the past, such as super power in events and monetary rewards, are back. Thank you.

Hello Homescapes Team, I've been playing this game for a long time, but recently it's becoming more frustrating than enjoyable. The Expedition event has been missing twice, even though my game is updated and working properly. Many levels feel too difficult, there are very few moves, and 900 coins for extra moves feels too expensive. The rewards after winning levels also feel too low. Please make the game more balanced and enjoyable for everyone. Thank you.

I've been playing since 2018. Cons - I don't like the update to the power ups, took away the best one (double airplanes) and split up the bomb & rocket so instead of both you only get one. Side games are boring now, always the same thing with a different story, earn energy points to spend. I miss the make overs and merge side games and wish they'd bring back the special holiday decorations that you could earn WITHOUT spending $. Also miss ads for coins. Pros - never spent any $ to beat a level.

I love this game, it is so fun but very irritating. Because you can purchase game packs the developers have set the game up so that moving between the levels is at times extremely hard if you are not making a purchase. Also it would be nice if you earned more than one star for certain levels so that you can finish more projects on Austin's family mansion.

I used to like this game. I started playing it as a way to spend time with my spouse. They have made even the "easy" levels after you reach 1,000 impossibly difficult. This is not a game of skill, but sheer dumb luck. And if you do get power ups, this game gives you the worst luck to immediately fail the level and lose all your power ups. This game no longer brings joy. Edit: This game made me cry in frustration. Don't download. This game only gets worse. Don't lose or you are screwed.

Gamemakers STILL haven't learnt that it is no fun for players to get stuck on levels for WEEKS, yes WEEKS on end with no way to navigate to another level if they cannot pass said level. It is SO BORING to play the same level FOR WEEKS...WEEKS, think about that, 1 level, over & over, several times a day for WEEKS. No other option! Because the player doesn't have enough coins to purchase extra moves to complete the level & it's simply not possible without extra moves. This game is absolute $h!t

enjoyable at first, but around level 5000 they make the puzzles impossible to finish without using coins to get more turns or using boosters. once those run out, you will need to buy them just to continue on with the game. you can choose not to buy but you will end up spending 20mins or more just to finish a level. it stopped being fun at that point. felt like either you pay up or don't play.

Games like this always start really fun and enjoyable. The puzzles are fun, the story is cute, creating and decorating the different rooms is delightful and cute. HOWEVER eventually it takes days to pass the super hard puzzles. you've run out of all of your power ups and it's nearly impossible to pass levels without them. They clearly do this to try to frustrate you into spending money. It's annoying and disgusting. I'd rather just pay $5 to forever just play and enjoy a game up front.

The game is really fun, but there are some problems. There aren’t enough ads to help us get extra chances, and the attempts are too expensive. Because of that, it’s really hard to finish difficult levels if we don’t have enough coins. Also, having only five lives isn’t enough sometimes. If you increase the number of lives and add more ads for extra chances, the game would be much better and more enjoyable.♥️

i used to love this game but now NO! they changed a lot of things about the game i've playing it for more than 5years and i'm on level 6348! the levels becomes unnecessarily hard they no longer put the bouns levels they changed the booasters that comes with the level they make you earn less money each level than before, and the events are extremely hard to achieve, what's going on! i'm so disappointed

The game releases events that accumulate quickly, the levels aren't helpful, and even the money and points we collect by playing levels are very few compared to what's required. I can't collect anything or succeed in difficult levels without spending a lot of money and using power-ups to progress. Even the boosters have changed; the old ones were better. The difficult levels take a month to complete, and events get lost and has very few chances to try; even the easy levels hard too

There aren't any ads like the game states, but many levels are difficult and you can get stuck on them for a few days unless your willing to spend money. They don't give you enough moves to get through the level and if you refuse to purchase anything after about 25 tries they make it easy to pass. I don't have the patience for this type of game.

I really enjoy playing Homescapes. The game is fun, relaxing, and the storyline keeps me engaged. The graphics are beautiful, and the puzzles are challenging without being frustrating. Thank you for creating such an entertaining game. I look forward to future updates, new levels, and exciting features! I have been playing Homescapes since 2019 and have truly enjoyed the journey. I have completed all available levels, which shows how much I love this game. The puzzles, events, graphics,.

Update, I gave the game another chance. I was mid game when the app crashed, and erased my win streak. also causing me to lose some in game advantages. Support was dismissive. THESE ADMINS ARE CROOKS!!! Lately, game won't save my progress and I go several hours without playing and I don't have any lives when I come back.

Very fun, great story lines... Updated 7/2/2026 Unable to use or play, stuck on one scene in the main storyline. Unable to progress past and will not allow me to play any portion of the game. Emailed playtrix with no response in a week. Long running game has had its ups and downs but this is different. Hope the dev team is watching these and responds as I do enjoy playing.

I LOVE this game so much. So addicting (in the best way) and enticing. I used to skip through the storyline in the past, but now going through it all is so interesting! I am now on level 855 and love the way the game has been going, but have noticed that the levels are SO HARD since about level 800, and every 3/4-ish levels, I reach a really challenging one that I am stuck on FOR DAYS. This is quite annoying, but overall love this game though. Thanks!

so sick of being stuck in a level, been playing the same level for weeks, it's not funny anymore will delete this boring game and unlink everything. hard level are not that hard only the regular ones. Your updates are useless.Their hard levels are their marketing strategy to buy your progress, just a waste of money and time. Requires update when there's nothing much interesting with the update.

I’ve been playing this game for months, and every time I close it, it always brings me back to the same spot, even if I was actively playing. With the new update, you removed that option and completely ruined the flow of the game. Please bring back the feature so that whenever I close the game, I can return to the exact same spot. Especially because it’s not always possible to finish a level, and sometimes I need to use my phone for other things while playing. Please fix this!

used to be good , it's just getting harder and harder to progress. I used to enjoy the expedition game but even that has gotten harder, the amount of energy needed for each task is ridiculous. now I can't even get the expedition, it's happened on the last two, the icon is covered by the safe icon so can't access the expedition. I contacted support but of no help., gave a load about device, I actually am using a brand new tablet and it's still a problem, it's obviously a game issue not my device

The levels are stupidly hard. Every level is hard to complete. And every item costs at least 7 stars. This makes the game boring and uninteresting. Just because we get to higher levels and it gets harder doesn't make this game interesting. I've been playing this game for six years, but recently it's gotten really bad. Boring and repetitive races and challenges, hard levels. I think it's lagging behind similar games and has lost its appeal.

I was saving up energy to play the quest games and now every time they have a new quest they decrease your energy back to 100. I had like 2500 saved up energy for the quest games and y'all squashed that. Also after level 400 the matching games become quite irritating and I've had to play levels upwards of 15 times to win and move on to the next puzzle. This game becomes less fun and more annoying the more you play it.

Been playing this game since 2017 & absolutely loved it, up until the new update. The old graphics were so satisfying and relaxing to look at. Now everything feels generic & clunky. The new visuals hurt my eyes and make the game feel stressful, I find myself quitting it. It's disappointing since I've invested years into this game & spent a significant amount of money on. I genuinely hope the developers consider giving players the option to use the old graphics or make changes based on feedback.

I have been playing this since 2017. and it get ridiculous you can't pass super hard level without buying coins. and it's starts being super hard level every 2nd level. we can't go on like this I'm seriously thinking of deleting it because of this changes you made on this game. it started to irritate the hell out of everyone in the group

It's fun until you reach match 3 levels that are impossible to beat. That's when getting you to spend $ to keep playing happens. No thank you. I gave 3☆ because the premise is really fun, but once you hit that point where the algorithm thinks you should be paying $, the fun is gone.

Edited: avoid this game, it holds you back on purpose. The items in game purposely miss targets or attack the same target in the end match. I've had power ups disappear mid use. The algorithm actually keep you from passing too manly levels to keep you from speeding through the mini games.it actually cheating you as you play. They stick you on easy levels to make sure you lose any power ups as well. This came cheats to frustration and forces people to be a cash grab bs pay to win game. Hate it.

Been playing since 2021 and max level. New updates terrible! Its been going downhill a while and this most recent one messed up boosters, but only for some players on the team, not all! They are going too far to push for purchases, especially during Olympus cup mode which is just the same old difficult levels over and over. Gold coin rewards are miniscule now.

Levels become straight up free with certain combos or nigh impossible without them, which obviously is not good stage design, as it doesn't reward strategy. Bonuses (super rainbow ball, cat's gift) are almost necessary for constant progression and choices for decorations become increasingly limited, removing the core aspect of the game. Along with an abundance of irrelevant tasks (have tea, water the plants) and an increasingly unrealistic storyline, this game has lost much of its former charm.

paid more than a 100 euros, this game is getting difficult and difficult. I am at level 4172. after so much hard work, patience and effort I am able to have golden disco ball and one defeat I lose it, the ratio of losses against the wins is very high. I get it the game should be challenging but this has crossed the limits of being unfair by large! many times to retain the golden ball and to stay on the bridge I spend micro transactions but then the next level is hard and so on! lost moral!

Example: You get exactly 15 moves to clear two whole boards, and it takes at least 13 to clear just the first board. For one board to take ovet 100 tries to clear it, it's not worth it! I recommend Strongblade as a much more satisfying match 3 game. If I could give THIS game no stars instead of one just to leave a review, I absolutely would! This game would be fun if they'd just give you enough moves per board. Defintely a pay to advance game. Big Nope for me!

It's a great game to play when you have some time to kill. game saves exactly where you left off, even in the middle of a game, when you close the app completely, for days lol. I'm not joking, it's actually impressive. I also enjoy no pop-ups. it's a great game to play, and it does evolve nicely. I'm in the very high levels now lol so I'm worried I will hit a house completion.. we shall see. My favorite game.

some levels are impossible to win without spending money. it's not challenging. it's meant to keep you from winning the level without money being spent. no one wants to be stuck on one board for weeks. it makes you want to smash your phone 😞. I'm getting tired of it... and if I wanted the extra boosts I'd get them, instead of accidentally spending EVERY COIN,!!

Not recommended for UK players. The chat function has been removed by the developers due to new laws that have been passed so instead of introducing age verification they've decided to just block the chat for UK players which has made the game unenjoyable. Its cut me off from chatting with team mates and severely limits me from achieving rewards as a result. Not a happy customer at the moment so wont be spending any money on this game going forward.

I’ve played Homescapes for years and I’m over level 12,000. I used to love how unique the board and pieces looked, but I’m disappointed by the visual update that changed its original style. Lately, most levels feel either hard or super hard, and it often takes hours to clear a single level. It feels less balanced and more geared toward pushing in-app spending, which takes away from the fun.I’ve enjoyed this game for a long time, but I miss the original charm and a more fair difficulty curve.

giving so many hard levels. Playing this made me frustrated. Whenever I'm getting a super rainbow ball by playing so many hard levels in a row suddenly it ruins everything with the very next level. this makes me so stressful to play . I hate these kinds of games. Didn't give chests which I deserve. worst game ever I played

I used to love this game. My original rating was 5 star. I've been playing for the past 5 years, now suddenly, the optional adverts, which used to help in raising some more coins, disappeared. What happened please? I'm sorry but after all these years I am being forced to uninstall this rather wonderful game. Very disappointed.

I enjoy the game but 2 things are irritating. 1) I hate that when you lose a level, it automatically prompts you to spend coins for rainbow balls. the amount of times my thumb has gotten too close to that button and spent coins I was saving up for extra moves is infuriating. it doesn't ask you if you're sure or anything, it just spends the coins. also, this is specific to the current game 2) the fact the growing a flower is part of the weights challenge thing is dumb it's takes SO many drops.

honestly the game itself was pretty good, but the algorithm of the mini games is diabolically frustrating. the level said it was 'super hard' but it wasn't hard at all. on the contrary, the level said it was 'hard' and the game is super very hard like bruh. y'all need to fix these issues

I'm kinda dissapointed by how the development studio remove some game in the new update like the Challenge Level (it is where you can earn 3 stars in just a one game) and the Pre-Game level where you solve the obstacle for the kitten and you get coins and energy for free. I hope someday you can bring that back :)

Best game out of the bunch.. but Sometimes The levels can take a while to beat but that all depends on if you're good at doing the puzzle games.And it's so fun to decorate Around the house. There is lots ofThings to do in the game so if you get stuck on one puzzle you can go and do another thing like decorate. Also The characters are so funny And quite the entertainment to watch. You can join groups with people and complete things with them earning coins and prizes. And No Ad's!

Been playing this game for years. I can now no longer use the hat to thank team mates for sending cards needed or ask if they need help. I'm in a great team and now I can't really be a part of it be cause since the new update the chat 'Feature Is Not Avaliable I'm Your Region' What an absolute joke 😠 😡 5 stars down to 3. That's being generous!

I enjoy both Gardenscapes and Homescapes and am a paying customer. I recently went back to HS and purchased the Home pass which I did not completely use before a new activation was asked for, meaning I was asked to pay again. This has rubbed me up the wrong way. There should not be a timeframe for using the pass. I won't purchase again.

playrix have treated us UK players very unfairly, by removing the chat function, due to some online changes coming in 2027. instead of investing in age verification, the UK has been penalised. As part of a great team , chat was always social and helpful in encouraging game play to win points and prizes, swapping cards to complete sets- that has now all gone. This is a game that wants you to be in a team. Its worldwide. BOYCOTT THIS GAME. GIVE US BCK CHAT NOW!!!!! ITS PURELY ABOUT MONEY.

Ive been playing this game off and on for almost 10 yrs, I enjoy traveling with Homescapes, you'll loose track off time. 💯 exhalent multi games app. never boring, loads of puzzles, word search, cross words, etc. ENJOY!!!!

Chat feature has been disabled for UK users due to new laws and restrictions. Team chat is a nice social part of the game, and losing it over regional rules is frustrating—especially when you haven't done anything wrong. 😭 Hope Playrix find a way around this so the feature can return or at the very least let other team members know the issue so they dnt think we are being rude or inactive!

Been playing this for several years. Now, when I try to play the games it says "Unable to play, you need to make a purchase of coins or power ups to continue. " I am unable to continue. May have to delete the game.

Played this games for a while. Why is it when I get the rainbow ball & a power up, I sit and watch the power ups go through obstacles and they don't get removed. If you want people to pay money, then make it work properly. Also why put on an event where you cannot ask your team mates for certain things as you've used banned words for group categories? Oh & now if you're UK based we can no longer talk to our team mates. That law doesn't even come in until next year, totally ruined this game.

The game was fun at first, but when you reach the upper levels, the number of stars needed to do basic things gets ridiculous (9 stars to paint a wall!) while at the same time you hit hard and extra levels constantly and they almost always require buying extra moves to win. The game is an obvious money grab.

New Ultra Hard Levels are impossible. They just want you to spend $$ just to pass one level. If not you go through all your lives and cannot advance in the game. Now it's just a big cash grab so its about time to uninstall.

it used to be a great game, you could chat with your team mates, they took that feature away for UK players, now the game is full of bugs. One to avoid if you like a little friendly chat with team mates.

Good, but an IRRITATING issue with the game. it asks for 900 coins if you need extra moves to clear a level & provides just 5 moves. This 900 should get reduced to 100 or 200 coins. And also there should be an UPDATE. There must be a separate pocket where extra moves get stored. Like when we complete a level quickly in a few moves and many moves are still left, so those moves should get stored in a pocket & it should be AVAILABLE for the player when they are out of moves in any level. PLEASE!!

They made an error that I contested yet my account was penalized. Not only was the error to purchase on homescapes but also my other game in which I never had a problem. Honestly wicked download at your own risk. After putting hundreds of dollars into these games im highly disappointed. Regular stages feels difficult. instead of them encouraging you to play it encouraging you to play. feels like money laundering

As a huge fan of match 3 games, I absolutely LOVE this one!🤩 I really like that in addition to decorating the house, the player also goes on a litle journey. There's so much to do, without it being too much, and allows for endless fun...as long as you can beat the next level.😄

this used to be fun. despite all the updates changing how you build stars and get coins it was okay but recently the difficulty level even on the so called easier levels is almost pay to win and im a bit bitter about it. would have like to keep going the way it was. I guess everyone is just out to make as much money off others as they can. such a shame. :(

I hate, when you have the game in the bag and all you need to do, is move one last piece and the game moves it into the wrong spot, away from the spot you picked! Don't get past level 1300! After that you can't win anything, unless you buy more moves. I have been so frustrated because I cannot finish any event! They give you this level and there is no way you can finish, unless you pay! They are sometimes not even the hard levels...

I downloaded the game for the interior design. It is nice but I start to get bored to play for stars to " give a call to.." or " remove the .." or "feed the cat". I really hope that the developers will consider this and make the earning stars more easier..at least if we really need to do this stupid thing, we will not have to play 3 days a level to have 2 stars!

I enjoy this game, minimal ads except for in game purchases. I took 2stars off as the lives take a long time to refresh, sometimes when I'm stuck on a bus , or in bed wanting something mindless to play its tge perfect game etc however I want to be able to play mindlessly, not be so limited by lives. When you die, that's it, can be a 30min+ wait for a new life - this is a very frustrating part of the game and feels like a ploy to try to get you to spend actual $$ to buy lives.

Started off as a pretty cool way to waste a bit of time. I like that you have 5 lives and you're done. Everything else about the game is awful. Obviously levels get harder as you progress... At the same time it takes more and more stars to do each task. eventually you spend as much as a week trying to pass a single level or else you pay cash to buy coins to trade for boosters or more moves. I won't put a penny into this sh**ty game. deleting it now. could have been a cool game.

Don't install this. Even the first few levels are incredibly hard. The idea is to match items in a Candy Crush-esque style game to upgrade small features of a house. If you don't beat the level in so many moves, then you have to spend money (fake and or real) to move on. It was fun for the 2 minutes before the devs start scrambling for your money.

So, basically it's a fun game and it's animated well but it is most defenietly a pay-to-win game. However when you do pay for boosters, the game forces you to use the booster first move, thus not having an impact or helping you at all. I have been stuck on a level for 3 days and am convinced that I cannot win unless I buy boosters. However, all the levels before hand were fun. I just wish it was possible to play without providing the game creators with money.

Game definitely is fun to play. However, the amount of 'money' you spend to purchaee a booster doesn't amount to what you get after finishing a level. There is also not enough moves to finish some, if not, most of thr levels. Therefore, forcing you to use your coins. Which again is a little pricey even to purchsse 5 extra moves. There are also a lot of 'other task' that will cost you a star that really should cost maybe 100 coins instead of a star. Fun and entertaining game but really frustrating. I understand that these games are someone else's 'paycheque' but you're going to lose more customers than gaining new ones. Perhaps lower the amount it cost to purchase lives and boosters or at least make what coins you get at the end of each level somewhat on the same brackrt as what one will spend. Then maybe Ill consider rating it 5 stars.

The game was and I guess still is fun. But after I think a recent update, if you aren't willing or able to drop money on this game for the coins or boosters, you end up stuck on the hard(red) or super hard(purple) levels for days without the boosters and additional moves. The game itself is very RNG heavy. Hard to keep a winning streak going once you fail a level. Which also means you can go days without advancing the story as you have no stars.

Fun game, but...as others have said, some levels are just too hard for the reward given. It takes much too long to refill lives and it costs too much to buy lives, and plus then you only get 5. I haven't thrown in the towel yet, but getting frustrated at a game that's supposed to be fun will not be happening for long. I know you want people to spend money, that will never happen with me. 🙂

In order for you to go forward you have to spend money to buy the additional bombs and pieces. I spent a week on one level and quit. It is supposed to be fun not super frustrating. There were more than a dozen times I had one piece left to go to the next level and couldn't get there. Doesn't make sense why sometimes they line up and sometimes there is no way to make them line up. If you like super frustration every other level, this game is for you. I give it a HUGE thumbs down!!!!

I started playing before all the fake ads came out. I liked the game. Eventually though you can't progress without money. Also the further into it I got, the more stressful it became. I wanted a game to relax with, but they bombard you with timed things to keep you playing. I realized it was time to uninstall when I no longer wanted to open it because I didn't want to feel like I had to play for hours to use in game boosts effectively. Once it's more stressful to play than not, it's time to quit

Having great fun with this game. I'd prefer to do more decorating and repair instead of "answering the door" and "calling people". It's taking a long time to finish the main level. I want to get to new rooms to decorate!! Update: Still using points to answer the door and play with the cat. C'mon...it's a decorating game!!

Advertisements show "order of operations" style problem solving scenarios in various rooms that are in disarray/on fire, etc where you have several tools to pick from to address the issues. I've been playing the game for a couple days now and have yet to come across anything at all like the advertised gameplay. So far, you pass matching levels like beweled or candy crush which earn you stars so that you can perform the suggested task to renovate the mansion. Very disappointed by the false ads.

Boring, deceptive cash grab. Got this game based on an ad in another game, however the "mini game" shown in the ad isn't even in this one. Just a standard, boring 'match three identical pieces and clear a board within x number of turns', exactly like the other 5000 of the same thing in the Play store . Easy and addictive at first, then surprise surprise now there's an impossible level. Just spend some real cash for some boosters and extra turns. Nope.

they constantly set you up to spend money. I will be on the same level for so long, they make it to where you have one thing left, all you need is one more move, so you are tempted to buy coins so you can get 5 more moves. After I make a purchase, it is smooth sailing through next few levels til the cycle starts over. about ready to delete

After a year of plaing, this is just not worth the aggravation! Some of the game challenges are not clear regarding the intended outcome, so you'll spend days trying to satisfy them and not getting credit for all matches. Other players are terrible at sharing lives. And, occasionally, you'll find a playtime "dump" -- being awarded 3 HOURS of free play time when you only actually had 15 minutes -- so all that goes to waste. The algorithms are exhausting. Don't waste your time!

this game is hard, almost to hard on some levels! its fun when you can advance but other wise it is very aggravating. almost to the point that you want to delete the game. Plus it is nithing like the ad, i am on level 132 and have yet to come across anything like what is shown in the ad for the game. You can get lifes or power ups but they cost to much game coins to beable to do anything. The game developers have made it so you cant pass levels without them, just to I'm guessing make money?

this game bleeds you out of your money. Firstly, they falsely advertise what the game is about. Secondly, the rewards on completing each level are less than the penalty you pay to increase your moves or buy special tools. So you end up paying real money to purchase coins and tools which get spent in an instant. Thirdly, if you apply those tools for a stage, they get implemented immediately, right in the beginning and not at the moment when you actually need it, thus often wasting the tool.

This game is really hard the moved you get are right on margin, I can't even count how many times I had to retry certain levels, won't even talk about the hard ones. In fact I'm stuck on a hard one for the past week, I just can't finish it, I even used boosters and it's still not enough. Clearly a cash grab and a way to force you to buy as much boosters as possible also to buy out the safe so you can get extra moves, because while buying 5 extra movies cost 900 gold you only gain about 60 per level .. that if you can finish it that is. No way to replay previous levels to farm gold either. Waste of a good game to be honest

I downloaded this game on my tablet based upon a game preview of a kitchen scene where you attempt to correct faulty appliances, plumbing, and other issues, but I've yet come to this level or even see it being part of the game. This appears to be a ploy to get us to play and spend money only to find that the level doesnt exist. I've already completed the kitchen level in this game! I'm uninstalling. What a joke!

I am editing my review and give you 1 star. Why? Aside from the fact that it has become unplayable because of the much fewer moves, this game gives me the headache. Since my last update, I was not able to play it at all. The update won't get installed into the game and it always says that I have a "slow connection". The other games that need internet connection doesn't have a problem ONLY Homescapes. My connection is fast yet the game says it's slow. Whatever.

I don't love the fact that as you increase in stages, the amount of stars required to complete even the simple tasks increase as well, and the golden ticket was a waste and incorrectly advertised, it wasnt knowledge that after the season ended the push to an "8" life bar would drop back to 5, even with tho we paid for the upgrade. As well as the amount of money for buying 5 more moves is too much, $900 when you award less than $200 for even the hardest stages. I think that could be reviewed.

Edit: Now the game actually has the minigames in it. It's so disappointing to have such a good game ruined. I'll really miss playing this game, but the minigames are a deal breaker. I really enjoy this game, and I've played it off and on for quite some time, but the false/deceptive ads are very off-putting. They are distasteful and reflect poorly on Gamehouse. The game is fantastic--you should be showcasing how good the games are as they are, not through trashy, misleading ads.

I really wanted to like this game but there are too many walls put in your place that pretty much force you to purchase power ups or gold in order to go beyond the super hard levels. I don't play mobile games to get frustrated and play the same level over the course of days in order to progress. I just want to experience the story, enjoy updating the house, and play some matching. Do not download this game unless you are ready to spend money and stare at the same level for days on end.

The game is okay. You cannot advance very far without spending money. The difficulty of the levels get ridiculous and just about impossible without wasting power ups or paying for extra turns. The game play otherwise isnt bad but its a rip off games like candy crush. Even with infinite lives for say 30 min-1hr beating a super hard level can't be done. Overrated. Plus the ads you come across for the game are entirely misleading. I saw the ad on IG and it didn't portray what the game really is.

Admittedly it's interesting, detailed, and fun for world-building, but drats, can't recommend as too many levels just cannot be beat without purchasing power-ups/additional help, so can get expensive fast. Also, a bit insulting and disturbing that the viewpoint of the game is that the elderly are apparently unable to care for a home by themselves.

Fake ads! The only puzzles in this game are of the matching kind, there are no pins to move or choices to make, Period. That being said, I like the story aspect of it, there's plenty of interesting plot twists with the broken mansion. Would recommend this game if they added stuff from the ads into the actual game!!! Between all the -scapes games they share the same dumb ad but there is no such gameplay in any games from the app store except "Pull the Pin" app is the only one I could find. :(

i was playing another game when i kept seeing 400 ads for this game... well, sort of... the ads i saw were an interesting match game for problems (broken items and what would you use to fix it). it was different and looked fun, so i thought i would give it a try. The actual game is a match 3 in a row and nothing like the ads I saw over and over again. Boo. game is now uninstalled.

Love being able to do the inside and having a cat. Now I can do the garden scapes and the home. I love the side rooms to make over but wish all the furnishings were cheaper. I have not been able to finish any of them. Maybe bring an area back so you can finish would be nice. I have since unloaded this game. It got incredibly hard and was no longer fun. Who wants to play the same game for weeks and still not be able to move on. Used to be fun but no longer.

I loved playing this. I spent several 100 hours playing. Even spent several $100 to keep playing..but as soon as I got a new phone nothing transferred.. I've tried online Q&A, emailing support, all the trouble shooting just to get back my saved game back. I absolutely will not start over. If someone can help me get my account back that would be great.

The game was fun for a long time. Now the levels are such that you can be stuck for days, and once stuck that delays progress in challenges, events and tournaments. I don't recall the last time I completed an event. Buying extra days would not see me through the event. And now this latest download will not download; I am given the option to play or uninstall.

Love decorating. Hate some of the incidental tasks. Seem a waste of time to me. Had to lower my review. I'm pretty good at strategy. I've won some of the contests & since I joined a team chest I've been rewarded for top contribution. Unfortunately, I've seen the same pattern as in Candy Crush & Pet Rescue Saga both of which I rarely play now. As I've gotten into the higher levels a game might come down to one move for the purpose of in game purchasing.

Always fun, oddly enough. I have been playing this game for two years and I am kept very engaged. I actually care about the little characters in this app. No idea why. It's basically candy crush but for every level you beat you can unlock more levels of the story that you can upgrade/design. I recommend logging in daily only when you have time to sit down and play it because the bonuses/hour of unlimited lives really help when you are on a hard level. Silly, fun, time waster! :)

Great game but its just "too much" for me. I want to play for fun, nothing serious, something to kill time. Made it to Level 54 and the puzzles became too rediculous to complete without a full cache of toys with only like 20 moves. It then no longer was "fun". Unlimited moves would have solved this. The game is obviously large and will take a very long time to complete (by look at the rest of the darkened board). Uninstalled, couldnt complete puzzle.

Definitely not the game from the ads. While periodically, you'd get one of the levels from the ads, it's more like a "bonus" level when your character gets to play his favorite game. The rest of the game is similar to candy crush, with levels hugely dependent on RNG which means you won't always have a solution available, and will have to depend on RNG luck, or paid boosts to pass the levels. It's not a puzzle game in any real capacity. Not worth it.

It's a pretty entertaining game but sometimes quite ridiculous although I think the game is designed that must be passed until the time set by the designers!... Honestly it's ridiculous when you get an hour to play for free and you spend it in a single game ...!!!!?? but as the designers what they want is to make 💰👍👉💰

I've been addicted to this game. It's been so much fun, however, once reaching higher levels and opening more rooms to re build, everything nearly doubles in Stars to complete a task but yet we still only get 1 star earned per level win. It's taking way too many level wins to do something so simple and it's bothering me so much I had to come leave a review. Besides the occasional 3 star challenge level, we should be getting more stars per level. Getting bored after getting so far along.

Just got out of a "Tournament of champions " where I was unable to play the regular game. Played about 30 levels regular (after buying the "golden ticket ". I still have another hour or so of great rewards, and could make a lot of progress, but guess what? Another tournament of champions. So I am now locked out of making any progress for 6 days. Great way to save money I guess, because I don't care at all about this tournament.

Love the game.. But the halloween one where u use ur tickets is ridiculous. The game is rigged. Wont give u anything to pass a level until maybe the last move and then u get what u need. All bc they want u to spend money for 5 more moves when u only need one. And 900 coins for 5 moves only is ridiculous. I get the game is free, but give us more then 5 moves. Give us free things sometimes. I like the other games where u get to spin the wheel and get more then 1 thing everyday. Or give us an hour free everyday without having to try and beat the levels that are impossible sometimes to not even get that much time to play.

I don't candy crush, matching type games, but this one was ok at first because I like the graphics in the house...but after a while, like others said, it becomes too much work & too time consuming for very little reward. The gameplay in the ad would've been way better. Anyone who rated the game under 5 stars pretty much have the same feelings about it. lol

This used to be 5 stars, but after the latest update, I'm frustrated. The amount of coins you get from beating levels has been drastically decreased. I also don't like this new "Cat's Gift" way of stacking powerups if you beat multiple levels without losing a life. I miss the one with the parrot. I've spent money on this game before, seeing the value in it. Now I feel like the game developers are FORCING people to spend cash and I won't be spending any more.

I uninstalled the game for good now, after playing a level that made my blood boil. Any game is of course made with the intention of making money, but after having played a level where it was so obvious they wanted me to pay I've finally had enough. It doesn't help how much people say it has to be easier. Money is the only reason people make games, and the harder the levels, the bigger is the chance people will buy coins.

The initial add was pretty dope but the initial gameplay is like a candy crush format. Which is not my style to each its own... But i still gave it a shot. The levels are pretty difficult and it seems like you have to purchase alot of powerups in order to advance. After i furnished everything in my bedroom, the reading area, and the tv area, i bought a tv(none of this is optional in order to advamce) then it told me i had to use one of my stars to open it then use stars to get the signal to work.

Game is cute, Advertisements are VERY inaccurate and misleading. Im not sure why you would make an ad for a game if its not gunna be the actual game. You can pick furniture out, but that's about it. You cant do what the ads show you. Maybe redo the ad. Or make a more interesting game so you dont have to lie about it. Its a match 3 game. I wish there were a little more coins or make levels just a TADDD easier.

Game is addictive and forced you to upkeep spending real money for this "free game", not recommend it. It's too boring and often game levels are very hard to beat without boosters, and boosters are cost money or you just keep collecting them for days, with daily check in, for being spending them to beat few levels up in half hour time. Is this worthy your spare time and real money!????

It's okay. I think the animations are so slow and boring though, it takes so long for Austin to stop blabbing and to move around, it feels painful to look at. I just skip everything with the narration since it's overdone. I wish your characters were more likeable and interesting. They can also use a makeover. Gameplay itself is okay, not sure what others are complaining about but I haven't had to spend any real money on this, it's a simple game that allows you to pass time.

I'm going to uninstall. Although it's nice that the main character address me by name and the storyline is endearing, the game itself is just too tedious/time consuming. It also lacks necessary instructions. For instance wth is the patch of grass all about... I found five vertical matches and three horizontal all stuck together yet it didn't improve my chance in any way?

Some of these levels are ridiculously hard. And there's times you're stuck on those levels days at a time. Coin accumulation is hard to gather as well. My suggestion would be allow users to collect coins on a daily basis especially when quite a few of these levels are hard to complete. It's a gimmick when your vault collects more coins then the actual game play itself. It's a rip to get you to buy that vault.

I have to say that I loves the game, same as fishdom, but the levels sometimes get super hard, and you cannot finish them even with all boosters and aditional moves. I even got the gold ticket, but it still didnt help with those levels. Overal, I am sad that sometimes I cannot play my game for entire days, cause I cannot go past some levels. Therefore, I deinstaled it and wont play it again. Too much frustration for nothing.

The game can be addictive, but some levels are downright ridiculous in how difficult they are. They pretty much force you to buy power ups in order to beat them. I'm only on unlocking the kitchen and it's already unbearably difficult... and there's a HUGE house to unlock. I can only imagine how hard it gets later on... I'm on the garden now. My review hasn't changed. In fact, it's a bit worse. So many "hard" levels are actually impossible and you HAVE to buy power ups. It's not okay.

Cute game! I love to beat the levels so I can go through the stories and decorate the house. *edit* They just changed the design of the levels (the tiles, the power-ups and the animation) and I hate it... It's way too busy and it's difficult to follow what is happening when things are moving. I don't understand this decision at all and I'm super disappointed after years of playing the game. This was completely unnecessary.

Shouldn't have to spend money to play it. You only have 5 lives and it goes really fast and you ha e to wait a day to get more. The levels are difficult . 7-24-2021 I have once again downloaded this game. Major improvements. More rewards and the levels are not all impossible. Loving it. Only issue is would like to decorate rooms more instead of silly stuff like trees etc

This is not a great game for casual play. The game requires you to beat levels to finish challenges. But the levels are sometimes pretty difficult,you only have 5 lives, and each challenge requires you beat several levels. So loose 5 times, get no stars, finish no goal, have no fun. I'll play this while I'm waiting on other games progress, but I don't play it consistently anymore

Don't play this game. I was so much interested while playing in the beginning, it looks so good but when I reach level 24 it's impossible. I tried more than fifty times it's impossible. I think the developer should be the one if he can do it first and then only let the your client player play this. I will never install ever again. It's not about the home renovation, actually it's a different game just like Candy Crush and all. I don't know about others. But for me, it's the worst.

I've played this game off and on for years since it first came out on mobile. I never had any issues with the game until I recently re-downloaded it a few weeks ago. It is unplayable for me and keeps crashing and dashboards me to my home screen. Despite having save progress between mobile and pc like it claims, it doesn't load it and everything is always different. I literally can't play the mobile version now due to the frequency of it crashing.

Idiotic. After seeing many ads, I finally decided to try it. The ads give the impression that it's a puzzle game, but it's not. It's more like playing house. The puzzles in the ads are infrequent mini games. It's actually just another cascading tile, get 3 in a row type games. Not my cup of tea. False advertising. Edit: If the game we're anything like the ads, I'd play it. But it's not, and I don't understand why you'd intentionally mislead people about what the gameplay is actually like.

changing review after about 10-14 days. another match-3 puzzle concept with a fun 'The Sims' element, music is chill, but then they push hard for in-game power purchases by upping difficulty considerably. after playing the same level multiple times over, I noticed that each puzzle doesn't provide much for randomization; usually the starting pieces are the same each time.

Ive enjoyed the game immensely for over a year now until the days of wonder came out. I wasnt able to buy the pass so i was trying hard to finish the challeges, In all other games ive played it is always possible to get through all the challenges and get to the prize at the end, it just takes longer. While playing through the days of wonder challenges however, the game kept upping the number of levels it took to unlock the next prize. It became so high, it became impossible to finish

I've been playing this game for years and loved it. I've spent money on small transactions here and there, too, but I liked the fact that it was never necessary to win. Now... with the recent updates, especially the one that takes away a heart even if you don't make moves it makes the game less strategic and forces you to be stuck more often on levels and giving the game a sense of pay to win vibes. I still like it, but im starting to lose interest.

Honestly I fell for this game because of the ads but actually it was nothing like it AT ALL! Which was very disappointing. It was fun until you reached like 8th level, it's kinda boring. What I dislike the most is that the fact we actually have to play a game in order to get a star so you actually can renovate the house, it's annoying. It's much better if you made it like set a limit of time for each star. Anyway, it was okay but for a short period of time.

If you're up for whatever is shown in the ad, or in the pictures (about repairing broken things, and choosing appropriate tools to repair things) then you should definitely NOT go for this game. Because it is totally decisive,what is shown in the ads (or pictures) than the real game. No such options are available to you as shown (purposefully),rather you've to match various different objects, in the inbuilt game (just like any other object matching game) to earn stars,to get the job done. Worst!

The game is not at all what the ad showed. The ad shows a fun puzzle game that had a variety of options on how to solve. The ACTUAL game is basically Bejeweled, or Candy Crush, with a home decorating aspect to it. Noticing a lot of games doing this kind of thing with false ads. It'd be really great if we could get the game that we see.

OK...so...the game is fun, but, there are some levels, at too early a stage that are near impossible. I watched ads about this game for ages before installing it and it plays nothing like the ads, which was horribly disappointing to me. I expected a more puzzle-like game, when it's it's just another match 3 game. Hoped for better...sorry, uninstalling.

No longer enjoyable. Before I can spend the time and enjoy the game solving the puzzles with a little bit of grind. Now it seems like no matter how many times you play a more difficult puzzle (purple or red levels) its specifically designed for you to fail unless you buy one of their packages for boosters. I feel like I'm just spending money on this game just to be frustrated and annoyed. Will be deleting game soon. Can't spend any more time and money on a rigged game designed to take your $.

I have played this game since it rolled out. For the first time I am contemplating deleting it. It's become more of a frustration and less fun, because it seems like its setting me up to spend even more money. The number or moves compared to goal are very one-sided. I like to buy things to increase my game play. However I don't like feeling as if I HAVE to inorder to move to a new level due to the number of moves.

Misleading adverts; not a puzzle solving game but a match three. After spending several days stuck on the same level (183), I uninstalled. Games are supposed to be fun. I don't necessarily mind making a purchase with real money occasionally, but unwinnable levels is, frankly, unfair. I won't install anymore 'scapes' games ever. Frankly, I'd love an an actual playable 'restyle the house' type puzzle solving game.

The story of this game is very charming which is a shame because the gameplay itself is yet another Candy Crush clone. That in itself is not terrible but this game is the worst kind of free to play. The term for it is "pay to win." At a certain point that's what is required to advance. Beating certain levels is impossible without boosters. Some levels are still nearly impossible with the help. Games are supposed to be fun, and it doesn't take long for this one to piss you off instead. Skip!!!

It is addictive game, even though it is nothing as advertised. I have yet to finish any room in the mansion. Nor have I been able to complete any decoration for the season's. It gets frustrating! I feel that they make the game over challenging to make money, not for the individual to have fun, and have the opportunity to complete challenges without purchases.

The game is very engaging especially the part wherein you renovate the house and choose the design for it. I also love the graphics of this game for it is interactive. At first, the levels are easy but I can't say this is a relaxing game. The game on each level is so hard that you will be stuck on that level for days. The game is so difficult. It would be better if the game for each level is not that hard for the users end up uninstalling the game due to its difficulty.

I really do love this game, the reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because it takes such a long time to beat all the levels. I've been stuck on a level for about 2 months now and even with using all the boosters I still can't pass it. Another reason it didn't get 5 stars was because every time you complete a task they give you 1 or more tasks to complete. Even when you got done they still had a lot of the room locked so there is really no beating the game. I MIGHT suggest this game to friends.

Fun game, but cost is too high. Add-ons for extra turns should cost maybe $0.25 - $0.99 at most, but instead you could easily dump $100 on this stuff. It's fun to make progress, but it gets to the point where the levels take far too long to beat without extras, and so you have to pay money to make progress. It feels more like it was designed as a gambling game you'd find in a casino.

Dropping my rating because false advertisements have gone from annoying to disgusting. There are even advertisements being shoved at players of their other games and we KNOW it's fake. I don't even want to play anymore. This is a bejeweled type game. No dramatic winter search and clicks, no evictions, the brunette in the adds is never in danger and certainly doesn't have a kid. Mini games are few, far between, and only recently added so they can get away with false advertising.

HORRIBLE!!!... I go to play. Have to update first, so they they can show me all their new holiday BS. Not enough memory. Go and delete a bunch of stuff and apps I would've liked to keep until I had enough memory. Try to update again. It starts the update and almost at the end, freezes and tells me again that I don't have enough memory. I don't care about your new holiday BS and just wanna play the game. Since I couldn't update, I uninstalled it. Problem solved!

Played this game for years, unfortunately, the further you progress, the less freedom you have with design choices (The Lake House). Added to that, I understand the hard and super hard levels are meant to take time to pass, but they have become near impossible to beat without buying boosters or extra moves.

Fun until you hit a point where you need massive power ups to advance any levels. More or less tries to back you into buying more and more power ups. Was also hoping for the puzzles they use in their advertisement and by level 24 I'd played a grand total of 2 of those. Just not worth it being a glorified version of countless other Bejeweled style games.

I used to play this game and it was fine, but there were no mini games at the time and there's only so much match 3 you can take before you're match 3'd out. Came back after viewing adverts featuring the mini games and enjoying it very much. You don't HAVE to spend money. I've had levels take several days and more than 35 attempts, but eventually will get them solved

Updated review: I have completed all the regular levels and now have to partake in the "Tournament of Champions". All that happens is you play the same levels, but with less moves. It's my favourite to spend day after day on the same level, even using all my boosters and free time to spend DAYS on the same purple level. It means I can never really play the side games because earning enough energy is impossible when you can't pass the levels.

waste of time. they make the rounds so you have the bare minimum of moves to use, so you spend money to buy boosters (which are needed in the higher levels) and continue with the round without losing, of course they once again only give you 5 additional moves, so if you didn't get the majority done you'll waste your gold and/or spend more. It would have been a relatively enjoyable game if they didnt design it so you spend money. not good for f2p. doesn't even have the same game types as the ads.

RIGGED GAME, NOT AS ADVERTISED AND EXPENSIVE AF! I originally downloaded this game because I wanted to play a game similar to what I saw on the ads, but this game is nothing like the ads. Very misleading! It's more like Candy Crush. I stuck with it though because I thought it would be fun to renovate the house, but it costs too many stars to complete tasks and the payoff just isn't there. The challenges are rigged to force you to spend real money in order to advance in the game. UNINSTALLING!

I saw the ad for this game and it looked really interesting, but when I downloaded the game, the game was nothing like the ad! Then, while you are playing it, there is a bad ratio of successful levels to tasks, ie you play a difficult, overcomplicated, level that takes forever to complete, only for the task of going to sleep, or something similarly useless. There are random, useless challenges that pop up, and you often spend real money to suceed. Do not get this game.

The game is a lot of fun in the beginning, but quickly boils down to spending gold (which turns into spending money). If you want to move the story forward it's pay to play. The game would be fine if there was an ad viewing option to get extra plays if you watch an ad. After awhile the levels are almost all hard/superhard, and the 'pin' games go away altogether. I'm moving on to something better. The links they post in responses take you to 404 sites by the way.

Ads for the game are absolutely misleading, you download the game and you find something completely different than what you've seen on the ad! You try the first few levels and frankly the game is nice. After that it gets insanely hard and no fun at all. It's not there for you to enjoy it, it is simply there for you to spend money on coins and powerups. It's a shame.

Guys why don't you read the reviews and fix the False ads for your games?????? I downloaded several of these games because you have ads showing characters in difficulty and you have to choose an options to help them, but i found nothing like that once downloaded. you find yourself in a BAD version of Candy Crush... the lebels are difficult, you cannot pass them unless you buy extras!!! it's too difficult and frustrating. worst game ever!

Like many others, I've been playing for years but I never had an issue. Played the game and kept it moving. However, now I really do have an issue. How do you go from 50 coins to 10 coins for normal levels? Not to mention, if you want to continue the level after you run out of moves, its still 900 coins. There has to be a trade off. If you want to change the amount, fine! Then drop the amount that it takes to buy moves. Freaking ridiculous. Get it together Playrix!

Some levels can be very challenging, and it might take a few days of multiple tries, until it lines them up better, for you to get a combo going. Unless you spend money. You won't complete the adventure games, without buying packages. I've only ever got about a quarter of the way through. Still... the graphics are good, story line is good. Better than most games. I'd rather play this, than a fighting game with alliances, that big spenders can crush you every 3 days

False advertising. They advertise problem solving but after clearing almost 50 levels of a candy crush like game, i was only able to play what they call a mini game about 3 to 4 times. That was the whole reason i got the game was for the problem solving. I hate games like candy crush. And would not have downloaded if i knew. I thought i would get more stars as levels progress to be able to upgrade more things in the house. But still only get one star and only being able to upgrade a single item

I used to love this game, but all of a sudden coins earned per normal level have gone from 50 to 10! Since you need 900 coins to add more moves, you now have to beat 90 levels before you can add 5 moves! They've also decreased the number of moves per level to the point it's extremely difficult to pass the normal levels. If the game stays this way, I will stop playing all together.

The game is cute and pretty but once you get into it you realize it's a cash grab of microtransactions. I loved the rebuild and rejuvenate aspect of the game but putting that behind a bejeweled style puzzle system which is based on luck really just turns me away. Puzzle games are a dime a dozen on mobile devices and this is one is just like the rest. It's a puzzle game which is cleverly hidden behind fun graphics and a "rebuild the mansion" objective.

I was expecting to play the game like the advertisement presented it. But no, I was tricked into downloading a game. That you would play like Candy crush or Farm hero. Then pick items to fix with energy points. In no way is it like the advertisement. So yes this particular game get a bad review for me. I want the bill the house like the advertisement. Make the choices like the advertisement. Not playing Candy crush then go around a house that's preset up. Not a fun game

If you are going to download this game because of the advertisement, please don't. The gameplay is not even as near as advertised where you fix things in your mansion and then could go up to next level and so on. It's just another Candy Crush game but with a story of renovating your mansion/garden. The graphic itself is good, fun, and basically is an easy game for kids or just for relaxing. Again, it is ashamed they are using false gameplay as advertisement.

This game is fun and addicting! I would have given the review 5 stars but chose to go with 4 stars because recently, in the past couple months, they raised the prices of everything that can be purchased in game. Or looking at it another way, the price may have stayed the same but you no longer receive the amount of coins, etc. for the money. For example, when your Gold Reserve is full, you get 3000 coins for 2.99. You used to get 5000 coins for that same 2.99. The old price point was better

You should be rewarded more stars when the level is hard. The levels should not be that difficult till at least level 45, not 21. I was stuck for a while l had to restart the game. finally got to level 100 and the first floor is barely done. Why is a normal level just as hard to do as a hard level? I keep playing and failing on the same one for two days now. I feel more stressed out playing this game then relaxed. I am just going to uninstall.

Ha! It was just a trick! The way this game is so different from the ads, and if you really downloaded it, gosh how red you might be! If you like decorating houses, yes, you'd love this game. But if you like the game Candy Crush as well, this is the game. The ads were liars. Deleting. I do not like sorts of games and tricks of this. Nice storyline, though. Hope you guys'll make modes on how to earn stars!

I enjoy playing the game very much and I love the holiday themes we can win. Mostly, I still enjoy playing even if I'm at level 7000+. The thing that I would love in this game would be the option to NOT put up decorations. Yes, win them, buy them, but have the option to remove them and leave an empty spot afterwards. Sometimes, everything feels so crowded after it's decorated. I'd just like to personalize it after my liking and have it more open.

I tried the game. The three match is fun as are the pin. But I have to say there are so many other side things happening that it takes away from the main part of the game. On top of that I do have to agree with other players. Once you hit a certain point you end up stuck without buying upgrades. I know they suggest contacting the company but that's just ridiculous for game hints. No one is going to turn it off to ask how-to's. I suggest make them a bit simpler past lvl 50.

The getting to renovate the house and pick stuff and watch it change is fun. The storyline is good so far. BUT the mini game you are forced to do nonstop... its dumb.. It was kinda fun at first because I could actually beat it.. but I've been trying since yesterday evening to beat one seemingly impossible level just to get out of the foyer of the house and I'm spent. I've used every help they offered and nothing worked. Definitely not the game from the add. Not a spend $ type of game.

It's fun...but I have been stuck on level 50 for a week...I get that the puzzles are supposed to get harder the further along you go...but it's tedious to get that far and to haven't even cleared the main hall yet. when EVERY ACTION requires a star or two (feed the cat, then name the cat, answer the door, open the box, choose a rug...) I haven't even cleared two rooms and there's so much house left and the puzzles are this hard already...?...I'll never have the patience to do the same level 100 times, days in a row, so I'm probably going to uninstall this one just like gardenscapes...

This game gets hard pretty fast. Boosters are expensive, as is the cost to continue the game. I'm at level 60 and many levels ago I had to either pay real money to win, or play levels 30 to 50 times to win, and for what? To clean Austin's room because the cat trashed it, or buy a toy for the dog, when all I want is to decorate the house! Playrix will not miss me; there are plenty of people willing to spend cash to play the game, and that's what these games are really all about.

I loved the small puzzles they had, and later on, they decided to remove them. I don't mind it. Later on, they decided to remove the option to give 3 stars for super hard levels. Now I'm past 6700 level. Now, they have decided to cut down the coins we get after completing each level. I mean, of course, players purchasing things help the game. But this game is only getting extremely desperate and annoying now. Booster winnings for knight's race been reduced. Ngl I love a challenge, but this sucks

I enjoy playing the game most of the time. The only exception (as I've read in so many other reviews) is when it takes ENTIRELY TOO LONG TO COMPLETE A LEVEL, only to receive 1star when completed. When I get too frustrated, I just put it down for awhile. No biggie. Overall, I really enjoy it. A few suggestions: ▫️ Offer more than 1 🌟 when completing the higher levels. ▫️ Visiting team member's mansions would be nice. ▫️Gift giving (furnishings, plants, etc) to team/friends, in addition to lives.

I really love this game and play it everyday. My love for it is starting to fade (rating would have been an easy 5).
