The levels get way to hard for no reason, it purposely don't move items the way I want. There are too many expeditions and they are not really fun. I really wish you would bring back the merge games, as I really enjoy those (minus the update of having to pass levels to merge). Also, bring back getting 50 coins when you beat easy levels. I am not having as much fun as I used to.

There are games that are enjoyable whether or not you pay for upgrades. In these games you'll spend a few dollars here and there, but you'll never feel cornered into spending money. Then there are games that are crafted to be frustrating and impossible to play without shelling out money hand over fist. This is the second type of app. Play this if youre looking to blow some cash....and still progress at a snail's pace.

I would have given the game of five because I actually really do like the game, but I'm super annoyed by the ads that I keep seeing for it on YouTube. I've never actually seen the game that they advertise on YouTube and call Homescapes. It has the same characters it's just not the same game at all. So, I give this a 3 instead of a five for false advertising.

Bait and switch. It's a fun game, but dont put any actual money into it. They can be very, very misleading with what you're getting. I bought the golden ticket for the season thing and found out the 8 lives wasnt permanent. And a lot of things we were supposed to get didnt stick. They're never gonna get my money again. Which makes me sad--this is the main game I play on my phone!!! Just WRONG!!!

I wish the ads were the actual gameplay. Super misleading. It's just another candy crush knockoff. If it was like the ads where you can pick items to solve different problems to save the house that would make for an interesting and unique game. It could also be fun and educational for kids if the gameplay was like the ads. But no, sadly the game I actually wanted to play does not exist. 2 stars for the story which is the only saving grace and unique thing about this game.

False advertising is illegal- ever hear of the Federal Trade Commission? Shame on the creators for this and several other games (that I've seen), for advertising gameplay that is in fact not part of the game. The false gameplay consists of succeeding (or failing) at fixing problems in a room using a variety of tools to pick from. This game in particular states in an ad that you can continue to play it (using the tools) after downloading the game. Not trustworthy and basically a lie.

I like the game and enjoy seeing the house come back to life...so to speak. I do however think the cost of game coins. is way too high. Way too much coin to purchase a broom or get a doughnut through to the heavy changed colored shapes. Way too much money for the task. If one earns a lot more when solving puzzles the game would flow better and be more enjoyable. I know you will not change anything. So, I still will play on occasion.

It shouldn't be marketed the way it is as the mini games are quite rare throughout. Should be marketed as a matching game with additional gameplay to redecorate spaces. Marketing right now is a tad misleading. I love this game though. I like that there are no ads and the matching game within actually leads to something other than going up a level.

I clicked on an ad to download this game because the ad made it seem like it was a game where you make choices to solve various problems. It turns out that this is another typical match-3 game. If the game had both elements, I would give a higher rating. However, showing one game in an ad for a totally different game is FRAUDULENT. This game gets 1 star only because I cannot give zero.

Update 1/21/25, The information below from the distributor is incorrect. The game definitely gets harder by limiting the amount of moves you're given to complete a level. Eventually you will play the same level for days. Then the only way to complete is to spend $$. This game was fun to play at the beginning. But as the levels have progressed they become very difficult and very monotonous and takes sometimes days to get past one level period and then in the side.

For clarity, I'm on level 700ish and never spent a dime. It's fun, puzzles are fairly well designed, story can be cute, but PLEASE SHUT UP AND LET ME PLAY YOUR GAME! It took neirly a minute to explain to me how a battlepass works without any way to skip, and does this constantly. I don't want them removed, I just want a checkbox so you never bring them up again. Also, I will pay for 100% of the dev time needed for a switch to turn off move suggestions. Dead serious, HMU.

Similar to candy crush. At higher levels game makes it much harder to win. Then after they think you've played enough, like 10 or 20 hours on same level, they let a lucky board through. I don't like the way the arrows changed working. They don't hit what you would like them to hit and they destroy your strategy. Almost to level 2000 but I can't deal with it, so deleting the game.

I have enjoyed this so far. I love the idea of renovating the old house and other quests. It really is true that the "Hard" and "Super Hard" levels are extremely difficult. I didn't want to exhaust all my power ups nor spend real money, so I just try and try again while also waiting for more lives that takes a while to be filled. I would like it if you could provide more moves every level so that we can have increase chances of beating it. So, more moves and decrease time for lives to be filled.

I love the game but I think there should be a way for us to claim infinite-life-for-a-certain-time later. It's difficult when I just want to play for few games before bed, but instead I have to claim 3 hours of infinite life. I couldn't stay for another 3 hours and that bonus just go to waste. Such a shame. There was also atime when I constantly got bonuses until I had to play for 9 hours straight. That's just tiring. Please consider a claim / use later button for bonuses

This game was alot of fun at first (just a day ago) and then it got ridiculous. You end up playing a Candy Crush style game for hours while only restoring the home for minutes. The puzzles become so difficult you either need luck or money to pass them, not skill. Read some other reviews of people that have been playing for a little while. Wish I did.

Do not recommend. Unless you are a huge fan of Candy Crush (which I'm not), you will spend hours playing Candy Crush-like levels to progress anywhere. Plus it takes real money to move forward on levels as it goes on because lives are way too easy to go through. I got to 60+ levels just to redesign the front room and never once played the advertised mini game. Don't waste your time with it unless you love the tedium of matching teapots and cups over and over to get one star.

Have been trying to get ahold of a live person in support. Personally think it needs a better system. Totally automated and I couldn't get my issue addressed bcuz it isn't on the list and no way to type my issue in. You can only pick from the list. NO LIVE PEOPLE!!! I have a problem with Level 63 it's only giving me 15 moves to clear level 63.

Having seen the ads EVERYWHERE, I gave it a whirl, but like most games with in-game purchases, it eventually gets to those parts in which in-game purchases help to move things along at the same pace as previously experienced. It's better than most, and the balding GSRM English butler is cute and flirty, so that's worth a star or two. In the end, though it's about doing all the work to help a rich butler fix up his rich parents' house, and that gets old fast.

Not a bad game, BUT I've gotta say the same as many others. It's NOT as advertised. I was waiting to see the advertised gameplay, but was sorely disappointed. Level 24 is basically impossible to pass without buying the powerups, and it's just like many other games. Candy Crush plus expensive home renovation? YIKES. 👎 Please don't bother. (Wasn't that bad until it wasn't the advertised product, and became too difficult to play.)

This game was....really bad! Not only did the adds lie, saying that it was a "problem solving" game, however there were a lot of adds! Also it took way to long to complete one level, and after you did, you only got ONE POINT! If you want to challenge yourself you can probably get to like level 20 but after that you need to either wait hours for a prize, or make an in app purchase. This game is a candy crush wannabe that lies to you, I am sorry but it is the truth!

I used to love this game. There were times where I didn't play anything else. The super rainbow ball (complete 10 levels and get a ball that eliminates two colors) is a great idea, in my opinion, but not if the game makes you lose it immediately one or two levels after you got it. The levels are ridiculously hard and more frustrating than anything, the expeditions take an insanely disproportionate amount of energy to clear obstacles. Not playable anymore.

Completely disconnected from the ads. First time I download a game based on the advertisements: help this guy escape certain death by handing him tools? None of that, instead you have to play a renovate/decorate game, but for every piece of decoration you have to get a star from a match three objects together-a la candy crush-game within the game. They managed to make that sort of challenging, but that's not what I came here for.

ADS ARE NOTHING LIKE THE GAME! it was fun at first! but then every game I lost lives right away.... mainly because I had no moves and the game kept reshuffling. Did you want my money that bad haha... and your games are harder and harder each time. if you want to keep playing constantly you HAVE to buy something... candy crush isn't even that silly.. too bad. the characters themselves and plot are great... too bad someone can't just make a game without wanting more out of it....

If I could give the overall game experience a 00000 I would. The makers of this game have made it so hard to pass a level in the hopes that you will spend an exorbinate amount of real money to get to the next level. They also do not let you earn enough coins to keep up with how much it is to keep going on a level. This game even puts a certain amount of the coins you earn for passing a level into a safe so that you have to pay real money to get them out. Free game....LOL.

Just like the other players, this was fun at first 2k levels. Then a very confusing levels and irrelevant activities take place. Getting stuck for days even at the hard level is frustrating enough. You win or gifted an unlimited life but you will not or cannot proceed to another level. Its like the game wants the players to spend lots of money. Its getting boring. Mini games are childs game.

Pay to win! The game isnt all that bad really but when you only get 50 coins per completed level and boosters and extra turns cost 900 at minimum it's easy to see this game is meant to keep you paying every few levels. I get this is a business model but you could at least make it possible without having to spend money. Some levels are setup to be near impossible even with boosters. This isn't a game of skill it's a game of luck with slot machine odds. Uninstalled.

Its fun but when I realized I had to play each time to get just a single star got old real quick. Like many others I get stuck on the same level and end up there for days. I will spend 30 mins playing one level over and over again and for nothing. Could be really fun but there's no opportunity to receive more lives or to advance. Have to wait an hr or longer to get my lives back to use them all up in 5 min. Going to see if there is something similar but not so difficult to advance.

I used to enjoy playing the games. Now, not anymore. The number of moves greatly reduced as I level up. Imagine you have less than 18 moves for level easy. I can't join the game tournament since I'm stuck at same level for days. Might as well uninstall to make space for other games in my phone. Playing games is supposed to be fun, not stressing you out.

Its an interesting enough game but it gets way too difficult as the levels progress. Also does it ever become the game that is advertised? When i saw the ads for the game i was really excited because it looked really fun but when i actually started playing the game i was actually dissappointed. Its good that installing the game is free because technically this is bait and switch which is an illegal practice. The company needs to come up with accurate ads if they want people to continue playing.

Not what it seems, I've seen ads for this and thought I should give it a shot since I thought it was more like puzzles, turns out it's like candy crush so I uninstalled because it's how you progress in the game. It'd be better if it wasn't some mini candy crush game that only had the "fix it" aspect where you choose what to do and depending on what you choose you either fail or succeed. It's just disappointing, time to find another game more up my alley.

Admittedly not a gamer but I got into this one and my daughter likes to do the decorating part. I refuse to spend money on it so I just play when I have lives. Then I got pretty good...THEN I placed 4th in a competition and won 45,000 coins (so now I'd definitely never have to spend a dime on it and could play when I want). But they only awarded me 1,500. So I messaged support and they said "you get 1/30 of what the award says". Seriously??? This game is a BS money grab waste of time. Uninstall

The game has gotten less fun. The events (individual) are almost impossible to achieve. If you are not able or incline to spend real money forget about it. Matchington mansion gives more satisfaction in this sense. Update: the developers actually listened. For the first time an special event is going on for longer and they added ways to actually earn a decent amount of tickets within the event. Let's hope this time I can finish one...

Even though I absolutely love this game, I am very disappointed at how they have increased prices for in-app purchases as well as for the pot. Most of the prices have doubled, e.g. you only get 3000 coins instead of 5000 in the pot, you pay R39.99 instead of R19.99 for 1000 coins. The levels are very difficult and it feels like we are getting much less for your money now.

Very nice at first, but then it gets boring and too difficult at times. The first week I get to play for over 100 levels a day, but after level 2000+ I got stuck for weeks in some impossible levels. I would never spend my money on match 3 games, so I just gave up and uninstalled it. I play games to relax, not to get depression. My life has difficult enough! PS: I wish people could sue your company for the straight frauds of ALL the misleading ads. You've robbed countless people for years now!

The animation is fine and the "overworld" is huge, but i was expecting a neat puzzle game with broken rooms and a line-up of tools to fix everything. Instead it just does everything for you after you clear yet another generic match 3 level. So sick of really neat looking puzzle games in ads that end up being nothing like what i went in for. Fooled me with Hero Wars on that too, but at least that game is pretty packed with stuff to do.

I've only played this game a few days and I'm already over it. Every tiny thing costs a star. Buy a TV? A star. Open the TV? Another star. Put the TV in the room? Yep, you guessed it. Then you have to play a "candy crush" type game to earn a single star. I haven't even progressed that far and the levels are already too hard to beat with more than a few attempts. I downloaded it cause I wanted to "save my house" like it shows in the ad videos, but the actual game is nothing like the ad.

Omg almost EVERY level is a slog now, even the easy ones. I used to love this game, found it relaxing, thus was happy to throw a few bucks in here and there. But now you can't get thru any level unless you burn mucho coins. I get it, they need to make money, but it's made the game frustrating and boring and now I want to spend zero. Need to come up with better ways to encourage purchases instead of making every level harder. On the plus side, I play a lot less now.

These games: fishdom, gardenscapes and homescapes can be fun. All reward you with hours of free play if you do well for a while. Then it will take you all of that time to beat a level. If you leave and come back in a day or two....wow boosters galore? Still won't pay, but bull....the hard and super hard levels are just that; usually. But the hardest ones I have come across on any game are not labeled as such? If you have a job do not try to stay around for level 4000 or...get a loan

Very rewarding and enjoyable at first, but gets difficult very fast. I'm now at level 60 and have failed about 30 or so times. That's a problem. The game makers should realize that by making the game too difficult, people will eventually just give up and stop spending the occasional dollar here and there. Candy crush did a much better job of stringing you along.

I have been playing this game for a couple years and I do enjoy it, have spent about $50 in the 2 years I have played. You can play this without making purchases within the game, that being said it will take you a month to pass those harder levels so it's set up to encourage you to spend to progress, if you are persistant, it can be done. The packages they offer are expensive and you don't get much for what you spend, not worth the money in my opinion,would consider if cheaper, until then NaH!

The game is too difficult for a casual game. Way too few moves. Two stars because the designers did a good job, but development greed has made this game undesirable. Edit: 1 star. They push entirely too hard to force one to make purchases by making the levels impossible to play. The rewards are so miniscule that they may as well not be given and the gameplay just isn't fun or interesting enough to make you even want to purchase anything. Boring and slow after only 2 days. Not worth the data.

This is complete false advertising for this app - it's not remotely close to what they show. The actual game consists of having to complete "candy crush" style levels to collect tokens. Those Tokens are then cashed in to complete small tasks such as build a fence around a garden, or plant a new lawn in front of the house. What you are seeing may represent gameplay later on, but I can advise you that after playing for a month, I haven't reached those levels.

I've been playing the Halloween event nonstop since it started. I only completed chapter 1. The only way you can complete an event is with real money. The hard levels are only hard because they barely give you any moves to complete it. The airplanes are useless. This game used to be fun, but it's not any more. All they care about is real money. I'm about to uninstall it. Also you could be stuck on a hard level for days but the second the event is over you suddenly pass it. This game is rigged.

The game is just like gardenscapes, once you hit a certain level, the puzzles are no longer challenging; but impossible. They are literally impossible and you are forced to spend money to progress. It is the developers way to limit your options. Spend or quit. This way they can advertise as free, when in reality it's only free for a limited time. I spend money on games quite often. I don't have a problem doing so. I won't when the developers are dishonest and underhanded. Uninstalled.

Entertaining but Expensive. I agree with majority of the reviews here. It is an entertaining game but definitely skewed in the favor of the game makers where you have to dish out more money just to advance to "build" the house. It's not worth the expense even with the fun graphics and entertaining story. If it were more even for the gamer to advance fairly.. I would have kept it.. but it's like a bad relationship... good for awhile but you have to let it go...

I'm a fan of Township, so I wanted to like this game - but I can't say that Playrix's teams seem to be learning from each other. This is entirely too dependent on luck and lots of it, perhaps to increase sales of boosters, but if the levels are unbeatable even with boosters and multiple attempts, then it just feels like a cheap cash grab. No thanks; uninstalled.

*New review* I found out that players other than myself get occasional mini games for coins, as well as occasional levels that if you beat on the first try, you get extra goodies (like they do in Gardenscapes.) I have been playing this game since it came out, and I have NEVER had a mini game or "beat in one try" levels. I contacted support and they said they "can't adjust the algorithm and hope I get to play one soon." What algorithm? The game isn't offering the mini games or those levels at all

I spent a reasonable amount of money on the game at the beginning because I don't expect something for nothing even though the game is "free to play". When you use up all of your power ups and still can't beat a level then you know the game is just too hard. I have played some levels over 25 times before I beat them. Even the regular levels are too difficult. I would suggest to others that they try "Lily's Garden". It is fun and has a more reasonable challenge.

its a pretty fun game (though not as advertised at all) until you get stuck on an absolute unbeatable level. they only give you enough coins to buy 5 extra moves every 15 games you win so if you get to a level you can't beat you're screwed. the game is absolutely worthless to me since there is no way for me to beat 174. i have tried for several days. like someone else mentioned, the bubbles, goo, whatever grows ways too fast to be able to beat some of the levels WITHOUT SPENDING MONEY OF COURSE.

I enjoy the game, however, I discovered after spending hundreds of dollars over time that it's nothing but a pay to play, money grabbing scam. I decided not to waste any more money on this and of course I'm stuck on levels for long periods. Well, it is what it is, I just learned an expensive lesson. Also, I needed one shot to get off a super hard level. There it was, one shot, one piece left. Boom, it went to some random piece instead of the one I needed to finally win. RIGGED SCAM!!!

I've played this game and it's a very addicting game but the two things that make me give it the low rating is #1 it's like candy crush. Once you get high up there in the game, you have to spend money to beat the levels. #2 before you even install this game, you see ads for it and the ads are very cool. BUT the ads showing the game are no where at all how the game is or what the game is about! Its complete false advertising and I'm surprised no has called them out on it yet!!

The beginning of this game is very good, but once you get deep into it you can hardly customize anything. The whole point of the game is to design the houses, but at the second house you can customize maybe 25% of the objects if that. The game just becomes about watching the boring story unfold, which I couldn't care less about. Game designers clearly got lazy with the late game because by that point they assume they have enough of your money. Pathetic.

Cute story, but I don't pay $$ to get further in a game. In higher levels of the matching puzzles (500+), the game messes with you. You'll swipe a piece in one direction, and it moves in the other direction (yes, my screen is clean), causing you to lose the level. Seems the game developers are trying to force you into paying real cash for coins that can be used for extra turns to finish the level. I'm in the 700's, and I'm ready to quit. Getting stuck on the same level for weeks is a scam.

Really like this game. Unfortunately, certain levels are designed so that you either need a huge stroke of luck or need to purchase additional coins. I have no issue buying extra coins here and there. (I understand the creators have to pay employees somehow,) but $5.99 for a safe with 12,000 coins is way too steep. Especially considering it takes 900 just to get an extra 5 moves, not counting the other perks available. If it were more reasonable around $1.99, I'd be more prone to purchase.

Dying game, devs make it harder to enjoy with every update. The events are a joke, they clearly tweek the puzzles during events to make it harder so you spend money on power ups. I have spent probably $50 with in game purchases for fun. But now it's just out of control. This game use to be enjoyable but now it's pretty much dead. I am also a team leader for my team. Impossible to recruit new members. Most people in my team haven't played in over a year.

I wish the game was more like the advertisement where you had to choose the correct item to keep the kitchen from burning down. That looked like alot of fun!! I do like that after about 20times playing the same board it gets a little easier. I hope that continues throughout the game. I'm having fun but I'm not that good at it.

Great puzzle game, that turned into a pile of garbage ever since the "new way" of advertising. I wish the developers, publishers, or advertisers changed their thinking of how to advertise their product and how to bring more customers to try it. Lies that are presented with terrible ad design, the mindset of "I bet you cannot beat this level!", and poor way of showing it, makes me sick and sad thinking where we went wrong. Awesome time killer, but disgusting advertisement choices.

it's a homescape game, solve puzzles to get points to decorate... not bake cakes and get pets, you can not turn it down to own animals and having to go back to rooms already complete to replace items. The puzzles are fun and challenging but about to move into another game that allows you actual do what the game is about. Being sick in bed I spent 3 days of solving puzzles only to use them to bake a cake, seriously. ok beyond that I guess.

I am going to uninstall. After so many levels, its very hard. It has good designs and grafics. The creators makes the game way to hard. It's been awhile since I played this game. The creators have made it way too hard. Besides why does it take a long time to play in the Garden? Since their is already a garden. I have given a 1 star, because it is very hard.

I have played this game for a long time (well over 1000 levels) . It used to be a great game but lately there have been so many more much harder levels that it isn't much fun to play anymore. I feel like the developers just want more and more money so make it harder so we will buy coins and boosters. I am not whining. I like hard levels but not ones that take DAYS to beat.

This game is too hard for what it is worth. There are too many tasks to complete to get the full satisfaction of your room. The puzzles become so hard that it will want you to spend money. If you are a casual player that doesnt spend money then dont even bother playing. This game is just as bad as Gardenscapes. You will spend days or even weeks as you get to higher levels. I personally haven't finished the first section of the house and its already too hard. I cannot imagine what the rest of the game is like. The developers need to either make the game easier, or remove the life system, or make power ups cheaper, or a combination of it all. The difficulty of this game takes the fun out of being a "casual" game.

Played this game since originational PC version. Now decoration choices mostly gone. Rates hiked across the board which is understandable but taking choices taken away? Used to be fun. A money pit if not careful. As you progress and open new areas, requiring more stars & their goal being our money and taking away our decoration and remodeling fun, we're the ones being played.

I think this game is a bit of a scam. It seems more of a chess game than a matching game. I noticed how the levels with the bubbles always leave you with no moves to make. You put the player at such a disadvantage even taking the bonus help. Also noticed how when you only have a few moves left, thats when all the bombs and all those help appear. I think its a way to get people to spend their money on the extra moves. Its fun but its a scam.

I WAS enjoying the game but the last part renovating the boat house, took waaaay too long to beat each level...I was excited about the mystery mini Game and even spent money hoping to get through it but with not winning levels I just couldn't get it done. That's no fun. I never spent money until the end...and when that didn't get me anywhere I am now deleting the game. It's become a time waster where it before it was just my spot of fun while waiting in line etc. You really feel set up. Bummer.

I want to like this game. I find the puzzles relaxing most of the time but they are mostly random chance for you to get move sets to win so you waste a lot of lives and time to not get very far. I want to advance the story but all of these trivial things happen to stop me. Just let me design the house! This is such an obvious cash grab it hurts. This should be a fun game that makes me want to spend money sometimes instead of punishing me for not spending money at all. Not a good business model.

Not even gonna download it. After playing the ad for this game, I was like "hell yea! This game looks awesome" but then I looked at the pictures and read the reviews for it and I learned that the ad is very misleading. Please design the ads so you actually get an idea of what the game is!!! Can't stand developers that false advertise a game to try and suck people in. It's rude, deceitful, and just wrong. Do it the right way, oh wait but if you did that you wouldn't get as many downloads

You know all the fun puzzles you see in the ads? Don't play this game if you're wanting to do a lot of those. This game is really Candy Crush 2.0. In order to work on the game's storyline, you have to earn points by passing Candy Crush-like levels. Note: I am almost to level 1,000 and I have probably seen fewer than 20 puzzle levels like the ones shown in the ads. It's still an addicting game, but I wouldn't have downloaded it if I'd known that. I have no self-control so I keep playing.

Enjoyed though it's nothing like the ad. I really just enjoyed clearing levels and decorating the house, however the levels get very hard overtime and it just stops being fun to me. Also throw in the fact you only have five lives at a time before you have to wait 30 mins for one new life. The game is fun, but it has multiple aspects I can't stand. I have uninstalled this game.

I liked it when I got it a year ago. Until I was stuck on a level for days, maybe weeks. I lost interest and deleted it. Also, the company started to join in on the crappy, obnoxious, loud, flashy, and low-quality ads that don't represent the game at all. That knocked the game down to two stars, and that's being generous.i thought Homescapes was better that. It's a Candy Crush-esque puzzle game, not a pull-the-right lever puzzle game. Shame on you, Homescapes.

This game quickly ropes you into spending real money. You earn very little coins on levels and most of what you do earn goes into the money vault which you can pay for later. I found myself spending a few bucks here and there to get power ups and coins but then you'd get through a few levels and you're already out, there's no real benefit. Seems like the makers want to make it next to impossible to make progress without spending money. I spent way too much, had to delete.

At first I really liked the game however after getting stuck on random levels and the only way to complete the level is to buy power ups, its just a money grab. The ads show you that you have to fix a stove on fire and a leaking sink and then in the real game its earning a star or 2 per task. It would be a fun game if it were what was advertised.

I just want to play games. Now they force you to sit through all the promos, even when you have a limited amount of unlimited lives time. Also they've recently made it to where you have to go to the special section after playing levels, before you can play levels again. The game levels are fine, but they are trying to force you into getting into the story. I'm not a fan of that. The story can be odd and unrealistic. The horses and the race cars specials are annoying. Just let me play levels.

I used to love this game, My go to for relaxing, I have it on multiple devices and have been playing for over 5yrs. Recently, it's become nothing but depressing and anger inducing. There's no reason to be stuck on an easy level for three weeks. Pieces are not responding to moves the way they used to or even should. Rewards are a 1/3 what they used to be. In the past, you could buy the golden ticket and earn rewards fairly easily. This time, I couldn't even get half way through. No more$$ for you

I'm sorry, but i was expecting to see something like the ads, in which you drag and drop tools and items to fix the house. The game was not what i expected at all! The ads are misleading, not to mention ridiculous, as they show (someone) making the stupidest decisions and failing miserably. What the ads failed to mention was that the game was just yet another swap-and-match game, like Candy Crush or Toon Blast. The same goes with Gardenscapes. Uninstalling!

Please abandon levels requiring pairs, like "rocket plus rocket x4." Those levels are extremely frustrating, since power-ups don't behave in a manner that help the player on those levels. I've gotten a spate of levels that give very few moves for gargantuan tasks. I'm weary of getting just 15 moves to clear 70 grout tiles and 20 cherries. Be more generous with the moves! Finally, too many challenge/one-shot levels. Do you think you're doing us a favor with those? They're far too frequent.

I'm not going to lie, this game was fun at first but after multiple days of being unable to beat one puzzle and then being almost forced to use the microtransaction system I think I can happily leave this one in the dust. I honestly came for the pull-pin puzzles, but even those aren't as numerous as the adds will have you believe. Sorry but 1 star. I would have given it 3 for just the design part but the game play REALLY makes it hard to vote higher.

I love this game. It is so addictive. I would have given it a five but some of the levels are so hard and I haven't even made it upstairs yet I'm still in the kitchen. So if they are this hard now I can only imagine what they are going to be like later and it's still a lot of rooms that have to be done. I think there should other ways to win coins and booster during the game maybe like a gift or some, although I like the addition of the daily gifts. Also there should be a gift of sometime w

I enjoy the game! Yes it's not as advertised but I still find it fun! my major complaints are the same as everyone else - 900 stars is too pricey for things, and wasting stars on making phones calls and other useless tasks is annoying. My biggest complaint is not being able to delay free play (30min, 1 hour, 3 hours! Who has 3 hours straight to play?!) It would be nice to be able to bank free play rewards to use when you want and in the time amount you want to use.

gameplay is fun most of the time. The problem this game has is the push to make you spend money. Devs say none of the levels are impossible to do without paying, and while true, it is a bit misleading. Many of the levels are impossible to beat on *most* attempts because of RNG. This means that you can either spend days to beat it as you have to wait so long between lives or pay some money to get additional turns or power ups. Let us pay a one time fee for infinite lives if you want my money.

I gave you 9 months to fix the freezing issue. But nothing changed. I play happily for an hour and when I want to continue it doesn't open. Green screen, thats all I get. Worst of all, You don't bother answering ratings and comments! Most comments hear sound rigged. These are the same as last June. This game as good as it was at the beginning, is a scam!

Totally different game than what is advertised. I was really disappointed that it's just another Candy Crash type grind fest forcibly intertwined with a "story". One plays one or more matching tiles game to "perform" ridiculously simple stuff like "feed the bird" or "greet the guest" & so on. Which is ok unless you get sucked into buying anything with actual money. The later levels are clearly designed to frustrate you and tempt you to buy stuff to get through tough levels. Therefore 2 stars.

I really like Homescapes and Gardenscapes, they are the top two games I play on my phone. That being said, some of the levels can be extremely hard, which I knew they would be, but they shouldn't be days to complete hard. Also, I don't love the Golden Tickets. I shouldn't have to pay $5 for every event. The free power-ups are nice, but I just think all of the events should be free. It's kind of a cash grab and unfair because there are SO many events. Let us participate in another way, please!

This game is a joke. From the false advertising to the programming that is designed to get you to pay them money in order to proceed. These developers are con artists through and through. I've ran into so many levels where I had just one item left to collect, but waste my turns trying to get blocks over there to match and break the item. Also, THIS IS A MATCH THREE game, not what is advertised. You guys are liars, out to collect money. Screw you all.

At first it was ok. I thought there were things to fix the way the ads showed me, but, no. Its boring match 3 puzzles over and over just like so many other games. Then theres the events.When I deleted the app, I had a stray cat chasing another cat, a love interest. The storyline was fine at first but as the game progressed, it became boring. Meet her, call him. Match 3 game to answer the door. I thought this was different, figuring out how to fix things was the puzzle. Its candy crush basically

Like most people have mentioned, the advertisements for the game are false and don't match the actual game. Another issue with this game is the level of difficulty for some levels. I have been stuck on level 24 for a few days and it's a real pain they don't provide the player with enough moves to complete the level. I wish I could give this game zero stars because it truly doesn't deserve any.

I want to like the game, but I have mixed feelings. The game is not as advertised, which really sucks. It could be a decent game though. I like how you have a news feed and Austin and his family uploads photos and statuses. Fixing the house seems like it would be fun. But the levels are far too difficult for you to actually achieve anything. You may attempt the same level dozens of times to only be able to add a stupid rug. I hate that the game isn't what the ad looked like in the first place.

Skip this if you prefer skill-based play. It's designed to be unplayable without using cheats. There is promise in the style for storytelling, but by lvl 21 (a match-3 game naming the cat) you can't play even 1 move. I came back several times to see if it would generate with a match, but it didn't. After looking at Reddit, I decided to quit while I'm relatively ahead. I'm curious about what people could do with this style of game, but this one is designed to not be played with skill alone.

I gave it 2 stars because it's a good game to play but if you can't pass a level and you've been on it for a ready for 2 weeks. I uninstalled it, why am I gonna keep playing the same game to keep on losing. They market it very well but in the wrong aspect they're making it seem like you're fixing at kitchen but all you're doing is playing another version of candy crush but with another obstacle.

I've been playing this game for quite a while. I've been stuck at level 1259 for a few days and it looks like I won't be getting any more Halloween decorations. So frustrating! I'm actually thinking of uninstalling the game as the difficulty of some levels has gotten ridiculous. Also at this point I need 3-5 stars for one action... stopped being fun.

This game used to be a lot of fun. Once you get to the higher levels (1874 for me) every other level is one of the hard or super hard levels that are next to impossible to beat with the amount of moves given. They desperately want you to pay real money for bonuses and fake coins to pass the levels which is ridiculous. You get below 100 coins for beating a level but it costs 900 coins to continue a level if you run out of moves. Honest, avoid this game and find something without in-app purchases.

Not as advertised! What was advertised seemed interesting. Actual game isn't anything like it. Don't download if you're expecting a choose your own adventure/puzzle solving problem game, because it's just a lie. The sister-game, Gardenscapes, is also a disappointment for the same reasons. You shouldn't be running those ads. It's blatant false advertising.

This game is annoying at best, and a greedy money grab at worst. The later levels, even the "easy" ones are so obviously designed to force you to purchase from the store, its pathetic. Many of the "puzzles" are just huge boards that are 75% blocked off. Even with every power up some of them are difficult to beat. I'd suggest playing this game for no more than the first 100 levels. I will never spend another dollar on anything from this awful developer.

False advertising. Only way to get through levels is by spending money. Ad was misleading nothing like the game. Even if you spend money in the app it doesn't ensure you win anything the game is built on luck. Blocks don't always fall into logical places when removing a block(s). You're also forced to sign into a group chat, adopt a cat and a dog and the app makes you waste stars to care for them and other things no option to progress until you do it. Would be better if you pick where stars go!

This game was fun at first and you incentive to play was really good early on. But when as you advance into the harder level progress is really slow and there are very few rewards to get you going. I ran out of lives really fast. The rewards are so little doesn't get you out going and then a decision to spend. I did spendt some moneyut I don't want to keep spending all the time. Come on, reward some or eternal life.I am about to abandon this game for good.

I'm on level 579. I LOVE this game, been playing for 1.5 years. Have not spent a penny on this game, so everyone saying you have to pay to beat the levels are lying. It takes persistence, patience and a lot of thinking to succeed. Only reason I have lowered my rating is because a few levels ago I got to the musical notes level, and since then the game has been laggy/glitchy. Please fix. My only suggestion to game creators is NEVER EVER make the levels timed.

Cute game, but requires three stars to progress and sometimes 4 as you get further. I really hate this. It's not fair when you work so hard to pass one level! Also, 900 in game dollars to continue?? When it takes more than ten levels to get that much? I got up to 617 and then couldn't progress because too many stars required. Plus you basically have to pay to play after awhile. It's not fair Devs.

NOT AS ADVERTISED. The ad is completely different from the game. In the ad you fix the sink with a wrench, or break the fish tank with a hammer, or spread a fire with a fan. In this game it's a candy crush type of game. You match 3 in a row and it fixes the house. What a waste of time. Dont advertise a false game. Very disappointed. Deleting the game solely on false advertisements, and the candy crush version isn't fun at all.

This game is complete and utter disappointment. The ads are for a game where you chose what tool would be the best to save the characters, but the actual game is completely different. All you do is play another match 3 game. After awile I got over that and decided to simply test out the game, but the game isn't even a good game. Some of the levels are ridiculously hard and even impossible to do without paying money and sorry, but you ain't getting a cent out of me.

Forcing me to pay? I think not. When I get a pop up that a certain level is so difficult that you're telling me to buy boosters to beat it, that's not cool. Then in order to get an extra try I also have to pay for coins? Not gonna happen. That and your ad doesn't even include the game play that's shown in it. FALSE ADVERTISING. I'd rather uninstall and that's what I'll do.

I deleted the app pretty quickly. I saw the ads and was interested because they were all about choosing the right things to either save the people or fix a house with fires and leaks and stuff. The game you actually get is just playing a candy crush like game and gaining one star to update an item in a house. It's ridiculous that they are advertising a completely different game, one which I would have definitely played. If you're getting this game thinking it's exactly like the ads, don't.

If you like match 3 games you'll like this one. I don't. And it seems every game like this is marketed deceptively now as something else. Basically you do progressively difficult match 3 puzzles as they slowly give you fewer boosts while simultaneously trying to push you to spend to get through. If I'm going to spend on a game it won't be this kind, although it must work since there are new ones every day.

It's ok, nothing special. But it's annoying. Too much work for simple little thingss. Plus you're limited to how much you can pay. I just turned the game on 5 minutes ago and already I can't play anymore. Very ridiculous. You want people to play but don't give them a chance to play?! I'm not waiting an hour or two for a heart to build up so I can do one single puzzle, and then repeat the process! These Mobile games get more ridiculous everyday! It's not even a fun game, it's boring and senseless

This game is great other than limitations on number of moves you can make in the mini game. and having to play the game in order to proceed is a little dumb. Also, it seemed like the game wouldn't let me win the last level I was needing to beat unless I paid money for more game money to extend the amount of moves I had so I could beat the mini game. Thanks, but no thanks. I'm not paying money just to win a puzzle.

It's time consuming and you need the patience of 3 gods in some levels. some days you log in just to get your bonus, not play. you used to be able to watch videos to get coins so I did that too. But they took that away! If they don't being them back I guess I stop at level 740 and uninstall. I ain't doing pay to play n win. Not when I can spend my money on easier games.

The game used to be much more fun, but since they cut the moves in half, it is nearly impossible to pass some of the levels (even when using powerups). Also, they added a Tournament of Champions, which you are forced to play, which is frustrating especially when the Tournament lasts 5 days and I barely get 1 day in between tournaments to work towards my own levels. I am probably going to stop playing this game as I don't want to spend money and it's not fun anymore.

The mini games are fun, as well as the storyline and fixing up the house, but it's not worth the time once you get to the higher levels. Unless you waste money (To buy items) or items, the higher levels will block you for days due to running out of lives. Being blocked means no story or progression. I'd rather play the mini games instead of the regular levels. That's actually why I downloaded the game.

I'd really like to love this game because it's cute and the fixing of the rooms is cute, but its toxic. I've been stuck on the same level for days and I cant even get close to what they want. the coins needed to add moves is ridiculously high and the powerup moves could be better designed. someone said it's not impossible, and that's fair, but the hard ones I passed was like the game took pity and went easy on me. I'm not spending 10 bucks to pass 1 level. i was looking for casual, not annoying.

The game is a waste of time. The customer service is the worst I've seen in Google games. I had to switch phones in any emergency, and after nearly a month, they still didn't fix my account event with screenshots .. every other game restored me within a week. Play Toon Blast Be instead .. same game but more challenging and more fun. Unless you spend shitloads of money this isn't worth checking your time.

Great game, would've given it 5 stars but the levels just drag on and on. I've been stuck in the garden level for ever and it's just add this thing, add that thing, add this thing, add that thing, on and on and on. I thought this would be a fun puzzle and decorate a house game, i mean they have a whole other decorate a garden game. Getting kinda old, might give up soon.

Can't buy from the shop. Was going to use my Google Reward Money, which currently has more than 5 bucks;(not much but still) and it says that I have zero dollars,which is wrong. It's whatever, I'll spend the money elsewhere. Besides,the levels begin to get harder to play and a lot of the moves are random and if you don't do them then there is no other move. So you are forced.

I enjoyed the fact they mix up the way you play the standard puzzle games. However, some of the puzzles are next to impossible to beat without a power up, some even if you have power ups. I've been on the same standard difficulty puzzle for 3 days now. Once you're stuck and out of coin, there's no way to earn more without making a real life purchase. And even if you, there's no guarantee you'll move on. Changing it so all power ups remaining after you're moves are up, may also help.

I should have read the reviews first! I wanted the game that "pull this pin/puzzle" what I got was a balloon pop/candy crush style game disguised as a refurbish a mansion game. I played for a day or so. Advanced quickly for awhile & then found the catch...either buy your way out with real money or play until the game decides to "let" you pass...which could be many many hours of play without any advancement at all. You don't even rack up any points at all for failed attempts you just lose a life.

I love fixing the house! Hate that the only way to get stars is to play the match game and the fact that you only get one star per game. And it costs too much just to get five more tries! Also why does so much money go into the deposit box and so little go into the piggy bank?!!?!! This game is made to take all your real money and gives you little fun remodeling in return!!!

i have been playing this game a long time and almost to level 1500. I do enjoy the game. However, i think there are too many missions per room and i think if we get free time as gifts then we shouldn't lose the time left because we have to get off the game. The free time we earn/gifts should be savable somehow! i hate it when i get a couple hours free time and i only have 30 minutes to play at that point, then i lose that extra time i could use later after i get home.

Let me be very clear. This "game's" sole design aspect is to get you to spend money. I figured I'd go as far as I could before it got unplayable. At this point when I beat a level it's more dumb luck than skill. Levels are so hard you cannot beat them without spending money, or stumbling your way into an extremely lucky power combo. At this rate, it's not even enjoyable when you manage to win. No one would buy this at $100 upfront but I bet a lot of people have trickled to that + over time.

Cool game to play but way too much money is being spent on the safe that’s in the upper right corner of your screen. It fills up to 12,000 coins max, and then you have to pay $5.99 to unlock it, only for the coins in there to be added to the coins you already have on the upper left side of your screen. I do not see the point in that. Just add all the coins together in one spot!! Unnecessary purchasing, you could almost go broke playing this game if you're carefully aware of your purchases!!

I shouldn't have to spend 2 hours trying to get past 1 F#$%ing level!!!!! What good are unlimited lives for 2 hours when you have to spend that much time on 1 level???? I had the rating at 2 stars....dropped it down to 1......wish I could go lower for all the time I wasted on 1 level....F#$% this game. Now I can't get the game to update when I tap the Install Button.....2nd time this has happened....

Same as Kristin Preston wrote below! The ad makes it look great, when really the game has nothing to do with what the ad portrays. Its a stupid candy crush style game and not like the ad at all. In the ad it shows you help the character along by choosing from 2 or 3 options, which item you want to give the character to help them out of their situation. Not stupid candy crush style puzzles. Make the game like the ad, and i will play it.

This isn't at all the game that was advertised, I started playing because I thought maybe it would get there but by the looks of it, it's just sleezy advertising. The levels have gotten way too hard, and I feel like the set up is intentionally manipulative: when you finally get unlimited lives for a certain amount of time, I don't actually want to waste two hours but then I do cuz I know that's the only way I can keep passing levels. And it costs way too many stars to do simple tasks.

I installed this game thinking it was going to be a decorating game. I wanted to decorate each room. Now I find the farther you get in the game, the more ridiculous things you have to do to just earn a few Stars. it completely went off track with the garden, the garage, Etc. each level is getting harder and harder and you can't win them without spending money. So no, I would not recommend it. I'm as far as the garage and I'm thinking about quitting the game altogether. I have already paid too muc

This ad is very deceptive. It seems this kind of ad is trending, and the quality of the assets is usually much lower than in the actual game. I play this game all the time. Its a match 3 puzzle where you earn stars to pay for completing actions. There is no point where Austin almost dies in a fire. Further more I can't imagine a scenario in which the game makers would have you decide if Austin would get to use the toilet or not. The new ads make the game look sleezy.

Used to play, but stopped when levels got repetitive and free to play rewards plateaued. Now I'm seeing ads with false gameplay and game mechanics copying the "War Hero" ads with the "what do you do next" and "how do you save this character" themed ads. Unfortunate that a mobile game company can't rely on the strength of their game to promote it and have to copy other companies deceitful marketing practices.

I love this game! Some elements of gameplay are very RNG-based, which can be a bother, and you must be careful when to use your boosters cause you dont want to be without them. But all in all this is the best game experience I've had with mobile games since it has no ads and is so well polished in every aspect! I love the story and renovating the house to my liking (though options are limited) proves fun too. This game soomehow makes me feel warm and safe !

I think for a casual game the challenges are hard, it takes forever to get anything done. I liked the game starting out and even spent my own money. I'm seriously thinking of uninstalling and finding something else Update: 3/19/20 Still not happy with this game :( you'll go broke playing this game. For the 3rd time I reinstalled only to realize you'll be stuck on the same level until you spend your own money on power ups and then 9 times out of 10 you still won't pass the level. Update 5/13/20

This game used to be so much fun for me. But once you get past the easy levels, it gets ridiculous. Their "super hard" levels are impossible to beat even with all the bonus stuff you can get, until you play the level over and over and over again. It shouldn't take me over 50 lives to beat a single level. Hard shouldnt equal literally impossible.

I love love love this game!! Play it everyday. However, I gave it 3 stars because you spend hundreds of levels on each area. I would like to be able to move rooms and areas at least after 100 levels. It is Homescapes and I've been outside in the garden decorating for weeks. Maybe a little less in each area would make it more enjoyable.

NOT what was advertised. If you're looking for a problem solving game like advertised. This is not it. This game is more like Bejeweled meat Candy Crush. I downloaded this game like many others based on the ad. When you search the game on the play store and click it a few of the pictures portray the ad that we fell for. The company seems to know about the false advertisement while also not caring. I mean there are alot of reviews about this and nothing changed.

I've been playing this game for a while (currently level 12,116), and lately, I've noticed the game is designed to cheat. Especially the planes. Also, they removed the side games I liked. I understand wanting to make money, but don't cheat me out of winning. Also, the amount of "money" you get for finishing a level has gone way down. When I first started the amount I'd get after a win was like 150-200+ coins, now I get like 25-40 coins. Will not continue much longer.

1. Austin is too old to be living at home 2. What's with all the stupid clapping? We aren't toddlers or attention-challenged dogs. Smh. Installed it, and uninstalled it within minutes. Lots of dialogue to read from the cartoon character. Bored me instantly. I'm also curious as to why this game and another by your company advertises it as a fun looking game of puzzles, but the puzzles are few and far between. Just more Candy Crush and home decorating. Terrible.

It is outrageous that a game advertising one thing is a completely different experience from it. If it were a store over here it would be penalized for false ads, too bad I have no idea how to do that here. Other than that the game itself is rather okay if you have patience and are rich. Ridiculous how much you need to do/have for each "harder" level. It's stressful. I won't recommend it.

I really hate the addition of the mini-games. Thankfully, you can skip them but I don't understand why they're in this game. The art style remind me of Family Guy, which is cheap-looking compared to the highly detailed artwork throughout the main game. On top of it, the theme of the mother/child duo living in poverty is so disturbing. This was probably added as it's trending in mobile games (especially towards women). It's creepy and gross. Uninstalled.

I like garden scapes, home scapes not as good, but what is horrible is that the adds through other apps is not actual game play! It makes it seem like a completely different game and other apps use the same animation to get you to click and download the game when it has nothing to do with the the actual game play. There is no disclaimer that this is "not actual game play." If it said that, they could have saved themselves, but they didn't so congrats on false advertising.

It was fun for a time. Now the devils at Playrix are just using it as a piggybank. As recent as a few months ago, you could spend $10 & get a huge haul of coins/boosters. You could never spend any money & still make incremental progress. Not anymore. Prices have TRIPLED, and you get less for anything you do spend. Furthermore, if you no longer spend money, the algorithms actively work against you so that you cannot complete levels. I'm playing a lot less; deleting soon.

Think you're getting a puzzle game? Think again. I've watched the ads for over a months flashing across my screen and finally decided to give it a shot. It's boring as hell. You have to buy items in the game and you do that by playing a candy crush style game. Back and forth, boring slow game with a lot of text, then stupid crush game. Screw that. Uninstalled after 5 minutes

This game is not as advertised. It is a puzzle game where you have to get at least 3 Crystal's of the same type together to get them to disappear. Sound familiar? You do this so you can "remodel" your house but you have no real control. At some point, you have to purchase "help" for the puzzles or you are stuck as they become unbeatable without these extra items.

The developers engineer a lot of the levels to take your money. An example is the airplane AI targets a grid square instead of the puzzle piece in the square, which means if the puzzle piece you were hoping it would hit moves, sorry about your luck. It's all about human greed and making you spend your hard-earned money to progress. Don't bother with this one, it's pay-to-win.

I've been playing this game for over a year now, and I'm begging y'all PLEASE GO BACK TO THE OLD ANIMATIONS!!! I hate these new animations, they don't match the game, are too cartoonish for the rest of the games style, and when using the bomb powerup the area they blow up looks like it should be bigger, but it's not because the animation makes it look inaccurate!! Overall the game itself is so fun, but the new animation makes my head spin!!

The only game that has kept me playing well over a year. ..and still going over a year later. This game has my only down time. It's a bit of my happy place. Because of that though, I cant stay awake more than a few rounds now. Life just wont slow down anymore, but at least there's a glimmer of the melancholy while I play. Thanks :) Years later, they've now made it just a cash grab and it's full of deception. Regular levels are actually hidden hard levels. One star used to equal one percentage.

I installed this from an ad in another game. The ad showed a logic puzzle in which you have to move certain levels to release hot coals into a fireplace without accidentally releasing water that would extinguish the fire. What I got instead was a "game" where I'm responsible for repairing and redecorating a house. Interspersed within that game are other puzzles, most of which I'm not interested in. What's advertised is one of those extra puzzles - but one you won't get to for quite a while.

It's a cool game but I hope you get to see your FB friend's house too, i mean i know you have the same house but the design isn't. Another thing is, please find a way where we can earn additional money. Like we're playing for 18 levels or less only to surrender it for just 5 moves, 900 is too much dear. Aaannd, there are so many extra activities that we didn't even need like greet the visitor lol, buy the cat stuff.

I am changing my review from five stars to three. This game is absolutely beautiful and totally fun... Until you get to the levels approaching 100. I'm convinced some of these levels are bordering on Impossible even with as many boosters as you could buy with real life money. That's not fun. Gardenscapes was playable. This is not. This stinks like a bunch of executives in a boardroom decided how they could squeeze every last penny out of the player. I feel bamboozled.

The game is not like what they advertise, infact it's candy crush game with story mode (not that boring though). The game play they advertise was a one time deal that i got to play at around level 250. To advance in this game (for F2P) you need to invest lot of time. The higher the level the harder the game becomes which is not the problem. The problem is the life the player has is only 5 and for f2p someone needs to spend more than 30 minutes/day if want to advance in game.

The game itself is a good game. It's the season pass that's an issue! You can play the game and once you've gotten enough ...."points" I guess(?) then you get your prize. Half the issue is that it takes entirely too long to even get the prizes, the other issue is the decorations you recieve as a prize! Absolutely no one needs useless decorations! We pay real money to be able to receive 2 prizes each time we've accumulated enough points,only for one of those "prizes" to a decoration!

So I've been playing this game for a while, and have enjoyed it. I saw the original ads that showed actual gameplay (which were cool). Now whenever i try to share this game with others they say "oh the lame figure out the solution to the burning house game? No thanks." i saw the false advertising with Gardenscapes but Devs, you've taken it too far doing this with Homescapes. Show the gameplay! the fact that you think you have to hide behind a gimmicky ad shows you aren't confident in your work!!

I have been playing this game since 2019 and I really love it!! I don't even mind the hard levels; I'm at level 11055. However, I am soooo tired of the adventure side quests or whatever they're called. After so many adventure quests, which I come no where close to finishing by the way, it has become boring. Bring back the other game or the side fashion makeovers or room redesigns. And what are the cards about? I don't get that concept at all.

Another fake "free" game that charges you a lot of money to progress. It draws you in with its charming characters and interesting storylines, but only has two different puzzle types on repeat to progress. Until, of course, it programs it so you can't progress beyond a certain point without paying, using psychological FOMO tactics against you to spend all your points then money in-game to continue. Too bad. I almost spent a few dollars to support it and I'm hella glad I didn't. Time waster!

I've been playing this game since it was released and just like all the other playrix games, it has gone from 5 stars to 1 star by way of the sheer greed that is playrixs business model. This last update made clearing levels impossible without power ups, in an attempt to get players to spend real money(won't even mention how ridiculously difficult their Halloween cash grab is). In a matter of 5 levels, I've had 2 of the new "super hard levels," 1 of which is where I am now stuck. To make matters worse, I've been stuck in the garden for a hundred or so levels, with no end in sight. If I wanted to be there, I would have not uninstalled gardenscapes! Congrats playrix, you have managed to make a player who will spend real money and made them absolutely refuse to spend a penny more on any of your games.

I'm going to rate this game at this time because it has frozen only on the third level. I purchased all the Easter promotion and got the "Special gift." However, when the gift was the bunny bed, it popped into the first bedroom(blinking), and the promotion special WON'T CLEAR so I can continue playing the game. Furthermore, as much money as I've spent or anyone else, they could at least gift us with extra boosters. Thank You.

I used to give this game 5 stars, but this one and Gardenscapes has really begun to frustrate me having hard levels and super hard levels almost every other game. Used to get 2 stars for beating the super hard levels, but that was taken away, which sucks. I should be much further than I am in both games, but the levels have become so ridiculous that I just run my lives out and try back a different day, only to be stuck on the same level for days or even weeks at a time.

Glad I waited a few weeks to write a review. The game is fun at first but then (as many reviewers pointed out) it becomes next to impossible to complete levels without powerups and while you can earn some for free, you'd still need way more of them to get ahead. It's not really fair and becoming less and less enjoyable. who has time to spend 10 lives on one level?! brutal.

At first this game seems good...but after you get into it you find it's geared to make you spend real money. If you don't want to become frustrated, don't bother with this game. It is extremely hard to beat the levels without buying something. What's so fun about a game you can't play without losing unless you buy 'bonuses '? This game like so many others will be uninstalled.

Some levels are just ridiculously hard! You are forced to spend money just to beat one level. Also, I can't believe I have to give 2-4 stars to do something so pointless, or not really that important, like calling someone sometimes would cost you 2-3 stars. It's so annoying! I expected a lot with all the updates you are doing, but I am always disappointed. I used to really love and enjoy this game, but now, I just get annoyed playing it.

I played this game for about a day hoping to eventually get to a level that would allow me to play one of the puzzle games shown in EVERY ad for Playrix developed games. Nope, no such gameplay. Every game of theirs that I've tried is simply a variation on match 3. No saving the (man and woman, fish, princess, you name it). Just a match 3 game to get some kind of reward so you can add content to your (garden, house, aquarium, ad nauseum). People who enjoy match 3 might enjoy Playrix. Not for me.

First of all there is false advertisement. They use a false add to draw you in. Then they try to take your money to solve puzzles that you can't solve for free. I highly recommend you do not play this game, essentially the game designers want money so they put out false advertisements and made it impossible to play w/o $$$! This app is not worth your time. Save your time and download a game that doesn't scheme and that's honest. If the advertisements aren't honest, the game probably isn't either.

I have enjoyed playing for a long time , I logged in today to see that everything you can purchase went up from a dollar, to as much as 20 dollars..the amount a player like myself spends you'd think prices would go lower or stay the same.. I just bought the season pass. Lasts Bout 20 days..And then I'm logging out for the last time. I can't afford it any longer.. not at these prices. Unfortunately it's sad to say, alot of others are feeling the same way. Well it was fun while it lasted!

This game was fun in the beginning. If you contribute to the platform and move forward, you are penalized. Their option for running out of levels is "Tournament of Champions". At this level, you don't move off insanely difficult levels without spending $$$$$$. Therefore, you are unable to gain ANY rewards, or contribute to your team. Maybe play for fun, but beware if you spend. Counter productive to slap the hands of players who do spend money on this game!

The add makes it look the game is slecting the right tool to fix broken stuff around a house. Nope. This is Candy Crush with a "story" between levels. I thought if i played lobg enough, I'd get to those levels, but after reading reviews that does not seem to be the case. So, if you want to play the game that was advertised, prepare for disappointment. This is not that game.

Used to be a good game. Developers got greedy, put in a "tournament" that you can't avoid. 5 day event where you make no progress in the storyline. Followed by 1 day playing Homescapes and then another tournament. Tournament prizes are nothing and difficulty is maxed to try and get you to spend money. I have been playing for years. But if I can't advance through the storyline, it's time to delete and find another match game

These ads need to stop! I played this game for a while after installing it based on the old ads - which showed the real gameplay - and I played it for a long time, but now I am seeing these horrible, fake ads everywhere and it makes me furious. I would have given this game a good review if they hadn't continued with such shameless, deceitful marketing. Game developers: if you think your game is so bad that you can't even advertise the real game, then make it better!

Its a rip off. Costs a fortune to progress through the game .That being said, it is addictive to see what the next task is. Developers will be happy because that is their objective. I think that the developers should allow unlimited lives and coins after a certain amount of money has been spent such as $$500 max. Other games can be purchased outright for much, much less.So how about it guys?? Come to the party for all your long term players.

This game is rigged like most playrix games. Some levels don't seem like chance. They seem like it's purposely giving you the worst possible move or keep pieces away from each other, so you can't pair them up. Like the others, the difficulty rating seems questionable at times and and event calls to beat hard levels for example, they take forever to come. Gets worse every update. It's like the levels are designed to force you to spend game money to continue because you win 1-2 moves later.

Played a few years ago. Not my style of game, nothing wrong with that. Don't personally have the patience for these types of games. HOWEVER, I have been seeing the ads for this game, and it is despicable in my opinion. Complete textbook example of false advertising. Cater to the people who have problems and work on keeping your current customer base happy, don't deceive others into downloading a what will be to them a lie.

This isn't like what I saw in the ad with dragging items to fix things. This is more like candy crush. Also in the levels 50+, its impossible to beat unless you play out all your lives over and over again, or Buy packages! I went through 12,000 coins in a little over an hour. I am pretty good at these games too. Which leads me to believe that its rigged. Its all about continuously spending money.

Waited until I got further in the game to leave a review. I knew it would end up getting ridiculous. I'm only in the 600s (currently the game has 16,000 levels) and every 3 levels you either have to spend money or play the level for 4+ days. The game used to be relaxing and satisfying, now its just frustrating and not worth it lol. It's free to play so I get it to a point, but Playrix has a way of sucking the fun out of all their games because of money. It's why I don't play Township anymore.

This game used to be 5 stars, but I have noticed some of the challenge games are difficult to finish because the algorithm is set to not give you Hard or Super Hard games to complete when you need them (I've kept track). And super hard doesn't count as hard? In games with the white bars that block moves, the planes will not go to those spaces to clear them, even if that is all that remains. They will do something absolutely useless. Sucks all the fun out of the game. Will spend no more money.

Utterly disappointed! After years of playing this game and making countless in game purchases. The creators of this game have taken it upon themselves to remove me as leader of the team I created and paid for with my money! And their reason, I was inactive for more than 14 days! After years of playing and many long breaks from the game in the past and never having this problem, suddenly there is a 14 day activity rule! The crators of the game are happy to take your money, but not happy to help!!

Had another account but restarting a new one just for fun. great game except i hate it when the rocket power up flew to the rainbow powerup. i wanna keep it but since it was used i lost some level which cd have been won.

i like the fact that you unlock story as you play. makes it feel more interesting addition: still enjoy the game as a side play here and there. My only complaint now is the recent misleading advertisements. I've seen dozens of games do this and I hate seeing this one do the same. Please advertise the game in its greatness and not one of those trashy "OMG why is this game so hard???" blow outs. lowering rate for false advertisement continuing.

This game is a joke now. Playing same levels for a week with all power ups and can't advance.Seems to be a money grab now. I have this game for few years. It used to be fun to play. Now levels are impossible to complete even with the 30 min free life and power ups. Takes weeks to get through some levels. When you haven't got 900 coins to buy more moves they offer you 35 moves. When you have the 900 coins you only can buy 5 more moves. They just want to get you to spend your money. Disappointing.

The game is super fun, killing boredom, love that. There was an update recently which completely changed the animations, the looks of power ups, and honestly, I think they look awful. The previous ones were much better, and looking at many bombs or paper planes exploding was super satysfying. But after changing the animations it looks much worse. The idea was good, 3d animations, but it didn't turn out so well. Bring them back pls 🙏🏻 Overall I really like the game

This used to be my favorite game but for some reason, I was accused of using a third party app or something to hack & they banned me from being on a team. I've tried contacting support several times, trying to figure out what happened but they keep saying the same thing & then closing the conversation. I'm very upset. I don't even know how to hack. 😖 Also, they make it very hard to beat harder levels without using coins or boosters. I've played certain levels for weeks, refusing to buy anything

Like all Playrix games, you can have some fun playing......until....... You will get to an impossible point where you have to spend money to continue. Ad sales aren't enough, they have to get in your wallet. This game was fun until level 80. An impossible level without buying your way through it. They will say, use your tools....... well, I had nearly 30 of all tools and in a week's time exhausted all of them and the level is still unsolved.

This game is very fun.... in the beginning. Then as the mini games get harder I've found that the only way to pass them is to spend money and purchase boosters. I understand the company trying to make money with the game, but they make the mini games almost impossible to beat unless you spend more money. I thought it would be fun and relaxing, instead it turned into nickle and diming g me to death, just to get to the fun parts. Not worth the stress... it's just a game.

There is a daily gift now and the levels are easier. There are mini games that let you earn tools to help with levels. Great story. Edit. I feel I have to share, I dropped into a depression and played this game a lot. Austin, the Main Character kept saying "I know why I'm so down, I haven't done my stretches today." and he'd do a mini exercise. I didn't want to be down anymore so every time he'd say that I'd force myself up and do his strectchs with him. I'm not out of the woods but, almost.

I spent days playing this game, and trust me, you wont be able to progress further without paying the game. The difficulty become more insane at the point it's imposible to beat the game just with power ups,, the only way to do it is by buying more action point using the gold. And you have to pay the gold. Thats it. I'm finished with this game.

It's an alright game but I've been stuck in level 28 for a week now. It's very clear that you either have to pay for powerups or waste your time hoping you get lucky and clear the level.. can't see myself spending money on this game in hopes I can clear a level. Would be nice if difficult levels aren't made for to spend money on. Sadly, I am going to be uninstalling this game.

This game is OK. Good for hours of mindless fun. But 200 levels in the garden??? Isn't there an ENTIRE other game devoted to gardening? Also, while I can appreciate a good story line, the number of sidequests and levels required to work your way through has me feeling like i just can't make any progress in any reasonable amount of time.
