I don't need infinite lives for hours on end. I don't have that kind of time. Give me some useful "prizes".

the current monotary system is a toxic one, the game is for all ages but in all cannot be played without spending real money to finish a puzzle, i tried both.. wanna know a fun fact? once you buy some gold to increase the amount of moves you make the game instantly gives you the correct colors and increases the amount of ''special'' blocks(explosives,colorpickers etc), i cant do a complete review as that would require more than 500 words, at any rate i can advice not to play this game.

Money grab plain and simple. While not the worst one out there unless you wish to sink more into the game each month than it would be to buy something of this style outright you will be waiting around a lot and rarely able to complete various timed events. The reason I'd have a game like this is to unwind on break or to occupy me while waiting... not just play a few minutes to wait for refills or adds ect. It also does not measure up the the adds. They were misleading

I'm finally deleting this game. I commented, I suggested, but yet again, there's a prompt to pave more of the outside. Who are you people who are trying to pave the planet? Chinese? Besides, the appeal was to renovate a house. I haven't done any inside work in at least 100 levels, probably more. If I wanted to pave a garden, I would play GardenScapes. Seriously, it's poor design to ONLY offer choices of paving stones, with no eco-friendly options! Please, please, please, let one of the 3 garden choices be to level the grass, or lay sod, not pave the whole thing. I had no choice but to pave the whole garden and that's just wrong.

They have made gameplay on harder levels so insanely difficult that it takes days, over a week sometimes to pass levels, I'm assuming to force players to purchase upgrades and packs. The moves allocated to difficult levels make them impossible to beat no matter how many extra bombs you have. It's too much. I'm so over this game now, it's a waste of time and money. Edit: I'm glad they made it so hard as a cash grab because it pushed me to uninstall and stop wasting time and money on this.

Game is nothing like the ads they show in other games (aka the first item / the video they show at the top of this app page). It's just another matching game like Candy Crush or Cookie Jam. Played it for a few levels and thought the game would change, it didn't, and then I searched online to see if it ever does... which it doesn't. The video is false advertising. If you came here looking to play THAT game, it isn't here. If you want yet another match-3 reskin, you've found one.

This game is too difficult for kids but not user friendly for adults. Theres too much animation and the free game time given is at the worst times. You cannot just jump on the game here and there. It's like they want you glued to the game all the time and working adults cannot so that. Otherwise, itd be a great game. Make some changes. Stop all the animation. Let us have a gift pile for our free hours or free 30 min game times so we can choose when we use it.

The advertisement indicated that the character would have decisions that could kill the character or allow the character to encounter the next event. I have reached level 24. It was nothing like its advertisement at all. In fact, it is the most boring game i have found. If i wanted a simple home design game, there are plenty to choose from. In fact, i believe they would be more entertaining.

Starting of this game, they will let you pass all the levels. But once you reach level 400+ above, they will start to make you lose, start to not let you mix and match with the colours to get a bomb or something. Start to not let you pass your level. Why? Because they want you to purchase their item in order to pass the level. They hook you to the game and make sure you cannot wait for it and purchase their item(Live♥️) to continue playing it. Rating 3/10 Bad.

Title: Fun but Too Hard to Progress, The game is really fun and challenging at first, but as you go on, the difficulty spikes. The levels become so tough that you need boosters or coins to progress. The problem is, coins are too expensive and the amount you earn from normal levels is way too low—often just 10 coins. It becomes frustrating because you either need to grind a lot or spend money to continue, which takes away from the fun.

I love this game. I've invested time and money into. The lvls get harder and to beat, as time goes on. You get stuck on lvls for days, spend money to try and beat it, and nothing. I've seen help a friend out before, but have not seen it in ages. This is something that should be brought out, once a month. But your company is creedy and all about the bottom dollar. So until this is brought back and out once a month, I will no longer spend money on the game, and call all players to do the same.

I downloaded because the mind puzzles shown during the ads in other games looked very interesting. However, the game was simply decorating walls, floors and furniture. I didn't see one single thing resembling the ads. Granted, they were probably further into the game but I don't have the patience to continue a child's deco game hoping that something that tests my mind MAY be hidden somewhere.

Once again another game from the same company with the same lazy and misleading advertising... It's a candy crush rip-off with a home improvement mechanic to make it seem original but it isn't... It's annoying to see the flat out fake ads for this game for more than half a minute only to endure an extra 15 seconds of their fake gameplay in the ad... Just use a few seconds of gameplay footage for your ads and you should be fine. There is no need to lie to your potential audience...

I love this game, as well as Fishdom & GardenScapes, playing 3-4 years.. a slight addiction, and probably overspend on transactions --> For those that say, you need to spend $$ to beat levels (my $.02 -->) The devs have to make a living, and a lot of work goes into creating and maintaining these games.. To not pay something (minimum, every now & then), while leaving neg reviews, is like asking the devs to create glitch-free, AD-FREE, entertaining and challenging games, for free! Just sayin

Dear Homescapes. If I wanted to play Candy Crush, then that is the game I would have chosen. I chose your game because of the advertisements for the other puzzles. It is not fun to spend 2 days trying to beat 1 candy crush level only to get 1 star. I appreciated the story line but again, to make levels so hard that it takes hours to complete, and then you still don't have enough rewards to continue the story line....... That to me is not enjoyment. I'm sorry.

I stopped playing the game for twelve hours. During that time, all of my gifted lives were gone and none of my lives were refreshed. When I went to the "Chat Feature" of the support portion in the game and explained what transpired, nothing. No feedback. I believe that the Chat box is ran by bots. Not a good experience, especially after all of the hours and Google Play transactions that I have made. Think twice before downloading and playing this game!

I've been playing this game for some time now. I'm on levels 1400. I'm starting to notice that this game actually be cheating. I always though that it might be glitches. But no, they're definitely cheating to make you make some in app purchases. For example, I had two rainbow balls and all I had to do was combine them to beat the level with one move left. I swipe down to combine them, but it went up and I ended up not beating the level. That made me convinced that this game cheats you.

This game model is ridiculous. How is it supposed to be fun when you're limited on tries to beat a level per so many minutes, and it takes a week to beat a level and advance in the game? Currently stuck on level 82, and I can tell by the game design that it goes on for much, much longer than that. I've only just started on the kitchen! I'll probably be giving up on this game soon, just like every other game like it before.

Not enough moves to get passed the harder levels. It takes to long, days to get passed certain levels. I don't like games where you are stuck on levels for a long amount of time, I know you want everyone to spend money on these games but some of us just don't have money like that. Can't even play a "free" game for free anymore.

The advertisement of this game and the game itself is so different. Dont waste your time on this, you're better off downloading the candy crush game directly and playing that instead. Such a waste of time... because after the first few levels, it becomes impossible to move forward and the coins you get is so so so little to decorate your house.... They definitely want you to pay in order to play.

Uninstalling immediately! This game was fun at the beginning but that ended fast. I got quite far in and the levels seem to be impossible to play. This game prompts false advertising, and only wants your money. If you don't pay, you won't be able to get that far. This is truly sad and disappointing, this game was fun and could have been great. This is the second shot I have given and it's the last.

Lately, the game messes with you to make it impossible to pass a level, especially if you're very far into the game. (I'm currently at lvl 5000+.) You swipe a piece in one direction, and it'll move in another, screwing your over. And without passing those levels to get extra energies, time limited adventures are impossible to be completed in time. The devs probably think that by doing this, we'll spend more money on this game. Guess what? I've lost interest in this game and I'm quitting.

Let's start with the false advertisement. There are technically games as you see in the ads but they are rare, so easy it's insulting, and damn near pointless. It's actually just candy crush with a bit more direction. Next let's talk about the pay wall. The devs are good about responding to complaints about it but it's always to contact them for tips. As if to suggest these are beatable in any realistic fashion. But don't worry. They have MANY options available to pay your way through.

This game is a scam. It's all about getting you to pay for coins (which they over charge for) pay for the add ons, use everything up as fast as they can make you so you have to buy more stuff. They even cheat you on the different levels and make it almost impossible to win so you use and buy more things on the app to win. It's a fun game but totally charges way to much for everything. Smh not sure if I'm going to keep it or remove it completely. I've already spent alot on it and in a few weeks!!

I've played this game for a long time. Now, I have reached the point where I'm being forced to either spend real money or waste countless lives to try to pass a level. I just spent 2 weeks trying to pass a "super hard" level, then played one level, and it's immediately another "super hard" level. It's unfortunate that the game makers are trying to bully players into spending real money on a "free" game.

Context: I'm in the mid 1400s for levels (yes 1400). I've been playing for over a year. After spending a good amount on this game because I enjoy the zen of the game play - there is nothing more frustrating than this alarm clock game functionality. This game is KNOWN for being pay to win... But the alarm clocks go beyond, pretty much directly taking from players through making them buy more lives if they don't match them out in time, or use power ups. How powerless I feel as a player to not be supplied with the pieces to move on, but rather see this blinking power up item on the side. Congratulations at making the least player focused choices to unempower the player and pretty much directly ask them to put money into the game to win. Feels bad.

Everyone is free to love what they love playing. What makes me unhappy with some developers is when they falsely advertise their game everywhere. I finally decided to try this game and the advertising wasn't anything like it showed. The game plays fine, easy levels are well easy and the hard ones will make you struggle it is a match 3 game but, the deception from all its ads is a deal breaker for me. I can't trust a developer if they can't even be honest with their game advertising.

I installed this app because of their ads, showing puzzles to solve. But it's bait and switch. You're basically playing candy crush with a few scenes spread between levels. I don't want to waste my time and money on this game when it doesn't play like the ads show. I feel like the company that produces this game lies to us. If you want to play a candy crush-like game, go for it. But just say no to this company's deception

It started out as promised, but then it became like every other match game with way too many other things... I don't want stories, card collecting, or strange side quests. I just want to match and decorate (even though your options aren't the greatest). You over promised and under delivered. I deleted my account and uninstalled the app. How disappointing.

In order to get anywhere further than the living room in this game, you have to pay, and that's ridiculous. The freefall minigames are designed for you to use up all of your lives, and if you do win, some of your coins go to a "gold reserve" that you have to buy back with actual money later. Also, you don't get to play the puzzles they put in their ads except for every 20 or so levels! That's the whole reason I downloaded the game. Not to play Candy Crush 🙄 This game is a joke.

Game is completely misleading. It's add would have you think it's a fun, interesting puzzle game where you go around getting people out of sticky situations. In reality, it's a skin for Candy crush with a "Butler fixes the place" storyline. Completely false advertising and should not be legal. If you like Candy crush you'll probably like this, but it's not what I expected.

Level 1518 is one example of why it is a waste of time. Leaves you frustrated and out of livrs. Dialogue is dull. I stopped buying golden ticket. Waste of money and having more lives available means my frustration lasts longer . I have spent days trying to get passed some levels. Eventually I do but at the price of not enjoying gameplay. The side events also lack interest. I can't play them without winning levels to gain tokens. I never completed any.

Waiting on lives is frustrating. Also, the higher up you are puts you at a disadvantage due to tougher games. Some games higher up don’t seem winnable without purchasing items. I play other games where this isn’t an issue, so it makes the games more enjoyable. This is a mediocre game, and I find myself playing it less frequently these past few weeks weeks because of this. I want to have fun, not feel like my arm is being twisted to put a lot of money into doing that.

Payable offline, no ads. Need I say more? Ok I will. It's got nice graphics and soundtrack without too many obnoxious sound effects. Being able to preview the "homescape" is nice and makes a great incentive. I also like the storyline. The butler is witty and clever and I find the touch of realism (neighbors with an actual character and they chat with one another via Facebook) to be a nice addition. Overall a good game. Btw at the time of this post I had not played nor updated in probably a year. But I can't imagine how they'd mess it up, it's a cool game as is ^_^

This game is the second worst cheating game I've ever played. I had to use over 20,000 coins in about a two hour period to finish some puzzles. I've spent my last dollar with you, Playrix. I've spent way too much on this game as it is. I have a compulsion to finish anything I start, so I have to finish this. Thankfully, I'm close to finishing the amusement park area. After that, I'm uninstalling the game. The game isn't even anything like the ads it portrays. FALSE ADVERTISING!!!

This game definitely preys on the sunk-cost fallacy more than anything else. After a while, it stops being fun and pushes you to either spend a week on a level or to spend money to blast through it. It's ridiculous. I would not recommend to anyone, particularly people who struggle with any kind of addictive tendencies. Unlocking new rooms is literally the only fun you'll have after a while.

Im like almost 700 levels deep and only opened up like less than 10 areas. Which is pretty gay, coz theres too many little things to do in between, "recieve a gift" blah blah there goes all the stars you've earned. And then it's pretty much just candy crush with different items instead of candy, I thought it would be more puzzles like advertised.

Used to enjoy playing this game to pass time. But turned into a pay to play. The algorithm has changed, and now you can tell the game has changed to be designed to get consumers to pay in order to advance. Otherwise, you will play one level 20 plus times or more just to get through. Bottom line I deleted this game and app out of my phone along with any other games by this company . Garden escape etc.

The game becomes unfair at higher levels. It has two stages but only 15 moves, making it nearly impossible to complete without buying extra moves. No matter how strategically I play, the number of moves is just too low. The only way to get extra moves is to stop playing the game for few weeks, which is frustrating and unreasonable. It feels like the game is designed to force players into purchases rather than skill-based gameplay. Very disappointing. Uninstalled.

Pay 2 Win match 3. Seems fun, cute, & different with the story & home rebuilding. However, you'll quickly learn that this game wasn't made to be enjoyed. It was made to be so hard that you'll spend hours, days, weeks, maybe months on one level till you either want to throw your cell across the room or shell out real money to beat the level. They'll toss you a bone by letting you win a "super hard" level but the next basic one is insanely difficult. These games should be banned for exploitation.

I played this game up to some 38th level. Got stuck on a level with 11 moves to clear 27 foams or whatever. Seriously?!?!?!? I’ve already spent enough money on this game. The number of levels where it’s IMPOSSIBLE to win without paying just keeps climbing every 100 levels, but 11 moves is straight-up ridiculous for this one. You don’t give a damn about players, so I’m done caring about your game. Uninstalled.

The game is NOTHING LIKE THEY ADVERTISE!! It is just another one of those stupid 'line up 3 things' games. This is the 3rd and last time that I will download one of these. The ad shows a guy getting into trouble, and we get to choose one of three tools to help him (rebuild the sink, tape up a pipe, etc.) THIS IS NOT THAT GAME. STRAIGHT CLICK BAIT. DO NOT DOWNLOAD. This game lets you play 5 rounds, then its impossible to go any further without spending real money to buy more 'stars' TOTAL RIP

While this game is fun, it is also very frustrating. I often get kicked out of a game, mid game and then lose my bonuses. I also often get bonuses and coins banked and then they disappear. So if you want to play a fun game for fun then this could be it. But if you want to play a game and compete among others and even yourself and advance to next levels this is probably not the game for you. I am going to delete both of them and find a different yet similar game without all the glitches

I've been playing this game for four years, but I couldn’t play for five months. When I resumed, I found new rules seemingly designed to encourage spending. Reducing coins earned in standard levels from 50 to just 10 makes it too hard to save for tough levels. Now, some levels require spending coins to continue, even if you have power-ups. If you can't earn enough coins to save for when you need them, you're forced to buy. It's really disappointing.

The game itself is meh, kind of fun but mostly just a different version of Candy crush. I gave it a one star review because I find the false advertising to be infuriating. This game is absolutely nothing like the advertisement show. Also, dear game developers or whoever actually replies to things like this, how do you explain the difference between advertisements, which you obviously put a fair amount of money and time towards, and the actual gameplay?

Game is not as advertised, it is a cheap candy crush, there is NO scenario fix or destroy. Some of the levels are far too hard early on that they clearly are trying to force you to pay for the extras to win. Some of the levels are nothing more than pure luck. 30min life reload time is too long. At this rate won't play long as been stuck on the same level for 2 days and approx 60+ failed attempts.

Been playing for years and I love it! I have it installed on multiple devices and they all sync without problem. There are daily prizes, tons of events, they even allow you to join teams. And sometimes allow team members to play levels for you. Some events are longer like or a month and some ar three day short. And there is almost always two or three events at a time. The mini games come after you pass a few levels. Highly recommend!

The game is different from what they show in the ads. If you see the ad, you'd think you'll be spending time repairing everything in your house but NOOOOO. YOU SPEND MOST OF YOUR TIME MATCHING AND SOLVING PUZZLES INSTEAD. The game says "redesign your beautiful mansion while solving puzzles along the way" but I honestly think it's the other way around. Your time revolves around solving puzzles.. Never ending puzzlesssssss. 😒

Great game, very addictive and very challenging at times. Nice to see how the property gets transformed with every level passed. Unlike what has been said in other reviews you do not have to spend money on this game. Be patient and do not overuse your rewards. I’m on level 1782 and I have not spent a single penny. Join a group that actually has people that play and you can earn coins during group challenges and then use your coins wisely for additional plays. If you want an easy game this is not for you. The challenge is what makes the game great.

I feel like I've been catfished. The ad for this game is literally nothing like the game itself. The game in the ad seemed like a simple little game to pass time and entertain myself, so I downloaded it. Then, turns out, the game is just a cheap knock-off of candy crush or something. You're fixing a house up by combining candies. I'm surprised the company isnt being sued.

This game use to be so much fun. Just recently they took away the opportunity to earn coins by watching ads. Which is very frustrating. The levels are getting way too hard to enjoy. And the events aren't fun anymore. They make items too expensive to buy. It seems to me the only way I can enjoy this is if I spend my real money on it. Ain't going to happen! Definitely not recommending this game.

How about with how the world is right now you change your coding to give more lives, renew lives faster, cheaper buying options, easier to attain rewards.......the list goes on for how a simple app. can work to make this awful time better. Other games apps. I play have done this to keep people inside. I was upset at the misleading advertising that got me to play this game to start with but I have stuck with it. Now I am upset I cant play much stuck inside without paying to continue.

Downloaded it because the ad made it look like an enticing puzzle escape game but then ended up with a second-rate candy crush. Would actually rate zero stars if I could just for how much the false adverts annoy me. Don't show people a logic puzzle and then give them a rip-off of another game we've seen a thousand times. The graphics aren't even the same.

On update: Thank God you removed extra lifes from wheel, at one point I had 30+... What's up with you people, when I started I was frustrated with star earning, but it's really not that hard. I play Gardenscapes too. It goes slow with progress because they can't make up millions of rooms and if you do it in a day what's the point. This is a match game, so you have to play match, but it's not a stupid match game. It has bunch of other fun stuff to do. But you can't ask creators to cut out match part, or to not make it harder along the way. I am at level 500 and something and not bored, and at Gardenscapes I am level 1200 and something. Yes, some areas are more interesting than the others but I love this game and give it a 5 star rating. I never had a glitch in this game, and am surprised that others did... Just want to say, that with orangery part is a bit boring, but am intrigued by the romance of our favourite butler, is this a thing, or am I only tripping... Good work guys, game is so good!

I love this game as well as garden scapes what makes me begin to dislike it is the fact that one has to spend weeks on a level all to use 4 to 6 stars in nothing special. It is really ANOYING. Hope you work on that. This game is for fun and to test your brain but doesn't mean having headache for fun. A game where I have to spend more than a month on just one game is sickening. I'm beginning to be discouraged. I so loved this game till it started becoming a headache .

I've been playing a couple years. I had been enjoying it but these days every other level is hard or superhard and it takes money and weeks to get out of it. I've literally spent hundreds and just can't do it anymore. The more you break down and buy, the harder it gets. I'm on a super hard level again. I just got out of one. I'm thinking this game has to go. I love playing, but it costs hundreds of $'s after a while.

The ads, where you see the guy madly putting out fires and fixing other household disasters, are the reason I downloaded this. But I played it for a good hour, quickly getting through all challenges, and it turns out it's just Candy crush, with a different premise and a dumb story. I'm sure that eventually I'd get to the stuff from the ad that looked so fun, but how long? I got burnt out on the candy crush template years ago. Can not possibly recommend.

I played this game for YEARS but have uninstalled it today. The developers have made the game nearly impossible to pass levels without spending real money. The more difficult the level, the LESS moves there are to play-- an obvious ploy to make people spend money. We used to have 30 moves to win and now it averages 15 or LESS! It's a huge disservice to loyal players who have spent real money in the past. BUYER BEWARE!! This game is a MONEY PIT now and only creates frustration!!!

False advertising. Just another match 3 game, Candy crush clone, nothing at all like the add. Even though I like some match 3 games, I refuse to keep any with false advertising like this. How hard is it to be honest in the add? They don't care though, I fell for it, downloaded and tried it. That's their business model, they made their money.

Game is nice for awhile but by the 50s and 60s levels, which only take a few days to get to, becomes nearly impossible to complete unless you use up most/all your power ups and even then may not complete. Getting stuck on levels among hundreds more for days (game should not get really hard that fast), not my thing, uninstalled after a couple weeks. Plus, the ads for this game (from other games) and what gameplay should be, do not represent anything what the game actually is.

There is more Candy crush saga mini games than the ones on the ads. For a game which is supposed to make you relax, this is failing. You will reach a hard level and you will go crazy to go through it without paying actual money. It gets more frustrating than enjoyable. Will I recommend it - if you like Candy crush saga, yes; otherwise don't waste your time

If I could give this game zero stars I would. I used to love it and have played it for years but its more stressful than fun now. I understand levels are made to get progressively harder and challenging but this has become unrealistic. Example: You need to do 49 things and you get 5 things to work with and they're locked in a block of ice to unfreeze first. Really ???

Wanted to give a 5, but it's obvious they're hoping you'll spend money by making the mini games get ridiculously hard. Could have an amazing game (and still make money) if they'd take advice from the people who aren't willing to "pay to play". I don't mind spending money on a game, but to continuously do so inorder to make any real progress..? No thank you. I'll just get bored and forget about the game.

My rating has changed due to misleading advertising. While I enjoyed the game itself, I will not be playing anymore, nor will I try any of the other "scapes" games due to the misleading ads I've seen all over. It really annoying to see advertisements for games that have gameplay shown that isn't in the game. Until the misleading ads end, I will not play, download or recommend any "scapes" games as I feel this is both dishonest and unethical marketing

I have been playing this for years. Each time I change to a new phone, I will still download and play this game. But ever since the latest update (May 2025), the developers behind change the style of game to clear every single objects with very little moves given, especially for both (purple and red) of the more challenging ones. please be more generous on the moves because I'm considering uninstalling this game.

First I have to say the ad is very misleading. It showed nothing about how this game is basically candy crush with some house decorating going on on the side. In fact it makes it look like a completely different type of game, which is false advertising. But I did get suckered into playing this game in the end so apparently their strategy sort of works. The nice thing about this one is that there are a good amount of opportunities to get unlimited hearts for X minutes

I was impressed by how entertaining the game was. Then I got past lvl 50 and realized the gimmick. They make the game impossible to beat unless you spend money. I knew it was too well designed to not have adds. I have played the same level around 40 times now trying to create enough powerups to beat the level. I wish programmers would let me enjoy a good game. I refuse to spend money on in app purchases. Its not healthy! Id rather buy the game for $10 and enjoy a full play through.

LOVE this game. It's very entertaining. I'm very picky about most games and I usually end up uninstalling within a couple of weeks. I've had this one for months. Unfortunately, that means I've reached a higher level. Even with all of the extras they give you, some levels are impossible to pass if you don't have the perfect combination of moves. You lose the extra stuff which means you are stuck at the same level unless you spend coins to get more moves. Not fun anymore.

Terrible! The advertisement was cute, and made this look like a fun puzzle game, but it is a huge bait-and-switch. The first thing you do in the game is nothing like the the ad, but instead is an unimaginative ripoff of Candy Crush. There are too many garbage games out now that are trying to capitalize on the success of Candy Crush (which I personally despise), constantly bombarding us with their obnoxious advertisements, such as Toon Blast and Merge Dragons (ugh!). If only it wasn't another one!

Do not install. Its a joke of a game. You get a handful of moves to try to complete the levels and just have to hope that the A.I. will step in to actually complete the level for you. The developers didnt even attempt to disguise the need to spend money on power ups if you have any interest in playing the game longer than the initial first few days. Disgraceful stuff.

Absolute scam. Not the game that is advertised. There's a half-hearted attempt at giving Mini Games every so often that are similar to the ad, but they give up on that after a few hundred levels. Definitely has an algorithm to make you lose and spend money. And constant events that you barely get any progress in because, you guessed it, you have to pay more money. And don't give us that 'ads give a general idea' because the game is still not remotely like the ads. Lying scammers.

Not satisfied, have seen many reviews about this game. Puzzles are nothing like it is shown in the game icon or the advertisements. Though the game is not very bad, the puzzles are really hard when it reaches level 20. I have also seen replies to the bad reviews. They say that the special feature is only for selected people. I prefer if that is the case they should have not put it in the advertisement. But if you want a game which is easier I prefer My story. I don't recommend this app.

The game is very fun! The matching, candy crush type mini games get a little overwhelming sometimes. The decorating is really fun, but the coins keep increasing for getting furniture so that means more matching and sometimes multiple levels to get the coins you need for one piece of furniture. I wish there was less matching levels, mostly just for moving on to the next day or for opening packages. Feels redundant.

I truly used to love this game. I'm on level 8009 and I'm probably going to uninstall. The levels are entirely too difficult to win. It sucks the fun out of the game entirely. Then when you lose it gives you a pop-up to buy a booster you accidentally press it and end up losing 900 coins. Or you'll finally get a super booster just to lose it immediately. I'm tired of spending 3-4 days stuck on one level. Game is a huge cash grab now and Never spent a penny on it.

I wish it would not make you play the puzzle to make the character to talk with someone, or to feed a cat, or to bring a scarecrow to a roof. In essence forcing you to complete multiple little tasks that can either be one task or omitted completely because all I want to do is play the game and interior design. It would also be nice to click through all the extra stuff after the game like it allows you in candy crush.

Like many others, I downloaded this game after seeing ads for a puzzle type game where you use tools to fix up areas along with a match 3 element. Don't be fooled, it is ONLY a candy crush type match 3, some if which are nigh impossible to beat without buying powerups. Redecorating the house is a nice touch, but i was looking for the puzzle game that was advertised, not the same ol' candy crush trash... Going to be an uninstall for me.

EDIT:I guess you kind of fixed it.. Thank you, I'm changing to 5 stars... ...It is a really great game, but it's TOO HARD!!! I love decorating the house, and it seems there are million rooms which is great, but that just means there are hundreds of milions of levels that I am not gonna be able to pass.. 1 star and 50 coins for couple of hours of playing just one level is simply not enough.. I love the game, but it is a game for kids, so make it that way!

Your typical match 3 game. Not a fan of the power-ups in this game, as compared to similar games, these are a lot more useless in terms of helping you. Specifically the airplane. Story is decent I suppose, and has several time sensitive side stories that take place. I've never been able to finish them though, as you either need to play countless hours, or pay money for energy to finish them.

Starts really well but as you progress levels get harder, which is fine, then it gets to where it is mostly hard levels & you either have to spend money which dosent help, you still can't beat the levels even using bonus items. I dont want to play a game for a few minutes, then have to wait hours for lives to refill, and I don't find playing the same level over & over for 2 days before finally beating it enjoyable. I will spend on $$ on games that are worth it, but this one is just annoying.

The game is fun, challenging and expansive. Only 2 complaints...first being some of the star requirements for tasks are silly. Three stars to make a phone call or hang a picture?? More importantly are the planes. Very, very frustrating to launch a plane and have it hit where a target USED to be. Targets move when they get launched but the game doesn't compensate for that. Can be annoying on difficult levels. Otherwise a good time-waster game.

This game is fun, but level 118 is literally impossible to beat; I've tried probably about 40 or 45 times to beat this level, used boosters, airplanes, rainbow balls, all of the extra rewards, and still haven't beaten it. I think they want you to spend money to get extra lives or something in order to beat this level, which I refuse to do, so I guess I'll be deleting the app 🤷‍♀️ it was fun up until then

I love this game, it has everything I wanted, no ads, restoring a home, a storyline, interesting characters, and pretty much unlimited play time. The only reason it is a 3 is because you need to keep from losing in order to keep the cat rewards. Levels are too hard without it (hard levels). Spent $200, just to get through the car episode. Can't afford to play so having to uninstall. Not fun repeating levels endlessly with 5 lives only.

This game is nothing like any of the ads. It is just a bad rip off of candy crush. It has a very bland storyline and after the first 5 levels it just got really boring. At least with candy crush you get to hear the voice in the back say things like "nice" or "sweet" while in this it is just a sad carcass of what the game could have been. If you want people to enjoy it make the ads more relevant and less clickbait. Overall a boring game and a huge waste of time I would not suggest you getting it

Not terrible. Homescapes is an OK game to pass the time. The 'challenge' tends to get predictable--there are levels that are very difficult to beat. but the absolute worst part is the game maker has added...Cards. Nothing says 'fake reward' like a digital trading card. I play Homescapes less often now because of that. Instead of rewards that benefit the player (which is how it used to be) they've added digital pictures of no worth. Not even worth the time.

Nice game, but the rewards system suck. It gets challenging very fast, which to me is not at all appealing. I am looking for something more chill and satisfying, but this game frustrates me. Having to pass a hard level to get only 1 star (which you need to be able to accomplish a single task) is not worth it. Not to mention that you get very little coins for passing each level, but extra moves and aids cost too much. Overall, I like the renovating part, but I'm very close to uninstalling it.

I absolutely love this game. I have been playing for nearly 3 years, I am on level 2378 and I'm still truckin'. It's like candy crush but with the bonus game of redecorating the house. There are no pop up ads, good graphics, and its satisfying to play. The level difficulties are intermixed, so sometimes you can easily blast through a level or get stuck for a few days on the next. The only flaw I find comes when there are seasonal challenges. Sometimes they feel almost impossible to beat

The game itself is fun and addicting. They have added new boosters to help beat tough levels. However, they have added super hard levels and sometimes you need four stars to accomplish just one new task. The game can also work against you!!! The paper airplanes land where they choose, not where you want them to. I can't tell you how many times they have screwed me into losing a level because it didn't go where I would have chosen it to go. Very frustrating, to say the least!!!

Edit of what was once a five-star review. It's been going downhill. Non customizable items, too little moves. Also, every third level is something hard you will fail that can grab the sparce boosters you got. I noticed that even with booster+color bomb,1 item would "magically" survive so they can take your money. Non existent customer support. If a bot is going to answer me at least use AI. You are not getting a cent from me until I see real improvement. Or maybe I'll just uninstall (many did)

The game was fun, for a while. When you get to the later levels, it's almost as if they want you to stop playing. I just want to fix the house; I don't want to pay 3 stars for this and 4 stars for that, while in the meantime there's still trash all over the room and no end in sight. The first few hundred levels are great, but once you're in the 8-900 range, it's a war of attrition. Uninstalled, unfortunately, as I invested a good bit of time into the game.

This game is a scam!!!! I have held off rating the game for a year. It's addictive and fun to decorate the house, but the levels become so hard that unless you spend money, you cannot progress . I haven't been able to log on for days now because it said that the program was uploading the updated version. Prior to that, it wouldn't let me play because it was "updating" new levels, and forcing me to play gardenscape. I do not recommend this game because it's obvious that you'll never be able to finish the house, and if you want to play once you reach the upper levels, you'll pay through the nose for the opportunity to play. I want a total refund for money spent over the last year from the designers of this game, if they can't fix this problem!!!

I want to love this game. It's certainly lovable, in theory. I played it until the kitchen was almost done, hit a level marked hard, and ended up using all of my carefully saved items, and even spending money for more, but was still stuck on it for the next few weeks, until I lost all interest in playing it. I'm deleting the game, because a game too hard to play really doesn't interest me, especially when it keeps asking for money.

Game is fine until you make a one-time purchase of extra coins. From that point on, the game tracks you until you run out of coins, and, at that point, then gives you an impossible puzzle that cannot be solved unless you buy more coins. I guess they think we're stupid and don't realize they're little trick to make money. It's pretty pathetic when you claim to be a free game, and I'm to the point of quitting and uninstalling because of it.

Used to love this game. Actually disagree with the people who say it makes you spend money. It does take longer to beat a level once it gets harder, especially since there's some luck involved. You don't have to buy boosters unless you want to progress faster. The thing that kind of annoys me is the false advertising. This is a match 3 game. No more, no less. I don't understand why they would make their ads so weirdly misleading.

I've been playing this game for some years now, on level 6000+ and I used to enjoy it sooo much. Now, if you don't spend money you remain on same board for days, sometimes weeks. I'm so over it. The game keeps getting harder and harder with not enough plays & hitting targets that doesn't need to be removed. It's ridiculous! I'll probably delete it very soon. I used to spend money for coins but it's not even worth it anymore. It was fun while it lasted.

Once you make it past about level 50 you have to use many of your boosters to pass the levels in a timely fashion. It takes 30 minutes to recover 1 life so if you run out your done for a while unless you want to spend coins, if you have them. But of course you can buy things with real money to help with all the above issues, too bad I refuse to spend money on a mobile game. It also takes several stars to buy each improvement for the house which is all I am interested in, it just takes too long.

This game is so annoying and stressful. I'll never recommend anyone to play this game! It's the same as when you're late for work and you're stuck in heavy traffic and some crazy guy cuts your lane just in time for him to cross the green and you're red and your hands are tight on the wheel gripping like a visegrip you wanna rip the wheel out! That's exactly what you'll feel everytime you play this game.

The adds lie. It shows a completely different game then what you play. The game from the adds look like a lot of fun but the real game is nothing like it. the ads are misleading, the game is same as candy crush. its well made if you want to play a shape matching game. there is no actual home reno concept, the game will make you to buy a chair or carpet etc, it lets you choose a color but nothing else. just another match game, same as others. too bad because the advertising makes you think there are puzzles to solve related to how you design your house. your cat's on fire, lets match some shapes! cant deviate from thier story or make any choices

Lowered from 3 to 1 stars for blatant false advertising from Playrix games. Levels are nearly impossible to pass and I'm only on 80. Downloaded because of the ads that show the game having puzzles to "help them!" Or "save them!" by fixing things or solving puzzles... The ads make it look more interesting than it is (a common theme with mobile games these days). It's really just another matching game. It's fun to play for a while, but like most mobile games, it's designed to frustrate you into spending money to get past the level you're stuck on. When I get frustrated with a level, I tend to just move on to another game, and that's pretty much where I'm at with this one.

I like the game and the graphics. It is interesting to see the house improve and take shape. I wish it were that easy and enjoyable to do real home improvements. The only thing that I dislike is the "beat the clock" elements, which add a level of stress that I was pleased to see was missing when I started playing, and was one of the main reason to start playing. Much as I like the game, if these stressful elements (which I can get enough of at work and don't need in my freetime) continue to come up, I will have to stop playing :-(

When they say hard, they mean it. They forgot to add frustrating. I'm to old for this and too poor. Can't afford to play. Costs way too much. Not what the ads project. When a game says "In app purchases " don't ignore the warning. Free to download, expensive to actually get anywhere. This game is a prime example of money-making greed. No change in foreseeable future.

Can't afford to live in a mansion? Then you can't afford this game. I have played every single power boost on a supposedly easy level and still did not defeat it. Absolutely fake advertising led to me downloading this game. It is not at all like the ads. Forget the ad for the game, "...are you tired of games that..." Yes, there ARE games like that, but like myself, most users point are used to this by now. And, for those that are lucky enough to remember, [Bejeweled] was the OG jewel matching game.

started out fun and interesting, but after awhile the game got stupid. levels too hard. Just like all other similar games, it's near impossible to win without spending money on power ups then still can't get past. then all the stupid tasks that require alot of stars. it would be nice to work on the other rooms of the mansion instead of the dumb green house.

I like this game (even though it's not what advertise ) but OMG it pisses me off at times. turns out good then starts getting harder and harder until it's not fun, some levels are so full of the ones that you can't move that you're basically stuck. you have to pay for extra coins and equipment. a waste of time and money, the simplest little tasks cost at least 2 stars when you only get 1 star for finishing a level and sometimes it takes forever just to finish them. very disappointed in the game.

Won't update. I have been playing for years now but I would say the last 4 months it has gone downhill. The levels have been getting too hard because the number of moves have been decreased. I have gotten to the point I delete the game and start over just to kill time where months ago I would be waiting for them to add new levels weekly.

I got to level 24, it is almost impossible to beat that level. The only way you could win is spending money on the app basically. The ads make the game seem completely different than it actually it. Personally I liked the idea of the game and fixing up the house but it's a waste of time and money.

At level 50 you hit a pay wall where you cannot advance without paying real money for power ups or turns. I've came to the conclusion that the pay wall is there to weed out the serious players that want to fund the developers. If you are looking for a fun game to pass time look elsewhere.

The game was fun, but the developers have become greedy and try to force you into microtransactions. By the time you get to level 200, most of the levels increase exponentially in difficulty - and are so difficult with so little moves/turns that you pretty much have to buy boosters to pass them. Unless you enjoy spending a week playing the same level over and over again while waiting for your lives to replenish.

One of the worst games out there! As others have said, the mini games are mini, and mind numbingly easy. The match three levels are alright but become absurdly hard at about level 28. And OMG, the bloody time spent on stupid tasks, to have to sit thru all the animation and dialogue is painful, and skip option doesn't skip anything. Truly horrid.

Officially Uninstalled. This started off super fun and addicting. I loved being good at the levels and the story was very fun. It got to the point where my Google rewards money was gone and I was about to spend my actual money. That is where I draw the line This is like legal gambling. Over it!

Game is entertaining for the most part; but, as others have stated, it gets almost impossible to beat some levels without spending boat loads of money. It would be great if the game would give boosters when you complete a level, and if it wouldn't charge a large amount of coins for just five more moves. Great game, and I spend quite a bit of time and money on it. The game itself is good, but unless you're willing to buy more lives and boosters it takes forever. I am not going to waste money just to get further ahead. This game was decently fun at times the levels are really hard but it is fun. But lately it won't even load. Even after uninstalling and installing multiple times. The game is fun and addictive but all of the tasks require to many stars. For example 4 stars just for cleaning the area or something simple like that. The levels are getting harder and harder so I think we should have better and better rewards.

Been playing 1yr+ and I really like the game play, yes some levels are VERY hard and can take a LONG time to beat. Polished graphics and fun animations. But ultimately it's just a money sink where levels are too difficult and progression is excruciatingly slow unless you buy the IAPs. I really love this game.But hey ! I loved the game at first but as you progress through the levels, the game becomes impossible to beat without spending hundreds of dollars. Pay to win kind of game. Been playing for a few months, am level 3000+. I get the pay to play. I don't pay, so I don't win as much. That's ok. The levels are painfully hard almost every level requiring you to have a booster any further from the 700th level. Uninstalled it before emptying my wallet on this.

It helps to join a club, and the company does give freebies. That's the 1st missing star. The 2nd missing star is the story. Initially its great. There's a cute in game social media feed, you can read about the characters. However after you finish the house the writing gets very stereotypical and oversimplified.

I really enjoy this game so much. Austin and his parents are adorable. At times, the levels are challenging. I am 67 and derive a lot of entertainment from Homescapes. However, I began to realize I was spending too.much money to extend my play and purchase power-ups. For the small amount of reward for completing a level, 50-100 or so points, the cost for extension and power-ups is way too high. However, I' m sure Google is making a mint!

I used to love this game but the higher the level in the game I get the harder the games are. It used to be several easy rounds then a super hard one but now it is all hard. If I don't spend money then I don't pass. I'll spend days to pass levels even with using the extras I purchased. Its become more frustrating than enjoyable. I am definitely going to have to leave this game.

Where is the part of the game where something goes wrong and you have to pick an item to try and fix it? The game profile in Google Playstore shows various pictures of game scenarios where you have to choose an item to avoid disaster, I saw nothing like that when actually playing the game. Another thing is, there is no end. Finish fixing up one area and another area opens. It's never done. Games that have no ending are just dumb.

I downloaded due to an ad showing a "choose your own adventure" style of gameplay. I have also downloaded Township and Cooking Diary. None of these games are anything at all like the ads. I looked up this issue online and found that this is now the new regular advertisement model. I am very upset about this false advertising and will be giving a 1 star ranking to each of these games. The games themselves are fairly well done and have lots of interesting things if you like there sort of games but how are you to know what sort it is when the ads are all so wrong? Homescapes is basically a match-3 to get stars to rebuild a big old house. Cute story. Cooking Diary is a diner dash type game and is probably my favorite of the three. Township is a farm style, grow things, make things in factories and build the town. None of them have the choose what to do in case of a disaster mode to them. I was hoping maybe they would have like a special event that does it but from what I'm reading online it doesn't even have that.

Too hard (absolutely hell) and wasted a lot of times. Like pay to win. I'll rarely come back when my life need a really serious puzzle game that will never reward my brain until I pass an impossible level for free player. (Just annoyed) But it's fine cuz it's play for free. Don't have to rush but need timessss to complete a house. Another complaining, can you just ads us like your main game ? I mean "Main" not "Mini" (fake) . I've played your game before, the ads was not like this.

It's a fun match 3 game, but not being able to save your progress without a Facebook account is definitely a deterrent. There's no reason to not have the option to connect to your Google account in order to save progress. Once I get a new device, I will probably stop playing because I will lose several hundred levels of progress and I don't want to have to redo it all over again. You're better off looking for another game that doesn't require Facebook in order to save your progress.

I enjoyed the game in the beginning. I liked playing match-3 games and how the levels got challenging as I progressed. Something I didn't enjoy was the tasks and how we were charged one or two stars at times and sometimes Austin would do those things himself which made me really upset. Can we not get charged for things like unlocking a closet or opening a box or calling someone for 2 stars

False Advertisement This game plays nothing at all like the ads where you have to choose the right tools to fix things in the home. It's a gen matching game and when you get a star after the level you just upgrade the items in the home. I think it's absolutely ridiculous that you try to get people to download the game by flat out lying about the experience.

I really like this game. Been playing it for two to three years now (I'm bad at keeping track). I had another phone once and it crashed and long story short I got a new one and I lost all my progress. Luckily I was on the garden chapter so I wasn't far and it didn't bother me to restart. Anyways this game is really fun and I'm on level 2000 and something and have never spent a dime on this game. Levels get hard but that just makes the game more challenging. Keep up the good work.

I really enjoy this game so I'm leaving my review at a 5. My reason for updating my review is that I do have one ongoing frustration. It would be so much better if when beating a level that results in a reward, instead of giving one or two hours of free play time, which I almost never have time to use, that it would give power-ups as a reward instead; or give an option to choose between the type of reward the player wants.

Text too small for visually impaired making story pointless. Fun but not as advert. Play is very slow if you don't pay. Not unusual to get stuck on a level for days & little payoff for finally beating it. Discouraging when you spend days beating a level just to get hit with another a difficult level Rate of reinforcement is too low. Stingy w/ prizes/coins. It's a con to have no other way to access the bank except to pay. Hard to stay motivated when it takes so long to do anything in the house.

Love the game since you have made improvements. I guess we just needed to be patient. ( January 2019 edit) This game has become tedious and greedy. No longer fun when you spend a week on one level. The game decides when you move on. Do Not buy anything because the game will just take the boosters and waste them!

I dig the game, been playing for years. Sure, there's some levels designed to make you either use power ups or spend money (or both) to beat, but once a week you earn unlimited lives and power ups for a period of time, and I've found you can usually beat those levels at these times. The only thing I find uncreative is the cat's gift. Seriously-that's the best name the developers came up with. 😂

Don't be fooled by ads you see, it's not the game you play sadly. You aren't making choices to get a character out of a silly predicament. It's just a "renovate an old mansion, feed the cat, bake a pie" game. You earn tokens by winning matching games that are a less fun version of candy crush. It's painstakingly slow, some levels are impossible to get thru and you don't earn nearly enough tokens for winning levels or each task costs too many tokens. Perfect for playing when you are beyond bored.

I have been stuck several times on many levels, sometimes playing that level at least 30 times or more. To me there is not enough bang for your buck when you pass a level. Only 1 star and sometimes 100 coins depending on the level, but usually only 50 to 60 coins. Then, what you have to use the stars for is sometimes ridiculous. Use a star to phone someone...not worth it. Pretty much at the end of my rope with this game. Also $900 coins for 5 more lives...when you can't pass levels 30 times.

Love the game! It can be very challenging at times but it works to distract my mind a keep it focused on something else for a little while. Just wish I had more friends on here to send lives. The only thing that would make it better it if you could pause the unlimited life hours you win. I work so hard to win them then I don't have the ability to stay playing for 6 hrs straight. You should be able to pause it so you can come back to it.

This game sucks. Gotta either have the patience of a saint or pay money to advance on the higher levels. Once you get past lvl 1500 you get hard or super hard levels every 2 levels. Waste of time. Didn't spend any money on this game which is what they want. Looking for dollars. Unless you enjoy spending 3 days per level.

2019: I love the storyline of the game, and the creativity in developing the characters and their speech/movements. Definitely recommend! 2025: The game has lost its appeal to me now. It feels as though it has become a money grab and the updates to the graphics take away from what it used to be. I know change is to be accepted, but change for the better, not this. Very disappointed and I don't play as often as I used to as even the easy levels are almost unbeatable now and I'm stuck for days.

In the Atlantis challenge, I couldn't pass through the Tower Viewer. Tried numerous times. Seems like the game creators don't really care about the people playing it, nor the game itself, but care mostly about the money they make from their 'deals'. No optional help in Chat Support. Seems like Playrix don't really fix the game's bugs. Disappointing.

I'm at around Level 1300. Been playing off and on for years. I love the game so much I don't want to give up. But it's to the point where it's not fun or relaxing. It's so hard that your forced to spend money or u don't move on. My biggest issue is that the hard and super hard levels are given to u every couple rounds. It should be every 10th round is hard. And every 20th is super hard. How can u put 2 super hard rounds within 5 rounds of each other. It feels impossible to advance without cash.

I never leave reviews on games but this game has me frustrated enough within a day of playing that I will. Making it impossible to pass levels to get stars to make your upgrades is ridiculous. I am sure there are plenty of people willing to spend money to be able to keep playing. I am not one of them. I am deleting the game and won't plan on downloading it again. One star because zero wasn't an option unfortunately because zero is what it deserves. the fact you have 4.6 rating is crazy

The game can be enjoyable at times, but most of the time it's frustrating. Most levels seem to be set up for failure. It takes the fun out of playing your game. Maybe u don't see it because u designed it, but a lot of us players do. Take a long hard look at both Home & Gardenscapes. It needs some tweeking! Make the games fun!

I have been playing this game for 3 years. I am in what I assume is the bonus rounds waiting for the developers to make new levels. Yes some levels are very hard. I have not spent any money until today since I love the Halloween event! Now the bonus levels are stupid hard. But thats ok. I keep at it and end up not playing much until new levels come out. All of these levels are able to get through. This is my escape from real life, when I want to check out.

I love this game. My only problem is after I left the mansion and started on the "lodge"( I dont know if it has an official name ) I could change less and less furniture. 62 levels later and you will find yourself STILL in just the front room and bedroom. Lets just say its annoying to say the least. This is a money sucker of a game that wont get a dime from me! Deleting.

I have a lot of $$ invested in this "game". Sure, levels can be beaten without buying boosters, moves, etc....Sometimes you will need to play a level nearly 100 times to beat it without a booster. Also, you might get a rainbow ball that lasts 10 minutes. If you don't have enough lives, that clock still keeps ticking whether you play or not. The rainbow ball disappears. I really think timers should only run when you are ACTUALLY playing a match 3 game and pause when you are not playing.

Any fun in this game is destroyed by the money grab from Playrix!! I'm a couple thousand levels in, and I always buy the golden tickets, just for the 8 lives. But recently I'm finding that 8 lives will only get you about 15 minutes or so of game time due to the levels being increasingly difficult and much less fun. But hey, you can always buy more lives.... Once this season is over, the game is getting deleted. Wish there waz a puzzles only version with no lives stipulation. I'd buy that.

This game is a complete lie. The ads for this game, as well as Gardenscapes and Matchington Mansion are absolutely nothing like the games they are supposed to be advertising. I'm pretty sure all three games are by the same company. Unlimited life bonuses pop up at the worst time and are immediate, so cant save them for "down time" play. Game play would be better if they multiplied all requirements by 3 and added 3-star option, with 1 star to move on. This would allow continual progress and ability to go back and redo.

Anyone else notice how the paper plane "booster" works against you? It never goes where you need it to go and sometimes it even takes out your next best move. As if it's programmed to make you fail. I'm done with this game. It's an obvious joke. Rarely need extra moves until you buy some coin and then it makes you use them all up in the next few levels.

Used to be one of my favs! Played daily. Now, seldom! It's a good game as far as the decorating and the matching game but the levels are rediculously difficult.... Five stars plus! These game developers are great. I've played all their games available at the play store except for one...I'm totally addicted to three. Fallen in love with Austin and Carl. Fun for a bit, but the puzzles fluctuate too wildly from easy to impossible without excessive gold and power ups. Increase in types of puzzle barriers becomes more irritating than fun. Its awful now. I've been playing this game for about 4 years, and it's the only one I play. Recently they started interrupting regular play with this "tournament of champions". You can't opt out of playing it and continue with your regular game, the levels are much harder, and you don't earn stars to progress on the home during it. And now its taken over the whole game where you literally get 2 out of 10 days maybe without having to be in the tournament. Not worth playing anymore

First, it's not cool that you have to force users to update the game? Not cool at all. Since I updated I can not play. It will not load and keeps crashing. Not only that, this game USE to be fun. Not anymore. When I first played this game, it was a pretty fun take on the match-3 formula with the story and renovation elements. I downloaded this game and Gardenscapes because I wanted to play the puzzle game where you are given some items and you have to choose one to solve the problem. Don't have any spare change to put towards digital items to beat it and I don't feel like I should have to pay to win. Uninstalled.

One of the best game I've played but coins too expensive and stars given are too little for each level. It's almost impossible to pass the level when it gets higher. At the end u will need to keep purchasing. Don't mind if it's cheaper but just too expensive to purchase coins which will make ppl leave this game at the end of the day. 2 stars not rated due to this reason

This game has become very boring and frustrating! I had been stuck on levels but not for 3 dang days! I've used up everything that I had to try and beat level 890, it's impossible to beat the level without purchasing to beat it. For it to be 900 coins to get 5 extra moves is ridiculous! Everything is too much! I've spent money on this game but I'm so tempted to just stop playing all together and uninstall this game, I refuse to have to spend more money to win a stupid level!

The game itself is very enjoyable. Not high pressure to "buy in" to advance like alot of the games. The 2 star is due to credits not being awarded when earned. My screen balances never reflected items being received. Will not make any purchases within the game because of this issue.

Update: Game developers cut the number of moves in half or more on the hard and super hard levels. Now takes days to beat, on accident And spend moves trying to get rid of alarm clocks or soap instead if attempting to try for the goal. Videos of game play as recently as 3 months ago show levels used to have 2-3 times as many moves available to achieve goal. NOT FUN ANYMORE!!! Going from 25 moves to 11 is not making a level more challenging,? It is making it impossible and frustrating.

After the update yesterday, the game keeps freezing. When you receive rewards such as 30 minutes of play, you have to go through announcements of current challenges which waste your free time. When activating powerups, they generally hit in areas they aren't needed during the mini game. This is definitely a game that wants you to spend money. If you like spending money to advance levels, this is the game for you.

I've been playing this game for a few months now and I loved it. But today I've just notice that as I'm demolishing my colored blocks that are required for me to win, they're not being counted down. I don't know if it's a glitch, but now I'm skeptical of the method to this game...😡🤔

I enjoy playing this game. Its fun to renovate the house. Im currently stuck on super hard lvl, 808 I think. I would like to not get stuck on the super hards for days, but I can deal with it. I never spend real money on any game, so no way I could get the pet. I try to save my boosters for superhards. Only complaint is that everytime I update the game it takes more and more of my storage. I will not update now because I need all my other apps. Unfortunately homescapes will have to wait.

This game is not at all like the ads. Don't be misled by the "download" stats. A friend of mine likes the game a lot, and I thought the problem-solving ads looked great. But I was sadly disappointed. You will hardly ever see the problem solving games. For the rest, lots of ads and levels to struggle with took all the fun out of it.

I don't appreciate the false advertising. Ads for this game on Facebook and other places show a game with home repair situations, choose the right tool for the job. I played this game for a few weeks expecting what was advertised to happen at some point, it never did. It's just another version of a match three game, another candy crush knock-off.

Just like all of the games from this dev, get ready to shell out bucks if you want to win. Almost every level needs multiple tries, bonuses, and in game purchases to win. Definitely your game if you want to be stuck on the same level for days/weeks, waiting for the auto-generated winning tile set. Also, the storyline is absurdly slow. Win a level to upgrade a single curtain or make one phonecall ??! Guys, come on. The concept and graphics are great, but the execution is a total fail.

You'll have to pay to enjoy other content rather than grinding to obtain those rewards. Same old cash grab, but I don't blame them for making a fun game, but I checked out as soon as I was not able to obtain the dog without a paying for a pass. At least when Supercell does it with the Clash franchise ( Clash Royale) it's challenging and stimulating. There are no restrictions on cards only in esthetics and faster progression if you're willing to pay.

I love the puzzles, BUT, to be stuck for days or weeks on a single level is getting discouraging, and I play less and less. You have to use all your boosts, extra lives, and use up your gold, and still be stuck until the Event is over and never able to get through to the end. 😐😔 to the point of heading out. Also teams, if a dormant player hasn't played, they should be taken off teams. 25 dormant players on a team is discouraging too

I saw an ad for this game where it looked like it would be a completely different game. This is just another game like candy crush except you design a house as you move up levels. I kept playing in hopes I'd get to do the things I saw in the ad (matching items to where they help fix stuff) no luck. At least my house looks nice I guess. Don't put it in your ad if it's not how you play the game.

It was fun at first, but as you progress to higher levels, you would be stuck with hard levels, not just days, it would be weeks. I've been playing this before and even spend money here, but instead of fun, it gives anxiety and annoyance. Been giving this game a chance, but uninstalling it for the third time. DO NOT DOWNLOAD, WASTE OF TIME, AND NOT FUN AS YOU PROGRESS.

Game is not getting better. With all of the updates, on the merging side game, they now make you have to beat levels to progress in the side game. It absolutely sucks. As the levels progress, there are far too few moves to solve the puzzles without either replaying the same level for days on end or spending money. I downloaded this to earn coins on another game and I wasn't able to finish that goal because of how horribly difficult the higher levels are.

After months of playing, the game just wiped all my progress. I'm literally back at the beginning. I've tried everything to get back my lost progress but nothing works. Will never use this or any of its similar games again.

Good match 3 game, challenging but never impossible obstacles. Nice story arc. I think the difficulty of the levels makes me wanna give up playing... it takes me too long to get one star and now I need 3 to complete one task! I was a bit sad that the advertisement that brought me here didnt accurately describe the game. However, ive really enjoyed the game. I love the graphics and the animations. It can be fun sometimes, but every time I get infinite lives, if it's 30 minutes or five hours I've learned to expect that you're going to play on the same level the whole time. Was fun at the beginning of the game, once the levels got higher, its impossible to win. It's almost like they want you to buy lives to continue playing this game. I love playing games like this but you can not play it and get past alot of the levels unless you buy extra moves that cost alot or get high priced power items and 90% of the time they are useless. when you finish the level you win tiny amount of coins. if you don't have money to spend on a game no matter how good you are do not download this game. I love this game! It is addictive and relaxing! UPDATE (8/20): I downloaded it again and it did get better! While I like this game for it's visual quality and narrative structure, I find myself questioning why some levels are unreasonable hard. I have only recently started this game and definetly enjoying it, love how it's not like every other match game out there. The levels are quite engaging and wanting me to play more and more. Otherwise, I like the layout, themes, & play of the game. Wish I could change it to 1 star. Funny how you can't beat a level after several dozen tries with however many moves you start out with, then suddenly you beat it easily with many moves left.

I've been playing for a while now and I love the game however, that intro music when you first turn the game on is SUPER obnoxious. I hate it. I always have to turn my volume down when I start the game up. If we could turn that off too like we can the regular music it would deserve 5 stars. Loud noise like that is a really big deal breaker for me.

Fun and challenging levels. Exciting ways to use points and coins. Always something new to enjoy! Update: I've been playing for over a year and I still play this daily. I'm on level 3231. As much as I enjoy the levels/challenges, its hardly worth the effort now because when I use my stars for renovations, there are no longer 3 options to customize my home, most are automaric and cannot be changed. The home design aspect was my favorite part, now I feel like the reward isn't worth my time.

In a nutshell, its almost a ripoff. They want you to spend spend spend. Paying 900 coins to extend is too much and having to pay to withdraw your coins from savings it also very sneaky. I'm now at level 2555 and there are times when you'd spent days on 'easy' levels which means you can forget about chasing any special stages or bonuses. You can't even make it by spending the boosters (which they'd want you to use and eventually buy more). Play if you want but don't spend any money on the game.

Starts easy, then gets harder and takes more power items to complete a game which cost a lot of $ and you have to play several games to get just one item. Then you find out there are yet more items to place and the only way you can get them in a reasonable amount of time is to buy power items to beat the games. I am done now that I have finished the living room.

I am very disappointed in this app. it is nothing like the ad showed it to me like. you don't get to fix anything like that. And it shows a totally different thing in the ad. I don't think it's fair that developers get to make ads for their games that are NOTHING LIKE THEIR GAMES AT ALL! It is just like candy crush, an you only get to pick and choose a few items for your house ONLY after you have completed a matching game level. It has the potential to be a really good game though.No in-game ads.

After seeing countless ads about how you choose a item between 3 choices to get out of a situation I decided to try the app. The game has absolutely nothing to do with the ad, it is completely missleading. I dont know if the actual game is good or not, it might be but it is not what it was advertised for. The developers should be ashamed. 1 star seens to much for this.

I enjoy playing the game, but I seem to get way too many extra hard levels, especially during team competitions. I don't buy the extras, so that might be why. Overall it is fun. Just wish it would give me more regular levels or at least just hard levels. Would be a lot more enjoyable to get through levels faster.

I wish you could choose when to use the unlimited life that's allotted. I get so pissed when I get it and have to go to sleep. It would be such a fun and engaging game if the levels didn't get so hard so fast, and it didn't have you waste precious stars on such stupid things like opening a window, greeting the mailman, or starting a new day. That pisses me off and makes me not want to play.

I have enjoyed this game for some time now and would have given a 5, I recently saw an ad for this game. The ad is for something different altogether. I find the ad very deceptive and misleading. This caused me to lower my thoughts (and ratings) about the company and other deceptive qualities they may have.

The ads for this game are 100% misleading. Every single ad I've seen is a pull the pin game. This is just a matching game. I've never seen a single ad of what the game actually mostly consists of. Of course there are pull the pin mini games but they are very few and far between. It seems like they had to at least put it in once every 10 matching levels but only so people couldn't technically claim false advertising. Uninstalling after barely 20 minutes of playing.

The games are intentionally way too hard to pass without purchasing power ups. Sure, eventually you can make it past some levels, but the difficulty level of MOST of the levels, is outrageous and feels like a scam. I am done with this bs. It's not fun to be constantly frustrated by a game that takes 20+ attempts to get past ONE level unless I spend money.

It was great actually because it trains your brain (for me) but it would be lovely if the super hard and hard levels will gave the player a 2 star or 3 star since it's so hard or if I had run out of moves, could you please lessen the money needed? It's so hard to earn them.. Thanks! But really, it's a great game! I'm on level 1200 and still loving it 😊

Pay to play every ten or so levels. Stuck on one level for a week now and I play daily. It's pretty disappointing to play a level and know after 4-5 moves that you won't be able to pass it because you already know you don't have enough moves to do it. I understand that some levels are harder than others, but to be stuck on one for days is plain stupid.

I've been having a lot of problems in the past month. First, I lost all of my progress after I received the message that I didn't have internet connection. Yet, I did. Now, the "no internet connection" message is back and can no longer access my team. They told me to uninstall/reinstall the game. Did that and now lost everything again.

I have played this game and I currently have Gardenscapes downloaded. They're both really fun games, and I enjoy them.
