Don't do it, you're better than that!!

The fact that this is so mindlessly repetitive cancels out the ability to enjoy the story. They're just the very rare mini games. Mostly it's match 3 garbage.

It is a good game.No add,no bugs.But! It makes me unhappy. I play games to relax after a hard day at work. And I don't need the feeling of hopelessness and the impossibility of changing anything. I love the game but If their is a update of getting some bucks,i think people will install more and play more,,for example: if we reach 100 level 1$, 200 level 2$, or else 1000 level any dollar..that will be more interesting,also getting some points by referring. I am on 1200 level...game is very challenging ...but i probably will uninstall this game cause the only way of getting through the hard levels is too spend money....you have no control on on how you spend your credits in building your house...now they ask more more credits for dumb things...like it at the beginning... but they need tomake it a more friendlier game..

What on earth is tournament of champions for? I just want to go to the next level but now I must wait 4 days until I can progress. I spend a lot of money on this game and it is addictive and quite fun but only when you can progress and move forward in the game. Tournament of champions needs to be removed and let players play. I wish it took fewer stars to advance. I enjoyed the game for a bit. But it eventually became nearly impossible to beat the levels. Simple thing like calls that shoyld be free or cost 1 start cost 5. Great game but... The levels get way too hard and then the rewards given in turn don't match the difficulty or the outlay required for the tasks. It feels like there are times when the game is totally on your side and then the algorithms change to go completely against the player to trick them into spending more. Fun game, but don't get sucked in to the spending side of it

I enjoyed the game up to level 993 and decided to buy a booster. The first purchase worked, but the second, more expensive one, failed. Support was no help. I expected better tracking of transactions from a professional developer. My advice: always screenshot your purchases for evidence. Unfortunately, offers vary and disappear after purchase, and I didn’t capture the one I bought.

I love this game, already playing it for over 3 years. Fun levels, sometimes pretty hard. Being stuck for a few days happens, is frustrating, but they warn you that the level is 'super hard '. One point less because the downloading isn't always going fast enough, or even gets stuck

l would enjoy the game allot more if the game wasn't set up to make you pay for gold. Some levels are impossible with out spending gold for that last turn you needed and you really don't make enough gold at all to keep up with how often you need that one last turn. I love the idea of the game the story fixing the house. It just seems like with allot of mobile games their just greedy.

Story, characters, and levels are captivatingly entertaining. I could literally play all day. Yet while I realize how much time, money, and creative energy has gone in to this games development It is too expensive to advance through the levels from an individual players standpoint. I have spent well over a $1000 just to reach level 3500. Playrix should offer a one time subscription that provides a daily dose of powerups and extra moves. There is a line between profit and greed.

I was starting to like this game even though I don't like match type games that much. I keep playing because I want to decorate the mansion but it gets boring when I only get 1 star each play. Why there are lots of events to do? Can it be just 1? I uninstalled the game now since everytime I finished a match play, my phone's whole screen turns blue and I have to restart it. I don't like the false advertising. Please just be honest.

Fun game, addictive, I appreciate a lot of things to.it- the graphics, the scenarios, the dialogue, the positive feedback s. I played it for a while, came back to it a few years later, it remembered my profile, and my bonuses, I appreciated that too. But lately it's became such a money digger, you get less and less for the money, because yes, its engineered to get money from you - if it's becoming more about the money, than the pleasure of creating it and playing it, it's not fun anymore.

Made some progress and then, like previous feedback, there is a point where you are unable to get through without paying money. I would have liked to have some of the situational puzzles that you show on the ads..aka, choose a solution to a problem, but these seem to be marketing gimmicks and are nowhere to be seen in the actual game

Starts off well if you like puzzles but you soon find yourself playing a game where the are ridiculous, a full board and literally no moves to make, as you play more there are constantly hard and super hard boards. They give you bonuses that make no difference with boards very hard and very small number of initial moves, the game is stacked towards players who will pay money. Play it free, with no expectations. You can find yourself playing the same board for days on end.

After several months, I finally deleted this stupid and addictive candy crush spinoff, and I'm avoiding the sister games like Gardenscapes and Fishdom. The ads have little to do with the actual gameplay. You think it's a game of logic and decision-making, but it's really more like a game of chance. And usually the only way to win levels is with boosters. It makes you chase and spend money on boosters. The app encourages reward seeking behaviour like a slot machine. It's unhealthy.

I really like this game, but the levels are impossible to beat! When I first played it the levels were impossible to beat, even on the normal difficulty levels. I think after some complaints they made alot of improvements and was alot better. But now its starting to be hard again and is not fun to play. I hate not making progress in a game and it takes me forever to get through these boards, no matter what the difficulty level is. Please update the game so it's not impossible to beat levels!!

The concept of pay to win is strong with this game. It starts off easy and lets you progress quickly, lulls you into a rhythm of fun, mindless swiping, but suddenly you will be stuck on a level sometime for days. Especially if you don't have unlimited lives. Then it becomes frustrating, but when you almost complete a level, they give you an option! Wanna pay for some extra moves? You are very close to progress. I was looking for a fun, easy game to occasionally occupy my time. But this is not it

The graphics are top notch, the gameplay is addicting and the character's stand out in their unique way. The game provides an experience unlike any other game of it's type. People say that the game is pay-to-win but it really isn't. With return bonus, kite bonus, side missions, competitions and the pass, progression is really steady.The game doesn't even have repetitive ads which is amazing. The false advertising of homescapes is not doing anything to help it though. Overall, the game is amazing

I used to play it until it got harder. When it got harder, it intentionally made me waste all my boosters, thus I decided to make in-app purchases. It got so unenjoyable that I wasted more than getting back. If you made a one big purchase instead 2-4 small purchases, then it magically allowed me to finish board with 2-5 turns left. When I noticed this, I looked over other apps outside of this developer and even if those apps were also money grabbers, they did offer more back than playing in here

I stopped playing for about a year, came back and it's no different. The mini game is better than the main quest but it's ridiculous the amount of energy it takes to play. On the game for 3 CLICKS every 5 hours. 😔 I started spending money to see if helps. Each mini game REQUIRES between 40 & 60 USD to beat the levels. It's important to know the prize is a lawn ornament. The mini game is addicting once you get to spend a few minutes playing, you grudgingly give more. If you aren't hooked, RUN!!

This game is not like the advertisements that I am watching on my much better phone games. I had expected more from this game! You play a matching game to earn stars to complete each little design item... kinda fun, but also tedious to be "earning" the design aspect with the matching games. And to compound the frustration, each designed item has 3 options... so example a red formal option, a yellow casual option or a green contemporary option. Whoooopy! This game will not entertain me for long.

The game itself is OK. I don't like the fact that they limit the time I can play a game. When you run out of the 3 lives, you have to wait 25 minutes before you can play the game again or purchase more lives. Not going to happen. I will uninstall 1st before I spend money on a match game. Let me play on my time not yours.I downloaded this app as a courtesy to you, not a privilege to me. Done!!! BTW, the way the game is advertised different from what's it is when installed.

This was a fun game in the beginning. I really enjoy thinking games, but the deeper I got into the game I started to realize just how horribly rigged it is to get players to spend money on it. At the beginning, it's fun and challenging, but pretty soon, you realize it has all the design malfunctions as Gardenscapes The levels don't work the way they're supposed to, and the number of attempts you need to finish a level are purposely cut short. I have frequently been 2-3 moves from finishing only to lose the level and forced to start again. Not only that, but the toon that advertises the game has NOTHING to do with it. This game would work much better if the games at each level were rotated, so if you can't finish one, you might finish another one. It would also be nice if they replenished the bombs you need every time you failed a level, and it would work better if each level gave you fifty moves instead of varying them. Several of the levels are rigged for you to waste moves before you can even play I do not recommend this game to anyone!!

Added: I'm so sick and tired of seeing fake ads for this game that I went back and adjusted my rating down. The fact that you either get the star or don't and there's no way to make small incremental progress (grinding) is a gamebreaker for me. It means that if you don't pay, you don't progress, and that's not going to work for me, if I wanted to finish the game I would seemingly have to pay more than the price of a triple A full blown PC game, and that's way too much ...

It's a fun game and I love the challenge in the levels. I'm giving 3 stars because the 30 minute wait time for each "life renewal" when you're only given 5 lives is pretty chinchy, and it seems to be impossible to pass some levels without spending money. I haven't spent money but got really close. **edited to add: Since posting that, I've spent a small fortune on the game and the allowed number of moves have been cut in half. I still enjoy it but had to make it so that I don't spend any more $!

The advertisements are NOT AT ALL like the game. The game is a tile matching game like candy crush. The advertisements make it seem like a survival choice game and IT IS NOT! The only choices you make in this game are for colors and styles of furnishings in a home you repair using stars won from levels. Definitely bland and boring gameplay.

Day 4 of play, puzzles are impossible to solve without a multitude of boosters which, on the 4th day of non- purchase play, you will never have enough to break all the blocks. You can get about halfway solved before the extremely low number of moves runs out. Then the game runs out your "life" and makes you wait to be able to play again? Thats just ridiculous. It was really fun, until it became impossible to enjoy. Uninstall complete.

I downloaded this game, and it was terrible... Well the colors are good, it is not what the ads say it is... There's no helping people over Bridges there's no helping people fix cars it's a puzzle game that you have to keep buying over and over. And if you run out of lives it takes up to a half an hour just to get one new life... I downloaded this game an hour later I got rid of it, and I told everybody not to download this

Can you please remove tournament of champions from the games? No point playing hundreds of level just to be out of top 10 and did not get any gift. Even if within top 10, only get few power ups. Better collect the stars that needed to do the task. I've been playing this games for years, already at level 7000+++. This is the first time I'm feeling very3 disappointed.

Brilliant game, highly addictive, only complaint is that when one gets bonus time, eg 2hrs continuous play, one needs to do so at one go..it is better if this time can be paused and resumed. Also, if there could be a prompt before this time starts it would b a great deal better, as many times I forget that I hv this bonus and the countdown starts when I am unable to play for such a long time.Would be willing to pay for hours eg when going for a plane trip and hv plenty of time to kill.

Overall, a nice game to kill time but not really all that entertaining. The so called threshpoints give you, after at least a year if playing, insignificant powerups, but the difficulty of the levels keep rising. Very disappointing.

The setup is good but the puzzles are ridiculously hard to beat. And they challenge for every little thing they do in the storyline and make stuff up along the way so you can never proceed on with the story an forget or don't care what is happening anymore because of the long time between incidents. They need to at least make the puzzles possible to win without multiple tools or helps. Make it a fair game!

Shameless money grab. I mean, I'll get it, I spent a few bucks, but then it got to where you couldn't beat levels without spending $5 per level on the more difficult ones. I admit, I waste money on stupid stuff, but I'm done being given the shaft by this one. It's either "spend $5 a level" or wait 3 days until you've tried every time you have a life (to play bejeweled... really?!) and maybe they'll give you the right combination to win their impossible levels. Nope. Not any more.

Was super fun and relaxing to play before bed...but then on level 1200ish there suddenly appeared these clocks that stop your gameplay if you don't destroy them in a certain number of moves. And the airplanes, that are the tools that you use to blow things up, won't hit the clocks! That ruined it for me. Bummer, 'cause I LOVED it until now.

I do love the game but the levels are just bad. They are really hard and it takes me millions of years to pass the level and adding the hard and super hard levels makes me not like the game. I also don't like how there aren't enough moves. There should be more moves and less hard and super hard levels. That just ruins the fun TBH

Probably one of the best free app games with fun events and story lines to go with it. I originally installed it for the puzzles, but I honestly enjoy the regular levels more and am glad you can play them anytime you have lives to use up (somewhat similar to candy crush, but way cooler and updated regularly). Can't understand why people complain about the difficulty when you get free lives every 20 minutes. Had this app for over a year now and haven't spent a dime, although I feel I should (;

I don't like the fact that i have to keep uploading so call new versions every couple of weeks and sometimes within the same week. And the fact that it too much time and money spent out side. It's fun and addicting for the most part. But they are super slow to get new levels and when you use stars they won't let you skip cut scenes which is super annoying. I gave it 5 stars. I play this game for 4 years. It gets worse with every update. Bug fixes means more bugs. Disappear lives from friends, starting to really annoy me I general. I really wanted to like this game but I'm about to delete it. The graphic are great but there's no reason that the levels are so hard. Wow, talk about false advertising! My rating is even lower than before now. The new ads for this game are pure lies. It's just another tile matching game! I love this game, I'm up past level 700. But the "hard" levels are easier than the regular levels sometimes, and it would be a lot nicer if I could start my "eternal life" whenever I'm able to play for 1-3hrs (depending) instead of it just beginning automatically. Also I'm above level 700 and I've only done the bedroom, kitchen, entry way, greenhouse area, and just started in the living room...I think it takes too many stars to do things as you progress and there are too many things to do. I'd like to see the house more completed since I've been playing so long! We can do the big things with 3+ stars and the small with 1!!! Calling someone should only be 1! I'm just saying I'd like to see the progress I've made much better displayed than it is. I do like the game, and the mini contests... Even if I don't always place high or finish them.

The levels are too difficult too fast. I get to a "hard" level and it takes weeks to get through and how is that fun? The game purposely makes it impossible to get boosters you need to complete the level, or there are not enough moves available. I had fun at first, but it's just too frustrating now. The game is more fun now that you get periods of unlimited lives because some levels just require it. I really don't like the purple bubbles because they continue to spread no matter what.

At first I loved the game but it became quickly apparent that it takes FOREVER to advance. I'd love to "finish" Homescapes at some point but at every turn it takes 3 stars to do the tiniest little task. It's a little annoying. I really like the story line, but it takes so long to move forward that I'm getting bored. I'd love it if players could actually finish the game. Remember when you could actually do that? Give your loyal players something really satisfying like that, and we'll look forward to the next game that Playrix releases! I'd also consider starting the game over to play a second time through and choose different designs. But I've been playing many months now every evening. I'm losing interest. Snoozing here.... Like any game, there are winning set ups and losing set ups. It can be challenging, but just go slow, pay attention, and you can get lucky and win. I'm up over L1900 now. [Edit] I have noticed too many levels that have a required target, reliant upon a drop rate, that drops less than the number of moves given, effectively sabotaging your game. 👎

It started out fun. Now its annoying. On Level 739. Some levels are harder than the so called "hard" levels. It should not take days at a time to complete a normal level. That makes no sense when there are a ton of rooms left.

The game literally screams out pay 2 win. It's easy for the first couple rounds and after that it gets insanely hard basically pushing you to spend money on the game to advance or spend 20 years on one level to complete it. The new update may seem like it was made to make it easier for you. It's a lie. Just more pay 2 win stuff.

I'm here to add to the frustratingly difficult levels. I'm stuck on level 63, and the only way I see to pass the level is to buy special moves or win by sheer luck. Very annoying match-3 puzzle game. Very few useless boosts which costs a lot. Too many hard levels, each 5 or 10 - is very hard, that will take you 2-3 fays to beat or spend a lot of coins. Story is really streched with stupid actions like "open box", "put item of the box on the table" and "tell mom you did it" - each of which requires you to spend star (equivalent of one level to beat). Graphics is really cool.

I had reviewed before about and then uninstalled due to some frustrating issues, I decided to try it again and it has been significantly improved and I was going to rate 5 stars. It is exceedingly frustrating and makes me not want to play at all. Please fix, it was such a great game otherwise!

I love this game! I've been playing for a while but the levels are getting harder and the number of stars needed for each take is also increasing. The game is ok. Sometimes I lose a life due to the game misreading my inputs. The difficulty curve can be a wee too steep. The story is paced a little slow as well. Decided to change my review. Been playing this game for the past 4 years. On my way to level 3000. But for the past few months this game has become more of a pain, than a relaxing time. Was initially good, but now through the advanced stages, it tends to cheat! I really enjoyed this game when I first started playing, but now it's just ridiculous. The "candy crush" type games you have to play to get stars are insanely hard, and then you only get 1 🌟. And it is never fun when it takes over 20 trys to get thru a level & then you get 1 measly 🌟. Not worth it. Definitely find something else to play.

I really enjoy this game. I've realized I have been playing it for maybe two or three years. I just dont like that ive on level 300+ and im still in the garden. why make a gardenscapes game if your going to combine the two. I just want to go back into the house and renovate the rest, there are so many rooms and only have done the living, kitchen, and dudes room is lame. Other than that, I like the extra side challenges that go on. they give you an extra opportunity to earn rewards.

I really enjoy this game. I feel that the owners may be a bit stingy with rewards and pay outside. I am constantly waiting for new levels (6???), I think once you pass certain levels more pay outs. Also, how can I get more coins on a regular level than a super hard one? Makes no sense. Rewards and pay outs need to be adjusted for sure. 900 for 5 extra moves but I can only win max like 79 equals greedy to me. Should go back to bejeweled blitz or candy crush.

I used to really really like this game in the beginning when acheiving goals was actually acheivable. Now at a much higher level it is essentially a pay-to-win game. Progress is super slow, levels are hard to beat and rewards are small compared to the amount of time, money and power-ups you will end up using just to complete a task. For completing a level you get maybe 90 points but to add life you spend a minimum 900 points. Ridiculous!!

Up till level 60 something and it's already hard for me. I wonder how hard the next levels are. This game is very addicting and I love the graphics. But the super hard levels makes me lose motivation. Edit: I uninstalled this game for 2 years and reinstall it this year, this game improves a lot than before. The levels are hard, but when u do solve them, u just felt a sense of accomplishment. I just wish we could share boosters for the hard lvl between our team mates aside from sharing lives.

Ive been playing for over a year! I truly enjoy the game!! However, many of the special games, such as decorating for Christmas or Valentine's day, is exceptionally expensive if you want to meet or finish the challenges. Easy to do at lower levels but I'm around level 2225 & it takes a bit to get done but if I can't finish decorating...its exceptionally disappointing!!

I really like this game. Decorating adds a great dimension to matching games. I would give 5 stars if you could get more than one star per level. Especially the harder levels. Maybe the higher a score more stars awarded. I have lowered my rating as new levels are not released in a fair way. I joined a team but can't help them as I'm stuck. Other teams in other countries seem to have access to higher levels much earlier.

The great part about this game is the ability to design. It's very fun and it's the only game I have on my phone. However, the small task such as putting away dishes/feeding the cat then making those levels impossible to pass is unnecessary. Those miscellaneous task should be one level, simple, and one token. Their goal is for us to get so frustrated and eager to pass that we'll want to pay for a package to move on to the next level/task. It's unfair and should be changed.

I started playing on Android a while ago, but have been playing on iOS the last few months. I agree with everything other players have said. The game has become a money pit lately. Levels are almost impossible to beat even with boosts. Staying on one level for days is frustrating to me, so I've basically stop playing. I get my freebie boost for the day, use up my lives, and close the game. I don't even bother with the golden tickets anymore. Just not worth it.

The levels are too difficult....I spend tens of hearts to go over some levels...It's annoying and it makes me hate the game. It should be relaxing but it's not, it makes me crazy. Don't get me wrong, I love the graphics and Austin and his family and the house and the many options to choose from in the house. Please make the levels more doable! I had it installed before and erased it because it annoyed me to death. I reinstalled it and I rediscovered why I started to hate it....

I used to love this game. It's cute, the story combined with puzzles is a great concept, annoying adds aren't a problem. Buuuuuut....they need to add difficulty settings. A lot of people are suggesting it's so hard so that you have to buy power ups to keep playing. If that's the case I'd have to buy a ton, because I'm only to the kitchen. I'd really looked forward to getting the whole house, but I think I'm gonna uninstall. Edit in 2023. It's like the ex you keep going back to. XD

The levels are hard to achieve. I love the idea of the game and i want to make progress on the house but i never have enough moves to complete the goal and find myself doing the same puzzles over and over im to a point now where i feel i should uninstall the game because i get stuck on the same puzzle because theres not enough moves for the amount of stuff i have to clear..

It was fun at first, but it is absolutely NO fun when you are given 4 HOURS free and you're lucky if you get ONE level accomplished in that time! When you happen to get free time you get either 'hard' levels or 'super hard' levels. I'm tired of lessons in frustration when I just want to play a game. And 900 coins for 5 more moves, or to renew lives!!?? That's ridiculous!! It takes forever just to reach 500!! I'll probably end up uninstalling this 'game', too!

Game play is absolutely nothing like the enticement videos used to coax me into installing the game in the first place. Nothing but another boring tile-matching game, only this one is VERY quick to run out of easily solvable levels before it presents you with a level (20) that is impossible to clear without buying lives or power-ups. The colors of the tiles will change on each retry, but the "random pattern" never alters, it's the same impossible to clear level over and over again. Waste of time

To call this game challenging is an understatement. It's impossible to win rewards such as new pets without purchase, and even more impossible to finish challenges in the time frame given. If you're satisfied to just play without winning challenges or rewards, it's a great little puzzle game. Oddly enough after almost 3 years, I'm still playing.

I've just uninstalled the game. It is very fun in the beginning and renovating the front hall is a lot of fun - but once you get to level 40 or so (not very long at all!), it is impossible to beat the levels in the given amount of moves (I've been stuck on a level that wants to cover 64 squares of carpet in 13 moves - get out of here). Clearly this game is pay-to-win... ridiculous.

I like it but it's a money pit for me. You got 8 lives when I started playing now you only get 5. Super hard levels with no boosters will quickly eat up 8 lives. 5? Blink and you'll miss it. I'm not opposed to in app purchases. I am opposed to outrageous pricing for those purchases. If you purchase coins to buy lives or boosters, be prepared to shell out some serious coin. I deleted the game and won't be playing it again. Too expensive to play, so, 2 stars.

Really enjoyed this game at first. But as others have said, too many stars are required to do many of the tasks. For example, the tasks required to complete a cake cost something like 15 stars! When it can literally take days to get past a really difficult level, that makes for pretty slow progression. It just stopped being fun honestly, I'm down for a challenge but this game eventually just got too hard/slow for me to bother with.

Not as satisfying as other similar games. A lot of limitations within the game as you progress (moves, boosters capabilities, lives, etc) so you dont have flexibility to play for a long time at once or benefit from rewards because you have to use them at the beginning if the game when blocks are locked/missing and less useful. Lack of autonomy in the game is meant to get you to buy coins so you can just enjoy the game. You are also unable to turn off story mode, so forced to spend time skipping.

I really did enjoy this game at first, but around level 80, something happened. The levels became INSANELY hard to beat without power-ups. I'm talking if you weren't lucky enough to get a chain reaction in the first few moves, you were doomed to fail. And then when you lost, it would give you the option of continuing... with items you purchased with real money. Is it TECHNICALLY possible to beat? Yes. Do I want to spend eight days on the same level? Nah. Uninstalled.

Love the game but it's too hard to pass some of the levels.-- some of the "easy" levels are harder to pass than the hard ones. -- Updated to add that level 1493 is horrible. Too many time bombs. It is supposed to be an easy level but it is not. I may quit playing again if I can't get past this one. It should not take days to get past a level that isn't marked hard. -- Final update: Made it to 1498, too many time bombs. Over it. Bye bye. Update: Same issues 3 years later. About to quit again.

I really like this game. Im on the brink of uninstalling. Ever since you added the alarm boms, it has literally made levels impossible to win and has taken away from the fun of the game. The levels are challenging enough to do with the few moves we get, but then add a timer that ends the game even when you have 12 moves left is ridiculous. This time, if I uninstall, it will NOT be reinstalled.

The game is fun, however, it's too hard. When a game is too hard, it's less fun. Also too much money to continue..you may need one more item and the cost to continue with five plays is 900. Way too much. I think that you should get an extra point for winning on the first round. Especially since they charge two and four points sometimes just to do one thing.

You have your game rigged to move pieces in the OPPOSITE direction you actually move them. The calibration sucks. I move a piece to the right and it goes to the left. You do this simply to suck more money out of the poor sap willing to pay to beat the level. And some of your levels considered not to be "hard" or "super hard" must've been selected by someone in a coma, because they have no idea what they're talking about when ranking the difficulty of a level.

Just Candy Crush with some extras. I thought this game would be a break from Candy Crush but it turns out it's the exact same thing. All the little games you see in previews are very few and far between. You get to upgrade a house, which is fun, but only when you win enough candy crush type levels. Right now, anything I do takes at least 3 levels beaten. So it's just monotonous at this point. 3 levels to hang a picture, 3 levels to hang the second picture. I'm over it.

Edit: Tried it again and was mostly surprised that it had gotten better. Then the forced work out gear into the room as an unchangeable element. I'm done yet again. Nope. The minute I went to spend money for "power ups" was the minute I knew it was a waste of time and money. It's pretty enough and the choices are nice but it takes so long in between to complete the mini games that it just isn't worth it. If you want a basic casual interior design game this isn't it. Waste.

I've been playing HOMESCAPES 3yrs (since the release)! I love the game and play a lot! HOWEVER: I HAVE NOTICED THAT PLAYRIX HAS GOTTEN GREEDY, THE SUPPORT TEAM TAKES A LONG TIME TO RESPOND, & WHEN THEY DO THEY USUALLY CAN'T HELP MUCH. The decorating part of the game is my favorite and I love Austin talking to me. Some match levels can get frustrating. I'd still recommend it to you. However I pre warn you that it can be frustrating at times. I think it's worth it for the most part though.

It's basically another candy crush that uses each game to renovate one small item at a time. It is a fun game however the ads are misleading. It looked like a trial and error game where you had different tools to fix rooms similar to the escape room games. As much as I like it I am rating it 3 stars for misleading ads. I was really looking forward to playing the game as it was advertised.

This game is designed to make you buy boosters to be able to progress through the puzzles. I was only on puzzle 67 and couldn't beat it without boosters. I tried about 40 times, only to finally give up. Youtube couldnt help because the puzzles are random. Such a shame. The game has potential, but I for one refuse to play a game that requires I purchase boosters to play it. I am usually pretty good at puzzle games, but this one sets you up to fail, in hopes you spend money (a lot of it).

Fun until the swipe game got ridiculously hard. I love this game, but after the first 10 or so levels, the swipe tile games were ridiculously hard. you have only a certain amount of chances to clear the tiles and you have to hit some tiles twice, but you aren't given enough chances to win without boosters which you have to buy. I uninstalled the game, and all of the other games the people make are the same, gardenscape, and fishdom. Don't invest any time in these games.

I downloaded this game a few years ago and deleted it. Once again, I installed the app because of the ad I saw. it was everything but not the ad. when you reach a certain level, it's impossible to beat the level. Of course, they tell you to contact their support to help you! how convenient... Limited moves to finish a challenge. Not designed to make you calm , it's just frustrating. Maybe it's time to update your game design or stick with what you're advertising.

I thought this would be fun, but when you complete a game you are only rewarded 50 coins plus extra coins - max you can get is 100+ sometimes 😁 If you need to buy more moves though it costs 900 coins and then more & more coins if you only have 1 or 2 things to achieve - where is the logic in that? You are not rewarded accordingly to gain the stars you need to help renovate. This is pretty much a money sucking game which I'm pretty much over. And the tasks I'm finding are just meaningless. Sorry

I love the game, for the most part, except for the small rewards on the difficult levels, the costly additions (for instance...3 stars to add a simple door. It took me all day to get those 3 stars!), and ALL THE CONSTANT upgrades that take up far too much space! I have other important apps on my phone and of it comes to having to delete them vs Homescapes, I'm sorry but Homescapes will have to go. I've been playing for a long while so I don't want to leave but the many updates are ridiculous!

I absolutely loved this game until level 88. I've put at least 30 hearts into the level, used up my powerups, bought extra turns, and I still can't beat it. It appears the only way to do so would be to spend money on the in game currency and get more powerups and turns, and then get really lucky. If the game is going to become impassible without purchasing add ons, just charge for the game instead.

I am thoroughly annoyed by this developer. I constantly see ads for these games, showing a choice-based storyline where you select what option will get you through the section of a level, or solve a little puzzle to get the character unstuck from the situation. The actual games? Matching cute little icons just like every other ad-spamming game, then you get to choose some kind of upgrade for a room or something you don't care about. False... Advertising!!! Bad developer! Bad!!

Thanks for the update. Now we only have to click power-ups 1x to use them. Good way to waste them accidentally. I hope the update didn't decrease the already absurdly low amount of moves you get in the higher levels. When I'm stuck on an impossible level, how-to videos on youtube show there used to be a lot more moves available. I shouldn't have to watch a 'how to' video just to beat a match 3 game!!! Smells like more cash-grab game manipulation.

Addictive in the beginning & great way to pass time. Coins earned are on the sparse side, so you have to be frugal with them, especially the higher levels past 100 or so (yes you will play it that much... I'm at 352) The 'makeover' of the garden & mini games make it more appealing to keep going forward... I really wanna see all of the garden sections in the end...??? If there is an end that is¿?

This game was really freaking fun for many levels. I enjoyed a lot of the events and renovating and decorating the house. I feel like the game is pretty generous with power ups and stuff for the most part... But now it is impossibly hard. I've been stuck on the same level for ages and finally uninstalled because I just can't beat the levels anymore and it's no longer fun. A little more balance for the high levels would be nice so I could continue to play.

I really enjoyed this game. However, the game wasn't same as what the ads showed to me. In the ads, they showed about if your house is in fire, you have to choose thing to put out the fire but the game doesn't even same. It was a game where you can play a match game and sometimes I took for 2 hours just to complete one level. I mean..it was good but doesn't if the level keep being difficult. Please help. This game should be fun not make peoples been stressing. 😫😫😫😕

Needs to have more bonuses and more stars when you beat a level. Especially when you get over level 2500. Now I can't download the latest update. This game is getting worse. The expeditions that come every so often don't give you enough time to finish, and you have to use a ridiculous amount of energy to chop down stuff and a ridiculous amount of coins for any of the extra that you can get along the path.

I downloaded because of the way the game was advertised, but the actual gameplay is so different. I expected it was about picking the best item to solve a problem such as putting out fires and house repairs as the videos and ads suggest. I figured the matching puzzle was an extra minigame. Really, the gameplay consists of just the matching puzzle like bejeweled. It's not a bad game, but I wanted to play what was advertised not this.

I forgot why I uninstall the game at the first time. The game was so cute. The image, the doll, the story.. So why did I uninstalled it? So I reinstalled the game and gave it a second chance. Ohh! I remember now. The higher level was ridiculously hard to pass even after your tenth time! You could not pass the level without using the bonus. (Only if you have some) If you don't have then you will have to spend money. Imagine if almost all level required you to do that. You'll be poor🤷‍♀️🤦‍♀️

About the same as other reviews, was fun at first, but now get stuck for days on a level (over 2500). Even with power ups and bonuses, eventually get lucky and might beat it...only to have another hard or super hard level after 2 normal ones. Can't compete the passes or challenge (then get a guilt trip about it), so I'm over it. No more season passes for me... Dropped a star in rating.

Misleading Ad and Stale Gameplay The ads I saw made this game seem like a puzzle game, but it turns out it's just a match-3 game with some house-renovating goal/reward system. At first, clearing stages and checking off the task list may satiate the craving for instant gratification, but the match-3 gameplay and the task system get stale pretty quickly. I got bored after 2 in-game days. If you're looking for a puzzle game that can really challenge your mind, keep looking.

Loved this game and didn't mind paying a little here or there, but now I'm advancing and it's just a ridiculous situation of making levels impossible without extras lives or assists... And once you buy, I feel you're targeted and they leave you missing one or two items and charging outrageous amounts to pass levels. I was going to keep playing but I find these types of behaviors disrespectful of the player. I'd love to support within reason... But you can keep the game with this approach. Not worth it. You've gotten the last dollar from me. Folks, find another game ..

I love the game but because every task requires so many stars its frustrating. that's what will eventually stop me from playing. it shouldn't take 4 stars for any task, cut us some slack. I spend allot but i'm getting frustrated. Everything else is great, but it should only take 1 or 2 stars per task, something big, 3 max. I feel like I spend so much time and money and aren't really getting anywhere

Starts out being entertaining in the early stages However, increasingly difficult levels eventually get to the point where you don't have enough resources to beat them. Level 20 puzzle is seemingly impassable. Been trying to beat this level unsuccessfully for weeks now. Simply put, the game can't be played for free very long unless you start purchasing with real $$ to buy expensive helper items to allow you to complete and move to higher levels. Used to be fun, not any more. Uninstalled, goodbye!

The puzzle aspect of the games, pull the pin style, that are in MOST of the ads I see for this, are mostly lies. You play those style puzzles very infrequently, and the puzzles you do get are matching games, like candy crush. No thanks. The rebuilding the house aspects are kinda interesting, but the ability to choose your scenario is not present, as advertised, and the initial story is lack luster, and boring. The ads in the game are annoying, but not as frequent as other games.

I downloaded this game because the ads lead you to believe this a unique "stop the disaster" game. In reality it is a puzzle game that you must pass the levels to continue the story. The levels were so hard I only got to about level ten before I stopped playing. I am not sure if at a higher level you actually have a chance to "stop disasters", but I feel it is pretty much a bate and switch, falsely advertised game.

Uninstalled. I was enjoying this game but it starts to become impossible beyond level 60. I've been trying to get past 67 for three days. I've spent money to get extra turns and power ups and nothing is helping. It's beyond frustrating. I'm invested in the stories of the mini events but they're all wrapping up in a few hours and I don't know how to beat these levels labeled super hard. I shouldn't be averaging one level every few days when each task requires at least two levels to fulfill.

Game started out okay but there are very few side (puzzle) games which is why I wanred to play this game. The actual matching game can ibe very challenging. It took numerous tries to beat some levels especially without using boosters. This game also keep trying to get me to install Gardenscapes, which was necessary to play one of the special events. Or maybe it was an ad that was made to appear as an event? Either way it was a little annoying but it didn't affect playing the game.

When I first started playing this game, it was fun, exciting, and different enough from Gardenscape to be enjoyable. Now when there are events the majority of the levels are the absolute hardest and they occur every 3rd or 4th level passed. Dev's made levels nearly impossible to pass without buying boosters etc. I stay away from the game for a few months hoping developers get a clue how to fix their issues, but nothing yet. Also, too similar to gardenscape & too much memory soaked up!

The story is solid and the characters are endearing, but the gameplay challenges are less about any skill and more about lucking out into having the right powerups in the exact right spots on the board at the right time (not to mention levels full of obstacles that only powerups can remove). Also you don't get much when you clear a level (50~ coins) versus the price for more chances in a level (900 coins). I'd give more stars for good atmosphere but this game is very blatant about cashgrabbing.

As many people on here have already noted, the advertisement is not what the game actually is, which is frustrating. The game is pretty simple and a time waster. I initially downloaded it because I was intrigued by the ads (should have read the reviews first) and hoped that something new (i.e., something like the ads) would happen after I got to a certain point in the game. If you like match-three games and silly storylines, this game is for you.

The game is fun to a certain extent. I continue playing it to find out how much of the house you can remodel. When playing the levels, if the game doesnt want you to win it, if you pay attention, it deliberately makes you lose . And on the hard levels, it will let you win when it wants you too. I have notice a lot of that after being stuck on certain levels for days just to try again one morning and win it in the easiest way. It can be very frustrating.

Sadly uninstalling. Gave it a good try though. Aside from being nothing like the advertisements, it's got a cute and compelling storyline. I don't like how you have to do a game every single time you need to advance the story and the "start a new day" is useless and silly considering we have to play almost impossible levels. This game is 1000% pay to win. At a certain point, it's almost impossible to win levels without boosters. I've paid for games, just don't see the worth in this one.

It's a fun concept, but I play games like this to relax. Once you get passed around level 45 or 50, it gets too difficult to be relaxing. Even with boosts and in game currency, it can take dozens of attempts to beat pretty low levels. My suggestion to the maker is to make collecting stars a bit easier, at least until after players can complete the first room.

Update on 9/19/2018. Still addicted to the game! Also glad that we are redoing the garden & outside areas as well. I would only ask that we have more choices of like wallpaper, floors ect. Everything is super dark or super frilly? Would like more options of colors or style. For example the floor in the uptairs is super funcky.. just my opinion. Thanks for keeping the game challenging!!! The graphics are amazing, the levels are super tough and make you think. I am only on level 723 and it's harder than Gardenscape was at that low of levels. I really like that there are three people that converse compared to Gardenscape we're people only visit Austin. Although, sometimes you move a piece and the games does a different move. Overall I am hooked on this game as well 😚

The game wasnt what ad made it out to be. As a matter of fact it is nothing like the ad said it was but ended up being fun. The concept is cool but like many others said the levels are rigged and you get stuck on them for ever unless you purchase cheats. I enjoy playing and designing the mansion but have gotten annoyed and stop playing due to that.

Fun game, but once you reach level 50, it feels as though you need to pay to win. The double chains makes it hard to finish the level within the given number of moves. There was the occasional 'side-game' that popped up to give a bit of diversity, but I'd like it if there were more of it. I didn't enjoy the pacing of the story all that much, because we needed stars for every action. It disrupted the flow and you stop caring at some point, because you're concentrating on beating the game levels.

I get some apps have difficult levels and some perks are really cool , I sometimes spend a little for those things. I do however have a problem with games that create situations where you cannot pass certain levels without buying power ups. I give it a 1 because it was ok until I realized that issue. If the dev's weren't so money hungry people would gladly pay a little here and there to have a good experience.

unless you want to spend a lot of real money, don't get it. I was really disappointed. Once you reach a certain level (before you've even finished a whole room of the house) the puzzles become too difficult to pass without buying more lives with gold. The problem is, the only way to get more gold is to buy it with real money. I spent 3 days trying to pass a level without spending gold. It's impossible. Especially since once you've failed 5 times to our have to wait to play again. I just deleted.

I love this game. Play it daily, but I dont like that I get airplanes and there is no point in using them because they dont hit ANYTHING. Then you get your stars but have to use 4 to do the simplest things, or you spend coins because you may be missing one thing and then you get 5 moves and your plane or arrow hits everything but what you need. It's very disappointing. Have got to the point of wanting to delete it.

I used to enjoy this game. In earlier levels, you could clear pretty easily with the occasional difficult level. Now, since I have progressed pretty far, every other level is "hard" or "very hard" and takes several days to clear one level. I have exhausted all of my power ups and coins and get stuck on levels. Typical money grab technique I guess. Start easy, rope em in, then make it nearly impossible with out spending $3 here and $5 there.

game is really fun, if you're on a team its very easy to get lives when you run out, BUT the hard and super hard levels are impossible to pass if you don't BUY multiple moves and special power up things, which you have to usually spend money on. I'd give it 5 stars if those levels weren't so ridiculously hard and impossible to pass. so if you dont want to spend actual money and get frustrated with unpassable levels, THIS GAME IS NOT FOR YOU! 🤷🏻‍♀️

I would normally rate this game high, as it's very fun. However, after playing for many years, the game has completely restarted on me TWICE, losing all of my progress and starting from the beginning. Both times, I think I am following the instructions to not override the previously saved game, and it does it anyways, starting a new game. First, it shouldn't keep restarting on me for no reason. Second, it shouldn't be this easy to override the previous game saved.

It passes time when you're lazy feeling. But good luck using any strategy at all in these games. They suck really bad. It's all computer generated if the computer wants you to win then you will if it doesn't then you won't. You literally have better odds winning at the casino then on one of these levels. They will let you play until they have your data patterns then watch out. They should just have a simulation button for each level see if you win or loose. Make a purchase and see what happens

Total waste of time!!! Levels are beyond passable unless you spend mega amounts of money! Its designed for failure unless you line their pockets!! I'm all for spending money on APs if its reasonable, but this AP is excessive and greedy!! Don't waste your time getting sucked in to the easy rounds, it goes down hill fast, real fast!! It is also nothing like the advertisement for the game. None of the games are that type of challenge. Just same over and over, so misleading! Zero stars!

The game is really fun. I seriously play it with my friends. But i think the time where you change the reward of super hard levels from 2 stars to coins are just making the game more time consuming, add up the hard levels. I wish you add more customizable options like for the characters and items that makes the game user-friendly. Overall good game

I like this game a lot! It's just not really accurately advertised, and it'd be nice if there were more challenge and strategy in the minigames that are advertised. But it's a lot like candy crush except you get to design a home along with it, and I find that a lot more enjoyable. It's a great game to play when you have no wifi, and theres no ads.

Even though this game has great graphics, it is really annoying. it is annoying that levels get crazy hard early on in the game. I wanted a fun relaxing yet a little challenging kind of game. instead even the easy levels take me several times to beat. I also hate all the pointless tasks. there is nothing more frustrating than to spend two days getting one star only to use it on catch the bird. you also stay in the same place for too long. how many times can you add stuff to the same room?

the game in itself is nice, but there's a bit of false advertising. i didn't know there was a "candy crush" portion to the game because that was not included in the ad. i just saw the portion where you drag and drop the appropriate solution to different chaotic issues in the household. i could personally care less for puzzle games like that, so I'll be uninstalling.

The game overall is just ok. The issue is when you need to spend coins to buy extra moves to complete a level. 900 coins only buys you 5 extra moves. Way too expensive. Also, the star system is not balanced or fair. For completing a normal level, hard level, and super hard you only earn 1 star each. Some tasks require 1 to 3 stars or more to complete. Why does making a phone call require stars? Why do you have to spend stars to start a new day after you completed an area/level? Please fix this.

I like the puzzle with story games. This puzzle is fun and unique not only in shape and color but by the combos you can do. at least it's unique to me though I'm pretty sure it's similar to a "candy crush" style though I've only seem it but not played it.🤣 But like most games of it's type it follows suit that the further you go the more you need the boosters to complete puzzles and then the hit you up with pay us so you can continue. It's annoying.

A good game... Yet, you don't do a lot of the challenges that you see on the advertisements. You clear levels of the match three or more colors and only get ONE star. I'm noticing now you maybe get two, that doesn't seem to be always. The advertisements for this game is more, get him to safety in the boat, repair the room with the right tools, they're in a tent what items do they need more then it shows what the game truly is. We need more of the fun challenges like the game advertisements show.

I do not like that you have to use a star to make him sleep. I think it's a waste. And rooms have way too many things to do. I want to get to the other rooms! And I don't want to take 50 years on one room. Like 10 or 15 levels a room sounds cool per room. But I understand the devs want a lot of levels for serial players. I also think 900 coins for 5 more turns is ridiculous when you get 50 coins a level. some of the levels are way to hard for early on in the game. It shouldn't be super easy but,,

Love the game to pass time.... disappointed that they false advertised the fact you could play puzzles and it's just a fancy bejeweled game, and also when I match enough colors I get cheated out of a booster (not all the time, but enough that it's irritating). Other than that I would have given a higher rating. Hopefully with this update it will be better!

I used to love this game but now I don't even see the point to playing anymore. Hard levels are really impossible, and when we are stuck we lose a lot of the special events rewards. It's not even fun anymore. And the planes changed. And when there are many boards on same lvl, all the added up boosters get lost. Which make it even more impossible to pass. I am stuck at lvl 106 and am thinking more about uninstalling the game. No fun anymore.

This game is such a joke. Way too hard after a certain amount of levels, mini games that you only get to play if the crappy algorithm picks you out of hundreds of other players (WHAT???). It's not worth the time, effort, or money. Sick of these stupid ads for a puzzle game when you can't even play the mini games without being the high and mighty chosen one. Bullcrap.

I wish rennovations didn't cost so much, and the levels were easier. I downloaded this game because I really liked the who home rennovation concept, but I've just been stuck on one level after another, and it's starting to get quite infuriating. I mean, it's just boring to play the same level over and over knowing that the only way that you will ever beat it is to get lucky, and you have no idea how long it will take for luck to find you. The fun and interesting part of the game is the rennovation part, but because of the difficulty of the levels, you don't actually get to do the rennovation part very often.

Editing my review down. I've been playing for quite awhile. When I saw the new ads with the new challenges, I was so excited! I've reached the unbeatable levels. Don't mind paying a little bit every now and then. But geez! Can't get past levels w/o paying ridiculous amount of money, new sections don't open, and FORGET what you see in those ads because it NEVER happens. It's a basic match-3 game. No deciding what to use to fix the sink, save yourself from sharks on the iceberg or ANYTHING!

Cute story line - can get more tasks accomplished with fewer wins on this game than GardenScapes, so that's a nice change. Edit - took off 1 star because I'm having much more difficulty getting through the lower levels of this game than other, similar games (including Gardenscapes). Not sure why - maybe I'm not in tune with the flow of this game as well. But it does cause frustration.

The game is solid and the objectives are reachable. However, 3 stars due to the alarm clock obstacle that you encounter later in the game. It is easily and by far the WORST addition that could have been added. Takes the skill away and leaves you with only random luck to defeat it. And if you don't? Level lost regardless of remaining moves.

I like the graphics, and characters. I like unravelling the storyline as I go. I enjoy the puzzles. The fact that they are difficult can be frustrating, however, it is all the more rewarding when that level is completed. I like all of the rewards the game gives you. Sometimes it is difficult to beat events before they are over, though I enjoy playing them while they last. The controls are easy, the puzzles are fun. I like seeing all the different design combinations for the mansion as well.

It was alright at first. But once you hit level 65+ it takes too much to beat the level (one level required all my powerups, plus bonus ones and still wasn't enough) and progress. Also being on level 75, I expected to have more puzzles that are in the avatar, but I have done 4 of them. Downloaded it to play those puzzles, not connect 3 the whole time (which is alright if mixed properly).

Graphics, storyline and game play are excellent. However it frustrates me instead of relaxing me. TOO few moves! Let me say that again, TOO few moves! Having a great game and not allowing the player to enjoy the game is a pity. Where is the relaxed mode? Why not have the challenges with a small number of moves and the main game in a more relaxed pace? A real pity for all the great artwork the game has to demonstrate.

takes too long, you should make it that if you clear a board first time you get 2 stars. sorry it gets boring after awhile. I'm deleting it. You make it take too long plus when I bust up the blocks a lot of the times it does not clear the board and then it takes my moves away. Not really any fun. And you also only give 5 lives and have to wait a half hour to build them up, nah it's just too time consuming and doesn't make it fun. Waiting that long makes a person forget about the game. Thanks

The game plays well on my lower end phone. Graphically is kinda nifty. I didn't play it for a really long time and I appreciate the option it gives the player to skip over aspects of the game that the player may not want to see/do I'm gameplay. It did inspire me to check out another couple of games that are nearly the same as far as the parts of acheiving the points to perform the tasks in this game. Such as the disco ball, the bomb, the airplanes and whatnot. For so reason I found that part 👍

Falling to 2 stars. There are barely any filler levels and it seems every other one is hard or super hard. It's incredibly frustrating as you cannot progress in this game without stars. So it just sits there...it shouldn't take more than 3 rounds of lives to beat a single level, tips and tricks are useless. The one shot levels are a joke and not even worth the effort. Then when you finally do get on streak the tasks cost so many stars it's barely a few minutes of progress. Lame and boring now.

I think that Austin is a little narcissistic, but I'm willing to go along with that. The levels don't seem all that hard, but it's still easy to get stuck. With so few power ups and no qui k ways to earn coins, this game stops being fun quickly. I may delete it. Update: I've gotten fed up and deleted this a bunch of times. I'll probably do so again. There are ways that this game pretends to be fair that really annoy me. But it's also one of the less cringey match 3 games out there.

Used to love this game, but absolutely cannot stand "The Tournament of Champions." The levels are SO obnoxious, you don't get stars, and it comes so often that it's a constant irritation. It also hinders my game play because since the levels are so obnoxious, as well as not being able to get stars (to do the building and therefore get boosts) I get stuck way too often and can't help my teammates - or even myself - in event activities. Please change this! It's just not fun anymore.

A great game I've enjoyed for years. But the devs implemented many changes that reduced the gameplay to a luck-based puzzle where every other level is hard or very hard so you pay money for coins to get power ups - which oftentimes don't help. I despise the alarm clock obstacle that ends the game. It'd be better if there were only 1-2 clocks on the board at a time instead of 5+ clocks with only 6 moves left on them all. It's all money-grab techniques.

The ads for this are incredibly misleading, for the actual gameplay is almost entirely different. The games themselves are fun if you're into the match-em-up style game however they become so repetitive that it becomes boring and quickly. I wish gameplay were more similar to the ads, or at least that there were more variety in the games. I'd be more likely to spend money on this if it were more capable of keeping my attention.

I really enjoyed the game at first. Even gave it 5 stars initially. Great graphics and the concept is good. But I found the higher up I got, the more some of the levels seemed nearly IMPOSSIBLE to beat without paying $$ for help. I'm typically against spending money in games, but I found this one so enjoyable, I didn't mind spending a dollar or two. I now regret that decision considering I'm no longer enjoying this game. Games are meant to be relaxing not stressful.

Before you download: Hands down match-3 candy crush clone. Rarely, there are super short, super easy mini games, like you see in the ads (as well as in the game icon) that seem to only serve the purpose of negating any false advertising claims, and they aren't even any fun. There is a storyline, redecorating and remodeling a house, but you have to play the match 3 puzzles in order to progress with the remodel. Constant upselling of powerups that seem neccesary to progress. Not reccomended.

False advertisement. I kept seeing ads in my other games for this homescspes game. The ad looked super fun. It showed you could put fires out, choose tools to do certain things. If the game was exactly how it's shown in the ad, it would be really fun. But the actual game is so freaking boring. Just another candy crush type thing. And lots of text and boring stuff. Nothing at all like the advertising.

Level of difficulty increases rapidly, more so than similar genre type games. They go right to the sales pitch and theres absolutely no getting by a level if you dont purchase. Experienced CC, Bejeweled etc player and was looking for a new game. Repeatedly stumped by level 40 puzzles and stuck on the same one for days now. Taking the app of my device. I'll find another game to give my money to. Don't waste your time.

So I did enjoy the game a little bit but I wanted to write a review to let people know that the ads that they've been showing are wrong. This game is a matching game (candy crush style) with the ability to choose like 3 different layout options for rebuilding some mansion. If you have a game you should show the game, not some other game that you can't even play. Advertising done very wrong.

While the game was fun (for a match-3), the ads are terrible and inappropriate. There is nothing adult about this game, yet ads depict Austin tied spread-eagle to a bed! That's not okay to show children! Furthermore, this is just a match-3 game. There are no other options to play it, such as situations described in ads. Either fix the ads or fix the game.

Loved this game, played every day, spent over $100.00 a month but thought it was worth it because of how much I played. Then I had a cust service issue...spoke to 6 people, not one bothered to read what the issue was, just gave me the scripted "uninstall/reinstall" Then when I got to the last person "oops, the event is over, better luck next time" without ever actually fixing it.

Annoying. Just got 14 levels first go in a row, with all the extras plus flints extras and I can't get through this level because of the bubbles. They are so rapid and you rarely get matches next to them. Even using coins to get extra moves it's practically impossible unless you use real money... had this problem throughout but this time is really annoying. Couldn't of have any extra help and still can't pass?????? The anger is real.

fun game; but they cheat you on the power ups. if you use the powerball, they will make it so that's the only move you have at the beginning of the game, essentially wasting the potential boost you'd receive if you paired the Powerball with the paper planes or another booster. if you use the planes, it will take them to a place that doesn't help you win the level, so that wastes 2 moves.

Better than the previous versions. More options on each level. However, it purposely doesn't give you the colors needed to win expecting you to buy coins to continue. I maintain that I don't like not getting the tiles needed to complete the level. Otherwise it's engaging. I didn't know there was an update. I do like the game. No change to my comments. Game is crashing. Can't get to the settings to let developers know!!

FALSE ADVERTISING!!!!!! The ONLY reason I installed this game is because the ads make it look so much fun and I was really looking forward to playing it. However, once it was installed, I found out its NOTHING like the ads. Its a completely different game with the same characters. So, I decided to keep playing thinking maybe at some point it would be like in the ads....nope still nothing like the ads so I uninstalled. Ads are so misleading. Major disappointment!!

Fun game; charming characters, and entertaining storylines. HOWEVER - rewards & costs of decorations are terribly skewed, which is discouraging. Player earns only 1 star for beating a level, regardless of the rating (regular, hard, super hard). And to pay NINE stars to place 3 chairs was infuriating. Also do not like the alarm clock obstacles - sucks the joy out of the game, and I dont play as much as I used to because of that. Overall, a nice game, though.

Started out cool then suddenly you are stuck on levels for a long time, the rewards are not great enough for the amount of times you have to play to beat one level and then you can not move on farther unless you spend your own money and it is not a buck or 2. I had to uninstall this game after spending approximately $75.00. The match 3 part is not great, the side games should be actual games. I wanted to be able to make upgrades on the house faster. Looking for another more rewarding game.

Don't get me wrong.. I love the game. It's my go-to game "whenever" I'm frustrated and want something to clear my head with and it works! But there are some glitches. The few moves that are given in difficult levels is so frustrating. After accumulating a reasonable amount of coins hoping to make a purchase for some boosters you're forced to use them to continue the unfinished level. And don't even get me started on the expeditions. They are always impossible to complete. But I love the game

Not the same thing as advertised. I went through levels of fixing up the Butler's home by collecting coins. You win coins by playing different matching puzzle games. At no point did I see anything like they claim. Maybe after you have renovated everything? I was unwilling to go that far. Wouldn't have minded going further if that was what I downloaded it for. I agree with other reviewers, some levels are very difficult and you can get stuck.

Enjoyed the game and recognize the efforts it required to create the graphics, storytelling, and puzzles. I was totally willing and happy to pay for a well designed game, until 58,000 coins run through like water. Now it seems bottomless to pay to keep up with playing the game. I'd rather have the option of buying out the game once and can play forever.

Too difficult to pass levels, no fun. I get that you wanted to make the levels difficult enough to be satisfying when beaten, but you have taken that to a ridiculous level. I get stuck on level for days and only can beat it if I'm lucky enough to have the gems (or whatever they are) fall in just the right way so I can make powerful pieces and it's designed so I feel like I might be able to beat it by buying boosters. WRONG. You'd think money spent would be spent well? NO. Just a money pit. F***

The game stopped working, I tried all the troubleshooting suggestions and then some. There's no opportunity to contact anyone except thru a bogus chat with no live person. Aside from not being able to actually play the game due to crashes and freezes, it's made to be addictive and take your money the way a casino game does so I wouldn't want my kids playing it. You can see one of the powerups (plane) delibertly making the wrong move and many of the renovations are just frustrating.

The game is honestly really enjoyable.. until they start making the mini game levels too difficult to pass without purchasing power ups. The mini games require no real skill needed to pass the levels, its all the luck of what items come up to match together. But without power ups that you have to pay for its impossible. I really like this game and find myself wanting to play, but don't want to be forced into buying power ups to clear a level. Very disappointing. I Uninstalled.

This is a game that will require money to advance. If you don't mind spending money for extra turns or extra bonuses then this game is fun. But don't think for a second you will be able to play for free. In order to fix the house u need to beat a board that is similar to candy crush. However there are never enough moves to do so. Which then require you to wait until you have another life (30 minutes) to try again. Example: i played for 3 days at a level before i gave up and bought bonuses.

Would have given this game 5 stars considering how addictive it is but the levels are too difficult to please do something about it please. How can I be stuck in a particular level for almost five days?? Please iñcrease the stars per level because sometimes I forget I'm supposed to renovate the house. Also increase the money at the end of the game. How can I use alot of boosters during the game and at the end I don't even get up to 100 or even 80???? It's so annoying . Please fix it🙏🙏🙏

Some levels on here take too long to beat. Even after using boosters and buying coins and boosters, I still can't win the level. I'm frustrated to the point of not playing anymore. It's bad enough trying to get enough stars to complete tasks. Been on same level now for over a week. Not wasting any more of my money or time. RIDICULOUS!!!

5 stars for the characters, story line, and first 20 puzzle levels. After that, forget it ... 1 star. You're subjected to hards to super hard impossible puzzles after you get past lvl 20, to beat without dipping into your real life wallet (which I won't do). It's sad. TO DEVELOPER - Keep the same leveling puzzles (like at beginning) throughout the game (keep it fun). No puzzles that are definitely impossible to do on 1 try. Maybe "options" to choose difficulty.

Had the game for a while and it's fine, bit definitely gets boring after a while. The actual gameplay is basically candy crush. It can be really frustrating because you'll get stuck on levels a lot and I think they do that on purpose to encourage you to spend money on stuff. The game constantly pushes you to spend money The storyline is boring, the decorating part is okay but basic. The ads I see for it are also completely different than anything in the game which is just false advertising.

Fun, enjoyable. Like the story line, keeps things interesting. The major down side is if in normal or hard levels some take a very long time to win. You will be down to 5 moves have only one last piece to collect and not get the needed pieces to finish level. Is very frustrating. Especially when this happens 10 to 15 times in a row. In upper levels if you don't buy needed pieces you will play same levels for weeks. Game has become pay to play. I stopped playing after this.

Updated review- I really enjoyed this game, even with the very difficult levels that sometimes took days to beat. About a month ago the game stopped loading on my phone out of the blue. I kept waiting for an update that might fix it, but nothing. Today I finally deleted the app - a game I've been playing for well over a year. All that progress is gone. Super disappointing.

Pretty cool game. Gets VERY challenging and difficult after a little. Not that there's anything wrong with that, I'm just sayin. But I thought that most of the game would be decorating and choosing interior, but apparently I was (very) wrong... It relies heavily on match 3. So if you're into that, you're gonna like this game. It has a cool twist of decorating.

It's a fun matching game but the design part is why I downloaded it. Unfortunately, I don't even get to really decorate how I want to anymore. I'm renovating the second home now, as I'm well in the 4700 level area, and the game just makes all the design choices for me. Once in a blue I'll be able to pick the floor tile but, other than that, I don't get to choose the furniture or decor anymore. I hate their choices and want to decorate it differently!

I waited to write my review until I came across one of the unbeatable levels (because every game has one). I'm sick of developers targeting children with levels that seem impossible to pass, so they cave in and purchase powerups. Level 78 is nearly impossible to win without multiple, multiple powerups. I've played that round more than 20 times now using different strategies, and it really isn't passable. Shame on your for tricking children the way you do. No stars.

I loved the concept, but frankly I started to hate the game as the match-3 levels became absurdly difficult while the renovations became more costly. I don't enjoy playing the stupid matching games, I just wanted to progress the renovation. Once I spent three days hammering away unsuccessfully at one puzzle while I needed to beat five more to finish the tasks on my list, I lost interest. Edit: Your ad videos are blatant lies. Actual gameplay looks nothing like the ads. Shame on you.

Disappointed with the recent update. While the game is still fun and challenging, it is also aggravating. The curtain is slow to open in the Halloween section - that's minor. The scoring system is at times unfair. I'm on level 1514. When I combine 2 bombs together to explode, they're not always counted or they're slow to be counted. If I perform this action next to a yellow lampshade(s), they count, not the bombs. This is not right. I've encountered this same issue in the past. Please fix.

Way way way too difficult without spending a bunch of money for more lives and tools. I wasn't going to blow a bunch of money. So I ended up stuck in one puzzle for 2 weeks. Crazy aggravating! They give you these puzzles that are challenging enough on their own, which is fine. But then they give you only 8 moves in which to solve it, and you can't! It's impossible! It was fun renovating the few things I was able to. But since I can't get past this one puzzle, I guess I'm done.

Great game to sit and play if you like puzzle games. It is a bit above ordinary match 3 games. Can get a bit frustrating though, when the "hard" boards start showing up every 3rd board. Also as some others have stated it sometimes takes a very long time to clear those boards if you do not have or purchase power ups to help. I have deleted Gardenscapes at over level 4000 for this reason this one may be next.

It's nothing like the ads show, and it's actually a spending game, just to beat the levels you need to spend money because you can't beat the levels to earn the coins, and the same goes for gardenscapes as well. If both games were like you see in the ads for the games then I would continue to play both games but unfortunately I've uninstalled them due to these reasons.

The drawback –as per usual– is the monetization/push to pay for progress; which is typical for these kind kf FTP games. Once you hit level 50+ the puzzles are practically impossible to beat without powerups. Other than that— well done, fun to play, and the different options for furnishings are nice. The mini-games are fun, and add a nice break from the usual match puzzles. It would be cool if those popped up a bit more frequently.

Addictive, but the cost of stuff is ridiculous compared to what you receive. Once you get past 600 it loses its fun and charm. Some levels make you wanna quit all together, while others are tough but still fun. I like it more fun not frustrating. The whole super hard levels are killing the game for me. Playing the same level over and over again is boring.

The game itself is fantastic, I love the story, been playing for years, but the new mechanic you guys implemented is just....it ruined the game for me actually. I would buy packs and everything, but those timers you added in are just plain unfair. Even WITH powerups. I tried and tried, but having thirty moves and having it end at ten moves just because of a timer going off because you couldn't match with it fast enough...really ruined the game for me. Please remove this.

It sucks you in to buy coins when you've been stuck on a level forever, & you'll get down to only needing ONE MORE, so that tempts you to buy it just to get past the level.
