But my MAIN COMPLAINT at this time is that I have lost access to all of my friends list, after troubleshooting many times and trying all options possible, I contacted customer support and get the response that tech is aware of the problem and is working on a solution. That was over 3 weeks ago!!!

I installed this game based on ads for it in other apps. Those ads are super misleading! This is not about making choices to prevent catastrophes, as the ads suggest, it's just shape matching to get points, which can then be traded for furniture and renovations. Addictive enough that I played for awhile, but not at all what I expected.

This game is mostly fun. However the higher levels Often end up costing me some money to purchase coins. I would play it more often if it were improved to the betterment of the player. So Chaz when you have 1 or 2 or 3 objects to clear should be able to obtain a certain number of coins to complete that level. After a while I just got tired of it and uninstalled it.

I like the game but I feel like it takes forever to complete a day. Also if you get 1 star for a regular level you should get 2 for a hard level and 3 for super hard. There should be more ways to get more stars too rather than just beating the game. Maybe an undo last move button or make that a special like the hammer. it's time to fix these issues I don't pay as much any more. smh

I actually have enjoyed this game more than I expected. However, at this point I'm about to get rid of it. The games are in my opinion to difficult to pass without having "outside help" or using coins to continue the game. This is why I stopped playing Candy Crush because the higher levels you get to, it takes forever to actually win one. It's gets boring and frustrating playing the same game over and over again. I'm only in the 100's and it is taking about 2 days to beat just one game.

It's addicting and interesting in regards to renovations. However, I'm on level 1800 something and still doing ridiculous things like wasting 2 or 3 stars to make a phone call. After getting only one star per level, it doesn't seem very worth it when the deeper you get into the house the more stars you have to spend! I'm up to spending 4 stars on a task sometimes 8 if you consider 2 part tasks. Used to earn 2 stars on hard and extra hard, now it's just one. I find myself playing less and less!

This is clickbait. The ads make the game look very fun as you drag different items to solve problems in different places. This looks like a fun game. The actual game, on the other hand, is a waste of time. It is pay-to-win, it doesn't include what the ads led me to believe. This game is an entire lie, and is not worth the storage on your phone or your download. Homescapes is just a crappy version of Candy Crush Saga, which I'm sure they drew "inspiration" from (aka they just stole the idea).

It was extremely fun at first i loved it. Then I got to a level where it was extremely hard. It kept rearranging my pieces over and over like it had no idea how to solve it its self. I ended up using all my powerups and it was trying to prompt me to buy. With that, i uninstalled the game and gave up. Also as you get higher, the levels should give you more than one star. Just one is stupid.

I've only been playing for a couple of days, but it is addicting. I wish that I didn't to have to use my hard earned stars for pointless tasks (e.g. naming the cat, answering the door, dressing the scarecrow, etc). It also takes way too long to earn a new life. I think that 10-15 mins is reasonable. It'd also be nice if we could earn more than one star after completing a puzzle. I'm only on level 45 and several of the puzzles have already been difficult. Update 10/7/18: I've been stuck on level 564 for quite awhile. It doesn't seem like I'll be able to pass it, so I'm thinking about deleting the app. Basically every task costs 3 stars now even the tedious ones. I was having so much fun with this game and now it just makes me frustrated. It takes way too long to open a room. I was stuck in the garden for ages. I could go on and on about what changes could be made, but a lot of the other reviewers have already addressed them.

So this is a completely different game from what was advertised. If you came here looking for a "choose the correct tool" kind of game, this is not it. It's a 3 way match game like Candy Crush. I stayed playing thinking that the gameplay will change later on. Nope. Although it is kind of fun to play, it gets ridiculously harder as you go on. I've noticed other reviewers saying they've spend money to move pass levels, however, I never have. I gave it 2 stars because of its difficulty and false ad

FALSE ADVERTISING!!! The game is nothing like the ads, its just a dressed up candy crush with a tiny bit of story between the levels. You have to pass the candy crush levels to keep remodeling the house. The levels get hard way too fast, and it is overall frustrating and boring. Not worth downloading unless you really like candy crush type games. If you are expecting something like the ads, don't bother.

Nothing at all like the advertisements, and I deleted the app because I and several other friends could not pass level 106. I wanted a mindless game to play, and after I watched the advertisement, I decided this was a perfect fit. Not worth your time! Very disappointed in the game. It is extremely misleading.

The game was marketed as a resource management / puzzle game. It turned out to be a candy crush alternative. Additionally, some puzzles are unsolvable or require you to spend money to solve. Generally, in game progress is very slow. Lastly, the story represented a VERY UNSAFE situation with a cat and a parrot. Deleting this app. It's not as advertised.

It started as a fun game very nice graphics and enjoyable storyline, and varying degrees of challenging levels to complete. Though I still like the game, I am becoming incredibly frustrated when I cannot complete the level after multiple tries using all three power in combination including two rainbow balls. That means despite their claims, the level is too hard to beat without using money to beat the level. And at that point it becomes more frustrating than it is fun. Greed is ruining this game.

You require more stars to complete tasks as we go through the game so give us more stars on the hard levels!!!! Let us use our unlimited lives when we want. We spend WAY too much time on a room or area - I've been in the garden for weeks now and it's getting really old planting flowers and hanging lanterns. Plus it looks super cluttered. I want to move back to the house - I've only worked on 3 rooms! It seems like everyone is giving this same feedback so FIX IT!!!

Takes way too long to beat hard and super hard levels. Shouldn't take weeks and weeks. Especially when there are mini games going on. Can't win ribbons or tickets or stars, when you are on the same level for almost the entire contest. It is why I deleted Gardenscapes and getting ready to do the same with this one. Would not recommend this to any of my friends, in fact, I tell them don't waste your time.

Homescapes, how do I hate thee, let me count the ways... 1. The monetization is very aggressive. You truly cannot play or enjoy this game without frequent double-digit payments. 2. The "mini-games" you see in the ads are few and far between, and the renovation elements are stifled by the constant need to pay match-3 games. 3. The match-3 games are INSANELY HARD. 4. The money I did spend was wasted because the rewards were still dependent on clearing a certain number of levels - SCAM.

This is a fun-to-play version of the universal "match 3 of the same colour" game. However, the levels of this game get RIDICULOUSLY HARD RIDICULOUSLY FAST. After only 50 or so levels, every 3 or 4 levels are impossible to win unless you get to match certain very rare combinations, which means it can be shown mathematically that an optimally intelligent player will solve those levels only 1 out of 100 trials. That means you can be stuck on a level for 2 weeks unless you pay the ransom. (You have to achieve a goal in a limited number of steps or lose a life; after 5 life losses, you are blocked to play for 30 minutes unless you pay REAL MONEY for 5 more lives, or if you pay REAL MONEY for 5 more steps beyond the life loss.) They should offer a one-off payment in exchange for unlimited lives for ever, but instead they want to suck your blood again and again and again. For ever.

Like many others i too downloaded the game because of the advertisements. The game is no way what they say it is. The false advertising is deceitful and shameful. The levels are ridiculously hard to beat without purchasing coins. The fact that it takes 900 coins to continue is outrageous. The game is designed to block you at every turn. Earning one star per level to complete simple tasks that take at least 2 or 3 stars is crazy. Terrible game. I am uninstalling and will not recommend to anyone.

This game and Machington Mansion feel exactly the same. Both are shape matching games and both are remodeling a mansion. They appear to have the same mansion, characters, and story lines. I've played both games enough to know they get hard and also eventually become boring. These games are nothing like the advertisements. I even reinstalled the game to see if they had changed it after seeing an advertisement. NOPE! Game hasn't changed. This is the epitome of false advertising.

Overall I enjoy the game. But there are some things about it that upset me. The planes going for an item that doesn't help me, some of the levels are extremely hard... Too hard... It needs more opportunities to get boosters and not spend money to win levels. Update: you don't get to play the mini games. It's just an ad so you will download the app. And I don't like how it takes a ton of stars to complete one task. And if you don't spend money, it could take days to complete one task...

Again, here's a game with levels that are almost virtually impossible to beat without power-ups. They design these games to have easy levels at the beginning to get you addicted, and then levels later on that are designed to get your money, because you're already addicted. It's a science. Also, that clapping thing that Austin does after most levels is pretty irritating. I try to continue as quickly as possible, but the annoying prick always manages to get in a couple of claps.

Like Fashion Makeover the advertisement for this game seems fun and you think it will be something different then what it is but no. Same ol' Candy Crush like game to earn coins that make it hard not to buy more coins to try to get addons to try to win levels (which are not cheap). I enjoyed the story, characters, and the mini games (which in the advertisements, these mini games are seen as the real game but they are few and far between) but I spent way too much money just to try to win levels.

The ad said 'I finally found a game that was exactly like the ads'. That ad lied twice. Not only is this game nothing like the ads, it is even less like the ads than the other 'not like the ads" games. But I'm still giving it three stars because, despite being NOTHING like the ads that say this game is 'just like the ads´, it's still a pretty fun game. Seriously though, you need to fix those ads, because those are not only lying, they are usually annoying as well. STOP! Decent game otherwise.

I have stubbornly persisted with this game. Some levels are impossibly hard on purpose (even if you are a smart player, unlike me), but will eventually concede to me after a few attempts without success. A pretty obvious ploy to get you to spend money for coins if you are impatient. A nice little storyline to keep you interested. I'm looking forward to finding out the ending.

I found this very boring. After 10 levels of doing basically the same thing over and over again, I deleted it. You play a matching type game, get a star, then choose a piece of furniture. The next level is the exact same except the matching game is a little different. It isn't anything like all the endless ads I've seen for it. Maybe after a certain level it changes to that, but I was too bored to find out.

Changed my review. Over time this game gets difficult and some of the function pushes against your favor. The game added a number of great additions but if you're a long time player you have difficulty getting the new things without paying for it. (A new player could clear numerous levels easily to get the new pets but a veteran player is already well into hard levels.). The game used to be casual and fun but is becoming a bit obnoxious. Moving on to something else.

Fun game fur a bit. But is not about escaping traps as is advertised. Similar to candy crush? Line up pieces to get clubs, points etc. Use coming to renovate old house. But around level 40 ish....... The game gets VERY hard. Often, you only need one more piece too get to next level and are tempted to buy coins to do it. I almost wonder if the game is designed to take you to the brink so you spend money. If skill alone won't cut it and you have to buy your way up. I don't want to play.

Came back after a very long time (years), to find many new things, it seemed better. BUT: THE ECONOMY GOT WORSE. I'm at a standstill most of the time at about the same point, despite the side stuff. Playrix, i bought your Farmscape games on several platforms for different computers. I'm so disappointed in this one. The economy is so blatantly greedy.☹️ Reward your players. Not just every ten levels, for a while. Don't make impossible levels. People rage quit. And don't be jerks about bonuses.

Game started to freeze after new android update, but I am not sure if it is related. It is basic match 3 game with a little decoration on the side. It is bit frustrating, when you need to spend 4 stars on building a bookshelf, especially when it means passing 4 hard levels... This is not very well thought, or maybe it is, but only developers have fun. Boosters are way too expensive, also when there is "discount". Also I would suggest to chose other main character, he looks really creepy XD

I got this game to get a reward in a different game (so I could get a reward in yet another game) and I'm considering giving up. It used to be hard, like took-three-people hard. Now it's I-just-spent-two-and-a-half-hours-on-one-level hard. Please return the game to how it used to be before you gave me ten moves on a super hard level. Ten is about three times too few moves. It makes me want to screech. Also when I finish a level it lags terribly.

I've played this game for a few years. It's a great match 3 game. However, I've noticed that the advertising has not only been completely misrepresenting the actual game play, but is also using malicious practices by not properly closing or crashing apps and sometimes the entire device. Again, it's a great game. I just hope these low ratings will help developers make better choices when looking for ad partners.

Frustrating... Once you get to levels 50+, it's impossible to pass/clear the mini games. They're trying to force you to buy (with real money) lives and power ups to pass each level. I never spend real money on these games and never will; I simply uninstall it and move on. I like these games to pass the time, but I still want to be able to win sometimes.

Way too much space needed! Was fun, relaxing, creative. I could watch the ads on my schedule....loved that! sadly, the update is eating up so much storage I cant play on my phone any longer, so lost the stars. The development team needs to enable the player to "opt out" of some of the update portions so it doesn't need so much storage space to run because it no longer runs on my. :-( phone due to storage space limits)

I was fine with the game at first, avoided paying and enjoying a free game. Then uh oh what do you know they make levels so ridiculous there's no other option but to buy something. Level 98 I've been on for 3 days. That makes for an extremely boring game and has inspired me to leave this review terrible game its bait and switch. 98 doesn't have enough moves to encourage you to buy them. Even with a ton of power ups there's not enough moves. Terrible game!

I really like this game because you earn stars to build up the mansion. But I hate how on the levels they don't give enough chances to beat it. So I keep having to wait to get more lives. Also, buying power-ups, extra lives, and ONLY 5 extra moves is a ridiculous amount! Especially when you beat a level, you don't even earn that much even if you did really good and beat it with a lot of extra moves. You guys should really improve on all of that. Thanks.

It's a really fun game. I just wish the time for health is shorter and we get more health when we start. The levels get harder and harder so more health would be very helpful, the amount of money we win should be more than 50 coins, as that's not nearly enough, and lastly if we don't have any more moves and we still have explosives in our round, they should still go off.

This is just as good as the pc versions. If you get stuck on a level, don't fret. The algorhythm won't let you go more than a week before it let's you win, without having to spend real money on bonuses. If you do make in app purchase, it won't waste your money and you will win. And then there's Austin the butler, best part of these games.update: they've added a bunch of new areas and events, bonuses galore! 😍

I don't mind the game, it's a good way to pass the time I suppose, will say probably not as goad as reading a book, but hey, who does that any more? The one thing I don't like is that when you progress into the game, and you're renovating, some of the most meaningless tasks are requiring multiple stars, three to be precise. Sweeping the floor or closing the window should not be three stars.

The upper levels are too difficult. I get stuck for a week at a time on the hard levels. I can't compete in any of the tournaments. Also you advertise the problem solving puzzles, but the game it mainly lining up colors. That's misleading! The story line is ok, but when is he going to finally ask Katherine on a date? It's supposedly been years they've known each other. Talk about failure to start!

It was fun, at first. It was fun when the levels were challenging but not too difficult. It was fun before they started lying about the game in ads. I actually liked this game. Now the levels are pretty much impossible when you hit the 70s, and, well, they lie about the game in adds! Even the title picture is a lie now! It's awful!

The game itself is fun to play but just like other games, they start out as a fun way to relax an then they keep making the levels nearly impossible to beat unless you spend real money! The rewards you get for completing levels are ridiculous! Its fine to have the option to spend real money to get through a level easier or quicker, but it pisses me off when you are forcing players to purchase items in order to keep playing, over 8days, 30hrs,15 P ups, still stuck, total BS! Get real!

I've been playing homescapes and gardenscapes for several years now. I do enjoy them -however- I'm dropping my rating because of the time limit and ridiculous amount of cash you put on the "renovations" I still have not been able to finish one. The game is no longer enjoyable. Plus you want 4 stars for some stupid little items or just to get more story w/o an items. At level 1000 or 2000 it should be just as fun as the earlier levels.

Puzzle gets too hard that it makes players quit. They try to make you buy more power ups to keep playing, or just never solve the puzzle and rely on luck and over hours of playing one puzzle. Got to the mid level of 1600s. After 10 hrs of playing this one stage (over 2 weeks), I used up all my power ups and 50k coins I saved in over 3 years of playing just to pass this one level, sounds insane right? Really pissed! 3 years as a fan of the game! They should allow us to skip impossible stages.

I'm sorry, half the levels are impossible and I don't even really care for that aspect of the game. I want to follow the story and restore the house without getting stuck on levels because it's based on luck and money. Ive even tried just looking for other redecor games but I like the story and style of this one. It's sad reading through the reviews and seeing the developers not care at all that everyone is so frustrated with the game. I even bought the d*mn homepass and it didn't really help.

This is not the game you see in the ads. It's just another match 3 game. The ad leads us to think it's a choice game to help the character through the obstacles, but there is NOTHING like that in the game. Same goes for Gardenscapes, Fishdom, etc. Seems like false advertising is what Playrix games are all about. Really disappointing. I wanted the game I saw in the ads.

Waste of a game is; #1 not as advertised whatsoever. It makes you believe that you are solving problems and figuring out ways around disaster. You are NOT in any way, shape or form #2 Greedy....no, you dont have to spend money to play BUT if you dont, it is very difficult to succeed and you have to wait 30 minutes just for one life #3 sets you up to fail....I have played multiple levels where almost ever move leads to a "no more moves" rearrange. How is it possible that a level has no moves??

The game itself is very nice, but I'm disappointed with the ads. They're basically advertising for a game that doesn't exist. Why this choice was even made is beyond me, as the actual game is very good while the one advertised looks pretty bad. This game used to have really good ads (animated) that actually were the reason I downloaded this game, but the current ads lure in people that are interested in puzzle games instead of connect 3.

I loved the game until I got to the level with some type of holes or seeds on the cookies and I couldn't complete the level because the pattern triggered my tripophobia. I tried to move on, I really did, but couldn't shake the trigger. Not writing this to be dramatic, just an FYI. Sadly, i deleted the app knowing I wouldn't be able to move passed any level with those patterns on the cookies. It really is a well put together app with a great storyline and lots of motivation to continue the game.

the game is fun but the makers made this game unfair, and way too complex.. For instance if your stuck on a level you have to pay real money to buy coins in order to get boosters so if you have used up all your boosters then the game pretty much keeps you stuck on the same level for days and you try and try your hardest and sometimes you really can't pass any levels love the game hate that some levels are too hard and you can't progress without real cash a HUGE THUMBS DOWN!!!!!!!!!!!

It is an ok game, could be better. Not like what I saw in the ad with the selection of various items to fix various problems and that was disappointing. It is difficult to get anywhere unless you spend a lot of time on it to get the minimal coin payouts. The connect game only gives one star at a time and that is ridiculous and does not give enough moves as it progresses. Wish using the boosters wasn't counted as a move, total waste.

I like being able to decorate but becoming not fun anymore. Level 80 is nearly impossible to beat; how are you supposed to get 86 tiles of grass on 20 moves when everything is chained up, so you end up wasting more than half your moves before you get anywhere. All to feed the parrot. Not enough stars awarded, lives take too long to reload, and are too expensive to buy back along with the boosters, not enough moves for the puzzles and they're always changing numerous times for a level.

Fun game, no ads but no way to beat levels if you're stuck. It's a great story but once you get stuck on a level, that's it, you're blocked. No way to get powerups once you use them all, no way to get more moves once your gold is all out. It's almost as if you need 30 moves to beat it and you get 25. Installed on a Tue, uninstalled on Fri. Shame, was really enjoying it, just not going to invest $ in a game that's rigged to force you to do that.

First of all, please fix the optional review. Why ask questions if it doesn't even help & make sense at all. For the main review, let's start with the FALSE ADVERTISING. It's effective which made me play this but I hope you consider the law or at least add a mini game feature similar to it (to make the game unique). Good thing about the game was its story & the customization of the home. The rest was the same as any other puzzle matching game you can see. Overall it's fun but disappointing.

If I wanted to play a matching(candy crush style) puzzle game I already have a couple favorites that I like to play. The game is nothing like the ad I kept seeing, I even thought well if I get to a certain level it would open up the puzzles that are on the ad but no...will be deleting this game from my phone. It's a shame that it couldn't be what was advertised that looked fun.

Fun, for the most part. The issue comes with levels that are horrifically difficult to beat....I understand this is the developer's ploy to try to get us to spend real $, but all that does for those of us who can't spend real money on games is cause us to stop playing and seek other games. When I get to a level that takes days to beat, with an entire half hour between lives, it's too frustrating to want to continue with gameplay. Playing games is supposed to be fun, not frustrating.

Extremely frustrating. My blood pressure went up- I checked it. The levels start out somewhat easy but quickly turn so difficult to beat, that you end up trying to beat the same level for days, even weeks. The mini games are almost absent, getting only 2 within the first 100 levels. It is not a calming game to say the least. I chose to spend my time playing an enjoyable game, not this one that creates a feeling of anger and frustration.

I was really disappointed by this game. I wanted to like it, I gave it a fair chance, but like many others have said it's a candy crush clone. The art and animation are fantastic, I will give it that. But I was expecting the game that was advertised. I could have forgiven it if not for the ridiculous difficulty curve and overly expensive life system. So I expected a cute puzzle game and got a match 3 that can only be played in short burst unless you want to drop the money for lives.

pay to pass levels. it's a good enough game, however, if you are going to make hard and super hard levels, you should at least make them passable. i have played level 85, 62 times and you can't get enough "power ups" to break the walls to move the doughnuts or the boxes. not nearly enough turns or power ups. and you can't go back to earn more. pay to play. be careful downloading this one.

The reason I downloaded this app was because when I saw the ad for it it showed this guy tied to a bed and you had to pick one of three items to try and save him from flames. Where is that part of the game??? The actual game is kind of annoying because every little action needs one of those things you get for completing a puzzle and you have to do this for everything even if the character was to pick his nose. its ridiculous.

This game is set on how to frustrate you into buying more tokens, so you can then buy more chances to progress through to new levels. Not many choices here. I feel the creators are very happy with the characters being able to guilt you into buying tokens or bombs. I am not into passive aggressive plotting...and I am not addicted...so I will delete both Austin type games after leaving this comment. Positives are good colors and lots of thought went into the conversations.

I love this game and I've played over 3200 levels and counting! However, I've previously given this game 5 stars but I lowered it to 4 now because I feel like the developer has gotten a little lazy with the skins of new items you unlock. In earlier levels of the game almost every item you placed gave you 3 different choices but now it seems like the majority of the unlocks only have one skin. I would really like to see a bit more variety come back since that was one of the best features!

As you play you learn the strategy and tricks. It's fun everyday, anytime, there is no pressure to play. I've been a player for 5 years and still going. Now it is 3/11/2022 I left the game for a year then decided to come back. I see many changes since I had played last. There are players on levels 7000 and up. This could keep me entertained for years. Some levels are tough but you have to keep trying.

I was able to restart the game from 0, and with lots of events that appeared I was able to get to level 44. But playing "Restaurant Revival" (up to level 60) I could understand why playing "Homescapes" I got stressed so easily: because it is purposely made for you to waste money. If you can't beat levels without wasting money, boosters and power ups, it will appear a time where you need to buy them. It is not enjoyful to play like that.

I guess I sorta knew going in that this game would be a lot like the Candy Crush "pay to win" styled game. but I wanted to try it out, because it had a story of sorts, and extra stuff you could do to shape up a house. but in actuality, you can't do anything with the house unless you beat levels. heres where the "pay to win" comes into play. im sorry, but paying into a game to move on to the next level, or to try to win a competition is just redundant. you literally have nothing to show for it.

Starting to really suck! Getting stuck on a level for weeks at a time is NOT fun! Cant participate in team challenges as a result. I feel that once you spend money they really control your game. I"ve been gaming for years. This one is the most rigged. I have no control over progress.Great concept and graphics. I highly recommend not spending any money here.

The advertising of this game is flipping misleading. When I downloaded the game it appeared to be a three-in-a-row game, not that kind of solving puzzles shown in the ad. However, I was playing it for a while until the game lost its charm and started enforcing me to buy some perks for hell of amount of real money. Deleted it in the end. P. S. If there were a chance to put minus zillion, I would have put this mark without any second thoughts.

Not what it made it look like in the little add. The ads made it look like the puzzle was to pick the right tools to fix up the house but the challenge isn't to see if you can fix up the place. You just match shapes and colors to earn stars and then spend stars to upgrade the house. Same thing over and over, I'm uninstalling.

Ok so this game is a cashgrab. Sorry but most level are rather easy and fun and will only require that you play a a few times to clear them. But once every five level they throw a "hard". Not a real hard just that there only 2 sequence of moves to beat it... So if you dont mind spending a whole day on it you won't have to spend anything on it. And ads that you can watch give you 35 to 46 gold, the cheapest power up is 900 gold and you can watch about 4 ads a day maximum.

This game has the potential to be fun but instead is manipulated for the apparent purpose of frustrating the player into making purchases. Any "brain teaser" aspect of it is ruined by the frequent experience of having been set up for frustration by piece positions leaving only one useless move available at any given time so that the player is guaranteed to run out of moves a few steps away from solving the puzzle.

Relaxing and fun, and initially I gave it 5 stars, but after getting into the upper levels, I end up spending at least 20.00 to 50.00 just to pass get through a few levels. Also, I have purchased the golden ticket on multiple occasions, and I have never been able to reach the end because of how much I end up spending to get there in the amount of time allotted. I also had somehow gotten charged for a 20.00 package of coins that I didn't purchase (glitch perhaps) and was refused a refund.

I really like the gameplay, and the storyline is very rich. I didn't used to even like match-3 games, but the choices within the game and plot have really hooked me. My criticisms are as follows. As others have said, the ads for this game are way off base. It has nothing to do with helping Austin pick out which tool to fix a house. There is nothing about that whatsoever. The choices in the game are based on design elements. I honestly have no idea why the ads are so way off base but it does seem incredibly weird. Secondly, I think if you finish all the levels, you should at least be able to redo the harder levels so that you can participate in the challenge events. A more minor complaint is that sometimes the dialogue pops up and goes away in like a split-second before I can even read it. My favorite part of the game so far has been the anniversary chapter that was added this summer. I thought the decorations were gorgeous and I really enjoyed collecting them. The match-3 elements have enough variety that the levels really sustain my attention and keep me guessing. I think there's a fair mix of challenging and less challenging levels, too.

I have enjoyed playing this game casually for a long time but they're losing me. I like the redesign part and the puzzles are more of a necessary evil. First house is very fun, but once you advance past the first house the game is clearly only meant for paying customers. The level of difficulty increases so much that you're going through 40 or 50 attempts on a regular basis if you don't buy powerups. I just don't have that kind of patience for the part I enjoy the least.

The game was fine in the beginning stages. Cheesy interactions between characters, really easy levels, really hideous redecorating choices. Oh, and a stupid main character. As soon as I got to level 50, all of a sudden levels are ridiculously hard. Can't skip them and can't go forward, and the idiotic "power ups" do nothing. This game sucks. The only reason I play it is because it's on Mistplay.

Enjoyed the game....... until I was forced to spend money to win levels.... I have limited time for games and really just want some distraction for an hour or so when I cannot sleep. I don't mind a few dollars here and there to get a boost or make something a little easier, but IMPOSSIBLE to win without paying is where I draw the line. Once you get past level 100, every 3rd or 4th game is impossible.... and waiting a half hour per 'life' to get one for free is ridiculous.

This game sucks. It's nothing like what was advertised and it takes forever to finish some levels. Despite playing it on and off for over a year, and advancing through a few thousand levels, I still think the game sucks. The difficult levels can take days to complete, the 20 or so minutes it takes to get another chance to play just 1 time is too long, and the meager coins you get, which can help you continue playing, are insufficient to keep you playing. Find a more engaging game.

It started like a nice game, but honestly right now, you guys are making me lose interest for the game. The timing is to short, levels are to hard and to many challenges at the same time in one game. It's not fun anymore! Game are purpose to help you relax not create stress! I remember in the past, no week passed by with me play but not I chose not to remember the game.

Misleading ads. I was expecting the game to be just like its ads. Turns out it is more like a combination of Candy Crush and a bit of The Sims. Still entertaining to play, at least until I reached level 60, in which it became impossible for me to proceed further without spending real money, buying coins to get additional moves and also power ups to make it easier to reach the goal. The coins is priced at MYR4.99 per 1000 coins (900 coins for additional 5 moves). No option to get reward by ads.

I've been playing this game religiously for quite a while now and I think with a few tweaks it could be even better, with less petty frustrations. The skip option after completing a level is a great idea, wastes too much time (of which we all have a lack of already). I also feel it is unfair to just throw unlimited lives at us without notice. Although a half hour is great, a 2hr bonus is more often than not wasted. I always seem to get them when I dont have the time to use them or I'm super sleepy. Hence they're wasted and they truly come in handy on those harder levels. Maybe a pause when gameplay is not active? Or some kind of pop up to let you know if you win you'll be granted unlimited lives for x amount of time. This way, us avid players, will get the most of out our free time. This game is great. It does exactly what it's supposed to, kill time and entertain with cute little twists along the way. Its not glitchy and it's lovely to look at. I like that you can buy lives and upgrades. Although some levels are difficult, as others have mentioned, they're not impossible (Except the random cat levels. I still haven't mastered ONE of those) Persistence pays off. Even more so with unlimited lives. Hint hint.

The ad I saw about this game was so captivating, like wow I get to pick tools and fix the house myself, after using eternity and plenty data to download it, it was nothing promised. Just a puzzle I get to play and things are done, even things that are unnecessary. Some levels are rather too difficult. Please make the game what you showed to us in the ad. I don't like it.

Not free game! you will end up spending money in order to be able to afford the extra moves you almost always need in order to finish a level. You can watch 2 adds a day for extra coins, but that is only about 80 to 100 coins a day, and since it takes 900 coins for only 5 extra moves, you can figure that out. Hard levels are almost every level the further along you get. Even though I am level 1369 I am deleting game, they now have added time bombs that ends the game after so many moves. No FUN!!

As usual with these types of games, started out fun but each level has gotten harder and harder until I couldn't pass it. They want you to buy 5 extra moves. They want you to buy packages so the game keeps frustrating you to buy coins! I won boosters, used them, and still couldn't pass it. I refuse to pay money for this ridiculous game. After several days of being stuck on a level not being able to pass, I deleted the game. The only fun part was the dragon game part and that got rid of that. F-

I actually really enjoy the game but there's only so many times I will play the same, practically impossible to solve without spending real money on boosts etc level, over and over and over and damn well over until I think...why am I playing this? It's supposed to be fun and relaxing. Not so frustrating I swear at Austin and want to throw him against the wall! Then I don't play for a few days and when I do finally come back to it...by some miracle I solve the level first go..hmm.

I like this better than Gardenscapes. The boosters are better. The amount of pop-ups for extra things in the game are annoying. You give free hearts for so many minutes but too much of that time is wasted exiting pop-ups so you can actually play the game. I also get frustrated at the continual amount of lengthy updates. By the time it's updated, I'm tired of waiting and give up on playing. Sometimes I go in to play and see there's ANOTHER update so I just exit and play a different game.

I downloaded this game after seeing an ad only to find out that it is nothing like the Homescapes game shown in the advertisement. I then, thinking I had made an error, watched for the ad again. The second time I saw the same ad, it was for Gardenscaped. After downloading that, it too is nothing like the ad suggests. The third time I saw this same ad, it was for Matchington Mansion. No, I will not be installing that game, I don't like to be jerked around. What a waste of time!

Reduced my rating from 3 to 1 ... since the last update can't cancel a game once you've started so stuck playing through all the moves when you know it's going to be a complete waste of time. game also now becomes completely unresponsive at times and need to close and reopen to get it to work again. More near impossible levels with too few moves to try and force you to buy power ups. Can be stuck for days before you miraculously get 'lucky' and clear the level with easy combos. Money grabbing bs

I used to enjoy playing Homescapes but there are multiple factors that are deterring me to continue playing. 1) Difficult to clear levels with low amount of moves, this has been drastically cut; 2) The game has become a cash grab/play to win; 3) They have increased the price overtime for buying coins; 4) Asking teammates for SOS timer is extremely long. I can keep going on but I think the developers should take in and listen to the feedback from players. Overall, it's been disappointing.

It looks like a good game and a fun way to pass time but it's not. You get 5 lives that refill every couple of hours and you spend them mostly failing because it limits the amount of moves you can make so liberally while giving you little to no meaningful chances to actually complete a level. It may give you 20 moves to complete a level and make you waste the first 5 or 7 before giving you a helpful move or reshuffling. Then the amount of useless side quests are irritating

I used to really enjoy this game despite some levels being very difficult but I had to come in and edit my review because the blatantly false ads just to draw in attention for people who are intrigues by wild quick thinking scenarios is just absurd and quite frankly dishonest. Township is just as bad but that isn't a game I ever played anyway. Either way it's wrong and I don't approve of advertising a completely different type of gameplay to get more downloads.

I keep getting ads for this game on my other games and its nothing like it portrays. It is a completely different and a total catch grab for something not even remotely close to what it really is. Ive had this game downloaded before and it is too hard to gain energy and other items and I ended up getting pretty tired of it but if you need to waste some time for a little bit, you should download it.

Bait & Switch! Do not download! Nothing like the ads. Loaded with cutesy-themed stupid cut scenes and annoying characters and IS NOT what was advertised. Instead, you have to "remodel" a large home in excruciatingly small steps at a time. And even to "earn" the opportunity to take each tiny step, you have to play a Bejeweled style mini-game. It is NOT the puzzle-based game shown in ads. What is the point of this trick, Developers?

It's a fun game to past the time -- however -- after you get to a certain level (medium or hard) it takes forever to get to the next. You end up getting stuck & frustrated from using all your lives and power ups. I like decorating but they are split up into 3 or more tasks. I like the concept but I am going to delete all the "Playrix" games bc they are all the same. I will miss them but my time is worth more than headaches, stress & frustration.

More interested in the deco. part, too many puzzles to do for just the tiny amount of play you get to do with the deco. Games are suppose to be fun, relaxing, and enjoyable. This one is more aggravating for me. Game designers make it hard to pass levels in hopes that you spend real money to complete levels. If you like repetiton of the same level for 2-3 days, this is the game for you.

Love the graphics and it is fun and addictive when you feel like you completing levels fairly. This game never gives you enough moves. You get to almost completing a level only for it to trip you up on the last moves. Designed for you to spend that extra 900 coins to finish a level. It's too frustrating playing the same levels over and over again. I like them to become challenging, but not so early into the game where you feel like not you're not getting anywhere. This is supposed to be fun and relaxing.

It's a fun game, but after a certain point, some levels are nearly impossible to beat without paying for bonuses. With the difficulty built into many levels, special bonus competitions are redundant because of the element of chance. Unless you're planning on continuously putting money into the game, there is hardly a point in downloading this one.

The game is highly addictive. I love the free prize a day. The side games are okay (planes and kites). I love the scarf game. I hate there are only 5 lives, because sometimes the levels are "super hard levels" and so your lives waste quickly. I don't Facebook to get extra lives. The placement of the 3 actions on the right side of the screen is wrong. I have an Android and when I use the feature of the phone to check a message, etc. I accidentally waste an action. Also there needs more tutorials on these actions, because I'm not sure how they work, because they are few and far in between. I love the 30 mins, 1 hr., etc rewards, but I wish they could be saved because I earn them and then don't get to use them because I have to go work etc.

Tried to play homescapes after watching a preview of a woman and her child freezing out in the cold, " Help her" is the opening Title. I downloaded it and there's an old man going back to his Mansion to fix it up. Not at all the same game that they showed the previews for. All different characters completely different story and game. Extremely disappointed, and the actual game is ridiculously slow and doesn't even play the way it shows on the previews.

It's a great game, pretty fun; but it has some issues. For starters, I really hope that the game would be advertised for what it really was which isn't a puzzle game. Another problem is that it could take like 3 or 4 stars to do something as simple as place a table or so, also 5 extra moves costing 900 gold coins is way too much. The levels, no matter the hardness, reward only 1 star. I think the harder the level, the more stars should be rewarded. It also takes way too long to generate one life

I've been playing this game for a few years and not once have I put a dime into the game. It takes skill and a little bit of luck to pass the levels. I like how they add mini quests to keep it interesting. I've already maxed out my levels and enjoy a challenge. Paying will help if you want items you normally wouldn't receive but will not effect your game's progress if you don't.

Homescapes is a very asthetically pleasing game. I love the level design, as well as the huge mansion and all the things to do and fix in it. The only problem i have is that levels get too hard over time, forcing you to buy bombs and rockets to advance in them. I would like the difficulty of the levels to drop a little, just to where i don't have to retry over and over, hoping i'll get lucky and manage to get a win. Though i do understand that without ads, you need a way to make money.

I really enjoy playing it some of the time, most of the time it's just too frustrating. It's free to play but it does get frustrating at times when a level is near impossible to win unless you keep trying over and over again or, at a price of course, add more moves to win. You win timed bonus items then burns most of the time with stupid story plots and click through "adventures". I normally quit playing for weeks at a time then come back to get frustrated again.

I like challenges but not to the point of frustration. The point of the game is to remodel the house. Easy enough when you are first asked to rate the game. Eventually the levels are short of completion in 1 or 2 moves, which you can buy for 900 coins. Eventually you need to buy coins or remain on the same level. I have played the same level 53 times over 1 week; making different moves, still not achieving a win. Without passing a level you can't remodel which is the entire reason to play. These designers have a racket in this game.

It's a okay game if you want to dump money into it, otherwise it takes up too much time to play... and wait for a life...to play again, and filled with boreing tasks like feed the cat, etcetera ...Update... game has improved! by the ability to send lives to players. Downside is the video clips are becoming 2 parts and the coins are less then some of the single videos. If one is having to sit through a 2 part video at least make it worth while.

while I like this game, I'm only giving it 3 stars. there are a few issues with it. like the fact it is not the same as the game advertised. Also, sometimes when I move a piece one way to make a power device it will move in a different direction. some levels are hard and have to be played several times to clear. and I CAN NOT connect with Facebook friends. I get to the screen where it says what FB info they will need but the box runs off the page and I can not scroll to accept terms. frustrating

Having some technical issues. I started to play after not logging into the game for a few weeks. Passed 4 levels. Can't get the task to load items. Takes my stars but no couch and no art work. Now reinstalling the game after deleting it. 😭😢 fun when I get the free time to play. love the puzzle games. tons of fun. love the art and graphics. keeps my brain busy.

Fun game, but can never finish the mini games. It's like you can't win many levels while remodeling a room. It would be the best part of the game to actually be able to finish a room. Update Dec 2021. They have made a lot of fun changes that keep things challenging, but a bit easier too. I still wish they would make it a bit easier to actually get to completion of remodels, or season grand prize.

I found the game through an ad which showed that you have to choose between tools to repair the kitchen. The game is completely diffrent and has nothing to do with the ad, but I still played it. It's quite addicting actually. But for someone who just wants to play, the storyline gets annoying - especially the parts you can't skip. Now, I have a problem. My phone shut down when I was playing level 285 (???) and the game resetet itself. I'd have to start over. No thank you, I am uninstalling it.

I really enjoy playing with this game. But two things are a bit troubling. The super hard levels are just way too hard and it feels like a waste of time. I've read other comments. I like a good challenge but a times I feel like calling it quits from the game. The other somewhat troubling item is that when you get awarded free time for something you have to often read dialogue for characters that just goes on a few seconds too long. So the free time is actually less.

It's a fun game, but you can only play it so long before you run out of hearts. Without paying, you're left to wait. Difficult levels are a nightmare if it takes a few to several tries to beat them, which is extra crumby when some levels come down to pure luck with what pieces fall each attempt. If the hearts system was better, I would play this regularly. Because it is not, I leave this game for months or longer and only come back to be disappointed again.

The game is a great way to relax or to play while you're waiting in a waiting room. The levels are a couple minutes long( I'm of course talking about playing a level not beating it, as some levels are trickier than others). The game requires you to think and a bit of luck at times. Biggest hint to give if you are just starting out check what needs to be done to beat the level before you start playing said level. The best thing about this game is there are always events that come around to help you gain some power ups, which can be quite useful on those hard to beat levels.

Your setup is frustrating beyond belief! You deliberately make it so we have to spend money or lose out on a quest. Three days to a week can be spent on one level--and that's if you have good luck; normally, just shy of two weeks is what can be expected. You've set a hard level, then an easy, followed by a hard and super hard level making it impossible to advance in time. Space levels out better and make a faster recharge time. Plus add more booster bonuses.

Although I like being able to earn stars from completing levels, you need to have enough lives (hearts) and you can only get a level completed within a certain number of moves. I wish it would still count the bonuses even if you just ran out of moves and had a few items or squares to complete the mission. Otherwise, it's a pretty simple and straight forward game. Good for all ages if they have the patience.

Really enjoyed this game, it was super fun!... at first. It becomes more challenging as you get to higher levels, which is great, but it has gotten to the point where (unless I want to spend money on extra bonuses and turns), it can take me days to get through a level... and then I only get one star! And when it takes 2 or 3 (usually 3) stars to complete each step of a task, it becomes way more frustrating than fun. Fun's over for me, so I'm deleting the app.

I honestly like the concept of the game and the idea the developers had in mind. I still give it one star because from the very beginning, most of the levels are nearly impossible to beat. Even the levels the game does not label as hard are extremely difficult to pass. I'm disappointed about working in that lame @$$ garden!! I just want to remodel the house. We only get one measly star for completing levels that are ridiculously hard. I'm thinking about deleting because they only want money.

while I am enjoying the game, i originally downloaded it because i was given the impression from the ads i saw that it was a different type of game. it is not what is presented in ads. that was disappointing. it can be hard to get through and earn a star, but i like the challenge. however, it can be frustrating to be constantly prompted to use power ups and buy other things. it takes a long time to get through and redecorate things which can be boring and you have to want to continously play

I like the game honestly... but from when I'm reading, the puzzles use to be easier. the puzzle are harder than I think they need to be. some of the puzzles seem impossible to beat unless you have tons of gold, or can afford to spend your own money to pay for more gold and boosters. i can't pour money into this game just to make a level easier to beat with extra moves and every booster.

I have come to hate this game. Instead of relaxing and enjoying a fun game, which is the premise this was built on, you can instead expect to stress out on levels that you have to play over and over for days on end. Even after you have used every last power up and spent coins on extra turns you can expect to be stuck on levels for ever with no end seeming to be in sight. The aggravation isn't worth it.

I haven't had a mini-game in several years (and several thousand levels). I see ads for this game all the time showing the mini-game puzzles (pull the pin, unblock the river, etc). Must be false advertising. Customer support was absolutely no help at all with that. They just went on about algorithms and whatnot. Ok, fine... but none in years? Why advertise the game to look one way, but that's not at all what the game actually is or what it looks like.

I enjoy playing this game, but a lot of times I wish it would be possible to skip the super hard puzzles. most of them are downright impossible to complete unless you are willing to purchase boosts. also, since the boosts are so expensive, you should get at least twice as much coins at the end of a level than we are given now. if it weren't for those couple things, I would definitely give this a 5-star rating. BTW: Your ads are very misleading! but it gets people to download the app, right?!

The game is fun. I like all the characters, and they have good personalities. It's getting 2 stars because it's EXPENSIVE! The levels get nearly impossible without buying and powerups are expensive and not always helpful. They split up tasks unnecessarily, or divert to a bunch of boring tasks. For example, you play a level just so he can get dressed or clean up messes the cat makes. I had this game before, and gave it another shot. Not worth it once, much less a second time.

Would've been a great puzzle game if only the developers didn't think too much about earning money out of this game. Most of the levels (even the regular ones and not the "hard" ones) are quite difficult as they give fewer chances of swaps. I noticed that you actually have to repeat a certain level over and over again until you can finally progress which is quite frustrating, unless you're ready to buy more swaps (which I did a few times using my google play rewards). I'm sorry, it's a failure.

It's a matching game 90% of the times. The advertising heavily promotes the feature (puzzle games) too heavily, when in fact you're barely ever given an option to play the puzzle games. As you progress through levels, the matching games become more and more difficult and you'd have to play them to do menial things like open the door, feed a pet, etc - stuff you couldn't care less about but must do to progress in the story. Like some others said - it's good at the beginning! Then it's tedious

I enjoy this game and don't mind a challenge, BUT it almost seems like the levels are being set up to not be able to win so you're forced to buy coins, lives, boosters, etc. It's very frustrating when it takes over 50 tries to be able to win because you're simply not given the colors you need to collect in the levels. Also, when you shoot an airplane and it flies on to something totally not relevant.

I liked the game at first. But then everytime you would get past one level you would have to get past an even harder level, now it's getting ridiculous, you do a hard level every other level. And the exploding ice bombs are pretty much going to be the end of this game for me. I got rid of the fish game when they started doing something similar and now I'm running into it in Garden scapes as well. I no longer care about trying to complete the renovations in either game. So, as soon as I find a couple of games to replace these two their both gone.To bad you guys took two games that were fun and interesting and made the levels so hard to beat that it takes forever to get enough stars to complete some small chore, and by the time I can finally do some fixing or rebuilding of an area I no longer remember what I needed to fix, replace, etc...and really no longer care, to bad lost the fun.

It's a good game and pretty fun. I just hate the fact that we have to go through all the storyline animations. Can't skip if we want too. I changed phones recently and the game wouldn't let me go to settings to see if I could recover my account, but made me start from the beginning; tutorial and all. You have to press where the mouse wants you to, no other option. It was so annoying, so I just deleted the game, even though it's a pretty good time killer.

An enjoyable game, sometimes the challenges are a bit frustrating, but it still is very rewarding when you overcome them and get to the next level. And you CAN do well without paying, you just have to think and plan your moves. *Edit: after getting to the current level(108), I am unable to advance unless I purchase certain items, and since I refuse to spend money to play, I guess I will be stuck on my current level - the same tiles appear in the same spots every time the game re-sets!!

I used to love this game and the story, discovering new levels and opening new rooms. Great graphics and fun levels. But after the update around level 1000 it just hasn't worked very well. I will pass a level or use game coins for extra moves and it cuts out completely. When I go back in my coins have been used and I'm still stuck on the same level without the extra moves I brought. Super frustrating! I ended up stopping playing as I don't want to use real money and have this happen.

Great game but too many busywork tasks. for example, sometimes you're working towards placing new furniture and stuff like that and sometimes you're working on things to further the "plot" (which most people skip through) and you have to spend 3 stars (which requires beating 3 levels) to solve a riddle or get your friend a drink or call someone on the phone. if they took out the pointless tasks like that, the game would be so much more rewarding. it's hard to find motivation to play sometimes.

It's super fun and addicting! I love the story. I love the element of choices and the catharsis of fixing a broken down house. The major drawback is that it really hounds you to make micro purchases. I feel pretty bombarded by it. I'm just trying to enjoy a game where I fix things, I'm not tryna spend a fortune just so I can get past difficult levels.

I think some of the reviews are too critical. If a game isn't challenging, it becomes boring and when it's too easy to earn coins and buy lives or boosters, the items seem to lose value. Besides, there's always gifts when completing daily tasks. The game comes off easy at first then the levels gradually become difficult yet exciting. I think I'm addicted to this gane because of how challenging it is. By the way, the graphic is perfect for a game of this size. I love it😊😊

The game, despite the false advertising is nice. Art is beautiful, the characters are lovable and the puzzles are fun. BUT , power ups don't do much, so I wouldn't pay for them even if I had that much to spare, some levels are made impassable without buying extra moves. Honestly, I'd pay a full price for this game but micro transactions are abusive.

Decided to try this game again to see if it changed. spoiler, it didn't. I have used over 50 lives to get past one level, still haven't gotten passed it. Don't waste your time or money on this game. Still a one star, would give less if I could. The power ups you use at the beginning of the level always and I mean absolutely always goes to the worst possible spot. The planes still target a random spot instead of a useful one.

Overall Great, but One Major Downfall... Overall, I absolutely love this game! However, it does have one major downfall. The majority of the animation does not give the player the option to skip. Therefore, in order to redeem the stars for bonuses, the player must watch the entire scene unfold. For kids, this may be great. As an adult, though, it's a major waste of time! Were the skip option available, I would definitely give the game a 5-star rating.

FALSE ADVERTISEMENTS. I installed the game for, what's shown on advertisements as "using the right tools to fix the house" puzzle. I know that match 3, was part of the game play, but I was hoping for the puzzle mini games. Turns out, after 100 or so levels, there's still no mini game. Apart from that, it is a game with interaction(chosing furniture to decorate) and a cute storyline. It keeps the game fun, hence 4 stars.

I've playing this game and GardenScapes for years. The unfortunately thing about it is that even when you pay for the season pass you don't really get many advantages. If you want people to keep buying, then you should probably make it easier to hit each mark after you've paid for the pass. Like you get double the points on weekends or double the coins. I mean, you get two prizes per level, but it takes forever to get there. I remember when I first started playing the advantages were better.

Honestly I put a lot of time into the game but I finally realized it actively works to take advantage of you. It wastes power ups if you use them (putting them where you cant use them) and tracks your swipes incorrectly to make the wrong move. And on top of that, the levels are randomly generated so it doesn't matter if it's a "hard level" or not, it can just load an unsolvable round. I am so disappointed.

Completely false advertising in gameplay style. This is just like Candy Crush combined with a more frustrating version of The Sims, instead of simply dragging and dropping items to fix various situations. I'm at a somewhat low level and it already feels like they're tough to beat, as in you NEED to spend real money in order to progress anywhere. Bonuses, lives, more moves, you name it, you'll have to pay for it. Feels a silly amount of impossible to beat at some point.

The farther you go in the game the more "unbeatable" levels you will encounter, meaning that they can't be won in the moves provided, even if you try 100+ times. You will have to buy extra moves, maybe two sets even, and boosters. In this way the game deliberately stops your progress until you spend more money. This happens annoyingly often. If you are okay with regularly dumping real cash into the game it may not bother you, but I'm pretty sick of the obvious greed of it.

Fun up to a point. But get to where the assignments become mundane and tedious and a waste of stars (wanted to renovate a house, not throw a party for some random chef). Also the levels get too difficult. Cash grab to be able to get anywhere. I have been stuck on the same level forever no matter how many lives and upgrades I use. has gotten to the point where its not even fun anymore. Just frustrating and impossible. Shame. Really enjoyed it at first. Typical for this app franchise.

The ads are misleading. I do enjoy the game. It's a standard match 3 or more game with increasing difficulty and power ups. Unlike similar games however, the power ups, when using multiple, are not additive. Combination power ups is possible, but for instance setting off a bomb that sets off a nearby bomb in the vicinity of something that needs to be broken only results in a single break, not multiple as is logical. While this makes the game strategically more difficult, I find it frustrating.

The game is fun, but it's too hard to complete the challenges without spending money. Seems like every level gets harder and harder, and costs more and more to complete the tasks. Wish you could complete the daily tasks without having to spend money. The matching game where you have to get the donuts to bottom, and collect the cherries, etc is a complete waste of time. Most of the time you will never meet all the requirements without using 900 coins the first try and 1200 coins the second.

I like the game, don't get me wrong. But the levels are very hard. I don't want a random hard level that I am forced to do. Please make the hard levels optional, and have a normal difficulty level that you could alternate from. Or just have a difficulty setting. Also, the ads are kinda false advertising as the mini-games they show are a rare occurrence. It's just Candy Crush.

The ads for the game are misleading. The ads make it seem like all you have to do is match repairs needed with the proper tool, but the game is NOTHING like that. You have to earn stars to fix things, there's too much "dialogue" and you spend FOR-E-VER on the different rooms of the house. Also the levels get extremely difficult and requires too much time. I deleted the app.

I really want to like this game, as the concept is fun. However, it doesn't take long until you have to spend days trying to pass a single level, sometimes even while using boosters. The game has quickly gone from fun/challenging to just being frustrating. On top of that, too little of the game is spent actually renovating. While I understand that they have to drag the game out, it's incredibly annoying to struggle to pass a level, only to have those stars go to some pointless action like calling someone or starting a new day. I love the PC Playrix games, but sadly this looks like a pass for me.

The game is great! Storyline is very well thought out. My biggest beef is that the level difficulty is very inconsistent. I have just as much if not more trouble on the 'regular' levels than on the 'super hard' levels. Sometimes it seems the ONLY way to beat a level is purchasing power ups. I understand you want to make money but it's a little frustrating sometimes.

Managed to get to level 98 and got tired of this rotation of being able to pass a couple puzzles easily, then spending a couple days on the following puzzles because the objectives are difficult. On top of that, it is not really like I can change how I play so much as it is luck with how the pieces fall, which adds to the frustration. Fun for a time, but I am not sorry to move on.

As addicting as this game truly is, it'd be nice if you could have the choice WHEN to activate a bonus (and how many) while playing, rather than before a new level. And for each additional 5 plays, I agree with an increase in cost, but you could easily just buy a full life with the amount it is for 5 more moves the first time. The amount should be adjusted to start out cheaper before increasing.

It's a good game, no doubt but it gets so stressful. Why don't you guys include an option for friends to send gifts like boosters and all? It would make playing a tad easier and more fun. And also, the cake competition, there should be an option to maybe pause or choose when we want the infinity lives. We can't continuously sit for more than 6 hours playing, that's just ridiculous.

I enjoy the puzzles and designing the home! however, the amount of stars you have to earn in order to do a task that has nothing to do with designing the home is frustrating! I've been working on a car for the past several hundred levels! I'm on level 1,026 and shouldnt have to use 4 stars to remove and dismantle an engine when every other level is "hard" and I end up having to use the cheats just to maybe pass them to only earn a small portion of what I need to do a pointless task.

This game is beyond frustrating. Most of the 'easy' levels are actually some of the most time consuming and frustrating and many of the supposedly hard levels are beaten nearly immediately. I almost go into a hard level wondering how quickly I'm going to beat it VS the easy ones before and after it. The amount of stars you need to complete some tasks are weirdly high. Hate the random tiny tasks that requires 4 stars. However, it is quite satisfying at times and I don't hate it.

Edit: New updates have me enjoying this game again! My only complaint would be that I can't save my time when given infinite lives. Other than that, great game! Super addicting! Original review: The levels get harder without adding any extra moves to fit the task given. It's a great game up until that point... from there on the game becomes boring because I'm constantly waiting on more lives so that I can continue trying to pass a seemingly impossible level. It then becomes apparent that the only way to beat these levels is to pay money to get more turns or power ups. I give it a meh.

While I enjoy the game in general, there are some issues that I think should be addressed in an update of the game; first, it doesn't take long for the levels to become just about impossible to beat without spending money for extra gold and boosters, which is not cool in and of itself. While a challenge is good, the kind that forces one to spend money is not. Second and on a similar note, it would be a good idea to add to the settings the option to choose your difficulty level. And lastly, the game just stopped opening altogether not long after downloading it and getting to that impossible level that was still in the beginning of the game.

Fun game, love the story progression, and the animation and overall execution of the game is very nice. However, the whole reason I downloaded the game was because the ads, which you've probably seen. And they are NOTHING like the real game. ?? Also, the levels start out really easy, but once you start getting even to the upper-teens, they get super hard. <3

The game is broken. Keeps wanting me to install the latest updates when I already have the latest version. My only option is to uninstall and never play it again. I guess they solved the problem for me. It was a major time-suck and I was starting to get annoyed at the racial and gender stereotypes sprinkled in the storytelling and design elements of the game. Like, iterally every cactus option had a Sombrero on it. I couldn't pick one without it.

Way too hard, and NOTHING like the ads! I was expecting a nice easy game of fixing up an old run-down home, but instead it's just a bunch of super-hard (not to mention boring) mini games of matching blocks like candy crush, toon blast, and all of those other lame games I never liked. The renovation is a very tiny and insignificant part of the game. The only reason I gave it 2 stars is because I really like the main character (Austin), and the renovation part, although brief, is fun.

I've enjoyed this game for years but it recently locked up on me and I can't get past the loading screen. Additionally, newer content has almost no customization. Earlier areas let me pick from three color choices or design options. Now I've played whole areas where I might pick the color of a refrigerator and nothing else.. not the floor or walls or anything anymore. The levels are extremely hard to solve, too. So you wind up doing a bunch of levels for zero options. Very disappointing!

I love the game (tile matching), but it's very addictive. Don't see the purpose of the mini games... You can watch adds for extra credit but otherwise ads will not bother your gameplay. LE: all ads have been removed, it's nice that there are a lot of events and team competitions to keep things interesting. Downside is that, at high levels (7000+) some levels seem to be repeating but still great game :)

I tried this game for a little while longer simply because I enjoy decorating. after getting to level 98... still on the first floor...I will say this: the game has way too many bugs in it. First there is no reason you should only get 1 star per game when each board is rather difficult to win. Then you're forced to use whatever stars you have to do tasks that are not related to decorating the house which I find a complete waste of energy.

I've played off and on for a couple years. It was fun at first, the puzzles were challenging and I like decorating the home. Later on, the puzzles get unbeatable without power-ups and it takes too many stars to put up the dozens of flowers and extra chairs (even in the garage chapter!). Possibly the most annoying part is when you combine power-ups with a plane, it will fly to the most counterintuitive area of the puzzle, it seems like sabotage.

So far so good. I love the game. It's super engaging & fun to play. Plus I love the different things you can do with your wins when playing the game and going up the levels. I actually also like the conversations of the characters too. Update (months later): The game eventually becomes too difficult & impossible to win or move levels and the only way to go up is to buy more coins or something. So disappointing- forcing players to spend money and/or download apps. Also the Ads just got too much.

(-1) Stars! Its a stressfull game because they want you to buy power ups in order to beat a level. The pieces never fall where you can win. I downloaded the game in hopes of having fun renovating a home but I found myself spending days on a single level just to feed the cat or put the bird in a cage! It was a waste of time and effort and just a straight up SCAM!!!

I love the idea of this game. However the more I progressed (level 1235) the game has become too difficult with not much reward. When you get a "no moves available" several times in one game, that isnt supposed to be difficult, it is clear you arent going to get the pieces you need to beat it. I love a challenge but when you have to play each level 20 times or more, wait 30min for a life, then only get 1 star when most things require 3 it isnt much fun anymore. You must throw a bone now & then.

The game by itself can be pretty fun, and the storyline is nice. Having to play the candy crush style mini game can be annoying, but it is understandable. The major issue with the game in my opinion is that sever of the level are insanely difficult. I've been stuck on the same level for about a week. The only way to beat the level is with coins, which I have none, leaving me trapped in a position where the only means of progression is to spend actual money on this game. Make the levels easier plz

ok, let's be honest, this game sucks. i love the home remodeling and the characters, pretty much everything but the puzzles. The puzzles are match 3 and its so difficult on some levels that it takes days to pass. The game is not as it is advertised, you do not get to drag the right tools where they go to fix up the sink or whatever, all you have are the match 3 puzzles. I have been on the same level now for like a week or so; this game is just way harder than it needs to be, way too hard.

Although the game can be fun, the advertisement for it on other games is very misleading. It is a 3-in-a-row matching game & it becomes pay to win very early on. Some levels are pretty difficult to beat without the power ups that you have to pay for. I wish it were like it were advertised on other games. I gave it 2 stars because the story is actually really well done & enjoyable. The house reconstruction is fun too.

It's a less-good version of Gardenscapes, basically. In particular, I voted 2 stars due to the levels CONSTANTLY seeming to be way more difficult in this game than in Gardenscapes, and the party room/balcony area designs are all awful. The rest of the house is beautiful and classy, and then there's the party room and the balcony. It's bad and makes it really difficult to get the motivation to keep going when every new addition makes it worse.

The advertising is miss leading. If you're wanting the game where you're trying to recover a room with the options at the bottom of the screen, then dont install this. That was the game I wanted but all you do in this game is play a 3 item matching challenge and then fix one item with a button. I'm at level 67 and I still have yet to play the game that's advertised. I'm uninstalling.

This app is far from "free" if you want to move to higher levels. Some of the levels are ridiculous to try to get past so if you don't have boosters you can be stuck for days... not my idea of fun. Not to mention you need stars to do the renovations however many of the stars earned are wasted on trivial things, calling someone, receiving a package, opening a package, assembling the item, fixing the object in the package because they break the object, fixing up a car... too many to list. Argh!

False Advertisement/Impossibly Difficult. You will never play the fix the problem game and if that is why you downloaded delete now. Levels become impossible to beat, too many starts required to do any real decorating, and you can't choose where to go in the story. It's fun for a few but in the end, got bored and deleted. Design Home if you want to decorate. Candy Crush if you want to puzzle play. If it was the game advertised it would be a winner. No one else has that kind of game. Sad really.

Honestly, in the beginning this game is pretty ok, but as the levels get higher every other level is an extremely hatd one, and frankly it makes those who have played a long time NOT want to play. Who wants to be stuck on hard levels that take days to beat all the time?? No one. The mini games, which are what is advertised for the game are very few and far between.
