And a shuffle type option would be excellent. In all its an ok game, but more often than not it is frustrating and unappealing

First, I installed it because of false advertising. I think it's a shame that this company needs to resort to it. Why not make the game in the ad instead? It would be more interesting. Second, this is a dull, repetitive connect-the-bubbles game. Some levels are impossible to complete without special items. There is very little actual building. Third, this morning, after playing for months, the game reset itself back to level one. So, it's uninstalled after this, and it's one less waste of time.

The videos that are shown in other games about Homescapes are a lie! This game is nothing like that. The characters do not even look the same. The further you get into the game, you get one hard level, two easier (although some are just as difficult as hard levels) levels and then one super hard. Repeat. Very frustrating to play the same level 5 or 6 days in a row because it is so difficult. Where is the fun in that? Then on team games you can't contribute because you are stuck. Ridiculous.

Very entertaining game. Some levels are very challenging and almost impossible to pass without boosters. I constantly ran out of lives as I didn't want to spend my boosters all at once. Wish that to continue when out of moves wouldn't cost as much as it did. The coins I accumulate over 20 levels are just enough to continue twice. Other than that, game is fine.

I enjoy the game for the most part. However, I would like to have the option to watch an advertisement to receive additional moves rather than ending the game or using coins. I also would like to have the option of decorating the house or other areas rather than being forced to decorate everything, make phone calls, etc.... In my opinion it requires too many stars to accomplish tasks.

Fun game, kept my interest with challenges & such, but after awhile it gets to be like work. Several hard levels in a row, followed by an almost impossible, have to use all the power-ups and your coins to continue on after its over just to beat the stupid level, followed by a super easy (beat it in less than 10 seconds) game, followed by another impossible one. I enjoy a challenge, but a *figure it all out so the pieces go together* challenge, not a *welp, now I have to get more power ups just to beat this level cuz there's no other freaking way to do it* challenge. I appreciate the "unlimited lives for x amount of time," but sometimes that doesn't matter since the level is impossible. Its a shame because, unlike other games I've played, I really did enjoy renovating the house too. Will probably take a break and try it again later to see if it still frustrates me.

Love the concept, but... The idea of the game is great, but it gets simply ridiculous with the normal levels being "stupid hard". There is almost no way to beat those levels unless you using up all your power-ups or get super lucky. It's a huge waste of time when you have to replay a normal level like 40 times and you've ran out of coins and power-ups. Is the game free or not?

It's a good game. It's fun and I want to keep playing it, but when you start getting into higher level puzzles it makes things almost impossible to beat unless you have a ton of boosts or really good luck with rng. After having to play a single puzzle more than 15 times on 2 separate occasions, I've had enough. No way to easily pass a level with out digging into your pockets to buy boosts. Not even worth downloading.

Fun game, thousands of levels. I especially like that you can play offline. When you run out of lives, you can wait for more, or if you've joined a team, you can ask teammates for lives. It's difficult to achieve the grand prize chest during special events, requires a lot of game play. Aside from playing the levels, there are silly little mini games, and a whole storyline of renovating a home. You're given a choice (out of 3) on decoration options. I hope they continue making new levels.

As has been said this is not the game advertised in trailers but rather just another variation of Candy Crush. I still found it enjoyable enough to keep playing. Despite the puzzles getting increasingly harder (more annoying) & 3, 4, or even five wins being required to advance the storyline I still kept slogging along. But now around Level 1360 an 'alarm clock' has been introduced so it's not even possible to take any time to plan a strategy. So long Austin. I'm done with this nonsense.

Fun game, love the choices for decorating. Can be challenging and take multiple attempts at some levels if you don't want to use real money, which (imho) is part of the fun. If you do want to go the $ route, be prepared, as it's not as affordable as their other games! Personally I'll play a level 20+ times rather than fork over the cash. Currently level 508.

All of the ads I saw for this game only showed the puzzle levels. I didn't realize this was a matching game until I came to the play store to download it. I gave it a try despite the false advertising I saw and it's not a bad matching game if that's what you like. The matching is challenging and the idea of playing levels to upgrade a mansion is more interesting than other games that want you to just get across a map. Uninstalling because I'm more into puzzles than I am matching games.

I agree with another reviewer, the game starts out really fun but the levels become very hard to win. Taking most of the fun out. I play games to unwind and relax not cuss out my phone because I've ran through my five hearts on one level and now have to wait 2 1/2 hours to get all my hearts refilled. I played one level (that wasn't labeled as "hard") about 20 times before I was able to move on. Some of the "normal" levels are harder than the "hard" ones. At the end of a level you get very few coins and only one star. But it's 900 coins for five extra moves. So you're almost guaranteed to have to spend real money for your in game coins. You only get one star per level and the renovations take at least two after the first day. Some actions even require two stars three times. So you need a total of six stars to complete that one task. What makes me sad is this is a good game with really cool ideas and a good story line. I've just found out you can now get two stars for completing the new "super hard" levels. Well 💩

The game itself is fun and challenging but i have 2 major issues with it. 1. Level difficulties. It gets to the point where you're forced to spend to actually win. 2. MISLEADING ADVERTISING. The ads only ever show the mini games which is a VERY small percentage of the full game. This wasn't the case as ads prior to the mini games were actually quite accurate to the gameplay. unless you pay attention to the screen shots, you won't realize what you're getting into.

the game is super good and really enjoyable but some levels are unnecessarily hard which is impossible to complete it. For example, level 152 that really hard that playing for 1 week can not complete it even though I used all of my boosters. Sometimes I get lucky and I pass the level after a long time. Overall it's really enjoyable! I hope that they fix these kind of levels😅 it's really hard.

It's fun but it takes way too long to do something and the levels are like a rollercoaster. One level is hard then the next is easy and it goes back and forth. The game would be much better if it would just get a little more difficult each level, and not just after you learn a new thing like walls, cookies, etc. I really hope that this game could be more consistent with it difficulty levels.

A mostly fun game! It has been fun and challenging! I know there are people on higher levels than I am, but when a level takes weeks to pass, it ain't fun no more! Yes you can pass each level, but this is where I draw the line. 3 weeks on one level, 4 days on level 1399, this is where I say goodbye and uninstall the game. Silly enough to pick the gam up at Christmas. Never doing it again. Fun has gone out. Can't stand these hard and superhard levels anymore.

533 levels later... you could say it's addictive... hahahah no really I didn't expect to love this game so much. Sometimes I wish there was more customization in the home but I can't complain. It's really well designed. My only issue is how little coin you get per level. Assuming you use all your moves, you only get 50 coin when powerups are 1,000+. But yeah, other then that. Pretty good. You can technically play for hours. But that's if you win every game. You only lose lives when you lose a round. So that's pretty nice.

Unfortunately, just like gardenscapes, I have to give a low review. I've played both games for many years and have always loved them. However people, be prepared to only really decorate to your taste on the first island in both games. Once u get to the next island, everything u decorate becomes less and less customizable. You don't get to choose between 3 different options anymore, the games say "no its this way or no way" I haven't played in months because of this! Bring back different options!

If you're downloading this game because the ads for it make it look fun, then don't download it. I've yet to find a scenario that matches the ads. It's just an extremely difficult version of candy crush. It was fun at first because I was beating the levels on the first or second try but now they don't give you enough moves to complete any level. I enjoy redecorating the house but that requires beating the impossible levels so I'll probably wind up uninstalling. It's not relaxing at all.

This game is alright, but it's frustrating when each level takes several turns and then each task takes more and more stars. Uninstalling it, because I don't intend on spending tons of money for a game like this. It would be smarter to make most levels easier and throw tough ones in here and there to entice you to continue to play. Nothing to keep you engrossed in the game when you can only play for 10-15 for one level and still don't make it.

Enjoyable game. Note to developers: tiles don't react to half the explosions when you have a few things going on at the same time. Meaning if your cat statue, for example, received 3 explosions from one move, it may react to only one of them most of the time in stead of being completely destroyed needing 3 explosions. A second point is that the bonuses you accumulate, do not count towards the end cash

Not as advertised. The game itself is fun but gets kind of repetitive. It is not as the ads show where you actually drag stuff to fix things. You play the matching game to earn points, then use the points to have the butler fix things around the house. I downloaded it because the ad drew me to it. If that's why you downloaded, it's not like that and I am on level 70.

The ads make it seem like a totally different game. The match3 gameplay is fine, but it isn't fun enough to do for long, and it can get impossible at higher levels. You can pay a lot of money to win faster; otherwise, it can take hours to pass one stupid level. Because the rest of the game relies on the match 3, getting stuck on a level effectively bricks the game. Otherwise, I guess it's one of the better match 3 games out there. I just hate pay-to-win mechanics.

It's a very good game. I've been playing it a long time now, on level 578. But it's reached an unbeatable (for me) point & I guess I'm just going to be forced to delete the game, like I did with Matchington Mansion, which I also loved. I wish they wouldn't make them so the more loyal you are, the more you play, the more they penalize your loyalty by making the game unwinnable. You can't get anywhere on the competitions because you're stuck on one level for days, maybe a week or more. The plane competition here actually penalizes you and sends your standing downward. I don't think that's fair at all. I love the games, Playrix, but please listen to your loyal fans. Make a few changes so we can continue in our quests to complete the renovations.

used to be great game but after last update, went downhill. you get stuck on easy level for few days... made me lose interest. only if you spend a lot of real cash(and lots of it) to pass it. I like story and graphics but when you are trying to pass same level for a long time makes it extremely boring very fast. I understand a little bit of coins here and there but not tons of coins for easy level most of the time.

Has the potential to be a fun game. You get way too little for the minigames and they get to the point where it feels you are required to pay to progress. DEFINITELY NOT AS ADVERTISED. Also being required to play a minigame to do anything feels very excessive. Graphics are nice and story seems interesting. It wants too much of both my wallet and time to be fun though. Dont know if the games change as you get higher in levels as I only progressed so far. Same as Gardenscapes, a little easier.

Uninstalled this game. The higher level you are, the more difficult it is to beat. The advertisements of this game are just mini-games you get every 25 levels. Every 1-3 easy levels, you're given either a "hard" or "superhard" level. I have gone past level 4,600 without buying any power-ups, yet it is much more difficult to beat if you don't spend the money, even on the easy levels. It used to be fun, but now it's like every other game where you can only benefit from spending your money.

Was all right at first. Nice visuals, ok concept. Not at all like the ad, which actually shows a minigame, which is pretty rare within the game itself. Then I got to level 28, and it got impossibly hard. There were not near enough moves to beat the level, and every time I retried, the few advantages I had were stripped away, and I didn't have enough coins to buy my way out. My only choice left given was to spend real money to advance in the game. This game is play-to-pay. Would not recommend.👎

This game is very nice and very addicting. It always gets me excited whenever I unlock a new room. Although there are some parts which needs improvement. For example: There are levels that aren't labeled as hard when it really is, the party room decorations do not compliment each other (some decorations don't match with one another), and you cannot finish some levels due to the very limited amount of moves. But overall, I like it and I wish it could add more rooms to it. hehe

This is a totally different game than advertised. It looked to be a problem solving game, with different tools to fix different disasters, in the right order. Instead, it's a home reno game combined with a candy crush style game. Despite the false advertising, I did enjoy the game for a while, but the levels have now become impossibly difficult. i have to spend days & days on the same level if i don't want to spend money to progress. it'ts no longer enjoyable - more like a source of stress.

Absolutely ridiculous. It begins very fun and casual, but evertually the levels get frustratingly difficult. You'll lose all your coins trying to beat the level because it's impossible to do so with the amount of moves given, and the only way to get more coins without completing levels is to buy them. I have Gardenscapes as well and that game is the same way.

If you love slamming your head against the wall, this is the game for you! The easy levels are so ridiculously easy, and the hard levels are demonic, especially around 385 and 400. The placement of the starting pieces is seemingly random so there really can't be much strategy. So, once you've got a level with 3 or 4 different sections, boxes that block you and frozen blocks that are impossible to move with an insanely low move limit, your only option to proceed in the game is to buy the win.

I want to like Homescapes, I really do. Getting to clean up the house, pick out decorations, and most levels are satisfying. Problem is, the levels just are not balanced for fun. The easy and medium ones are fun and take a little thought. But the Very Hard levels... no amount of thought solves them. They come down to either insane luck, using power-ups, or both. And when you run out, there's no way to get more besides spending $$$. If there was a way to get power-ups or coins otherwise, maybe.

I downloaded this game after seeing a month worth of ads where you have choices on the bottom and have to fix random stuff on the screen or ruin stuff depending on what you pick. That's the concept that I wanted to play. Now on level 50, I realize the only reason for me getting this game is not actually a part of the game. Very upset. Change your ads!!!!

I got stuck on level 60. Not willing to pay money for the necessary power ups. You can see from the map that there is a lot of game to play. By level 60 you still haven't left the entry. I liked the game at first because there were choices to build. As the game went along there were random activities instead. Perhaps they could leave the random stories until after the building if the house. It was fun for a while but lost my interest as it dragged on.

Okay, I have the notion to uninstal this game again. I love the graphics and the concept of decorating your own mansion. But, a lot of the levels are way too hard and can take over a week to pass. Like level 85. Or if you don't have enough coins to add 5 extra lives you end up losing all the items you gain. Basically, you need to purchase stuff. And I've already wasted $20. It's more stress than fun. The creator isn't listening to ideas to make the game easier. Fix it, get better rating.

When I started playing, this was a fantastic game. The boosters you could buy were helpful, but not necessary, and I even spent 10 bucks or so over the last 6 months buying boosters to beat difficult levels. Now, the devs have reduced the number of moves on levels, making it nearly impossible to complete. I have been stuck on level 1280 for over a month, and have wasted hours playing. This level used to have 33 moves, now it has 25. Seriously considering uninstalling.

The game started out fun, but I was disappointed to see how many gold pieces you have to spend for 5 more lives. 900! Also, the levels got hard very quickly. I started playing to build the mansion. The most stars you can get on a level is 3. You have to use 3 stars to pull the cover off the car?! Has potential to be a great game but can be frustrating more often than not.

It's a great way to kill some time. The design aspect is really fun too. They have different events throughout the year and week to week to keep it interesting. I'm on level 3200+ so don't listen to the whiners saying it's impossible to win ot they're cheating you out of money. I've never put a cent in and it's super fun. The only annoyance is the false advertising that's been going on for a couple of months now... super weird... it hasn't affected the gameplay tho 🤷🏼‍♀️

I enjoy the game & find it entertaining but, have some complaints. Very often, always with just a few moves left, when moving a power-up to a crucial spot, it goes in the opposite direction which ruins any chance of winning. It's like the game is cheating. Also, it is most annoying to get an unlimited lives bonus & then not be able to use all of it, or at all. We should at least be able to start it when it's convenient. I got 1 for 6 hours just as i was going to bed, so couldn't use any of it.

Changing the rating from 5 stars to 3. This game is outstanding. The power-ups are great and I use them all the time. The levels are challenging and I like that. I am on level 1600 and what I don't like is the fact that now there are "hard-level" after every normal level. Its tough to complete hard level and I would want few normal levels to enjoy the game before getting to another hard level.

It's a great match 3 games with lots of levels and options for play. However it is nothing like the recent ads show. It's not a pick a plan game or a point and click game. It is the same thing as all the other match 3 games but with different colors on screen. I used to love this game but couldnt afford to keep it. Its slow on new lives and coins are sparse. Conclusion is that if you like match 3 games it's a good one to try but if you came to get a problem solving game, go elsewhere.

I am on level 2259. I love the story. However, I hate getting stuck on levels. I'm not good at games. I'm almost 50 and play to exercise my mind. It would be nice, if you can gain moves after say 10 or 20 lives are used. I don't have the budget to purchase game packs and coins. Watching the ads helps but at about 40 coins a video, it can take weeks stuck on the same level to gain enough coins to use for 5 additional moves to complete a hard level. The game gets boring when you get stuck.

Game is very addicting and very fun at the same time testing your cognitive abilities. Some levels you're guaranteed to need coins to repeat as they are not set up to win right away. One reward is unlimited lives for a certain amount of time but you can't choose when to use this so if you don't have time to continue playing, the reward gets wasted. Those 2 things are the only thing I would change.

In 9 months of playing. I only completed just over 300 levels. You spend weeks trying to beat one level. It's more frustrating than fun. As lately it's been freezing up. So I uninstalled it and will not redownload it. Go play Gardenscape. It's put out by them but it's way more fun. You still get stuck on levels but not for weeks. More in games challenges.

I really like this game. It seems rare these days for an app not to force you to watch ads, but this one doesn't! It's a cute game and the rebuilding the house story is a lot more creative and aesthetically pleasing than games that just have a trail of levels. I'm on level 483 so obviously I've been playing a while. Some levels are really hard, but you get an extra star and more coins for those. It's also a more stable app than some others I've tried.

Really fun, at first. Then to accomplish anything in the house, you have to pass a mini game level for each task. Became impossible to pass levels very quickly unless you buy extra points and the tools. I've uninstalled it. This should've been a fun and relaxing game, fixing up an old house. Great story line, fun idea, but instead it's just frustrating and pointless. The mini games shouldn't be such a hindrance to the actual game.

Not as advertised. The sample of the game that is shown is a repare type game where you can choose from different items to fix things in the house. I'm up to level 26 and so far none of the things in the demo have come up. It's a match 3 game. For every change in the house you have to play a match 3 to get a point. I thought it was a new type of game.Very disappointing

Developers, you are absolutely killing us with the in game pop ups for events. At the beginning of the event, sure - pop up and let us know it's on the go but EVERY time we log in?? Every time we beat a level and pass another player?? It wastes precious booster timers, on top of being incredibly annoying. Especially when there is more than one event going on! There's no need, we can check our own progress by tapping the icon on the main screen if we want to be competitive. Make it stop, please.

Like others, I would rate this 5 stars if the levels didn't require an incredible amount of luck and/or repeated use of power-ups -- the latter of which are given out quite sparingly. I imagine the idea is that in lieu of ads, they entice you with being invested in the renovation and story so that you'll spend money on power-ups and game coins to beat some of their flat-out impossible levels (I'm looking at you 118). It's unfortunate that it's so frustrating as it is an enjoyable game otherwise.

While it is enjoyable, it's definitely not the game that is advertised. If it was the game that was advertised, then I would rate it higher. But no; it's an unnecessarily harder version of a 3 matching game. 900 coins is way too high for 5 extra moves, when you only get about 50 coins (100 if you're lucky in certain levels) on average after each level.

The game is amazing in everything, except its progress. It is very very slow, amd you have to spent way too much time doing useless errands, especially in the garden part, i almost deleted the game because of its slow progress. Other than that, everything else is just great, from graphics to game play, all is amazing.

I'm at around level 8500. Most of the easy levels are way too hard and those that are supposed to ver very hard way too easy. For the one that gives you 50, 10 moves are impossible unless you can buy extra moves. Also it's getting very annoying that I play 1 day for stars and then 5 days for when you guys do updates and can't earn any stars. I have been playing it for over 4 years now, but this is just starting to get very annoying. Other than that the game is great.

I am on level 244 and it is next to impossible to complete. The levels are becoming way to hard, I've used about half my boosters and still cant get through it. Plus I love the addition of the new "dream puzzles" but there should be more of them. Something to look forward too especially after it takes so much effort to get through the main puzzles.

I love this game and its really not bad. It gives hours of fun gameplay but its really tedious when you're able go beat 6 levels without doing anything at all but then you get to 1 level that you spend hours on so I wish that there was a bit more balance in the levels. Also, some of the house decorations just look awful? So I wish there were a few more options but that's just a personal opinion. (Also, they have started false advertising which makes many people upset so that's also a minus)

So far I like this game overall. It'd be great if u didn't have to spend money to buy special items/boosts, or the vault.. add a free option like other games for us on tight budgets. The coin price 4 special items/extra moves is too high. It takes too long to get 900 coins. Fix,rate it 5 stars. It would be nice to be able to skip a level your stuck on.. I've been stuck on 749 for 2+ months. No help. No Boosters. Not enough lives.. We shouldn't have to spend money to get extra coins, boosts, etc.

It was fun at first, and highly addictive. But I have a thing about paying to play online games, and you reach a point it is impossible to go up a level without paying for boosters, lives, or joining their social network. Oh, and the puzzles they post in the ads? Few and far between. You go up a level my matching 3 or more characters, which doesn't require problem solving, just patience. If you want to throw away money to forget to do things you need to be doing, play it! Otherwise don't!

While the animation is wonderfully done and the concept is good, I find it incredibly frustrating and annoying that it is near impossible to win or play this game without spending money. Either on coins, lifes or more turns in the actual gameplay. The fact that you can barely play and you definitely can't win, without spending actual money, is a huge setback for me. I was hoping this was going to be a fun, relatively cheap game and was thoroughly disappointed.

Honestly this could be a great game if they didn't make some of the levels ridiculously hard. When I have to spend over an hour(if I get lucky and have infinite lives) or 20+ lives to beat a level just so I can answer the door then the game is not fun anymore. It's just frustrating. When you've only gotten through renovating 2 rooms and the levels are already this difficult I can't imagine anyone ever coming close to finishing the game.

its a money hog, doesnt allow you to win and make sure you have to pay in. when you run out of moves you only have like one piece left. I bought into a few times it doesn't help but it's like every board is more difficult and doesn't make it any easier and I'm still a beginner, other than that far as the Mansion goes putting it together it's fun. if the developers could make the puzzles a little bit more easier that would be awesome

The game is great in asthetics and over all gameplay. Money is required to move ahead else it is frustrating. You don't have options to acquire coins from watching ads which makes it impossible to move ahead if you don't have money. Additional moves are very expensive both in actual money and in-game coins. Sometimes levels are deliberate and it is only by-chance that you can pass a level. All of their games-scapes are similar in some way and form. Else, they are a great story and game.

I redownload game after that commercial help save the house! where you have to pick the right option to repair the house. and I thought maybe the game was updated so I downloaded the game again to see if it was different. but I'm at level 40 and theres no changes to the game and there hasn't been a save your house! mission. So why was it in the ad if it has nothing to do with the game?! You think you can add it to the game or just stop advertising lies? that'd be great! Thanks

I really enjoyed this game at first. But as the levels progressed and the "super hard" levels came. I found myself spending days on certain levels, to come to find out really the only way to beat a level is to purchase coins and boosts. Sometimes its literally the ONLY way to get past a level. Its okay every once in a while but, when those challenge levels are every few levels it gets annoying really quick.

love the game( the decorating part) but after level 50 I had a really hard time beating the levels so I uninstalled the game. Even after I spent money on it, what a waste. I greatly enjoyed the storyline and graphics and the first several levels, but it just got to stressful for me when I just wanted to relax and enjoy the decorating and storyline.

It was fun at the beginning but after you got up to the puzzles in the 30's it got drawn out and boring. Most things now required 2 stars or so many steps it was ridiculous. Also the puzzles were made more difficult and seemed set up so you could rarely pass a level without using power ups or buying extra moves. Cute concept but I will probably delete the app. It is way too slow moving for me. The controls are so inaccurate and move the wrong piece or move it the wrong way. Game sucks, deleting.

Not as advertised. The ad showed a puzzle game where you have some disasters in a room and you must select the correct action for the correct problem area. In reality, this is a tile matching game and is nothing like the ad. Might be fun if you like tile matching games. Difficulty increases quickly. + good graphics, challenging puzzles, they don't flood you with ads. - Not what was advertised.

I have had to review my rating and downgrade it to a 1. I lost all my many years progress and the effort to get assistance was futile. I have had to start from level 1 when I was already heading for level 6000. This is my previous review👉🏾Been playing for years. Good fun and out of the box creativity upgrades. I'm disappointed!

I like playing this game. Most of the levels are interesting to play and I like the story behind the levels. Also developers don't look too greedy. You can get bonuses from regular events, some times you get decent discounts to buy bonuses for real money, but you can beat any level without bonuses if you persistent and a little bit lucky. Also I would hope developers will change the speed of main story progress. It is getting annoying when you have to beat 3-4 levels to renovate 1 little item.

Really is a fun game. But the tasks become too expensive, thus the storyline progression becomes extremely slow. This will be the only reason for me to stop playing the game. I don't mind spending SOME money, but it really is frustrating to enjoy a game that becomes increasingly expensive to progress. It really spoils the fun when you are stuck on a level for 5 days. Please, for the love of the game, listen to people's suggestions. The hard levels are already difficult, adding a super hard is just ridiculous. It's not a game if you make it that difficult.

This game can be fun when it's not trying to squeeze every cent out of you. Gameplay is simple. Match 3 tiles. Match more in a specfic order to gain power ups. Complete the tasks in the allotted moves. But, unless you're a chess master, many of these levels can't be completed in the alloted number. Period. You can purchase more with coins, but they never give you enough. And, conveniently when you are buying additional moves, you will just as often be unable to complete, forcing you to buy more.

I like this one a lot better than Gardenscapes, but the ads on both are totally misleading. It's a good game without the false advertising. They could market it as a design game with mini games to progress, but those aren't the ads I see. It is completely different from what it says it is, so it gets a low rating purely for tricking people into downloading it when they're looking for something else.

I originally gave this game five stars but am changing to only one star. One of the game updates drastically reduced the number of moves allowed on the levels that it is no longer fun to play. There have always been hard and super hard levels, but now because of the reduced number of moves per level, the harder levels are coming every three or four levels. Some of the hard and super hard level can take two or three days to beat. This game is more frustrating than fun. Would NOT recommend.

I really enjoy this game, I like the idea of using puzzle games to progress into building but some of the levels are unreasonably difficult and depend on luck to pass them. The rocket pieces in game do nothing, they can't break more than one obstacle (cookie or box) when they should break through the whole row. Getting stars to progress is also difficult when you can't pass any level, spending a week on a level to get 1 star is frustrating and spending 900 coins to get 5 more moves is too much

You know, I've had this game for a long time, but it's getting very redundant and pointless. Add in that the "problem solving" ads I've seen are completely inaccurate, as this is a "make the most advantageous move" matching game and, well if I believed those ads, I'd feel like a bait and switch had been pulled. This game is on my "soon to be uninstalled" list.

The home repair and interior decorating aspects of the game are the best parts. I understand the psychology of having a player work for prizes, but as a person not investing real money into the game, the increasing difficulty (+ sometimes lack of aids) to earn stars on levels not labeled "hard" or "super hard" via shape-matching mini games, becomes redundant. After I've repeated a level for the 5th time, I become all too aware I'm wasting my time on a video game. With good games, you can't tell.

The levels are too hard to beat the higher up we go. I understand it has to be more difficult, for hard levels especially, but it shouldn't take me an entire month just to beat one level and get stuck on the very next one. That's bad game planning. Update: the loading takes at least 3 minutes to fully load. That's a long time for players, especially if they have nothing to do.

Edited: this game will give you impossible levels with virtually no move so you have to spend real money on boosts to beat them once you get to the higher levels. Levels are too hard/time consuming. There needs to be an undo button so if you make a mistake during the puzzle play you can take a move back, even if it's just once per game. Plus, some levels are way too hard. I spend days stuck on one level sometimes, a lot of ppl I know have uninstalled the game already because of it.

gets really hard almost immediately after the first few puzzles. It basicly forces you to either buy lives with your wallet, or wait the few hours to play over and over again until you finally beat the level you are on. As well as forces you to buy the various items that slightly help you get through the level. and it rewards you with a pitiful amount of coins for beating a difficult level. My honest opinion is that it's fun, sure. But its a money grabber, its unenjoyable without a wallet.

It was fun to play on a slow day, but I really didn't like that I couldn't pause my infinite lives. I won 3 hours of infinite lives at 1 am and the whole situation soured me on the game. Sleep or prize? Reality won, but a pause function would go a long way. Also, I would like to play the game shown in the ads, where you choose the tool you need to fix the issue, rather than playing a matching game. Again, fun enough, but not great!

The game is ok but once you go to higher levels, it was only level 43 for me, they are so hard to do. I spent 6$ just to get thru that level thinking the next one would be easier it wasn't so after spending over 30 dollars and not having much fun, I uninstalled it. Duh, wish i had done that sooner. Plus the reason i downloaded it was it showed a different game where you pick tools to fix things in a house like a broken faucet or a fire and i never saw that in the game that would have been fun.

I wish I could rate this game higher because it has a lot of charm in its design and appeal and, at first, the puzzles are quite clever. Unfortunately as you progress the puzzles rely almost entirely upon random chance and even using boosters or buying extra moves will not allow you to solve it. There are more problems than I can list in 500 characters but again, it makes me sad that I have to rate it so poorly.

First of all, i downloaded the game based on the ads I saw where I had to choose some options to solve a puzzle. After I installed and played for a while, I got to know that it is nothing but just fancy candy crush. Also, the levels get too difficult. I spent days on 1level and one day suddenly the level gets easy and I get win streak back to back. It's really frustrating as I can clearly see that they are waiting for me to waste my money on stupid powerups. Don't waste ur time and energy here..

Great game and very addictive but their is a problem!! PLEASE FIX and I'll change my review!! When you complete a level you only get one star! You should be able to get stars in a gift for completing certain things. We should be able to win 5 or 6 stars no more but otherwise it's a great game. PRETTY PRETTY PLEASE FIX THIS AND I'LL CHANGE MY REVIEW!! I love the game but hate that you can't win or get more then 1 star for completing a level!!

I really wish this was a choices game ad advertised, but it's really just a token matching game. Additionally, the algorithm is set up to give you the least likely chance of fulfilling each level unless you are willing to pay for the extras you can control. The awards and extras just "happen" to be placed in the least helpful place in your board, and when you are awarded with infinity lives you must use it then. So hopefully you have hours of time to spend not making any progress.

To call this a "home renovation" game is a bit of a stretch. You earn one star for each level you beat which are used to complete different tasks, but they make you use stars for things like answering the doorbell or the phone. I just spent 18 stars baking a freaking cake. Had to beat 231 levels just to complete the first three rooms. Also some of the levels are way too hard the game is set up to make you spend money on boosters, coins, etc. Update: most rigged game I've ever played this is as bad as a slot machine

I got this game because I was interested in the story of fixing up the house and I enjoy matching games. I've had this game for three years and have only completed four and a half areas and am on level 855. That is RIDICULOUS! At a certain point the levels become unbeatable unless you pay for extra moves in order to win. I get that they need to make money but the levels are too hard and the tasks cost too many stars to complete so it takes forever to do anything. I'm probably going to delete it.

Reasons for my low rating: 1) False advertising. I am at level 165 and I still haven't met the feature for which I downloaded the game. 2) Too difficult.It gets very frustrating trying to pass a level for 40-50 times by chance, when there is ahead of you another 2000 levels, and having no other way to pass the level. At least generating a few coins in every play could partly solve that.

This is just another match 3 game plagued by a "cheating" algorithm, which makes it statistically close to impossible to go past a certain level (in this case level 24) and most other levels without spending any money on lives, bonuses or similar. If you don't believe me, simply count the number of fields, the number of different colors, the number of moves you can make and compare that to the number of tiles you need to clear... don't encourage these developers.

I don't know why are people leaving a review saying levels are hard to pass. This is a challenging game, you don't need to buy anything if you play to win. Eventually you will pass. I was stuck on a level for 3 days, multiple times, it's just makes the game more interesting, not annoying, it's annoying if you pass every level after 1-2-3 attempts. I'm on level 3000 and have NEVER purchased anything. Play and have fun, don't play to waste time.

It's fun at first and then you quickly realise that's how they try to suck you in and then progressively make the levels so hard that you have no choice but to buy coins to complete them. I've played certain levels at least 10 times to see if luck can change but no, it's literally impossible to beat the level unless you buy coins to get more moves in order to complete it. It's very demotivational actually and I wish I could refund the money that I have already spent because it's not fun anymore

Completely false advertising. In ads on other mobile games, Homescapes presents itself as a puzzle game, wherein you have to repair a home by using the correct tools in the correct places. Upon actually playing the game, however, you quickly learn that it is actually just a bad ripoff of The Sims formula, with a weird ripoff of Bejeweled in it for no reason. I'm sure the game is fine if you like that genre and that's what you're expecting, but the advertising is entirely false.

Too many distractions. Every day there's a new side game that distracts from the actual manor, and it gets annoying really quickly. Stopped playing entirely when suddenly you had to join a team and work towards team goals. That's not the type of game I signed up for. I just wanted to decorate and renovate the mansion, not all this other stuff. They are going a thousand different directions at once with the game play and it's very annoying.

Just got to level 101 and will be deleting it again. I've downloaded this game multiple times because of it's enticing advertising. However, the game has nothing to do with it. The fun puzzles shown in ads are a recent addition, and I've only seen about 5 for 100 levels. Levels take multiple attempts and the 5 "lives" restrict your gameplay. You can't play whenever you want, instead only when your "lives" refill. Each "life" takes 30min to refill. Horrible game, I don't recommend it.

Happy. I enjoy the game immensely. My main frustration is coins. I cannot afford to buy them but once in a while. I usually play the levels until I finally win it, frequently without power-ups and after days (sometimes as long as a month) of trying. Would be nice if the computer tracked how long you've tried without purchasing coins to buy power-ups and rewarded the perseverance.

I enjoy this game but the story gets very tedious at times. I just want to fix up my house but I'm stuck in this story throwing parties and baking cakes. I'd prefer if as you progressed you kept fixing up the home. The game is called Homescapes and I've spent more time in the garden. Outside of that their take on the match 3 puzzle game is fun with the right amount of difficulty. Power ups are fun and provide relief in difficult levels.

Honestly I would love to give this game 5 stars but these hard and super hard levels are just impossible if you don't have power ups, you need to make micro transactions to complete them. I'm a strategic player and I shouldn't have to spend an entire week on one level because it's so hard. I'm all for a challenge but at a certain point it's just defeating to even continue to try and beat these levels. They are unattainable goals. Hope for better levels in the future I guess.

Thank you for adding more power-ups as rewards! I feel like the game has been a bit "glitchy" lately.... The airplanes are hitting random, unhelpful targets and when connecting 4 pieces, many times, I have not gotten the arrows. Better rating if this was fixed. It would be cool if you could actually choose where the arrow landed!

Game mode is easy (matching game). It's different from the ad that made me download this game, from the ad I thought this was a running and puzzle solving game, but the real game isn't that, also in some level, this game is deliberately making it almost impossible for you to pass, at some level I even tried using 3 knids of boosters and still needs to buy 5 more moves to pass. I'd like to agree with some other user's comment, this game requires much more luck that your skill.

3 stars because Game play (so far) is not as advertised. Basically a swap and match with ability to make some choices to remodel a house. Nice graphics and music though. Seems like it may eventually turn into a "pay to play". I've only reached level 15 and, though they aren't nessecary, I have already been prompted to buy in game currency two or 3x.

In general it's a fun game, but the "hard" and "super hard" levels border on "impossible". Using up all lives repeatedly on the same level for several days in a row without being able to make any progress on the house is frustrating and takes the fun out of playing it. You could add a "skip this level" option in exchange for watching an ad for example. That would save a lot of people a lot of frustration and make the game more enjoyable. Just please don't make it cost coins!

I've put literally years into this game on my kindle and loved it. I'm still playing it now. The only reason I downloaded this again on my phone was because the ads I've seen for it recently have shown an entirely different style of gameplay. I thought, "oh! the phone version must be different! ". Ads show an avatar clicking on different tools to fix up a dilapidated room. NOPE. Same old match three as before. I'm very disappointed. I want to play the game they advertise!

The game are enjoyable, fun and pretty addicting. As you get higher up in levels the game, seems designed to make you spend money to complete levels. The game is fun until it's pretty, impossible to move forward. I think the developers make the puzzle easier to solve after doing the same puzzle about 30 times. They must use of some sort of All.

This "game" is a great time waster, as as long as you only use it to waste time, it's good. There is almost no skill involved, and no luck whatsoever. You will only solve the puzzles when the game wants you to, no exceptions. It gets very frustrating when some levels take over 100 "lives" to complete, only because the game doesn't want you to get through it. It might be different for people that actually spend real money in the game, but I refuse to pay to play.

All the ads were super misleading.. I was expecting a game where I chose the things to save the guy from dying or something, but it was a simple match the three same symbols puzzle with some home renovation. It wasn't what I was looking for, but I guess if you're looking for a puzzle/simple decorating game, this is it. (But I seriously don't get the misleading ads...)

I use to enjoy playing this game, but now they take away majority of the moves on higher levels and the computer doesn't register some moves with the kites and rockets, or bombs and the amount of money you gain with each level isn't enough to pay for extra moves, and some furnishings for the home is a bit to much, every little tiny thing comes with a cost, that actually could have been included in the original cost! All this and more to make people buy coin packages or coins! Fun but not fair!

I used to play this often. The concept is great. The butler is a good character and the story is well written. But its nearly impossible to proceed at some points. Either you spend money to get some boosters, which doesn't guarantee your success, or you spend days or weeks on the same level getting frustrated. If this was more like their other game Township, where you could just build and not worry about the Candy Crush ripoff puzzles, it would be so much better.

I had originally given 5 stars but the further you get into the game the harder it is to beat levels. I get so frustrated that i stop playing for weeks or months at a time. Don't know if i'll ever finish redoing the house as its so hard to beat levels. Especially the higher you get it seems every other level is a hard or super hard level. The mini-games are few and far between. I haven't had one show up since beating level 3000. Now I have to update the game every week it seems.

It's nothing like advertised, you basically are playing Candy crush style game to win one star. Each star allows you to complete a task. Not so bad, until those "tasks" include 'call a cab' or 'find the cat'. On top of that the game levels begin to get increasingly more difficult to where you have pay more money to get through them. I started playing this game because I thought it was going to be like the advertisement: help the guy/lady by choosing what object they need. Not what I was wanting.

Its pretty good, I wish there were a way to replay levels for more stars, or a way to enjoy the remodeling without having to play the levels. The game entices you with the prospect of remodeling and choosing decor, but it ends up being just another candy crush type matching game. I plan to quit as soon as it gets difficult. Maybe make a decorating mode that isn't based on stars and obviously has no competitive aspect, just for relaxation?

This game has many levels that require boosters, which inevitably means you have to spend money. Unfortunately, once you buy something and use boosters, their algorithm actually makes the game harder, which then becomes impossible to continue without spending more. This is absolute highway robbery! I've played countless match games like this. I'm disappointed, because I do enjoy the interaction with Arthur and Co fixing things, but it's too expensive to be fun, which is why I only gave 2 stars.

If I could give this game zero stars, I would. This and another one of their games was advertised as something completely different than the game you're actually playing. I played the other one for awhile but it just got boring. I saw the ad for this and thought "why not" The ad they even advertise on this page (the picture frame) has absolutely nothing to do struth the actual ad on YouTube or the game for that matter. I was really liking forward to the puzzles of fixing a home, make THAT game!

Great addictive game but the pricing of the boosts along with the small amount of coins after each level. I've spent a lot on this game due to pure addiction to it. Real money on a game.. Regardless to how fun it is. The pricing vs. the amount of time it takes to even get those coins is super annoying. Should definitely lower the pricing so not everyone has to pay real money for boosters or a few extra turns.. that is the only reason it's not a 5 star review. I do adore the game without a doubt.

Been playing this game for s while now, like 2 years or so. Level 1895 or something. Game is getting ridiculous hard. A challenge is one thing. But if it takes over a week and a level still can't be beat it realy takes the fun out. I get they want folks to buy coins and power up stuff. I have a few times. But it shouldn't be the only way to beat a level. Not to mention after the last update the icon to play it is gone and i can only access by going through then play store.

Game is awesome. However, the set up almost forces you to buy coins. After you lose "hearts", you have to wait 25 minutes to play again or you can "buy" more coins... if you want to make money that bad then don't make the game free, just charge for it. But instead, it's "free" but requires money in order not to be extremely frustrated.

I gave it three stars instead of five because some levels take a ridiculous amount of time to beat. I've almost stopped playing several times because it becomes more frustrating than fun. I love a challenge but this is more than simply a challenge. It's almost like they make it unrealistically hard to force you to buy help packages.

Very addictive, makes you feel in control, while simply at the whims of their "randomness". I've seen falling sets of items be randomly interpreted as 3, 4 or 5 in a row, depending on whether I would have beaten the game with it, always in my disadvantage, along with other things that are constantly inconsistent in their behaviour. The obvious push towards buying upgrades that could dissipate without much impact makes this game unbearable at times. It's a fun game, but built around purchases.

This is not a good game. My first impression was good, but then I found I have to pay money every time I wanted to beat a level. Finally I cut myself off, because i was spending too much, and found I couldn't get to Level 50. Overall, the game could be better if you had more moves, and the levels were randomized (shape wise) Play "Penny and Flo, Finding Home" instead. Worth the time, easier levels, has more story, same output with the decorating.

I love playing this game, but I got a notification to install an update and now it won't let me play the game at all unless I do. the update won't download; waste of time. As for the game itself, it is really frustrating that they only offer 1 star per beaten level, but then sometimes have tasks that can only be completed with 2, or 3, or 4 stars! it makes it feel like way more work than it's worth.

I was a big fan of this game originally, and didn't mind paying for the monthly events. Then the drive for more money started with reducing the number of turns for all levels last year. You could sink hundreds per month into Homescapes now. They'll tell you to "change your strategy"... Strategy doesn't matter when it's impossible to beat many levels without power ups. It's unfortunate, it was otherwise a great game.

This game has so many different ads showing all the things that it DOES NOT DO! The ads look fun and involved where you are given a choice between certain objects to solve an issue. The real game; however, is just another version of candy crush where you earn 2-3 types of currency to exchange for upgrades to your mansion. I am disappointed when I download the game and find out its not like what they said it would be. I also don't like the side stories that take you away from decorating.

Preview of this game is nothing like the actual play. Must complete puzzles resembling Candy Crush in order to progress. Some are mundane tasks that have no point but regardless, a puzzle is required. Further progression will eventually lead to puzzles that cannot be completed without coins or boosts and will essentially lead you to a "pay to play" style game. Cool for a short period, but disappointing in the long run.

I hate the false advertising. I really liked the concept in the commercial. Curse you for making me find the type of game i would like, then giving me candy crush. The syoryline was fine, but i was most interested in renovating the house and often got stuck working on levels to rebuild the car, etc. I dont like the 5 lives as they go too fast. It was fun while i played, but i found a game i like more. My suggestion would be to have a variety of games to earn star instead of just match 3.

Love the game but having to pass a level to make a call, feed the cat or the bird, is a bit ridicuous. And the game is a huge download and causes your phone to run slow or even mess up during uses.... Updated review... The game has gotten crazy with levels having moves taken from it now and making it impossible to pass without paying. It's no fun to play anymore, just frustrating as hell when you know you can't possible pass with 12 moves.

You have a very rigged system. When I swipe right or left, the puzzle piece goes in opposite direction, causing me not to get the bomb or airplane etc, usually causing me to lose game by one point. Same with getting rid of donuts, when I have a jet or bomb that should cause them to exit field, towards ultimate goal of getting rid of them to win the game. ENOUGH!....I've just wasted too much time on a game where you cheat! LOSER.

Too hard. Even the levels that aren't labeled as "hard" or "super hard." Can't win without using powerups, and even then some levels have two parts, so if you do use a powerup, you can't use it on the harder half of the level. I just wanted to play a relaxing game and decorate a house. I couldn't even get to the second floor. More aggrivating than relaxing.

First of all I DID spend actual money on this game. Its too expensive to play. All your adds make it seem like there are perilous adventures when there aren't. You need to fix that bcz it's bad advertising. Drop the pricing on objects and I'll come back. I had gotten to the point that I was hooked. But the costs go up further in when it shouldn't. At times I also would lose progress or the monies I had spent weren't there. So I decided to stop bcz I'm not losing real money

I'm about ready to give up. The ads I saw were missleading, and while I like matching games, this game gets to the point where you have to spend lots of real money to continue. I'm about as far as I can go without spending anything. Here's the thing, I don't mind spending money on games, however, I do take issue with recurring microtransactions and a pay to win system. Such models mean that "free to play" isn't actually "free to play", this a predatory practice IMO.

Complete waste of time. the advertising for this game is completely false. nothing like it ever happens. however, the game itself could be fantastic, but you don't even get a full day's play out of it before the puzzle levels become impossible to complete without spending real money on power ups, or whatever they call it in this game. total waste of what could be a fun game. you also spend more time on pointless quests, like feeding a cat, than fixing up the house.

It was enjoyable up to lvl 24 or 25 at which point the only purchasing boosts. I didn't get game to spend money all the time. I play to take the edge off my anxiety issues. Not to generate more. Up to that point it was fun and interesting. However a niegh impossible level just takes all the fun out of it. I will say it is possible if the right boosts are generated or you managed to save some. But overall it works out to slim and none for us average people. Tried for two days uninstalled.

From fun to frustrating! I'm above the 5500 level mark and what used to be fun and challenging is now just frustrating. It takes way too long and way too many of the item to be collected in ordered to acquire items to complete the events w/o spending out loads of 💰, especially w/in the timeframe given. But wait! You can extend your time, all you have to do is spend more 💰! Factor all that in with the the increase of hard/superhard levels and you don't stand a chance!!

False Advertising I like this game, however it isnt the one advertised in ads. You renovate a home with a choice of three different color patterns, sometimes you dont even get that. Some scenes and dialogue you are unable to skip through. I'm past level 1000 and I haven't spent any money on this game. If that's ok with you, get this app, but just know it's not the game advertised.

Like any game of this type it has a really bad difficulty curve just to try and push you towards frustration, in hopes that you buy something to keep progressing. My biggest issue is with the ads I've been seeing for this game, which have nothing to do with the actual game but instead show gameplay from a game that doesn't exist; where you have to do real time fixes in the correct order to pass, no match 3 or anything is shown. The ads are lies just to get more downloads.

I used to play this rather frequently. The graphics are nice, the story is cute and well written, and there are no ads unless you choose to watch one (with the reward of five coins). However, as some of the other reviews said, the levels get to be nearly impossible to beat without boosters (which don't seem expensive, but trust me, it adds up). You do not get enough moves, which is more money you have to spend for only five moves. I do recommend this game, but not if you don't want to spend money

This used to be my favorite game, but the levels have become so ridiculously difficult that I'm rapidly losing interest. A little challenge is okay, but when you're stuck on the same level for weeks on end, and every season ends long before you can get all the items, it ceases to be fun. Also, the seasonal items each cost way too much, imo.

I downloaded this game because of the problem solving ad which isnt even involved in this game. At all. Complete false advertising. Then the levels are IMPOSSIBLE to beat. I've been trying to beat the same level for over a week. The pieces never fall in a way for me to win. They want you to breakdown and buy coins for more turns. I haven't and will not. 1 Star and game deleted. Total scam of a game. ALSO, it collected 12,000 of my coins, put it in a vault and then wants me to PAY for them! Crazy!

Update 1/1/2020 I've played the game for at least 2 years (probably more) but it's so boring now. Level 1389. This party room is taking too long even though I received play money for Christmas and never lose a level. The Christmas decorations were better, but not that much better. I'm going to quit playing again for awhile and play gardenscapes instead. I'm over level 3000 on that game and got all the Christmas decorations this year. It moves along faster.

The game design is not on track with what you would expect. It is more focused on the "candy crush" like Game than the actual making the house, which is annoying since people play this game not for that and that the gameplay for the "candy crush" is not the best, very RNG based and too punishing for those who can't finish the levels on the first try. (Retry too expensive 900 coins, lose all streak bonuses, lose tech points, lose medals). I am also already level 100 but i just finished area 1...

Clickbait game! I gave it two stars because some of the puzzles can be fun. However like many others on here, what was advertised in the ad is not what you play. I was hoping to help the character escape tricky situations but am matching colors. Some of the puzzles require a booster and if you run out they want you to buy. If you love matching games then you won't mind this but you will be disappointed if you came for what was advertised!

Its misleading in its advertisements. The gameplay is completing puzzles to obtain stars which allow you to decorate. I downloaded believing it was a point and click game. The puzzles are bland, there are much more entertaining puzzle games in the market. It also forces you through unnecessary tutorials and boring cut scenes, which are frustrating when you just want to play the game.

This game is a lot of fun and quite interesting, but to really enjoy and gain experience through the game, you will reach a point where you absolutely have to spend real money to achieve the next level. I truly despise that. I was at level 256 and finally decided to uninstall the game after spending around $50 or $60 at various points of seemingly impossible difficulty. Remodeling and renovating amenities was rather entertaining, but not remotely worth real world money.

Game is fun, but challenging. It's normal to get stuck on a hard level for a couple days, especially if you are out of boosters. The daily bonuses do help. One frustration is that the game won't open when there's a new update until you download it. If my device is low on space or something is glitching, I can't access the game at all when there's a new update.

While the interior design aspect of the game is great, everything else is a desperate cash grab. The levels are impossible to beat in the given number of moves without buying power ups. The character dialogue is completely unnecessary. You need to spend stars on completely meaningless tasks before you can actually accomplish anything, which just makes you play more levels and spend more power ups until you're completely stuck. I had high hopes going into this game, but now I'm competely fed up.

I enjoyed the game. It can get addicting if luck is with you and you can pass several lvls. Renovating the house need stars that you get from clearing a lvl. It gets annoying when the star/story plot almost did nothing, and is just used to play more levels, especially when there's still so many places to unlock. I ended up stop playing. Now I see ads everywhere that shows a completely different gameplay! It's really annoying. What's with these metal bars in all their games?? False advert much?

It's fun. The only thing i dont like are some of the events. They're just not the reason that I'm playing and I don't care about them, but they tend to get in my way. I do like how often the game gives you power ups and gifts, the fact that some levels are in the style of the ads you sometimes see (so the ads aren't false advertising technically), and that there's a skip dialogue button. I am here to decorate a house and nothing more and i like that the game accomodates my play style.

While the graphics are great and the design is fun, the matching game itself is intentionally overly difficult. Many of the regular levels are infuriatingly difficult, even using various bonus items to give yourself an advantage. The hard and super hard (seriously) are even worse. If you have money and time to spend burning through bonus items and trying to pass levels so clearly designed to make you fail, then this game may be for you. I uninstalled it because it was no longer fun for me.

I was looking for a fun home decorating app and this popped up in my search. I was VERY disappointed to discover that it was just another match 3 game. I played for a while and was extremely frustrated by how difficult it was to match any of the decor...there is like one set that coordinates (usually in a color I don't like) and every else is just random. Also, I've been seeing ads for this in other games I play and they are FALSE ADVERTISING. Shame on Google for allowing them to be viewed.

I wouldn't say I hate this game, I've been playing up to level 100, basically I save my stars until I can get an unlimited play time, then play for 30 minutes until I beat a hard level. Here's the problem with this game... IT IS NOT LIKE THE AD AT ALL!! In fact it's just basically candy crush, except after you beat a few levels you get to add a piece of furniture to your house, and judging by the size of your house, you're never gonna get very far very quickly. I don't recommend getting this if you can from seeing the AD or you want to find a game you can progress through fairly easily. Some levels are unbeatable unless your luck is amazing.

I do enjoy this game; however, when I spend days and days trying to complete the same level it gets tedious. I honestly believe the level isn't going to come out and then suddenly through no change of tactics it works (almost like there an inbuilt number of attempts needed at some levels!) Even boosts are totally useless...until the game decides the level can be completed.

Its fun in the beginning. Basically, the puzzles get so hard that you essentially have to pay for everything to win/continue on. It's taken days per level without paying for anything and its discouraging. You join a team and even a member said that because I was stuck on lvl 50 I should just quit then. I made it a few more levels, but ultimately decided to just delete it. If it wasn't so expensive and difficult, maybe I'd do more, but until that day it's just not worth it.

Absolutely not the game you see in the pics and ads. Instead it's a build and clean house game where it tells you everything you need to do. You can't even leave the house, it's 100% scripted. The little choose your own adventures and puzzles in the ads simply don't exist!! And I tried playing it until the entire mansion was renovated because I thought it would change. Waste of time.

It grabbed my interest at first but the levels got to difficule to pass without costing real money...which I won't do. Plus it distracts you from restoring the mansion with other things to do with no option. I want to play a game for entertainment which this is failing to do. I agree with many of the other's comments when it comes to difficulty & coin gains. It cost coins just to wake up to a new day! Ceasing to be fun!! Frustrations lends me toward un-installing this game. :(

Saw a review that claimed you have to pay to beat certain levels. It's definitely not true. I haven't once paid for this game and I'm into the lake house. Yes some levels are very hard and this game is easier for some than for others. Yes I have had levels I was stuck on for a week and I have good pattern matching skills but I have never had a level I didn't eventually just get lucky if I spent enough time.

I want a game to be an enjoyable way to pass some time. Not a frustrating, want to throw my phone, have to attend anger management classes just to play one level 10,000 times as the ultimate exercise in futility. I would never spend cash on this game. I have to get rid of this game now. The developers introduced a "super hard" level which just makes playing this game worthless. Horrible decision.

I enjoy Gardenscapes, but I personally enjoy this game even more. The characters are engaging, the gameplay is fun, the writing is pretty good and overall, it's a very good app. P.S., DON'T listen to the reviews complaining about having to spend coins and being unable to pass levels even IF you use a powerup. That's not the game's fault and you have to be smart/careful in winning and if it takes forever, guess what, you'll still pass eventually. Stop blaming the game because of YOUR fault.

This used to be my favorite game. Not anymore. The levels have become too hard, making any competition almost impossible to compete in. Spending weeks trying to beat just 1 level, well, it just isn't fun anymore. And you can't even watch videos to get coins anymore, unless you beat a level. I'm not asking to make the levels easy, just not so darn hard. And maybe bonus coins when you check in for a week straight. I wish they'd just make this game fun again.

I really enjoy playing this game, but the micro-transactions massively add up without you realizing how much you're really spending. The in-app purchases would be more understandable if they were optional extra tools, but eventually, it becomes almost impossible to play without buying (with REAL MONEY) the coins that you've already "earned." I'll try to keep playing without spending money, but it may not be worth the effort.

This game is not what you see on the adds. It's basically like Candy Crush and sometimes it has minigames that "look like" (not that much) the ones in the adds. Overall it's a good game, I just dont like the fact that there are hard levels that require literally a week to pass... and if you can't pass a level, then you can't complete the events.A very good example of false advertising. The content shown in the ad is less than %5 of the actual gameplay.

Suddenly the game freezes during "wait for the guests" at Andy's exhibition. It stops progressing after Austin says he wants to check in with the others. He just stands there, and you can see Ellen off to the side sit down, then stand up, then sit down again. Clearly a glitch. I tried uninstalling and reinstalling, but it just did it again. Please fix this.

The game is fun however it's hard to get enough points in order buy extra options and you run out of retries too fast. It's fun to be able to have options when your updating the house, but it would be nice to be able to change your options without having to pay for it each time. 6/11/9/19 update: Wish you could undo a move as sometimes seems the move doesn't go the way you wanted it to. as of 8/1/19 wish you could undo a move

I like that you get to decorate. But I'm changing my rating to 2 stars. Not sure what update it was but the game developers have made it impossible to win levels without using all your perks or spending money! I'm on level 3423 and I have to play 20 or 30 times to win! A game is supposed to be fun not frustrating. And while I understand that the developers need to make money, I don't feel that the gameplay should be geared towards forcing players to spend $!

I too am downgrading my review based on the developers significantly reducing the number of moves needed to complete a level from what was needed for other players when the levels were released. My current level for example, 6616, was released a couple months ago with 24 moves to complete. I only have 13 moves to complete. Playrix is responding to other reviewers that the YouTube videos are outdated. Well, yes they are. The YouTube videos are showing how fun and successful the game used to be.

At the start of this game I was really excited about it it was fun it was challenging and I enjoyed the puzzles the part of what I really liked about the game was the fact that I got to design and build the house and it was great when it was 1 star for each event that you had to do but now we're up to three stars just to start a new day so that means that I have to play three levels and pass three levels just a start a new day it's ridiculous and it's become no longer fun the levels are too hard what I'm stuck playing one level for 2 weeks it loses the fun of the game and it's sad because it really could potentially be a very fun and enjoyable game if the game makers wouldn't make it so darn hard. I I would also love to be able to do more work on my house

Deleted the game eventually...and you are able to progress in due time...I am like many others...never spend real money...ever. Updated this Jan 21...2021. I rated the game after roughly 700 levels. I am adding to it after 832 levels and editing it now in July of 2019 while on level 1238. The game passes the time and I don't use my money on any game, as I play it with patience and when time allows it. The game keeps me interested and occupied. If it was boring then I would just delete it.

It's a fun game, but some of the puzzles have so few moves and they become impossible to complete without using power ups. Been stuck on one level waiting hours just for more hearts to try it again. Edit: Reinstalled after two years and I'm still having the same issues. I really wanna enjoy this game but it just feels like its difficulty is artificially inflated.

The game itself is fun, but it punishes its loyal players and the longer you play, the less you can enjoy it. You cannot reset your progress and the whole game is based on completing many levels in a row on your first try, but the levels get so crazy, you cam get stuck for days on a single level. You dont get any benefits for being a loyal or a paying player. If the intention is not to make all loyal players quit, it should really be adjusted and reset should be possible.

I would love to give this game 5stars but I just can't. there are some levels that have taken weeks to clear. I don't like using my power ups unless I have to and these levels I personally think are designed to make you use them up. I would love a call it quits button for levels. maybe cost a grand or 2 and skip the level. or buy stars so I can finish a quest objective. needless to say I do like it and I continue to play daily. please keep up the good work

I love this game less and less the more I play it. I'm currently on level 215, where I have to beat 9 levels in total to bake the cake for the show they're putting on. I wanted this game for the home decorating fun, not random little side tasks like this. It was tolerable when it was one star per task, but 9 is ridiculous! Update: The cake decorating continued. It gave me two new tasks for it, bringing the levels to beat from 9 to 15. One of my favorite games is now deleted :(

Still playing after 3 years. Good game. The characters are a little weird 😂. The only difference I've noticed is that over time, the devs have gotten a bit stingy. It's way harder to get an amount of the boosts needed to progress. Obviously they'd like you to spend money. But, if you're patient you can still play without spending unless you want to.

The game is good except for the boards being so hard....it took me 3 months to beat 1 level..,,after awhile playing the same board over and over you get discouraged and won't want to play any more....when i first started it was fun but now it's getting really hard to upgrade your home and that's what my goal is to fix the mantion but it's just so time consuming.... impossible and too hard...I can't spend any money on games but over all I still play it..

*EDIT: I feel the new house doesn't have as many options in the design. Part of the reason why i loved this game so much in the first place was the customization. For example: Now you use 4 stars and have no choice for a counter top. This is my favorite game! Had it for about 3 years now and still play it almost every day. One suggestion would be to allow team members to give power ups as well!

Loved and played this game for years, I even recommended more rewards before more rewards were given and it felt like the company listened to my advice so i was very happy. But i absolutely, positively HATE the new ad campaign. It doesn't tell you what actually happens in the game, it's false advertising, it should be illegal, and it's turned off most of the friends i wanted to play this game with me. Absolutely terrible idea on the marketing teams side.

I downloaded because of those ads where you have to move the metal pins and get the water through the pipes properly without mixing the sludge. App is not as described in ads. Its a mix and match game and only contains what they show in their ads as a mini game and you dont even get to play one after every level. I think I got to play 1 mini game of it and played for a while longer but uninstalled when I realized the game is nothing like it is advertised. They shouldnt false advertise. No good.

Frustrating game. I used every single one of my powerups and still couldn't beat the level. The ads for this game are very deceptive. If you saw the ads for an interesting and engaging puzzle game and decided to try it don't waste your time, the games you see in the ads are only one tenth of actual gameplay, the rest is frustrating match 3 games you have to play to get stars and sometimes you need multiple stars to do one thing.

I like the game its cute. I hate the advertising is so misleading this is a bejeweled style matching game primarily. I wish the adds matched thus. I'm still playing I'm like at level 600ish.
