One complaint is that you don't get to choose when you receive your awards. Like i could be playing to chill out before bed and get 3 hours unlimited lives. Which sucks because i would love to use that at a better time.

Between last night and today I have not received at least 3 stars for passing levels and 5500 coins I paid for. Others have been having glitches as well. I'm new to this game and disappointed to not get what I'm earning and paying for. Update for some reason the purchase of 5500 coins package didn't complete. Even though my other purchases did. However, I still didn't receive the at least 3 stars I earned. But every game has glitches from time to time. So pretty good game thus far.

Would like to be able to play for more stars at a time so I could do more reno's at a time instead of having to play for one at a time. I think some of the super hard stages are set up to eat your coins so you need to buy more to finish that level. Would be great idea to be able to help a cache of all the powerr ups we accumulate that you take away.

I have been a loyal player of this game for the past few years. I am happy to pay $ a month for extra lives if I am interested in the game. If you give me up to 2hrs of free game I am very happy unless that is a waste. I will no longer pay for extra games if I am on the same level for too long. I understand as developers you need to put hard levels in, however if it takes so long to solve a level that I can't even remember the side tasks that go with the game. Not interested anymore.

Nice game, good graphics. .. but nothing like advertised on other gamesites. Extreme money drain...... I've made it to level 787, but have decided to uninstall as some levels are just so hard without spending considerable amounts of hard earned money. This would be a great game if everything didn't cost so much. The storyline is ok, except for all the rich people and their constant buying and throwing perfectly good stuff away.

This game was advertised differently then what it actually appeared to be, but I went ahead and played. It was fun for a while, but it got harder. I spent money buing lives. What a waste. It cost way too many coins to get extra 5 moves. Plus it takes 20 minutes to get one life. Then the game froze on me at level 27. So I'm uninstalling. I wish I could get my money back on what I spent on this game. The makers of this game should be sued for false advertising.

Have loved this app for years. Very disappointed with the latest "side" game though. I'm still giving it 5 stars, but with the hope that you'll change it for the next game. When I'm stuck on a level, it's relaxing to be able to play the side game. Now you have made part of the side game passing levels. That's not a side game and it's very disappointing and annoying. I have played this game less than my other regulars since this happened. Please don't do it again. Edit: 3 stars. Reason above.

While it started out as a fun game, I am now at the level where it can take 3 WEEKS before I'm allowed to win a level. They REALLY want me to buy to the point where I can't even play the merge game without passing the level game and it takes longer to pass the level than you have days to play the merge game. Frustration because I won't buy isn't much fun.

I literally cannot put this game down in the little free time I have. It is my favorite outlet from the stress of medschool. Kudos you savvy mf's. Totally better than other puzzle games because it gets you totally involved in the role playing aspect with the story line. It's like an RPG puzzle game that just blows everything else out of the water. It also is true to the players because they don't make it overly difficult and force in-game purchase. They have tons of opportunity to earn bonuses through gameplay alone. 5 star without a doubt. And I usually just be my way through these reviews to get the "rate us" messages to stop. This one I feel deserved the extra time to celebrate a truly awesome addition to the app market.

I have been playing and loved this game for a long time and have even purchased the kind of expensive-ish 'seasons'.. what happened to being able to obtain all those great gifts? I can not possibly pass through hundreds of levels to complete each stage no matter how many hours a day I play! I think it's ridiculous that I can't complete the season that I paid for! I'll never buy into it again! Thanks, but no thanks!

Game is adicting, challenging, and fun. Ads are optional to watch wich is a huge plus. The only thing I'd say would be better is if the levels give you one star for Normal levels, 2 stars for Hard levels, and 3 starts for Super Hards levels. I'm level 800+ and it's costing up to 4 stars to finish one or half a task. Other than that the game is great.

Typical match 3 game with the bonus of room design and home remodeling as a reward perk. It's a fairly entertaining game, both the "Scapes" games are but I've noticed both of them rather aggressively hit a couple puzzles where you are forced to spend money or you're going to grind it a dozen times. There's no magic combo you're going to pull off, it's actively programmed for you to get stuck there until you spend money or a certain amount of hearts. For that I can only give it 2⭐

This can be quite a fun and relaxing game, but the way they make levels hard is to reduce moves. This can get frustrating. No real strategy, except in knowing what boosters to make during that level. Using a booster before beginning a level can be a waste, as it comes down to the fall of the tiles in the game. It could be 50 turns and get no where, then on 51 you will finish the level in 5 moves. I wish they would include ads for boosters 🤔

This game has so much potential to be wonderful. if you just made the levels easier I would play this all of the time! love this type of gameplay. I play matching mansion. and I'm sad to say it's better. it would be equally as fun if these levels were not so hard. I'm on level 75 and it is honestly impossible to pass. I have played this level over 100 times and it's very frustrating. I am not putting money in this game to continue. however. If these issues were fixed, I would play so much more!

The game is not based on skill or strategy. It is pure luck,or based on who the developers allow to win. If you aren't on that list for that level that day no dice. If you are supposed to collect a certain number of items it will frequently withhold a portion of them until you are down to one move. I figure it's to try to get people to pay real money for game coins and such,but it also puts a damper on the entertainment quality of the game.

This game is fun but would be better if it had a watch an ad feature to get more coins. At least that way you could get through harder levels by continuing playing. Also is like to use my extra power ups when i need them during a game, not at the beginning of a game where the computer places them when they are quite useless at that point.

The game is ok, I guess, but it is NOT what's advertised, I only played 1 60 second part that was even remotely like what was advertised, I've played it for a while hoping to get to the part that's shown in the add but never did, just 60 seconds worth. I definitely will watch for this company and avoid downloading, as I hate wasting time having to go back and delete something after only a short time. If the problem solving part is only between 1-100, then I can delete this game.

Since the 10/21/21 update I can't play because the main screen won't display properly on my LG Velvet. The edges are outside the viewable area of my screen, and that's where all the buttons to play are. Please fix! I have enjoyed the game as a time waster, but agree with others who point out that the puzzles they use to advertise the game almost never occur in game. 95% is playing a candy crush style game, 4% "fixing" your home by spending points you earned playing that game.

This game is very addictive, but the pieces move all on there own. example i just touch the piece I want to move when I touch the space i want the piece to move too, but instead of this, it moves as soon as I touch the piece sometimes. It never goes where it is supposed to go when this happens either. which is incredibly maddening. If this gets corrected. the game will have 5 stars.

Addictive, fun, very challenging levels. The only downside to this game app is getting enough life to beat challenging levels. That and there are no boosters, once you use your 3 free ones, unless you purchase them, they are extremely rare get. As I am trying to live on social security, I do not purchase game items or lives. So needless to say, it often takes me weeks or even months to beat hard levels😢

Unfortunately, the game is not what I expected. I played it for a while even though it's rarely the mini puzzles and mostly matching the pieces stuff. I did like the home improvement visuals and the story. After reaching level 100, it gets really tough to get past the matching puzzle unless one spends actual money to buy and get through by getting extra moves and skills. I got bored because it's repeatative and not playable because of the hard levels.

This game is very fun, but the levels got very hard very quickly. It's also very annoying how fast you run out of lives, and while they give you unlimited lives for a certain amount of time, you could not be playing the game while you have that time. I think they should make it so your unlimited lives time can be paused for when your not playing. Also, please make the levels easier.

Fun game overall. Really enjoyed my progress in repairing the house. A lot of the levels are impossible to complete with the amount of moves they give you. Huge focus to buy coins and boosters. I tried a level 50 times and could not pass it without buying more coins to get boosters, and I have played similar games for more than 10yrs. I ended up unistalling the app.

I love this game but recently became very disappointed in the developers that they would raise their prices so much. It used to be that when you got the safe full you could purchase 5,000 coins for $2.99 but now it is only 3,000 coins. The prices in the bank itself just went up as well. Did they think we wouldn't notice?? There's only so much you can spend on a game and then someone has to go and get greedy. Shame on them.

I used to absolutely love this game! Now ive been hopelessly stuck in the garden section for almost a year!!!! I honestly dont know why i havent deleted the game. I think a small part of me still loves playing it.. The false advertising is atrocious! 99% of its advertising is completely false. It started with video ads and now this page os covered in it. Even the app face is of the false ad! Very disappointed in what used to be my favourite game has become. Please fix it.

Graphics really good.Not the game I thought it was going to be; at least the way it was advertised. in order to get stars you have to beat puzzles, if you can't complete a level of puzzle your stuck there till you do. This gets tiring as you only have so many boosters to work with. After only 2 days I deleted the game as I can't progress past level 11, plus it's minus 1 heart for every failed puzzle.

I love the game I'm also happy that we now have "Groups" to join which makes getting/giving lives faster & easier. Only main issue is when pieces don't move the direction I tell them to; right instead of left, up instead of down or move when double tapped. The "Challenges" annoy me but it's sooo addictive ➕ I like puzzles/decorating its a 2 for 1 & not as boring as others I've tried.

This game is okay but with all the money I've spent and I'm sure others have spent, you should get more coins as you level up and more stars for the harder levels. I had to uninstall it because it was just got too much on spending. It's almost impossible to get through the levels without spending. You all have gotten your last from me that's for sure.

Something is wrong. I've played this game for years and it keeps freezing after winning game. I sent them a screen shot of the problem, it drained my free booster hour and power-ups, and never heard back. Sent the issue within the platform. I filled out a form and used the message board. Silence. I have spent money on this game before, but I'm not going to continue to play it if I'm cheated out of well earned free play time through no fault of my own.

Recent updates hurt playability. We get it...it's about making money for Playrix, but the latest update nerfing the ability to back-out of a level prior to making a move is a bridge too far. I've played 2 years as a way to relax & have happily bought season passes or extra gold to help push through a tough stretch ($100's), but also to support the development of a game I enjoy which would otherwise be free. Not anymore. Congrats Playrix, you playrix-ed yourself. I'm no longer a paying customer.

It would make more sense to have the coins that are earned when one conquers a level to be more in line with what it costs to get five more moves if you need more to finish a level. One has to use 900 coins to get 5 more moves, but one only earns between 50 - 100+ as reward if you beat the level. If this were the case you would have a five star game all around.

this game was good, but the last couple of updates have destroyed the fun. First....the mini games you see in ads are fake, they do not exist. 2. The "side challenges" are now so ridiculous, the rewards are worthless and you can't get the top prize unless you are paying to play 24/7. Worst yet, the pre-game boosts that used to be helpful are now downgraded to be completely worthless.The game is fun when there is a challenge, but it is not fun to get stuck at every level.

Over all, it's a fun game. Sometimes the puzzles work against you and make it difficult. However, I been stuck on the same puzzle for 3 weeks. I don't have any coins to spend to get 5 more moves. I'm out of boosts and I can't seem to earn any free lives. I get 5 shots then have to wait hours to play again. Due to the fact some puzzles are almost impossible, I'm uninstalling the game. Fun game, but when you get in my position, they want you to spend real money. They had a good idea, but ruined it
I've haven't played the game in awhile but it's nice but I wish there was a setting to auto skip those simple games that you see in the adds that they can't solve and only play the match 3 puzzles

The game is nice, I like the puzzles, but when they release a parallel event such as adventures it's extremely frustrating cause you can't do almost nothing, every obstacle costs an impossible amount of energy and the levels give to you only 5. It's annoying because you wanna play, you wanna evolve in the game, but they don't let you. It's the same problem of the higher levels puzzles, they force you to buy they're stuff. I tried all games of this company and all of them have the same problem

Looks like they deleted my review...nice. I said, this used to be my absolute favorite game. I would spend money on the occasional times that I would get stuck and couldn't pass a level and the monthly challenges. However. In June 2021, they went in and decreased the number of moves for each level, practically forcing you to buy moves if you want to proceed. I will not spend another dime.

Great Game. I will warn those who spend money that if you are going to buy one of the "packs" look at what you get and the price. If you add it up, I found that buying multiple of the smaller pack gives you more for the same price than buying the more expensive "packs". Not sure if that was by design or just an oversight but I would expect to get a better deal for spending more money, especially in a "free" game. Game is great otherwise. Hope everyone enjoys it as I do. Thanks to the devs!!

Could have been more fun if this didn't look like extortion. Sometimes you are on one level for three days, so there's nothing relaxing at all! Twice I checked on YouTube how other people beat a super hard level. You know what? Before those were normal ones with more moves (37 instead of 18 for instance). I understand you want money. I personally don't mind paying once a month for an event. I think that would be more than enough, considering how many people play this. Don't be so greedy!

Would rate 5 the game is nice and the content is great BUT when you play levels that ask you to collect 55 items with only 15 moves and you LUCKILY pass them and you get to a super hard level but with no luck to win the first two times it starts taking away things you have worked hard to collect!! And it takes 900 coins to get 5 more moves but the amount of coins you gain from each level is ~60coins only! Who ever created this game definitely wanted people to pay in order to be able to play!

I have been playing this for years and am up to level 8001. I stopped playing because it would take weeks to get past a level. I decided to give it another go but unless you want to spend a lot of money, you are back to taking weeks to get past a level. I understand challenging but this game (plus Gardenscapes and Township) have levels that that have nothing to do with skill.

The game seems easy enough until you are paying more that you are getting. Only getting one star at level 600, paying 900 coins for 5 moves, only getting 50 to 100 coins per mission. But needing to spend 10 times that for powers up and everything else. Needing 3 to 8 star per remodeled wouldn't bother me if i get more then 1 to 2 star per level. Also getting stuck on a level for days and loose the points for the other missions suck. Not even spending money you get the level up.

just dropped you a star for one simple reason. you're missing a difficulty level! How could you have missed that? Level 870 isn't hard... it's stupid. I vote you add a "Difficulty: Stupid" to the game. I watch the adds and have even bit on a couple, but I'm not paying to get past a level. I'll try a few more days to get past it then you're getting removed.

I have transferred some money to get coins and power up, but the game suddenly crashed. I waited for like 10 to 15 minutes. I had to restart the game because it seemed like Austin didn't even want to stop drinking his tea. I lost the power ball, and progress on the super hard level, in the middle of team tournament. And when the game has restarted, the number of coins i have didn't even change. I wasted my money, and lost all the hard work I've been putting on the game. It sucks

Been playing this game more than 6 years, i think. But can I suggest 1 thing about the power up item? Can you make the double impacts really do have double impacts? For instance, if I use plane on bilyard table, and bomb goes off beside it at the same time, it only have 1 effect. Only 1 ball decreased. It happened in other things too. I mean, it makes other item effect become obsolete. Maybe it's a thing to consider since I believe you devs still reading review? Thanks anyway.

I have had this game for years, and there are phases when I play every single day. It has been clear since the beginning that you can only clear levels when the game wants you to. Fair enough, that keeps people playing longer. But since the last update, the minimum amount of coins you get for clearing one simple level has dropped to 15 coins. How are you supposed to have enough coins to get the 5 additional swaps for a 900 coins each time, when you get only 15 coins at a time? So disappointing.

When a game creates a "challenge" to complete 10 levels in 2 days, its the makers agreeing that its difficult & employing a marketing tactic to pressure players into a sense of fomo. Home upgrades are only possible by paying stars that you win after completing a level. First few levels are easy, but as you go along, the difficulty increases so much that you essentially have to buy boosts to complete a them. Also, how is it possible to run out of moves on the same level, 4 times in a row!?

Honestly I only play this to advance the story. If not for that I would have been quit. It's like Candy Crush but more money hungry. As you get further in the game, the levels are not overly hard, they just don't give you enough moves to beat a level. It's like it trying to get you to spend money on power ups and coins. its frustrating to get to the end of a level and only need one move. Plus now I see ads for the game and I just laugh. For example, ther are honey and bubble spaces that you have to match pieces on or by to get rid of them. The problem is, if the space hasn't fully materialized with the obstacle, matching on or by doest get rid of the space. Further, there are plenty of events that give you unlimited lives for a period of time, but the time ticks away even if you aren't in game. I love this game but it has been rigged lately purposely so you can spend tons of money trying to beat levels and not just the hard ones. You get no sort of rewards for putting in money and can't get any refunds because they have all the tools so pricy that you can only buy one set and then you still lose so they can get more money. First of all, ALL THE ADS YOU SEE FOR THIS GAME ARE LIES. The gameplay is NOTHING like what's shown in any ad I've ever seen for this game. It's mainly a Candy Crush type matching game to earn points to advance in the story part of the game. I haven't played for long as I'm kind of irked at the deceptive advertising practices of this sleazy company. The matching game is ok in its own right, but that's NOT the game you sold me on. Bloody dishonest company.

Apparently my last review got deleted, so I'll post again. Free-to-play doesn't always have to mean pay-to-win but unfortunately this is the case. Game is very predatory starting around level 180+. They give you like 5 moves to clear two screens of gems, so you have no other option than spend boosters or coins. This is a great example of a game just fishing for 'whales' like EA. No paid version or ad version. They even gaslight people in the reviews telling they should just get good. Terrible.

**BUYER BEWARE** The programmers are trying to force you to spend money. I have video recording showing when I try to get a power up, the pieces move a different direction or airplanes head to a target and last second hits a different one and you have to pay to make that one more move any many more examples of deceit.If you don't mind spending money, then enjoy the game. I for one won't be forced to spend money and will take my business elsewhere. Watch the YouTube videos and see for yourself

I can't spend money on a game,but it seems as you get higher in levels its impossible to beat unless you make in app purchases. I might just have to remove the game altogether because I cant keep trying to beat the same level day in day out. Each time nearly beating it only to fail every time. That is when I had the realization I can't win with out spending money. Not cool folks,not cool at all!

I don't like the cat levels. I'm not very good and my the time i get to the first gift basket I've already lost all 3 followers. I wish the gift included at least 1 flower so i could at least have a small chance of making it up the windows to the other kitty. Also, i can't wait till i can decorate the inside of the house again! I already play garden scapes! This one should be inside again! Not out in the garden... 🙄

I made it to level 545. Unfortunately that level is not beatable in 1 go. You are given only 12 moves. I have gone as far as eliminating all but 1 acorn obstacle. The game offers me to continue with 5 more moves however I don't have enough coins. I also can't purchase coins because the app says purchases are unavailable. So the game is now useless. There is absolutely no way to beat the level and 3 others who are as advanced as I have tried on my phone. Nobody can beat the level.

I like this game the only reason I didn't rate it 5 stars is because of the amount of coins you have to use just to get 5 extra moves. 900 is a lot. 500 is more reasonable, to me, for those few moves. I usually only need 1-2 more moves and I have to either wait 2 hours for lives to replenish or spend 900 coins. Other than that, the concept is cool and the game is fun to play.

mixes a couple of different game styles. downloaded because of the terrible ads (that you can't even play to see the family happy; touching anything brings you here). neat little brain teasers, but i would never play this more than once, nor would i spend money on this. better than Hero Wars by a long shot at least. Uninstalled.

First levels are fun. Over the course of a few months I have spent $$ and made my way to level 3326. Almost every other level is extra hard or hard. The app knows you will spend money and if you do the app will hold out on letting you advance until more is pumped in. Unreal how it expects you to advance without paying. A dollar here or there is price is admission, but daily brick walls takes the fun out of the game. Happy to delete this game and get it out of my life.

I shouldnt have to play a level 200 times to finally beat it. Im just going to stick to matchington Mansion. At least if you played it 20 times they help you beat it. I've played the level I'm on so many times its ridiculous. They try to get you to buy stuff so bad. Put and add in every once in awhile and make money off those like normal games.

Homescapes is not your ordinary match 3 game. It is challenging, and so very addictive. The home renovations are a unique way for the player to become involved with not only the strategy of the game, but also the cast of characters, animal and human. It is a good way to kill 30 minutes, or pass the 2,3 hours of a flight delay. Overall, this game is one not to miss. Its rewards, and different levels will keep you interested, and entertained, no doubt.

I was looking for a different game to play, I saw the ads for this so i thought I'd try it. I liked it at first, but after about level 160, items that were 1-2 stars went to 2-4 stars and I could see that this game is totally pay-to-win. Some of the levels were also quite imbalanced as to # of turns vs. final goals (as in you have to max the powerups and it still takes several tries to pass) it seems solely to run the player out of powerups sooner so they have to purchase more. Uninstalling.

Loved the game for a few days but the levels keep getting really difficult to complete and we have to depend on boosters and spend money. There are so many levels where they give only one place where you can destroy the candy and they aren't helpful in completing the level but we still have to keep playing it and loose our moves till after 6 moves the game says no moved left. Please fix it. And I understand that it needs to keep getting tougher but please don't make it impossible for us to play.

The game is great until you get an issue with an in app purchase. Their customer service is the worse! I lost my golden ticket after syncing my progress in between devices. Its been a few days now and after several emails and I have only received a generic canned response from them. Both the in game and online support portal doesn't take you to someone who can help. PS. I STILL HAVE NOT GOTTEN SUPPORT.

Well it's understandable that the game is sort of online (requires internet) but I just don't like the fact that it keeps on updating like every single time. Apart from that the infinite life is sometimes not enough for a super hard level and idk if I need to pay for the boosters just to get on the next one. But a nice game to kill time.

At first this game was challenging-yet-doable. But starting at about level 750 the levels are impossible to win without spending money. You can play and play for a week on one level and the game will never let you win. This game is fun, but the final straw is that it keeps glitching and not giving you things you paid for. I have lost boosters twice now that never registered.🤦‍♀️ It keeps stealing my money and frankly I'm fed up!

Dissappointed. Many flaws. Uninstalling. It was totally different from the ad, it came out 2 be a gem matching game. Initially it was ok but as we move 2 the higher levels every level becomes difficult. Only 1 particular level is mentioned as hard which is not true. Its difficult 2 complete because the moves are very less compared 2 the challenge. The boosters cannot be used in between the game. Less stars and coins are given compared 2 the level completed only once in a while it gets doubled.

I just want to leave a review for those of you that say it is pay to win once you get up to the higher and harder levels. I'd like to know which levels you seem to find this to be true about because as I find there to be levels up past the 100's that do often become extremely challenging, I can however eventually make it through those said levels without having to pay to win. There is always eventually a solution, sometimes it just takes a little luck and patience! Overall I like this to pass⏰

So I was enjoying this game despite the challenging levels until the most recent update. Why are we no longer allowed to redecorate our house?! This is so frustrating because you never know what a room is going to look like until you've unlocked all the elements. So I like to make changes once everything is unlocked and now I can't. I'm stuck with mismatched decor and I really hate it. I think I'll be getting rid of the game if this change sticks.

I kept seeing the ad where you choose what items to use in order to fix problems in the kitchen (leaky faucet, electrical issue, stove on fire etc). The actual game is totally different, it's one of the many many games where you line up 3 shapes and get points. The whole home renovation aspect was slow and mundane.

Can be fun at times. Once you get in the higher levels the ones that are supposed to be easier are just as hard or take just as long to try to win compared to the levels that are specifically labeled hard or super hard. However, I just realized there's no more mini games inbetween the levels. I'm at level 7296 and I haven't had a mini game for a long time like in the beginning. False advertisement! What's up with that? Why aren't there any mini games??

love the game and its so addictive. only thing i dont care for is that you have to spend real money if you want to continue after being stuck on a hard level and lose all your lives. if you do spend money, the packages i think cost too much for what you get and it takes 900 coins just to continue or get full lives. but in the end, its a great and fun game. love fixing up the house and getting to choose different options on how you decorate it.

It's a really relaxing game. I've played it before but got stuck in a lvl cuz I don't have coins to continue, then I downloaded the game when I got my phone, started saving from lvl 1, rn I'm at lvl 9090 and I've saved 451,000 coins—yep, it's really hard to earn coins but when you save from the start I mean I don't use my coins at the initial lvls I try over and over again lol. I just wanna suggest that we are able to send images and also help our friends with coins not just lives and cards >.<

I really like this game. I haven't experienced many buggy things, but sometimes the levels can get extremely hard, but all in all I enjoy playing the game. You can change your name and the cats, and if you are using the rockets, it makes two rockets go off in the game when you only "release" one. Although, some of the updates make it so that it freezes and sticks at 80 some percent, or says that something went wrong. I played a long time before this though and it was fine.

since I have been playing, I played this game religiously. Gave reviews joined a group where I was at the bottom and gradually I became the highest ranked member. But then all of a sudden there is this golden pass thing. Which gives golden frames to people and makes them look privileged because they paid $4.99! What about our dedication? And what about other players who keep playing and score instead of buying perks? No motivation for them?? The golden frame was super depressing.

I really love this game and it's very addicting, however it gets considerably more difficult after level 2000 or so, and by level 2400, I'm finding myself spending way too much money on this game because they give you hard levels with only like 11-14 moves. I almost always end up paying for more moves to get past hard and very hard levels, and it's more hard and very hard than normal levels. I added up all the micro transactions over the last month and I've spent over $50 I can't keep doing that

It takes too long to finish each level. Many of the levels are too difficult. Some have taken 5-6 days to defeat. Frequently that makes me want to delete the game. This game is called “Homescapes“. It would be nice to go back into the house rather than having two “Gardenscapes“. Each area is getting too much ”stuff” to the point of looking messy. We should have an options on updates! 2 required updates in 10 days is ridiculous 😤 When one can win more than one game in a row, it is really fun

Not as advertised. Downloaded it because of the puzzles advertised, but it turns out those are actually "mini games" that rarely pop up. It's basically a match-3 game, but for that I'd rather stick with Candy Crush. The rewards you get that are needed to "renovate" the mansion are not worth it in my opinion. I'll be renovating it well into my retirement years at the rate this is going.

Pros: Fun, engaging, a light story, creative, challenging to the right degree, mini-games give useful bonus prizes just for participating - and more for doing well. Cons: Asks you to review even if you have. Tricks you to coming here. A bit frustrating and slow paced at points. The stacks of popups and the like when lots of mini-games start up at the same time are obnoxious. Some normal levels are obscenely hard, while some hard ones are a breeze. Team element needs more controls by the leader.

This is a good matching game. The story can be interesting and there a different challenges in the levels. There are times when it seems the game does not want you to win, it stop giving you a certain color or type you need, for example. There have been a couple times where I've earn something and it hasn't been awarded. That's frustrating. It is a time killer for me so it is whatever, if I were more into it it would be a bigger issue. Just know this going in. Overall an ok game.

Designed to make you pay for stuff in an annoyingly manipulative way. The AI for the planes (most of the levels basically run on) is the worst I've seen. When used, they target things based on how the board WAS. If its under something you need, and the object moves from just using the plane, it is now popping the spot above it. I know games need money, but I absolutely refuse to put one cent into a game that makes using a powerup a way to lose. It's mostly fun, but BS mechanics tries patience..

I uninstalled the game a while ago and reinstalled it now. My progress was saved but there are elements in my home decor that I used to be able to change and now they say I can't and I'm sure it's a bug. For example, I'm stuck with christmas themed garden Items and i'm not allowed to change them. Any idea how to fix this??

It was fun at first but I slowly lost interest in the game. It overheats my phone and the levels can get fiendishly hard. Not very enjoyable to grind through all this. Glad I didn't spend any cash on this game even though it really squeezed me to the limits. Often I'll be stuck at a level for a week before I can proceed.

Cool game with good animation, storytelling and versatility until it puts you in a trap, a hard level 45 puzzle is impossible to beat with 13 moves and 50 double chained pieces without spending some money which is it's exact intention. Since I'm not an idiot I just uninstalled the game, I guess I saw it coming. The only reason it's addictive is because it copied bejeweled but instead of playing infinitely like the good ol days they want you to pay or wait 5 hours before you can keep playing.

While I like this game, I found it a big waste of money as I found myself spending money wanting to beat levels and within 2 weeks, I think I wasted a few hundred $$$ on coins. Unbelievable. If I could get a refund, I definitely would. Could you consider upping the coin payout per level game? I think it's currently 50 coins per level and 100 - 150 for hard levels to beat. The 1 🌟 is because of the cost of topping up when you run out of moves. Match 3 games are the most boring games IMO.

Enjoyed the game until it was time to transfer progress from an old device to a new one. "Automated customer support" is no help at all and they limit your "open conversations" when you have issues. For people that don't have Facebook, I wouldn't recommend this game. Too much of a hassle to transfer game progress when you don't have FB.

So this game really wants your money, but it's not entirely obnoxious about it. You can play without spending a dime, but you will get caught on some levels that will eat up your five lives forcing you to wait for them to refill, or pay enough stars to get to the next day for 5 more. I've dropped a couple bucks as what I call a stupid tax. (this game earned the purchase when I made such a bone headed mistake that I felt compelled to spend the money to fix it.) Great variety of puzzles though!

I spend probably a little too much time playing this game. I do love it. The hard and super hard levels are challenging for sure, but they are beatable. I've played this game for years the Champions tournament has me considering deleting it. The levels there are so hard it's not fun anymore. I'm stuck on the same level for days until the tournament ends. Pretty much over it

The premise of the game is fun however the game play for hard and super hard levels is ridiculously difficult and 900 coins for 5 extra moves is a little much when you're only earning 50 coin per level. If you're using all 3 powerups and 900 coins for an extra 5 moves and you still are unable to pass the hard level, you're making it too difficult. Deleted! There are plenty of gem games out there that don't require such an investment and have unlimited play.

This game is great to take up time, it can be habit forming and it's very similar to candy crush in the platform style. The storyline is cute. The negative would be that plenty of the levels you need to beat are nearly impossible without the power ups you can buy with coins OR the 900 coin fee to get 5 extra moves to finish a level. It's very easy to spend 16 usd to get more powerups or coins to continue on in game.

Downloaded the game for the "Fix with tools" option. That aspect never appears. You're thrown into a match shapes type of game that just gets harder and harder. Played enough to see if it would come and it never did. I did enjoy it in the beginning but got frustrated because it never produced what was in the ad.

- I'm really angry now because we've just won a team tournament and we didn't get all the coins. The prize was shared between 30members but we are 7 in the team - I used to win 2 stars at superhard levels. Now - only 1. -At the current competition for Christmas decorations the number of firs needed is huge and you can win very few on a level. I haven't uninstalled it yet, because there are some friends in the game and we play in the same team. But we'll all uninstalling soon if nothing changes.

Great mobile game. Easy to pick up and put down and highly addicting. Edit: sometimes the levels are so stupidly hard that it's almost not worth playing. The story is fun, though. I understand that the goal of the game is to make money, so I don't fault it too much, but the fact that some levels take 7+ attempts unless you spend money on a lot of boosters is a bit excessive.
Not bad , a bit slow on being able to complete think would be better if more points were given on completion. Tend to lose interest.

Not at all what the ads suggest! Just like every other home improvement game its a match 3 thing that you have to earn coins to do any kind of home improvement, and the improvements are not the way they are portrayed! Very misleading! UPDATE: Tried it again, just to be objective, and I stand by my initial review. The levels get so difficult, even early on, that you're stuck for days. More of a test of patience than an enjoyable game.

This game must have been sold or something because it has gotten SO INCREDIBLY GREEDY. You used to get like 70 gold per level minimum, now the minimum is 10 and your super lucky if you can get even close to 30. The paid path used to be a few bucks and now it is $10. You used to get double stars when you got the x2, now you just get double the new mini game currency. All of their effort to try to get me to feel frustrated and pay more money has resulted in me playing, and therefore paying, less.

Had really enjoyed this game but for some reason playrix thought it would be a good idea to take away moves in each level that make the hard ones impossible to beat. The one I'm on now has 10 moves and it used to be 23 moves to complete the level. Why would you do this? Won't be spending money on this game anymore if that's how we are going to get rewarded so poorly.

It's a good way to pass some time. However I think that when you have levels that are much more difficult....then you should receive more stars and coins! Also....having to use stars to start a new day, feed the cat, answer the door, seems a bit much! I want to use my stars for getting things, repairing things on and in the home!! It gets a bit boring when the levels are too hard and takes so long to beat......I don't mind being challenged, but I also want to keep moving ahead!!

I love this game but when I'm stuck and I go to view a YouTube video to see how others have passed the stage, I've noticed that they always get way more moves than I do... For instance on level 2681 I get 15 moves while the person doing the video has 22 moves. Sometimes they finish the level on their very last move, but I don't have as many moves and I'm stuck in the level for ages. It's truly frustrating!!

The game that is advertised is not what my experiance has been, it was advvertized as a game where you are solving puzzles to help your character escape by pulling the right pins. Also i have played this game for 4 days, solving gem puzzles that get harder as you go, but you only have five lifes and then you have to wait some time before you can play again unless you have coins which can be bought for real money, which of course the company needs to make money, but i cant get enough game time in

The game keeps throwing me out. Gardenscapes too. :( Again this problem. Since the update! Homescapes, Gardenscapes & Wildscapes!! I play a level and struggle with it only to get kicked out of the game after eventually completing it, resulting in me having to do it all over again. I used to love these games and played it for years.

It's become obvious to me that the algorithm has been changed to force you to purchase power ups. Several times I have had literally one block left and I hit a plane, yet somehow it keeps going to a random block that doesn't complete the level. I've spent a lot of money playing this game the past few months. I didn't mind it when it wasn't obvious I was being forced to do so. Now it's becoming ridiculous and the fact that two thirds of the reviews here state the same issue speaks volumes

This was one of my all time favorite games, until here recently. I've dumped more money into this game than I care to admit and I'm in level 2336 however, I recently got a new phone and when I pulled my game over and signed back in I lost my golden ticket that I paid for. It wants me to pay for another. I tried troubleshooting, sent screen shots of my transactions and I've still not heard from the developers and it isn't fixed. Now the season is ending and I've lost all the perks. :/

2/23/26: new update messed up the minecarts. I cleared the whole thing but the treasures are off screen and not getting cleared. wasted 20 or so attempts for nothing. have emailed support but only got auto reply saying to message from within app but app contact button just goes back to the FAQ. disappointing lack of support

need to make this game easier to play. I love the whole decorating part, but to have to use all your keys for dumb things like opening a box is maddening. I want to actually decorate more and use my keys less for the other stuff such as calling, answering door, open box, feed cat. make it a little more fun. I've deleted this game 3x hoping it will get easier and better. let's hope it did, I'm about to play again. thank you!

It's challenging, yet fun and intriguing. With the newest update I really dislike seeing Austin's face when playing a level. It brings me more anxiety and this game is a game I use to bring down my anxiety levels. Please remove Austin from the board.

I feel that stars are earned too slowly for the amount of puzzle solving you have to put in. Too much time is wasted waiting for lives to be replenished when you JUST want to be able to keep playing the game. And I REALLY dislike the fact that the majority of earned money goes into a pot that you earned, but you now must lose real money to purchase. Also when you use bombs, etc, the game places them. You get the sensation that you will NEVER really complete the house before you die in real life!

After some time, the game becomes so difficult that in order to complete the next level you need to buy additional equipment. At the same time, the cost increases, previously additional coins and bonuses could be purchased for 1 dollar, now for at least 2. that is, if you play every day, you will spend about 60 dollars a month. Even levels marked as "simple" are not actually that way. At first I enjoyed playing, but now I'm disappointed.

I enjoy this game a lot except for the unskippable dialogs and scenes. I really don't care about the story, I want to match and renovate the house, but it's very annoying when Austin takes a century to walk around the house, to speak with someone who shows up at the door, etc. If we could also skip those, it'd be great. We should be able to skip all dialogs and scenes, not just some.
I like this game alot yet after passing 3000 levels, I find that some levels are impossible to pass without using some coins. more opportunity to earn coins in game play would be good.

Edit: The game is certainly fun to a point. It's clear early on that this is not a strategy game, but more a game of luck. After a certain point It's common to go days stuck on a level even if you constantly use boosters and pay to continue, bc you just get a bad hand of puzzles, and that's not even counting the "Super Hard" levels. Definitely encourages paying to keep pushing, or just keep being patient until you get a good hand. Also would love more options to decorate.

The game is fun, but difficulty is a problem at later levels. Levels increase in difficulty and renovations require more stars, yet rewards do not scale accordingly. Having to play a level 20 times for one star toward a 6 stars needed for baking a cake isn't fun. Award more gold or award more stars for completing harder levels, this isn't Dark Souls guys.

Not to bad of a game. But nothing like what the ads show. I was expecting to be doing the things the ads show. Not a matching 3 game. And it wouldn't be to bad if it gave you more moves, and less cost to add more moves on. It is not good that you have to play a matching game and beat it, just to do things in the house. I am gonna give it a few more days, and if it still is boring, then I will be uninstalling it.

I have Uninstalled this game once. I am doing it again, the levels get so hard that after a month of playing I cannot get through the level. I am done. I will not spend anything else on this game. If the developers want to see how to keep players look at Lily's Garden. They take care of the players and offer lots of freebies and make it worth spending money once and awhile.

It's quite fun and addictive keep renovation the house. HOWEVER each and every single move, even silly ones like opening the door requires a Star. The games to obtain the stars were ridiculously hard at some levels, i stucked hours and days in a single level. It was so annoying and time wasting trying to get through some levels which is impossible unless you have dozen of power ups. I end up deleted the game even though i wanted to continue with the renovation and keep unlocking new rooms.

Ok, I love this game. I've been playing for a couple of years now, and it's fun. But honestly, they will cheat you as much as possible with the in game purchases and the bonus games-which they make impossible you beat or win to get the grand prize or any prize. I paid for the golden ticket to get the new pet and I do not have this pet. I know ultimately they want the money, but they are on the verge of losing a loyal, loyal player. I don't mind paying but I want to get what I pay for. The cheats
Stop asking to send notifications after I refused already! I keep getting the stupid pop-up between almost every game. "No, thanks" does NOT mean "ask me again in a minute"

Loved this game! They now have a Tournament of Champions, which is a chance to win great prizes... i play in the evening after I put my son to bed and work all day. I dont even have a chance to collect enough to win anything. While this is active, which seems very often latley, you cannot collect stars to progress and build in the game.. which is the point of the game. If I wanted to play that great, but I don't. Terrible move

Updating review at level 4833. Like most match three games, the skill set needed was mastered 3500 levels ago. The game eventually devolves into a nearly mindless experience similar to sitting in the corner and rolling dice, hoping to draw a perfect board. If you are not into spending funds to throw boosters or extra moves at multiple levels, you could play some levels more than 50 times. BORING. Story line is nice, graphics cute, but those wear thin at some point.

I will seriously call this game a betraying one, especially in the adbreak thing, it is completely 100% different from what you see in ads of other games. You think it is too interesting to have and you install it , but when you open it , it is completely different from what you saw, same thing happened to me. If anyone prefers boring and troubling games, this one is just the one made for you. I recommend not to install after seeing the ad, i did not even feel like giving it one star, but had to.

I was having fun until this level, you don't get enough moves to remove all the chained blocks and cover the background in green,also the spreading bubbles I'm on my third day, can't get it. Hopefully I can, I like this game, but if other levels are this hard I will quit.update , did pass that one, was doing good until I got to level 130, this is really hard, you get only 23 moves to cover and collect a bunch of bombs and planes, the blocks are covered with chains, it's impossible. Hopefully .

I've been stuck on level 24 for 4 days, over and over again I tried. No luck. Kinda annoying that the game can't give me a little boost to help get through the level. and do we really need to earn all these points just to open a stupid box in the house?.. I just wanted a game where I can simply design a house but not one that's going to keep me stuck at a level this long.. So.. As of now this game gets only 2 stars.

I will be reporting this app for false advertising. I see that a LOT of Playrix games have same type of clickbaity advertisement. I thought that the game was a scenario solving game (as advertised) but, nope, it's not. It's a match 3 game with an added home remodel motif. I was EXTREMELY disappointed. This is the truth about most of these games and it's unfair to gain downloads via deception.

Bogus. This game is ridiculous. I've played it for years and am in the 7700 plus levels. They started this nonsense with a tournament that you can't get items to advance the story with which is why I played to begin with. Recently though I've noticed a blatant pattern in the game where it will absolutely screw you on levels to try to get you to spend money. The "AI" will cause the random planes to go to pieces you don't need removed when you need things like only one more piece removed to win

I installed seeing the advertisement of the game. The advertisement showed the levels similar mini game. I was disappointed it's similar to candy crush, instead what I thought would be the actual game just comes as a mini game in between. If your looking for something similar to candy crush then this is a great game with nice graphics gives your chance to remodel a house as well.

Like the game, the hard and super hard levels though have no rhyme or reason as to where they are placed with in the game. Not like every 5th or 10th level. Could be placed 30th and then you'll get another one on the 34th level for example. Also on the levels where you have shifting tiles, the paper airplanes pick a square that sometimes makes no sense. Makes it harder to use them to clear that last nagging piece. Overall a cool game, just frustrating game play at times.

This game was fun for a while. Then it was updated to reduce the amount of moves available, making "regular" levels hard, and Super Hard levels impossible without getting lucky. Undercutting the customer to make a few extra bucks is pretty low. I've never spent a dime, and I'm sure not going to when the game changed is obviously only to make more money. Not sure how much longer I'll keep this game installed.

Disappointed with all the updates. Using power-ups is practically useless because they rarely hit where needed but rather one next to it or an empty space. Got bored of playing the same game over and over in order to get stars. Scummy shadow updates in order to maximize their profits and transactions. been playing this game for years and the past year updates to game's UI and changes in difficulty with levels (more objectives, less time rewards, etc), harder/less free rewards, and overall these changes have made it less about fun and more about how to make more money from micro transactions and passes. It's very disappointing ...In adds they show that we have to pull the strings so that the coins could come in the pot which is quite interesting but it's totally the different ......When I opened the game only the first level was like this but the others were not and they tell to put coins for renovation or whatever it's called instead of putting focus on the game .....I was really disappointed.This review is not to hurt anyone it's just an honest review

Need more points. Challenging, but almost too hard... Some levels are just unbeatable without power ups (which you almost never get) and the new event with the cats is way too difficult. Level 5366 finally confirmed to me there is DEFINITELY not a way to win a level. You can't "figure" the puzzle out by trying different things. Sucks!!! Just started playing this a couple of weeks ago, I thought this was a renovating game. Its a great matching game but it updates more than an old iphone and it never fails to need an update right in the middle of unlimited timed lives (which you will loose). You really have to be into the game to complete the work im on level 1356 and still have lots to do

if you like loosing and wasting your time then this game is definetly for you. except good graphics and a good story there is nothing awesome about both this and gardenscapes. they habe purposefully made game so difficult that after crossing some 200 levels you wont be able to clear most of the levels even after 4 5 attemps and some even going on for days. conveniently at the last step you get powerups etc so you are tempted to use 900 coins pushing you to play ahead and buy more coins.

The ads for these kind of games (gardenscapes, Lily's garden, etc.) are ridiculous. Whoever makes the ads for these games needs to be fired. They don't have anything to do with the actual gameplay. Have been playing for quite a while.. Love the game. There are some things that could be better!! I wish that the challenges were actually attainable, having to earn over 20,000 items to complete a redesign space or play the special decorating challenges is ridiculous. This game is entertaining with minimal adds I enjoy the puzzle solving candy crush type game style However a lot of the levels I will spend a hour on to finally solve it But when I decide to spend a dollar for enough coins to get a few more moves the level gets cancelled out and I have to close the app and reopen for my purchase to be registered I have wasted a lot of money for no reason because I spend another thirty minutes trying to get the same result If you want me to spend money fix it plz

The game is enjoyable, however there is too much focus on microtransactions to continue the game, use of in game boosters and coinage to complete levels are a game downer. Simply put it saps the enjoyment of the game, now days I play this game to kill time. I rarely care to complete any levels. It is sad in a way, it had such potential.

Like a few others mentioned, I was swayed by ads for this game that are not true at all. This game and Matchington Mansion are about the same.....match type games. I wasn't trying to play another match 3 type game. I thought there would be problem solving issues like in the playable ads show on Game of Sultans, but no dice. If the game play was like v that, a lot of people might actually stick around. Game of Sultans is also different from how is advertised, but at least you're not playing a CC.

I truly enjoy playing this game. Some levels are very challenging, some you can breeze right through it. That's what makes it exciting, Love it! So far had no problems with this game and have been playing off and on for couple of years. I have won two diff. silly puzzles or maze games (so I know it's real!)and thought that they were doing better with adding two stars for some levels and mini games. At first it seemed like a good game, until I got stuck on one level what is impossible to beat without paying real money, basically they force you to spend if you want to progress further, so I think that I will uninstall very soon, because if it's money greedy at the very beginning, what can I expect later on! So be careful when you download! -----And after a while I uninstalled it!!!

Ok for one, I've been stuck on current level for 5 days now.. tired of trying. But main complaint is I have lives from friends that I cannot collect. There is a problem with the game I cannot touch any button in the game not even the button to play but I can move the screen to look around so its not my phones problem. I might just have to drop this game I've uninstalled it three times but nothing changed. I already reach 3,400 + levels and I'm so disappointed that there's a problem with the game.

The amount of moves you get is worse now. I used to get 20 something moves on a hard level and now? I get 13 moves. Why did the amount of moves change so much? Hangs a lot. Now a days the number of moves have been reduced and the game seems to be programmed not allowing to win when we get unlimited life time. I decided to quit this game often but going on to pass the time that's it. Earlier i use to enjoy this game a lot but not anymore

I've really enjoyed playing homescapes as well as garden scapes. I believe the extra little challenges should go on for longer because I never even get half the stuff before the thing ends. Even when I buy a golden ticket I don't feel I get my money's Wirth because you have to pass too many levels to get the rewards. Other than that I love playing this game.

Cute game. I liked it until I realized that you reach a certain level in the side game (similar to candy crush) and cant beat the levels without tons of in app purchases. Its set up so you cannot progress the storyline without earning stars from said side game. It quickly sucks real world cash. Super greedy developers. 3 days in and cannot progress. I refuse to spend any more money. Uninstalling. Never using an app by this developer again. And I thought other games were greedy.Ha.

This game is 80 to 90% a candy crush clone. There is other content, like an interior decorating game (You will get three choices of items and it will be in a fixed position in a room) and a pull the pin game and probably other mini games later on, but the vast majority of the main 'rpg' (air quotes because it is more of a point and click game) is match 3. Personally, I'm not a fan of match 3, and I feel like this game was falsely advertised because the pull the pin mini game only shows up 5-10%

Such an adorable and well-designed game. Great work from your developers. This was the only game I had on my phone for ages. Now, however, since I played it so long, the upper levels aren't that fun anymore. I know no one uses this for massive intellectual stimulation, but you become hyper aware of wasting time when every other level is "super hard," and you spend your hour of free lives clicking on the same level over and over. I miss my old play-while-multitasking fun little game.

Really liked this game at first, but got to a point where it became exceedingly hard to advance without buying boosts. With other games I'm able to watch an ad to help advance, but not with this one. It's not really a great business strategy because I haven't had time to get truly invested in the game which would compel me to buy boosts.

A nice game, but not as advertised. I thought it would be like the demo. Matching construction problems with solutions, but it's just a match 3+ game. Worst part is you use your bonuses up early, and have to buy more. Not looking to spend money I don't have, so... uninstalled.

This is a great concept. the only part that frustrates me is how impossible it is to move up in the game right at the start without spending a TON of money on coins or lives. I i normally love these types of games and love a good challenge, but I ended up deleting this out of frustration.

I loved this game when I first started playing. However, since the last update, there have been so many issues with connection. I've tried multiple times to restart my phone, app, and WiFi but cannot connect to my team. I've also purchased some coins to help pass a level, and they have not shown in my account until hours later or after contacting customer support. I will likely delete this app soon, despite enjoying the game play.

I initially gave this game a 5 star thinking its a great game. The mini game used in advertising is hardly shown. All you do is decir and decor and decor or just play candy crush. Its bad advertising. You are better off downloading something else. Am deleting the app right away. The developers doesnt even seem to care what people are saying. Ideally you'll expect that they would have a workaround all the complains but naaah. They are not interested.

Used to be much more fun. Now there is no difference between a normal level and a hard level spending too much time repeating the same level which is very frustrating. This game relies very heavily on luck and not skill. You're always at the mercy of what might come up, and you hardly ever get what you need. Even when using powerups, there are some levels that take forever to beat. I've been stuck on one level for over a week now, and I'm pretty high level. Or I should say was high level because I just uninstalled it. I'm done.

The time it takes to rejuvenate the lives is entirely too long. Waiting almost 2 hours for full life is ridiculous. When buying extra time 900 and up, is completely too much Considering a player doesn't get even 1 tenth of that for completing a level, it isn't a fair deal. While I do enjoy playing, these things make me want to walk away from the game. You should make the coin situation a bit more fairl and decrease the wait time.

You can tell that some people on the dev team have put a lot of passion and effort into this game, but unfortunately Homescapes is one of those games that tries to frustrate you into spending money. The difficulty level slowly ramps up to the point where you've got little chance of beating a level on the 1st try without using paid powerups. The worst thing with f2p games that frustrate you into paying though isn't just that they're not fun, it's that they still aren't fun even if you pay.

I like the game but I refuse to pay money for more coins and such. I feel like I get stuck on a level for awhile and finally once I use all my extras and lives a few times the board changes a bit to where it's actually possible to beat that level. It is becoming longer wait before that happens. I am going to get tired of it. Other games have ads where you can watch to get stuff. I would rather do that.... I may have to delete.

still having difficulties on some levels. Still arguing with hubby over the $$$ I've spent. probably around $120 at least update: Although levels are still hard and I've had to buy help, I still can't get enough of this game. I WAS really enjoying this game until I got stuck for over a week on level 60. My thought is it's way too early in game to have to pay for power ups. So it's not fun anymore. I think I'm a prettty smart woman, if I can't pass on next 5 lives I'm uninstalling.

Ive got to say... I was very skeptical of this game and I mostly downloaded it so I'd stop seeing so many advertisements for it lol the story line is pretty silly but the puzzles are fantastic.
