I'd definitely recommend to players of candy crush or other games like bejeweled. PS watch out for the cat. he basically ruins everything haha

They advertise many, many pin pull levels and games, but they are so few and far between, it's like false advertising. I'm over level 4000, so it's not like I haven't given it time. The "mini" games are foolish and also rare. I have also paid a lot for extra coins and things to see if pin pulls would happen, and they don't. Also, nearly everytime I do the required update, it takes days before it connects correctly again. I've tried on Gardenscapes too, same thing, false pin pulling advertising.

This game is a cheat. You waste your time trying to pass levels just to put flowers everywhere. The game should really be called flowerscapes. I thought this game was to decorate the inside of the house. So much time wasted decorating the garden outside when there's already a gardenscapes. And at the beginning you only needed 1 star to do stuff now you need up to 3. Not worth it

The game itself seems to be nice.. but I had to uninstall it after the first minutes of playing although I was excited to try it out. The first mini task was to give a woman a makeover and one is presented with two choices which ultimately translate into clichés of beautiful and ugly - yet both choices are neither the cream of the crop nor bad taste ... so one is left with stereotypes of choices and based on that presented with an IQ.

Really like the game. Still waiting for the "Save Them" feature. :( Also wish I didn't have to wait for lives to refill. But I'm not spending real money to refresh lives. I go through them too fast Lol! Great pass time, though. Update: Two months later and 600 levels and I STILL have not seen the mini game. 😠 Update: Almost on Level 800. Still no mini game! What the heck? Classic misrepresentation/bait & switch. Good thing I love the game.

Entertaining and fun game for the entire family, I enjoy it, but with small rewards, one star per level is way to low of reward especially since one has to do all does of tedious exercise. How come one gets rewarded 1 star for hard levels, same as a normal level and only 2 for super hard level when some tasks in the game require 3 stars. I just think the stars received by players should be reviewed.

Could be a good app, but after beating a few levels seems like you'd be lucky to match 3. Eventually got fed up and uninstalled it, not fun total waste of time especially if you were looking forward to the mini games, 100's of levels and only came across 1. Basically just trying to get you to spend money. Don't waste your time

Been playing this game for a long time now and I'm done with all the possible levels. Saying that, I'm uninstalling it now, as the tasks are becoming boring and every task requires 5 stars. Doesn't make sense. Also some levels are almost impossible to pass. It's been fun but every fun has its ending.

Been in this game for almost 3 years now and currently on level 3873. The game was definitely helping me when I'm bored. Connected it to your facebook account was helping a lot since a lot of my friends play this game so lives was always there. Being in a team was helping too for getting added lives. Overall, good job team! Appreciate your work and art, keep up the amazing job!

This game is like Fishdom in that we beat "match three or more" levels and get coins. However, I like this game better than Fishdom because the coins we earn on levels(and sometimes pay for) buy us more tries, lives, power-ups, and event extensions(yes, event extensions appear possible). And with stars we earn on levels, we can accomplish tasks on the property, and open new areas. Mini games have been added at least at my level range. And there are events to win and teams to join for help. ☺

Haven't played this game for a long time. Recently have been seeing ads. The ads are inaccurate as they aren't really showing the game just what is probably now a side challenge. Plus the game play makes stupid moves designed to lose as if that would get any serious gamer to download it. Most of us aren't that idiotic.

Fun, but 900 coins to "keep playing" a failed level is too much. You earn 60 coins best per level won. THAT'S AT LEAST 15 OR MORE LEVELS TO GET ENOUGH TO DO ONLY ONE(!!) "keep playing" for one more move. That's absolutely ridiculous. Only worth playing if you're THAT bored. If it had higher reward for winning, I would be much more inclined to pay for that extra bit during events. Getting almost nothing for winning is a money grab. You want my money? Make it worth it.

My game just reset in mid-play after a year of playing and several months at the top level (6000+), crashing my system (which never happens). Hope my guild doesn't miss me! sorry housefixers! I'll miss you guys! Good thing I took screenshots of my yard, because all of it is gone. No, they don't get together, and no, the racial bias doesn't get much better. Lucky too I didn't pay for anything - what a scam.

Just like their other games, too much candy crush not enough "mini games". The design and room finishing aspect are fine, i just wish this game wasnt like those matching games and took a totally different path. I do also wish that there were more colour/style options for room designs than what we get. I also absolutely hate the paper plane events with a fury >.>

The game is fun and addicting. BUT!!! What the ads use to advertise the game are false, and one of the things I was actually looking forward to doing. Outside of that, you only give out 1 star per level. Its costing 1 to 3+ stars to perform acts around the house. I honestly think harder levels should give out more stars. Regular levels should give 1 star, Hard levels 2 stars, and Extra hard 3 stars. If you all fix the stars earned on the harder levels, I would honestly rate this game 5 stars.

The game is fun...even on the tough levels, however there should be a different way to save the progress of the game other than linking Facebook. I would like to long in through an email. I changed phones and lost allll my progress because it wasn't linked to a Facebook account. Disappointed.

Never have I spent so many hours on a game just to "rage uninstall" it. The game was fun and definitely addicting (hence the two stars). And then it gets so ridiculously hard, even the "easy" levels, that you can't possibly pass the levels without buying tons of extra turns and powerups. I'm telling you now, I wish I never installed it in the first place. You should do the same, unless you like getting invested in a game, and then it getting so hard that it takes you days to pass a single level.

Edit: my previous review was 1 and 2 stars, but since 2019 they seem to have updated the game a bit. Of course they push the purchase of packages, unlike before they seem to have changed the game play so that it's possible to beat the hard levels without spending real cash. Unfortunately that means you have to play the hard levels many times before you beat it, but if you don't take the game to seriously it's a fun distraction.

I really like playing the games to earn star in order to refurbish the garden, but I don't like having "waste" stars to do frivolous actions that don't affect the garden at all. I also don't want to have to put a lot of real money into the game, and this game sometimes requires real money in order to pass the various levels.

Meh... Good way to spend money! otherwise impossible to beat. You have to renovate what the game tells you to, no choice in what you do and you have to use stars for stupid things like feeding the parrot instead of actual renovations or you can't move to the next level/renovation. I'm bored, I think I'll spend my money on actual things instead of virtual coins.

I should give this game zero stars!! The ad I saw for this game showed a VERY different game about a puzzle that involved pulling levers for a favoritable outcome or a hilariously disastrous outcome. Even stranger, ANOTHER completely different ad showed a game about selecting the right or wrong item for either success or hilarity. Instead, BOTH ADS led to an incredibly weak and underwhelming copy of Candy Crush Saga that is neither fun nor funny! FALSE ADVERTISING!!

It was really fun at first but then some levels became impossible to beat and it just started to irritate me after awhile. I have been stuck on the same level for 2 days and now I'm bored of trying to pass this level and I don't want to play anymore. Also, there needs to be way more rewards or infinitive for passing levels.

Love the game in theory. But to get decorations for themed holidays or areas are very expensive in coins. I play alot and have NEVER been able to complete an area. It's very discouraging. Other games I play are not as expensive for decorations and alot more fun when actually being able to complete. Need to lower holiday and themed area decorations

A Free to play, Pay to win game. The characters and storyline are fun, graphics great, but I uninstalled (and I was at level 200) . Renovating was rewarding, but it takes too many stars to get any done. Each level needs more moves and usually a couple of power ups to prevail. Those cost big, naturally. Hated hard levels, ice, foam, cookies, grass, and especially the oil of the upper game levels. I think hard levels should have greater rewards and be optional. I think rewards acquired during game play should be kept: bombs, rockets, paper planes, rainbow balls, etc; I have lost many as the level slid screens or the level was beat without them being used. At first, it was addictive, then no fun at all, so was time to uninstall.

I have been playing Homescapes for some time now....I'm on level 778 and I really enjoy the game. But I'm very disappointed that in the middle of my hour of free moves it went black. Now the screen is frozen on Playrix. It has been 4 days now. I really would love to get back to my garage. I've power down my phone thinking that that would help...but nothing nothing nothing. Please help me out.

Loved playing this game for last couple of years. So disappointed with the newest changes on this newest photo album challenge that forces you to play up to 7 regular Match 3 games Just to be able to continue making things to advance thru the album. WHY?! The photos & pitiful rewards certainly aren't worth it plus you've already made the regular Match 3 games almost too difficult for loyal long-time players. This Is No Longer Fun!!! Great way to lose players.

This is a very rewarding game, between beating level's, designing a gorgeous mansion, changing design's if you choose, joining a team and winning additional reward's, my kitty who I named Gracie, that likes to get into mischief and my favourite is going to new room's/area's. The one change I would like is that we could visit other team members houses along with sending them lives. Just a peek would be fun while waiting for lives to reup : )

The game and renovations are fun, but the match 3 game is boring, everyone is doing match 3, there's no relief, and it's such a great game because with skill you would never need to spend money. Maybe include the game from your adverts where the player makes timed decisions with a pass or fail outcome for bonus stars or something. I know thousands of people play so this opinion doesn't matter, but it's just a suggestion, if some changes can be made I'll reinstall.

Levels are frustrating and repeatedly getting stuck which is not fun. Should be able to beat levels . Also would be nice to be able to earn more stars and not have to use them on distracting tasks like greeting a guest and just be able to complete decorating. Gets tedious to not make progress.

Once you start unlocking new rooms, it's impossible to progress in the game without spending real money. The levels are designed to fail and the completion of each task will require atleast 2 or more stars. Even the levels that are rated as easy will require multiple trials to pass, or will require spending coins. Play only if you are willing to spend money. Otherwise progressing in the game is frustrating.

Used to enjoy this game, but forgot I had it on my phone for a while, since I stopped using my phone to play games all together. I have to give this one star now because it's not like the ads I've been seeing them use at all. I'm honestly surprised since this game USED to have ads that actually were close to the gameplay. For anyone who came for the gameplay in the ads, sorry to disappoint, but I guess the developers thought they had to "catch up" to the other games whose ads are blatantly false

Just about had enough. I used to play this multiple times a day, but levels are taking far too long to pass for too few rewards. The biggest issues I have are matching pieces to get rainbow balls or whatever they are and only getting a rocket, and stars that go missing. Getting fed up with earning stars only for them to be missing the next time I play. About ready to uninstall.

I love the game, I've been playing it for ages (install/ uninstall/ reinstall), and what about I love it, is its graphics. I like the new changes though but the graphics now seems a bit unsmooth unlike before, when you zooms in it now it looks a bit blurry , especially the graphics of the mansion and other places of it, that's why I give it 4star. Nevertheless, the game is still in good shape.

A solid match-3 game with a home design aspect. Essentially you earn stars by completing levels, then spend those stars on tasks related to the story. Sometimes levels are very difficult and you can get stuck on and off, but I'm on level 575 with 0 purchases. It does require patience so if you get easily frustrated this is not the game for you unless you want to spend money. Sound is great, graphics are smooth and gameplay is extremely fun. No ads whatsoever unless you want to choose to watch.

This game is a lot of fun in the beginning. The challenges are reasonable and it is possible to move to the next chore; however, when reaching the higher levels it is almost impossible to move ahead without spending money or being on Facebook. I am not willing to do either of these. I do not want my fb page to show how often I play nor do I wish to bombard my friends with requests. I refuse to spend money on games.

What a scam. While the first levels are easy, it doesn't take long to reach a level where you have to pay money to complete. There's literally no way to complete some levels without paying for a lot of power ups. There are levels where you have around 10 moves to clear 30-50 squares that each have to be hit twice. Don't be tricked into giving them money.

Games are good. But when the moves are exhausted, it is too much to pay 900 for just 5 moves. And at times just 1-2 moves are enough to get over with the game. Money gets exhausted very soon. Love the games where different items fall from different objects & you keep on joining them to get final items. I think currently its school supplies. Keep bringing them more please. Also the hunt expedition that keeps coming up often takes up too many energies in just clearing half a minute thrash.

Past i rate it 5 star ,now i down it why? First of all too much things that have to be purchased with money,way too expensive please lower it down Second of all for the mini games maybe just put it like in the bottom left or bottom right so we can just play the mini games while the heart refills Third of all too much events. I didnt play it in awhile and oh boy i see too much events in the right maybe just 2 or 3 events in a year If you enjoy the game okay i dont judge,just some tips here bud

Dont know why, but this game is addicting!! I only really have one complaint. See whenever I get to these really hard levels and cant pass, but im only a few moves away from winning,it gets really frustrating cause I sometimes dont have the gold, and the game tries to get you to buy with real money more gold. I just think that it should give you more gold for those little tasks things. Im not gonna give it 5 stars because there is still some things that should be done, but its kinda boring too.

If you want to go far in this game, be prepared to spend significant money. Most levels need boosters in order to complete. The majority of the time it's the extra moves that's needed. The first +5 moves costs 500 coins and they sequentially and significantly go up from there. It adds up super quickly. Otherwise, I truly enjoy the game.

This game is fun, but I very quickly becomes pay-to-win after a few days. At that point it goes from fun to frustrating because you just want to advance but some levels make it near impossible without a plethora of power ups. It would be nice to be able to watch an ad to get these power ups instead of having to buy coins.

OK game to start with, but rapidly turns into a grind with near impossible levels designed to make you buy stuff, or repeat endlessly until "luck" gets you through. Cute story, nice team aspects, but gameplay gets tedious and frustrating. Oh, and the advertising being nothing like the game absolutely sucks. Don't bother unless you want to waste both your life and money.

Really liked the game until I had a problem and couldn't make contact with a real human to fix it. Their system decided that I was a problem and took my team and status away. I've tried repeatedly to get this resolved and have my team that I paid for returned to me. Perhaps this rating will get a real person's attention and they'll fix the mistake their system created.

Great game. Highly recommend. But I hate the false advertisement in the ads. I'm tempted to quit just because of that. Stop it. Very disappointed. There's enough of that from underhanded, money hungry grottos like last shelter. Love playing the game but im order to have a good experience, you have to spend money. Only one star after beating a level, is a sham. Most of the tasks you do need two to four stars for one task. Same with the games that you need tckets for. Beginning to rethink if I want to keep playing or not, which makes me sad. Started playing because of the mini games, thought there would be more of those but now see that's not the case. Quit Fishdom, 99% sure will stop playing this soon.

Its fun but I only keep playing till i get new levels. Im tired of the same type if games. I only downloaded bc of what was advertised. Like when you get to pick options to help them out. Like wgen they on the ice and you pick a burger, chicken.... Or how to warm them up. Im almost to level 100 and still have not seen this. Def false advertising.

I am currently on level 3263. I was having extreme difficulty and decided to see if there were any strategy tips via a Google search. In all the videos and sites, they start off with 26 moves. In my game, I start off with 10 moves. I don't understand why and feel like not only is it unfair that I have less moves, but also 10 moves is absolutely not enough for the level. I really liked the game, but now I may uninstall.

Pretty tricky, developers... game is presented as a puzzle-solving exercise, but is yet another jewel matching game, which is not my idea of enjoyable brain stimulation.
